title: Discover Procida: Italy   S Hidden Gem Of Authentic Charm And Rich Heritage
description:
Head to the small but picturesque island of Procida, situated in the Bay of Naples. Still relatively undiscovered, it offers visitors all the beauty of the Italian islands but without the crowds. Procida is perfectly situated to explore its more famous neighbours, Capri and Ischia as well as Naples and the stunning Amalfi coast, just a short hop away. Despite its small size, Procida has a rich history and vibrant culture that attract visitors looking for a more authentic and less touristy experience. 

 This stunning island has been the setting for several literary works and films and was used a filming location for "Il Postino" and "The Talented Mr. Ripley". Filmmakers were no doubt drawn to its picturesque scenery, the island is known for its colourful houses, charming narrow streets, and beautiful beaches. The Marina Corricella, with its pastel-coloured buildings, draws cinematographers and visitors alike.  

In 2022, Procida was named the Italian Capital of Culture, which brought increased attention to the island and highlighted its cultural and historical significance. This recognition has helped boost its profile as a travel destination, but it still retains a relatively low-key and tranquil atmosphere. 

The deal: This wonderful five-day itinerary includes flights and transfers to the enchanting island of Procida. Embark on a Journey to Procida: The Smallest and Most Colorful Island in the Gulf of Naples Set off to discover Procida, the smallest and most vibrant of the islands in the Gulf of Naples. An idyllic paradise where time seems to stand still, far from the usual tourist routesStroll through its picturesque alleys, immerse yourself in the Mediterranean scents, and embrace an authentic, timeless atmosphere. A place where every corner tells a story, each color evokes emotions, and every flavor leaves an indelible memory. Additionally, you have the opportunity to enrich your experience by visiting Naples and the Amalfi Coast, enhancing your journey with these captivating destinations.

itinerary.title: Arrival Procida
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Naples airport or train station and transfer to the port for the ferry to Procida.
Upon arrival on the island, make your way independently to your nearby hotel. After check-in, enjoy some free time to soak in the authentic atmosphere of Procida, between charming streets and Mediterranean scents.
Overnight in hotel.

itinerary.title: FLAVORS OF PROCIDA
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, the day is free to explore the island at your own pace: fishing villages, hidden corners, and scenic views that have inspired writers and filmmakers. Your experience includes tasting the typical “Lingua di bue” with cappuccino at a partner bar located at Procida’s port, for a truly local experience. In the afternoon, enjoy an exclusive lemon-themed aperitif served in the hotel’s garden, where the famous Procida “Pane” Lemon takes center stage, known for its large size and extraordinarily sweet flavor. Savor a refreshing limoncello spritz accompanied by Mediterranean-inspired bites. A relaxing sensory experience combining local nature, flavors, and calm.
Overnight in hotel.

itinerary.title: AMALFI COAST & POMPEII (optional experience to buy as an extra)
itinerary.description:
The excursion starts directly from Procida with a ferry ride to Naples. Upon arrival on the mainland, board a bus and travel together along the stunning Amalfi Coast, between turquoise waters and breathtaking hills. Drive along the Sorrento Coast on a scenic road with photo stops at the most picturesque viewpoints, where you can admire hilltop villages and iconic coastal panoramas.
Along the Amalfi Coast, enjoy a light lunch at a selected local restaurant, prepared with fresh seasonal ingredients. Next, reach Amalfi, an ancient Maritime Republic and the heart of this UNESCO-listed coast. Free time to explore the town at your own pace: visit the Cathedral of Sant’Andrea, stroll its charming streets, or relax along the waterfront. In the afternoon, continue to Pompeii, where you’ll discover one of the world’s most extraordinary archaeological sites. Walk along the ancient streets and visit emblematic sites such as the Forum, the Small Theater, and the Stabian Baths, sharing the experience with the group.
At the end of the visit, return to Naples and board the ferry back to Procida. A full day rich in spectacular views, authentic flavors, and unforgettable moments along the Amalfi Coast and in Pompeii.
Overnight in hotel

itinerary.title: NAPLES WALKING TOUR (optional experience to buy as an extra)
itinerary.description:
In the morning, independently reach the port of Procida and collect your included ferry ticket. Board the ferry to Naples.
Upon arrival, not far from the port in Piazza Municipio near the Fountain of Neptune, meet your guide and begin the tour.
The visit starts in the heart of Naples, walking through streets spanning centuries of history: Greek-origin streets, Roman underground spaces, and the city’s most representative squares reveal a unique blend of cultures and influences.Continue to Piazza del Gesù and Piazza San Domenico Maggiore, where the coexistence of Christian traditions and pagan roots is evident — a fascinating contrast that defines Naples’ identity. This duality is also visible in the artisan shops of San Gregorio Armeno, where every detail tells ancient stories, and in the rich Baroque architecture of the Cathedral. Walk through lively alleys, filled with musicians and characteristic city scents, adding an authentic touch to the experience. In the monumental area, admire landmarks such as Castel Nuovo (Maschio Angioino) and the elegant Neoclassical theatre. Continue through the Galleria and the long avenue that leads to one of Naples’ most iconic squares. At the end of the tour, return to the starting point and board the ferry back to Procida, taking with you the memory of a city rich in history, culture, and vitality — a complete and unforgettable experience.
Overnight in hotel.

title: Sorrento and Sicily A Rail Adventure Through Southern Italy
description:
Italian Journey: Sorrento & Sicily with Sleeper Train Adventure

Experience the captivating beauty of southern Italy with this unique 7-night holiday combining coastal Sorrento with historic Sicily, connected by an enchanting overnight train journey.

Begin with three nights in Sorrento, perched above the stunning Bay of Naples. Explore this charming town at your leisure, perhaps venturing to nearby Pompeii or taking a boat trip along the spectacular Amalfi Coast. Your sea view room offers the perfect backdrop to unwind after days of exploration.

Your adventure continues aboard the Intercity Notte sleeper train from Naples to Syracuse. As you sleep in your comfortable cabin, your train crosses the Strait of Messina by ferry – a unique travel experience that maximises your holiday time.

Wake to the warm Sicilian sunshine as you arrive in Syracuse, where you'll spend three nights in the historic Ortigia district. Discover ancient Greek ruins, wander through Baroque piazzas, and perhaps relax on the local beaches before your journey home from nearby Catania.

This thoughtfully designed holiday offers the perfect balance of guided travel and independent exploration across two of Italy's most beautiful regions.

Solo travellers welcome from £799.

Arrive in Venice as the sun rises, ready to discover the beauty of its canals, hidden alleyways, and stunning architecture. With two nights in this iconic city, you’ll have plenty of time to explore its treasures, from St. Mark’s Square to gondola rides along the Grand Canal.

A holiday that blends comfort, culture and classic European charm – ideal for those seeking both elegance and exploration.

title: Sorrento & Sicily: Italian Escape With Scenic Train Journey

Arriving in Sicily, enjoy three nights discovering the island’s vibrant cities, ancient ruins, and picturesque beaches. Whether exploring the lively streets of Palermo, the stunning beauty of Taormina, or the historic wonders of Agrigento, Sicily promises an unforgettable experience.

This holiday blends relaxation, culture, and adventure, offering an effortless way to explore two of Italy’s most captivating destinations.

title: 3 Night Escape to Venice with 4 star Hotel and Breakfast
description:
Nestled in a lagoon in the Adriatic, Venice is an Italian slither of paradise that excites even the most seasoned of travellers. Why? Because there is nowhere else quite like it on Earth.

A firm feature on many holidaymakers’ bucket-lists, Venice is exciting and unusual. Built on more than 100 small islands, the city has no roads – only canals. Boats and gondolas slice through the emerald-hued waters like knives to a birthday cake and the labyrinthine streets, like never-ending strands of spaghetti, bathe in the scent of rich, Italian delicacies and invite endless wandering.  

Within their innermost crevices and corners, you’ll find splendid-looking timeworn buildings, dinky little trattorias serving up fluffy mozzarella and gnocchi doused in truffle oil, and quirky antique stores. 

Emerging from the winding alleys and looping streets, feast your eyes upon the city’s central plazas and main areas of interest, including Piazza San Marco (the central square home to St Mark’s Basilica and the Campanile bell tower) and the Grand Canal thoroughfare, fringed by Renaissance and Gothic palaces. 

Visit Doge’s Palace, wander Venice’s Jewish Quarter and haggle at Rialto Market. The Rialto Bridge is one of Venice’s most renowned icons – scurry up to the highest part, huddle around the edge and put that selfie stick to good use. 

And should you want to spend one of your days away from the hustle and bustle of mainland Venice, the surrounding miniature islands (such as Murano, Burano and Torcello) are home to an abundance of nature and rainbow-coloured houses. Accessible by water taxi, they are just a short ride away. And with 24-hour travel cards priced at 20 euros, there’s no excuse not to hop around and see as much of this aquatic wonderland as possible. 

At night, rest your head at your four-star abode – the Mercure Venice Marghera Hotel. With bright, comfortable rooms and located within spitting distance of the historic centre of Venice (only a 15 minute bus ride away) expect nothing less than a cosy, accommodating stay just outside the city’s core.

And a trip to Rome isn’t complete without a spellbinding hotel stay – ideally with delightful cuisine and situated not far from all the major sights and landmarks.

Luckily, the Hotel Gambrinus ticks both those boxes. Just a 15-minute walk from the Spanish Steps and Via Veneto and a short bus ride from the Colosseum and the Vatican City, you couldn’t ask for a better location when it comes to exploring the city.

And to top it off, the atmosphere within the hotel is just as lovely as it is outside. Warm, intimate and charming, the hotel is your very own home away from home – from the dazzling daily breakfasts to the charming staff who are full of knowledge on the best city tours and best restaurants, the Hotel Gambrinus offers a relaxing stay with plenty of rest and relaxation.

title: 3 Nights Secret Hideaway in Palermo
description:
A much treasured novel entitled “The Leopard” conjures up everything that is so enticing about Palermo. The buildings, the people, the empires and the sheer beauty of the place! Lampedusa was filled with intrigue and wonder at the phantoms that must hide in waiting; “these monument of the past, standing round us like lovely mute ghosts…all these things have formed our character.”We do hope we will ignite your imaginations with our wonderful trip to Palermo!

Stroll across Palermo’s backstreets to find the facade of a derelict Baroque palazzo, marked with a plaque bearing a forgotten name. The sight of this noble structure is baffling. To stand alone at sunset watching the locals whilst savouring the scent of lemon and fresh fish wafting from the market stalls, you soon drift off into a dream of what the palace once was, but mostly you like it just as it is, a magnificent residence ravished by time and history!

The four star Porta Felice Hotel is located in the very heart of the historical centre, a charming spot home to Foro Italico, Piazza Marina and Via Alloro and manages to reflect a real sense of history and legacy. The hotel was renovated from a building of the 18th century and cultivates a sense of luxury and refinement complete with its Wellness Club offering a sauna, steam bath and Jacuzzi.

title: Four Incredible Nights In Florence And Venice
description:
Your adventure begins in Florence, one of the major economic centres and tourist hubs of Italy, located in Tuscany, north of the Chianti region. The Duomo di Firenze, Florence’s iconic symbol, is a cathedral etched onto millions of postcards worldwide and a product of the renaissance. Then, Giotto’s Tower offers a stunning 360 degree view of the city’s surrounding areas in all their glory, and the Palazzo Vecchio, located in the Piazza Signoria,is where fine art, sculptures and murals dwell peacefully. This lively square will have you darting between the various shops and cafes dotted along its edges and marveling at its range of statues. Plus, don’t forget to pay a visit to the Santa Croce church which holds the monumental tombs of Galileo, Michelangelo and many others, and the Boboli Gardens which are home to fascinating sculptures and incredible views of the city. 

After a memorable 2 nights stay in Florence’s vibrant core, you’ll find yourself strolling alongside the curling, teal-coloured canals of Venice for a further two blissful nights. Listed as a World Heritage Site, Venice is situated across a group of 118 small islands, enabling visitors to hop between them via sparkly canals and dinky bridges. Churches, palaces and an endless supply of Cucina Italiana and buttery pastaadorn the narrow, cobbled backstreets, and gondolas and vaporetti (water buses) sit bobbing along the ripples of the canals, eager for hopeless romantics to hop on in. 

You’re truly spoilt for choice when it comes to activities. Discover the treasures of St Mark’s Basilica or take a trip to Doge’s Palace and the Bell Tower of St Mark which offers unparalleled views of the enticing lagoon. Go island hopping to Murano, Burano and Torcello, three breathtaking pieces of land a mere boat ride away. Visit the exquisite glass museum in Murano, gaze at the dreamy, pastel-colored houses of Burano and wander the quaint streets of Torcello and its famous church. 

You’ll rest your weary feet at two top-quality hotels throughout your holiday. In Florence, you will stay at the 4 star Diana Park Hotel. A few steps from the Renaissance masterpieces of Florence, you can breathe air of a charming private hotel, in a good position to visit all the attractions of downtown Florence, dine out in then best restaurants and take advantage of personalised excursions to visit the surrounding Tuscan countryside. The architectural details of the hall, enriched by marbles, antique carpets and decorated stuccos, create a sophisticated and welcoming atmosphere.

title: Rome City Break Deals
description:
Want to warm up your winter and spice up your stay in the Eternal City? Then the Donna Camilla Savelli Hotel is definitely for you! For starters, the location is sizzling with wow factor – set in a renovated 17th century convent (the hotel’s Baroque interior was designed by Francesco Borromini and there is something very romantic about strolling across the secluded cloister, gazing at the stars). Another big plus is that the retreat is slap bang in the heart of Rome, located in the hip hustle and bustle of Trastevere and the Donna Camilla Savelli, while tucked away in a peaceful spot at the foot of the Gianicolo Hill, is still within easy walking distance to the Vatican. 

Trastevere is one of those unique places in Rome that is revered across the city as the crème de la crème of neighbourhoods. The leafy southwest district has been home to everyone from Julius Caesar and Jewish traders, to Italian countesses. Walking along the medieval streets you will enter a dusky pink world made up of authentic Italian character with a fiery kick; labyrinth streets lead onto piazzas fringed with restaurants, churches and steep steps that spiral up to an untouched kingdom and musicians sing folk songs in Old Italian dialect, not even the Romans can understand.The food is out of this world, and so affordable you will surely look twice when you see the bill!

While Trastevere smoulders, Gianicolo Hill is the theatre of bloody fights between the troops of the Roman Republic, led by Giuseppe Garibaldi, and the French troops who attacked Rome in order to restore the power of the Pope. Marvel at the statue of Garibaldi and find epic views of Rome, continue to the private villas where the sounds of  Frank Sinarata drift down from the gardens. 

If you want to mingle with the locals, walk along the west bank of the Tiber for some buzzing atmosphere at the bars and markets that line the river. This is always a popular place to cut loose and to see the red-robed monks who stand amidst the crowd like spiritual beacons.       

Stop dreaming and start living the Roman way for 3 Nights at this beautiful hotel from £249 pp!

title: Whisk Yourself Away To The Floating Paradise Of Venice
description:
Venice is a romantic and enchanting city of turquoise canals, ancient palaces and serenading gondoliers. It is a whimsical wonderland binded together by the ethos of its surreal charm, and the magnetism of its fairy tale allure. The quintessential ‘City of Romance’ has the power to alter your thought process and take you into a different world; into the world of fantasies, mystery and awe.

Epic grandeurs, breathtaking scenery, fabulous feasts – When you are in Venice, you are in for the Sojourn of your lifetime. Get mesmerized by the Piazza San Marco, described by Napolean as ‘the drawing room of Europe’, or why not just walk down to the eastern end and feel the grandeur of the St Mark’s Basilica. The most famous of the city’s churches, it has always been revered to as the symbol of Venetian wealth and power..

But the best way to discover the real essence of Venice lies in exploring its beautiful lagoons, the criss crossing canals and some of the most beautiful stone bridges. Get lost in the numerous alleys, or hop on to a Gondola, and let Venice cast a captivating spell on you, which may seem too hard to break in your lifetime….

Facing the magical Grand Canal, the Hotel Carlton on the Grand Canal is the ideal destination for an unforgettable holiday in Venice. The pastel colours, Venetian plaster-work and wall-lamps in Murano glass, the Hotel Carlton on the Grand Canal will enchant you with its refined elegance. The hotel is the ideal place for a romantic evening with a splendid view of the Grand Canal and the Venice skyline.

title: Venice City Break Deals - Holidays - Flights and Packages
description:
Located in the north east of Italy and the capital of the Veneto region, parts of Venice are actually considered a World Heritage Site, and it doesn’t take a genius to work out why. A modern day Atlantis, the city is rooted into colorful canals and sprinkled with curved bridges, enticing gondolas and rustic boats which etch their way in style around the narrow alleys of the 118 small islands, greeting tourists and bellowing an enthusiastic ciao to all whom they pass. Stepping foot (or flipper) into this aquatic realm will leave you inspired by the wonderful architecture and churches which go back thousands of years, as well as mesmerized by the scenic canals and star-studded Lido di Venezia which hosts the Venice Film Festival. The vaporetti (water buses) enable visitors to hop about between the different lagoons and marvel at the scenic landscapes while doing so. If you’ve caught the love bug, be sure to take a romantic dinner cruise along the canals by gondola and fall in love with this irresistibly charming city. 

During your whirlwind city break, make sure you tick off all the major attractions on the tourist bucket-list, as well as sample cuttlefish and ink, one of Venice’s trademark foods. Marvel at the gilded bronze horses of St Mark’s Basilica, take a guided tour of Doge’s Palace and head to the top of the Campanile di San Marco, offering breathtaking views of Venice. Then, get ready to splash the cash on Venetian gems at Rialto market, a haven for shopaholics containing restaurants and a famers’ market to the west. The history of this market which sits by the Rialto Bridge has a history spanning over 800 years.

After whiling away the hours in Venice’s dainty stores, leaping from vaporetto to gondola and chowing down on buttery spaghetti, you’ll spend your nights in the Hotel Savoia and Jolanda which overlooks St Mark’s Basin in the heart of Venice’s lagoon. Put your feet up in this luxurious hotel or head out and explore Venezia’s nightlife.

title: Escape to Ischia: An Island of Beauty and Relaxation
description:
The prodigious properties of Ischia’s waters have been well-known since ancient Roman times and even then, the island was probably one of the most famous thermal stations for the healing of both body and soul. Ischia is tradition, hospitality and undisputed beauty to be appreciated with your own eyes and enjoyed at your own pleasure. The island boasts delightful views over the sparkling Mediterranean and fine sandy beaches. Holidays to Ischia are ideal for those looking for a respite with the islands fantastic beaches and range of exclusive spas.

With breakfast and dinner covered, you’re free to spend the day as you like, enjoying your holiday with no obligation to trek back to the hotel for lunch. You’ll also be able to make the most of the local restaurants and cafés, trying out the local cuisine.

title: Escape to Sicily: A Mediterranean Paradise Awaits
description:
Escaping to Sicily, an island just off the ‘toe’ of Italy’s ‘boot’ and the largest one in the Mediterranean, is like entering a dream world – one where history lurks around every corner and dramatic volcanic landscapes collide with miles and miles of peaceful coastline. 

The Valley of the Temples and the Cappella Palatina with its Byzantine mosaics invite endless wandering, while the Nebrodi and Madonie Mountains offer a different kind of wandering. From salt flats to seaside towns, Sicily offers sightseeing for the masses – whether you’re a beach-bum at heart or a secret history buff. 

And as if that wasn’t enough, the food there is to die for. Picture mouth-watering desserts (Sicilians are some of the best dessert-makers in Italy) such as cannoli and cassata, as well as succulent arancini (fried rice balls with fillings) piled high on plates. 

When you’re not hunkering down over delicious dishes or gazing up at the mesmerizing Mount Etna (the active stratovolcano which dominates Sicily’s skyline like a brooding watchdog), spend your days relaxing at the luxurious Hotel Avalon Sikani, nestled in the picturesque town of Gioiosa Marea. 

This four-star resort sits on Sicily’s northern coast, better known as the Costa Saracena. What does this mean for you? As a guest as this deluxe hotel, you’ll be able to feast your eyes upon breath-taking views of the Tyrrhenian Sea and the impossibly beautiful Aeolian islands. 

Gioiosa Marea is also widely considered the pearl of the Tyrrhenian – the perfect springboard for visiting sites such as the Nebrodi Mountains, the city of Cefalu and the town of Taormina. The area offers ample opportunity both for relaxing and venturing off to some of Sicily’s must-sees.

Nestled on Southern Italy’s rugged Amalfi Coast is Sorrento, a picture-perfect hilltop town overlooking the turquoise glow of the Bay of Naples. Here, the fresh scent of gnocchi all a Sorrentina wafts through the air, locals bustle about in quirky antique stores and tourists swarm to the glorious shores like bees to honey. Should they look out into the horizon, they’ll see the enormous shadow of Mount Vesuvius looming in the distance. 

Scattered around Sorrento are colourful ports and sun-soaked beaches sitting beneath rows of honey-coloured houses and shop fronts, selling anything from ceramics to lacework. Dickens, Tolstoy and the poet Byron holidayed here, self-confessed addicts to the salt-tinged Sorrentine air. 

Wander around the Piazza Tasso, splurge at the shopping district on Via San Cesareo and make sure you cap off your days with a bowl or two of sensational gnocchi alla sorrentina. For dessert, gobble up the typical cake of the region known as la pastiera and round off your evening with an ice-cold shot of Limoncelloin true Italian style.

description:
Rome is the capital and a can't-miss destination of Italy. Positioned in the very center of the Italian peninsula, Rome has been the hub of the Lazio Region and the entirety of Italy since Ancient Times; as the saying goes, “all roads lead to Rome”.

The city of Rome houses a collection of artwork and monuments that are unrivaled. Tourists could spend an entire year in Rome and still not see everything the Eternal City has to offer. Today Rome is the vibrant capital of Italy and the country’s largest city.

Lovers of art and archeology will certainly not be disappointed by Rome’s countless offerings. Naturally, there is a great intersection when it comes to Museums and Churches in Rome. Rome’s magnificent churches--over 900 of them--are often museums in their own right. It is not an exaggeration to say that a church can be found on nearly every main street of the city. Not only do these breathtaking structures embody the city’s central role in the Catholic faith, but they also house some of the most beautiful works of art in the world, attracting both devout pilgrims and art lovers alike.

title: Puglia: Your Perfect Italian Escape by the Sea
description:
Forming the heel of Italy's boot is Puglia – clad with hill towns, centuries old farmland, iridescent coastline and topaz-hued waters. The vibrant port of Bari (Puglia's capital) throngs with university students; the town of Lecce is rich with baroque architecture (resulting in the area being dubbed the Florence of the South) and Alberobello, brimming with cone-shaped rooves, invites endless wandering. 

Prepare to spend seven nights in the glorious town of Salento, home to the sensational seaside gems of Gallipoli and Otranto – real must-sees if you’re fortunate enough to visit the “boot" of the bel paese. 

Nestled just 800 metres from the historic centre of Otranto is your hotel, the Basiliani Resort and Spa. It’s also within spitting distance to the cathedral and medieval castle, making it the perfect springboard for historical sightseeing. 

The hotel also boasts a wellness centre (the biggest in Salento) where you can banish away those aches and pains with massages. After a treatment or two, lounge about on the pearly-white beaches just a stone’s throw from the hotel. 

Salento itself is a glistening haven filled with unspoiled sleepy towns and an interior area which is fundamental for the production of olive oil and wine, offering its visitors plenty to do (and sample!). Along its craggy and undulating coastline, you can find a whole range of different natural treasures – from golden sands to Karstic grottoes and saltwater lagoons. 

And if you’re more of a history buff than a sun seeker, Salento's sleepy towns are full of historic Greek remnants dating back to thousands of years ago – indeed, you'll find that the Greeks have left their footprints on the cuisine, culture and religion of the area.

title: Half Board Stay In Sensational Sardinia With Flights
description:
The Italian island of Sardinia sits within the Tyrrhenian Sea between the Balearic Islands, the Italian peninsula and Corsica. Boasting nearly 2,000km of coastline, pearly-white beaches and a rugged interior landscape which invites endless wandering, Sardinia is the perfect getaway for beach-hoppers and thrill-seekers alike.

Although certainly picturesque, eye candy isn’t Sardinia’s only redeeming factor – the island is rich in history too! Dotted within its undulating landscapes are thousands of nuraghi (Bronze Age stone ruins which look like beehives) – one of which dates all the way back to 1500 B.C.

When you’re not combing the countryside for Nuraghi, spend your time flitting between sun-kissed beaches (such as Budoni or Stintino) or island-hopping to the Maddalena archipelago or Asinara National Park, famous for its albino donkey population. 

You can also head off hiking in the Monte Limbara mountain range, take to the open seas during a sailing trip along the sparkling Costa Smeralda and cap off fun-filled days with succulent, mouth-watering local cuisine.

Expect to see plates piled high with culurgiones (similar to ravioli), malloreddus (a type of gnocchi) and salsiccia di cinghiale (wild boar sausage) – you’ll come to realise that restaurants, markets and cafes are an absolute feast for the senses here. 

By night, rest your head at the Blu Hotel Laconia Village. Its convenient location (2km from the centre, 50m from the beach and 15km from bustling Porto Cervo) makes it the perfect place for serendipitous strolls along the shores of the Costa Smeralda and daytime jaunts to dinky Sardinian cafes and local markets.

Plant yourself on a sunbed by the twinkling pool or meander down to the beach for a swim. Work up an appetite by taking advantage of the hotel’s extensive sports facilities; try your hand at tennis, football, beach volleyball or bowls to get your blood pumping, before cooling off with a mid-afternoon dip in the teal-coloured sea.

description:
Ask any Italian what their favourite destination is and the answer you will surely get is Puglia. Whoever you ask they will gasp in delight, “The beaches! title: Discover Puglia: The Untouched Beauty Of Southern Italy
description:
Puglia’s coastline is vast, stretching hundreds of kilometres and studded with sun-soaked beaches. This southern region forms the heel of Italy’s “boot” and has bucket-loads of charm – from its whitewashed hilltop towns to its awe-inspiring cave complexes and national parks. 

You’ve got historically-rich towns such as Bari and Lecce, full of character; then, alongside them is striking architecture – like the “trulli" of Alberobello (cone-shaped buildings, some of which date back to the 14th century) and the Castel del Monte, a 13th century citadel sitting atop a hill in Andria.

The area is a great place for holidaymakers that want to relax and do nothing, but also those who are eager explorers. With history oozing out of its pores in the form of time-ravaged architecture, as well as glittery shorelines that'll have you falling head over heels, Puglia entices every kind of traveller.

When you’re not out sightseeing or snorkelling off Baia dell'Orte (included in your package, weather permitting), flop down on a lounger by the beach or pool of the 4* Relais Masseria Le Cesine. 

Doze off on a lounger by the edge of the twinkly pool, pamper yourself at the  spa facilities and stroll along the coastline.

description:
For holiday seekers looking for a memorable Mediterranean holiday, the island of Sicily, located at the tip of Italy's boot, provides the whole package. Sicily is the largest island in the Mediterranean, and has all the charm and history of a holiday in Italy with its own unique culture, away from the mainland. A long coastline full of gorgeous beaches, legendary food and some of the finest art and culture around, it is a great destination for all tastes. Not forgetting the weather – the sunshine is pretty amazing, too.

title: 4 Night Break At A 4 Star Hotel In Bardolino Lake Garda
description:
Lake Garda is a place that caters to all sorts of travellers’ tastes. Fringed by mountains and a hotspot for water sports and outdoor activities, you can hike, sail, climb or sunbathe to your heart’s content here, drinking in the impossibly beautiful scenery as you do so. 

As Italy’s largest lake, Lake Garda also plays host to a range of picturesque towns and resorts scattered along its teal-hued shores – one of which is Bardolino, a comune in the region of Veneto, and the setting for this four-night stay.  

Here, you’ll stay at the 4-star Aqualux Hotel & Spa, sitting just a short distance from some of Bardolino’s interesting sites, including the Chiesetta di San Zeno (a 9th century church) and the Villa Carrara Bottagisio di Bardolino – making it a convenient springboard for getting out and about. 

The hotel itself is nothing short of magical. With eight different swimming pools (both indoor and outdoor), a sauna area and fitness centre to accompany, there’s plenty to keep you busy at this eco-friendly resort – whether you’re cooling off with afternoon dips, enjoying a massage or two or tucking into delicious local delicacies on the sun-dappled Evo Bardolino terrace.

title: Half Board Stay In Ischia With Transfers
description:
Fancy crossing the brilliant blue waters of Italy to a sun-soaked paradise, including breakfast, return flights, transfers and a Four-night boutique hotel stay?  Then you have to head to the tiny Tyrrhenian island of Ischia, the most vibrant islet in the Bay of Naples.

Holidays in Ischia invite you to one of Italy’s best kept secrets. Fondly known as the Capital of European Spas, it’s famous for its spas and it’s no surprise it was once a go to destination for Romans. With its thermal springs, luscious landscape and a wide choice of restaurants, it's no wonder the island of Ischia is always a popular destination for Italy holidays. Located just off the Neapolitan Riviera, here you'll find ample vineyards, small towns and beaches to explore, while the historic Castello Aragonese is a bonus.

During you holiday you will stay at the 4 Star Hermitage Resort & Thermal Spa's a real life oasis, courtesy of its well-kept gardens, thermal pools and top-of-the-range spa. This place is in a peaceful, pine-scented neighbourhood, a 20-minute walk from Ischia Porto’s harbour. It’s less than that to the beach, plus the hotel puts on a free shuttle bus there and back. The hotel draws on Ischia’s relaxing reputation, feeding its pools from the island’s underground springs, offering mud spa treatments and a hydrotherapy circuit with a difference.

Thermal spas, wine tasting, beach days and hiking among beautiful scenery are all on the list here. Holidays in Ischia are more than just a typical island escape. title: 4 Star Holiday In Lake Como
description:
Lake Como is one of Italy’s first class destinations – a sparkling upscale resort area that cosies up to the foothills of the Alps in the Lombardy region.  

Sprinkled around it are village scenes and picturesque towns, one of which is Cernobbio – around two kilometres northwest of Como itself and the setting for this whirlwind four-night mini-break. 

You’ll be staying at the Hotel Villa Flori, a converted 19th century historic villa on the cusp of Lake Como – views of this eye-opening blue body of water spilling into your room. 

This four-star paradise sits nestled right in the middle of a private park of orange and lemon groves, giving it a real Italian feel. It also boasts Venetian stucco work, floral frescoes and antique furnishings that are enough to evoke the fairy tale feeling that so many travellers seek when in Italy. 

When it comes to meals, you’ll be staying on bed and breakfast basis with a range of treats served up in the dining room daily, panoramic views of the lake before you. What better way to start your day?

itinerary.title: PISA AND WINE TASTING
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel and departure by train to Pisa. Today we give you the opportunity to discover this wonderful city in total autonomy. When we talk about Pisa we inevitably refer to its tower; but this imposing leaning bell tower is just one of the many monuments the beautiful Tuscan city offers. The beautiful “PIAZZA DEL DUOMO” gathers, in an architectural complex unique in the world, not surprisingly called “CAMPO DEI MIRACOLI”, the main religious monuments of the city: the TOWER, the “DUOMO”, the BAPTISTERY and the “CAMPO SANTO”. in this square: just move a little to discover the artistic wonders that make it one of the most beautiful cities of art in Italy. Return in Montecatini Terme by train.
In the afternoon, enjoy an exclusive wine tasting at the hotel, led by an expert sommelier, where you will have the opportunity to savor the wonderful wines from one of the region’s finest wineries. Free time will follow. (train ticket and wine tasting included in the tour rate)
Dinner and Overnight in hotel.

itinerary.title: CINQUE TERRE FULL DAY
itinerary.description:
Breakfast in hotel and day dedicated to visit Cinque Terre. A whole, intense, unforgettable day dedicated to discover one of the most enchanting landscapes in the world. Little villages, suspended between sea and land, hanging from sheer cliffs surrounded by hills and vineyards. The visit begins with MANAROLA where you can admire the houses leaning one against the other and stroll along the narrow cobble alleyways and sheltered paths; later a local train will take us to VERNAZZA one of the most colorful and photographed fishing villages of the area, where you will have free time to sit on the tiny harbor and relax, breathing in the atmosphere of this unique area out of time. Next head to MONTEROSSO train: you will be awed by this ancient fishing village considered “the pearl of the Cinque Terre”, where you will be overcome by enchanting beaches and luxuriant vegetation that surrounds the little village. Here you will have free time to plunge into the crystal sea before taking the boat to our last destination RIOMAGGIORE where you can have free time to explore the delicious seaside town surrounding a small natural port. The itinerary may be subject to variations due to force majeure. Return to Montecatini Terme. (experience included in the price, meeting point to be reached independently)
Dinner and overnight in hotel.

itinerary.title: CHIANTI COLOURS (OPTIONAL TOUR WITH EXTRA CHARGE)
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel and the possibility to continue discovering the authentic Tuscany.
Transfer by train from Montecatini to Florence to reach the meeting point, where the excursion will begin.
Tuscany is world-renowned for its nature, small villages, vineyards, and gentle hills.
Your tour starts with a visit to a rustic wine estate, in the heart of the vineyards, where you will be welcomed by the owners and led to their cellar to learn all the secrets of the Chianti wine-making process. You will then enjoy a tasting of Tuscan crostini paired with locally produced olive oil and, of course, Chianti wine. You will have the chance to taste several wines and, if you wish, purchase bottles to take home or have them shipped.
Next, you will visit Greve in Chianti, one of the most famous and well-known Chianti wine villages in Italy. Here, you will have free time to explore the charming alleyways and the central square with its numerous medieval buildings and picturesque artisan shops.
But the day is not over yet… In the heart of olive groves, rolling hills, and vineyards, we will visit another enchanting wine estate. Here, you will be offered more delicious snacks and exquisite Chianti-made wines to taste. The estate owners will share more about their wines, and by the end of the day, you will be a true Chianti wine expert!
Don’t forget your camera as you embark on this incredible journey through the fairytale land of Chianti… Cheers!
Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.

title: A Half Board Stay In Sardinia With Flights
description:
Wild, unpredictable, but always stunning, it is little surprise that Sardinia tempts travellers back to its shores frequently. The island is perfect for a family trip, to travel with your partner or with friends. Sardinia has a lot to offer. Having a good time is easy; the hard thing is to choose between the wide range of beaches, activities and water sports, traditional restaurants, typical villages and the fascinating insular culture and folklore.

This rocky island off the Italian mainland is a maze of twisting coastal drives, picture-perfect sandy beaches and a fascinating history.

Cala Gonone is a picturesque seaside town on the central east coast of Sardinia, offering an ideal blend of sunny beaches, scenic landscapes and excellent attractions for your Italy holiday. Located 56 kilometres to the east of the famous Costa Esmeralda, Cala Gonone is a useful base from which to explore the beautiful surrounding area. The town is well-equipped to welcome tourists, with a selection of restaurants and bars, while at the harbour boats take holidaymakers along the coast to the bays and beaches in the nearby area.

Your stay during this holiday will be in Hotel Brancamaria. This hotel is located at the entrance to the town of Cala Gonone, in the province of Nuoro, on the central/eastern coast of Sardinia. It is just 900 metres from the town centre, the marina, and the promenade with its picturesque beaches. This charming beach hotel was recently renovated and is extremely well equipped and elegantly decorated in a Mediterranean style. The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool and a sun terrace with parasols. Other sport and leisure activities available to guests include diving, canoeing, tennis and biking. The family-friendly establishment is spacious and bright, ideal for those looking for comfort and tranquillity in a charming and relaxing atmosphere.

title: Rome And Sorrento Twin Centre With Scenic Train Journey
description:
Italy is all about baroque statues, mouth watering cuisine and quaint beachside havens. On this twin-centre retreat, you’ll have the perfect balance – staying first in the city and then onto the Bay of Naples in south western Italy with its sandy/pebble beaches. Your Italian holiday will include train ride so you’ll have the unique chance to thunder towards the coast.

You’ll begin your fantastic break at the four-star hotel in Rome. Best Western ARS Hotel has the character of a boutique hotel. It is ideally situated in the Citta Giardino residential area, in Rome's quiet and green Monte Sacro district, which makes it a peaceful haven away from the bustle and noise of Rome's hectic tourist areas. This hotel is housed in a beautiful four-storey villa surrounded by a small but beautiful garden that offers superb panoramic views. 

After exploring Rome, you’ll take our unforgettable train ride to Sorrento. Here you will stay at the 4 Star Mar Hotel Alimuri, Sorrento. Located in one of the most beautiful bay of Sorrento Peninsula, Mar Hotel Alimuri offers wonderful panoramic views of its own private sandy beach. Set in Alimuri bay, the hotel is just a few steps from the beach, restaurants and bars. During the day you can relax while overlooking the beach and the surrounding area from the hotel's terrace, with a drink from the bar.  Alternatively you can rejuvenate yourself with a trip to the hotel's spa center, where you can unwind in the sauna, or choose one of the many beauty treatments offered.

title: Ischia Elegance and Capri Charm  A Journey Of Sun Sea and Serenity
description:
Discover the timeless charm of Ischia with a special offer that combines relaxation, adventure, and wellness. Stay at Hotel Punta Imperatore 4*, a slice of paradise located in the stunning Citara Bay, just 12 steps from the sea. Thanks to its prime panoramic position, you can enjoy spectacular sunsets and, if you're lucky, witness the magical “Green Flash” of Ischia. Unwind in the hotel’s ozone-treated pool with hydromassage or relax on the equipped solarium, where you can indulge in moments of pure tranquility. 

The offer also includes two unforgettable experiences: a full day on the island of Capri, exploring its breathtaking landscapes, charming streets, and unique atmosphere, and a walk through the picturesque village of Sant’Angelo with a tasting of local limoncello, immersing yourself in the authentic flavors and scents of the island. 

To further enrich your stay, you can choose from many optional experiences available on-site, such as a mini-cruise along the coast, an excursion to the enchanting island of Procida, and many other exciting activities to make your vacation even more special. Hotel Punta Imperatore is the perfect starting point for a holiday that combines luxury, nature, and culture. Don’t miss this opportunity to discover the best of Ischia, Capri, and the surrounding wonders.

title: Romantic Venice and Delightful Lake Garda Twin Centre
description:
On this twin-city Italy vacation you can explore the beautiful sites of Venice before winding down in a hotel overlooking the picturesque Lake Garda.

Located in the northeast of Italy, Venice is a romantic and enchanting city of turquoise canals, ancient palaces and serenading gondoliers.  With its tranquil canals, crooked buildings, and lively festivals this floating city is a beautiful world heritage site and a must visit location. Listed as a World Heritage Site, the city's contributions to art, architecture and music are evident around every corner.

The first half of your holiday will be spent at the 4 Star Smart Hotel Holiday which is an ideal choice for travellers seeking a 4-star hotel in Mestre within reach of Venice in just 10 minutes. Conveniently situated in the Mestre part of Venice, this property puts you close to attractions and interesting dining options. This 4-star property is packed with in-house facilities to improve the quality and joy of your stay.

Travelling by train, you’ll spend the second half of your stay in Riva del Garda, Lake Garda. Your stay in Lake Garda will be at the 4 Star Antico Borgo Hotel. This hotel is an elegant building nestled in the historical town centre of Riva del Garda, against the unique backdrop of the mountains and one of Italy’s most beautiful lakes. Combining chic accommodation with a central location, this is the perfect choice for those looking for the comfort and convenience.

title: Rome And Venice Break - Flights and Train Ride
description:
Italy, ah Italy! Every heart beats for this capsule of bygone and changing times. Italian art, architecture and culture have left an unforgettable mark on many. And now the Italian Dream is yours!

First up, we fly you to Venice. Located in the northeast of Italy, Venice is a romantic and enchanting city of turquoise canals, ancient palaces and serenading gondoliers. Listed as a World Heritage Site, the city’s contributions to art, architecture and music are evident round every corner. Whether you’re falling in love on a moonlit gondola ride or soothing your soul at an orchestral symphony, Venice promises to dazzle you with its artistic flair.

Even if you chose to do nothing else but wander the streets your entire stay, this city would still dazzle you with its history, culture and romance. Sit back and relax upon a Gondola and adore a scenic punt around this picturesque city to wherever your heart desires.

Your stay in Venice will be in the NH Collection Hotel Dei Dogi, housed in the old and prestigious Rizzo-Patarol noble palace, an excellent location for completely immersing yourself in the enchanting atmosphere of Venice. 

Next up, thunder across the vastness of Italy's plains in a scenic train crossing the magnificent country and visit the Eternal City of Rome. With round-the-clock energy and jaw-dropping views, Rome offers everything you’ve been dreaming of. 

As one of the world's most historically enchanting cities, Rome has long been a must-see for European travellers. History is around every corner of Rome. There are plenty of places to go to after sundown in Rome. The cobbled streets are full of colourful characters, all looking for a night out in the Italian capital. 

Here you will stay at the 5 Star Hotel Lord Byron. The property is located in one of the most chic residential neighborhoods in Rome, Parioli, and is just a few moments walk from the splendid Villa Borghese gardens and 15 minutes walk from Piazza del Popolo. Once inside the Art-Deco villa, one feels as if they are guests in a smart art collector’s home, with a vast collection of both paintings and sculptures.

Hotel Lord Byron offers outstanding service, an incomparable fine dining experience, and a feeling of warmth and intimacy that can only be found inside a private home. The hotel evokes a glamorous era in the eternal city while all the while providing modern conveniences and comforts, offering our guests an unforgettable experience.

title: 5 Night Stay In Puglia With Half Board
description:
Sandwiched between the Adriatic in the north and the Ionio in the south, the Italian region of Puglia boasts around 800km of coastline, as well as centuries-old castles and fairytale-like towns and villages offering a window into the past of this southeast region.

Culturally rich with a tumultuous past, the heel of Italy is said to be one of the most beautiful and enchanting regions in the country. Known for its vast coastline, Puglia boasts whitewashed villages with pretty cobbled streets, and pristine sands that meet the clear blue of the Adriatic Sea. Fall in love with the hauntingly beautiful medieval towns as you meander down the ancient streets or relax to the sound of the waves as they fall on the shore.

You’ll be staying close to the coastal town of Otranto, home to the striking 15th century Aragonese Castle and 11th century Otranto Cathedral with rose-tinted windows and beautifully ornate mosaic flooring. 

During your five-night break, we’ll be putting you up at the Dolmen Sport Resort which is the perfect destination for a holiday in Salento both as a family and as a couple. Far from the hustle and bustle of seaside tourism, it is surrounded by the cool heat of a lush olive grove. Guests can alternate pleasant stops at the sea and excursions in the surrounding area or spend the days between the pool and the bar, entertained by the fantastic entertainment staff, or choose the regenerative life path that runs through the entire structure.

title: Luxury 5 Star Lake Maggiore Retreat With Breakfast
description:
This four-night stay takes place at a 5-star resort in the town of Stresa on Italy’s Lake Maggiore (the second largest lake in the country), nestled on the south side of the Alps. 

Close to the Borromean Islands and Isola dei Pescatori, this picturesque town is home to palazzos, museums and villas (including the beautiful Villa Pallavicino zoo and gardens). 

Your home away from home during this mini-break is the 5-star Hotel Des Iles Borromées, nestled on the shores of Lake Maggiore and just a stone’s throw from Milan (Ernest Hemingway was a guest here once upon a time!). 

It boasts a spa and indoor and outdoor swimming pools so you can bathe, soak up the sun and pamper yourself with beauty treatments and massages during your stay. 

The hotel has elegant rooms –(some of which look onto garden landscapes and the Alps) along with an on-site restaurant called Il Borromeo, serving up delicious regional cuisine and a generous breakfast buffet for you to tuck into in the mornings.

title: Florence And Venice With Breakfast And Train Transfer
description:
Start your holiday in Florence. This city is  magnetic, romantic and busy. Its urban fabric has hardly changed since  the Renaissance, its narrow streets evoke a thousand tales, and its food  and wine are so wonderful that you will return time and time again and  still will not have enough. You will see glorious architecture, such as the Duomo of the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore designed by Brunelleschi, and the Basilica of San Lorenzo, one of the oldest churches in the city.

In Florence your stay for 2 nights will be at the 4 Star Atlantic Palace Hotel. The hotel is located in the heart of the city, the ideal place to spend a relaxing holiday or a profitable business stay in a refined environment, rich in history and tradition, which, at the same time, offers all the comforts of a state-of-the-art facility.

Next, it’s off to the floating city of Venice. Just 2.5 hours away by train, soak in the rolling Tuscan countryside, past rows of grapes standing to attention, and pretty, medieval hillside towns and villages telling the story of Italy’s history. Water meets art in Venice, a city made up of 118 islands, with an incredible array of museums and art galleries. Colonnaded squares, domes and arches can be seen while on a sleek motorboat or during a gondola ride that will carry visitors through the city’s main waterways. Sample the fresh seafood featured on every restaurant menu, or enjoy a piece of chocolate salami with a strong coffee. 

Luxury, art and relaxation await you in the bright, airy spaces of the Liassidi Palace, a 4-star boutique hotel in the historic centre of Venice, situated in a rare peaceful spot within walking distance of Piazza San Marco. Inside the restored Gothic palazzo of ‘Zorzi dalle Colonne Storte‘ on the border between the Castello and San Marco districts, you’ll experience the romantic atmosphere of a former Venetian residence, its spacious rooms adorned with magnificent oil-on-canvas reproductions of the famous masterpieces that represent the essence of art history from the last century. The irrepressible charm of Venice endures in all its glory at the Liassidi Palace Hotel, ready to entice you with a dream holiday steeped in the art and music of the city.

title: Ischia Half Board Escape
description:
Capri’s lesser-known neighbour, Ischia, is actually one of Campania’s finest destinations. Famous for its natural beauty, Ischia is also renowned for its rich thermal-mineral waters. The prodigious properties of Ischia’s waters have been well-known since ancient Roman times and even then, the island was probably one of the most famous thermal stations for the healing of both body and soul. Ischia is tradition, hospitality and undisputed beauty to be appreciated with your own eyes and enjoyed at your own pleasure.

The island boasts delightful views over the sparkling Mediterranean and fine sandy beaches. Holidays to Ischia are ideal for those looking for a respite with the islands fantastic beaches and range of exclusive spas.

Recently redeveloped into a stylish four-star hotel, the Gran Paradiso (Travelers' Choice 2022) combines charm and elegance with a wonderfully harmonious décor and respect for its environment. The Hotel Gran Paradiso,an attractive structure enjoying an unrivalled panoramic view over the Gulf of Naples, overlooks the yacht harbour and Casamicciola Terme’s fascinating old town district, just a few steps away. Surrounded by beautiful pine groves, this is one of the best places to stay in Ischia, where guests can rediscover a taste for high culture, the arts, nature and the island’s traditions, combined with total and absolute comfort, fulfilling the needs of those who love to travel without giving up the conveniences to which they are accustomed.

title: Sardinia Holiday with All Inclusive Board Basis
description:
If you’re looking for a region full to the brim with history and beauty, Sardinia should be the first name on your lips. This is an amazing island with jaw dropping beauty and the ability to mesmerise with its charm is definitely god’s masterpiece. It’s unspoilt coastline renowned for beautiful beaches, translucent azure blue sea and fascinating rock formations need no introduction. It is the second largest island in the Mediterranean and fiercely proud of its unique identity. If you’re looking for a break with plenty of peace and tranquillity, holidays to Sardinia could be just what the doctor ordered! While the mainland is buzzing 24 hours a day, the laid-back attitude is perfect for those holidaying with children or couples sneaking a romantic escape. Blessed with some of the most beautiful beaches in the Mediterranean, there are plenty of places where you can top up your tan, from quiet, secluded coves with silvery sands, to spacious beaches with water sports on tap.

Located opposite the island of Asinara, overlooking one of the most stunning beaches in the area, the MClub Del Golfo is surrounded by lush vegetation, offering guests an exclusive stay in contact with uncontaminated nature. The beach, just a few metres from the hotel, is equipped with sun umbrellas and sun loungers and there are bars nearby for a coffee, ice cream or a refreshing drink between swims.

title: Geneva And Lake Maggiore Twin Centre Via The Alps
description:
Often mistaken as the Swiss capital, Geneva is the second largest city in beautiful Switzerland. Whether you spend your time feasting on Swiss cuisine or strolling through the Old Town, city breaks in Geneva are a real treat. Holidays in Geneva revolve around the magnificent lakeside – stroll along the waterfront promenade and hop aboard a cruise boat for wonderful views. Sample the chocolate and cheese of Gruyeres or drive to Chamonix, one of the French Alps most famous villages.

Along the pedestrianised, cobbled streets of the Old Town there are many historical highlights to explore including the Cathédrale St-Pierre presented alongside the International Museum of the Reformation, as well as the popular city square, Place du Bourg-de-Four, with its lovely cafés, boutiques and restaurants.

The first half of your holiday will be spent at the 4 Star Hotel Tiffany. A luxury boutique hotel, Hotel Tiffany welcomes you in an Art Nouveau spirit revisited with modernity. Discover the pleasures of Geneva's Artists' neighbourhood while enjoying our beautiful 19th century building with its timeless charm. The refined setting of hotel Tiffany and its 65 rooms and suites will make your stay a moment of conviviality and relaxation. Hotel Tiffany is not only an idea of luxury, it is also the authentic art of living in Geneva. 

From Geneva, you'll whisk you off by train to Stresa. With a backdrop of alpine mountains, Lake Maggiore is nestled between Switzerland and Italy in the Southern Alps, giving a fresh Mediterranean climate.  Stresa's Lake Maggiore's most popular resort. Holidays in Stresa take you to one of the prettiest locations in the Italian Lakes, with the elegant town perched on the western shore of Lake Maggiore where soaring mountains form a photogenic backdrop.  It's the kind of place that you never forget, and perfect for making memories.

Hotel La Palma (Travellers' Choice 2022) is set just across from the lakefront and a 5-minute stroll along the promenade from the town centre. The hotel has some of the most spectacular lake views from their rooftop, and they’ve certainly made the most of this space with the Sky Bar*, rooftop pool and sun terrace. On top of that, the lakefront pool's just across the road from the hotel and has more great views and direct access into the lake.

title: Full Board Sicily Break
description:
Sicily’s capital (and largest city) is Palermo – a spellbinding metropolis home to Italy’s largest opera house (the Teatro Massimo) and centuries-old cathedrals and palaces. 

An eclectic mix of Byzantine mosaics, thronging marketplaces and baroque churches make Palermo a real feast for the senses. Explore the city’s vibrant, historic corners and crevices – including the 12th century Cathedral and 9th century Norman Palace – during your seven-night stay here at the 4* CDS Terrasini Resort. 

Fringed by acres and acres of picture-perfect garden landscape, the CDS Terrasini boasts beautiful views of the Gulf of Castellammare (plus the famous “Toboggan” water slide leading into the balmy Gulf) as well as three different swimming pools. 

When you’re not sunbathing or shimmying into azure-coloured waters via the slide, load up on Italian delicacies at the restaurant, pamper yourself at the wellness centre or soak up the views from the solarium. The resort is also conveniently located, with all the major airports, ports and cultural sights a short journey away.

title: Half Board Ischia And Capri: Two Islands To Fall In Love
description:
In this twin centre holiday, you will experience two beautiful island--Ischia and Capri. Nestled in the Gulf of Naples, the islands of Capri and Ischia have 
attracted travelers for centuries. Holidays to Capri and Ischia are a 
vivacious combination of laid-back modern glamour and ancient beauty. 

Ischia offers a more rustic and laid back affair. A gorgeous island with a
 laid-back vibe and plenty to explore, Ischia is one of Italy’s hidden 
gems. Thermal spas, wine tasting, beach days and hiking among beautiful 
scenery are all on the list here. A volcanic island located just off the
 coast of Naples, Ischia is surrounded by the dazzling blue waters of 
the Tyrrhenian Sea. This picturesque island is known for its dramatic 
volcanic landscape, filled with natural wonders. A holiday to the island
 of Ischia allows you to explore another side of Italy, far away from 
the metropolitan cities of the mainland, taking you back to nature and 
giving you the chance to explore the great outdoors. Ischia is famous 
for its hot springs and thermal spas which provide the perfect place to 
relax. This stunning island is a true hidden gem, and promises a holiday
 to remember.

The first 4 nights' of your holiday will be spent at Hotel La Ginestra (Travellers' Choice 2022). The Hotel La Ginestra is located in a marvelous position on the Saint Angelo Bay. It was one of the first hotel built in the nice location of Panza. The hotel has been modified and renovated several times and today it is one of the most comfortable hotels of the whole area. Set on the southern coast of the island, it is within walking distance of the famous Maronti beach and to the large beach at Citara, with its Poseidon Spa Gardens. The picturesque bay of Sorgeto with its hot spa springs can also be reached easily.

After Ischia take a ferry to Capri. Capri promises a touch of glitz and glamour. Wander its charming streets lined with boutique shops and cafés, or perhaps discover the many walking trails and magical sea caves. Capri is a blend of upscale culture and natural wonders, with toney shops and swanky spot, splendid scenery, nature trails and climbs, and protected coves for diving. It is one of Italy's most picturesque places.

In Capri, you will stay at the Hotel Bussola Hermes for 3 nights. Hotel La Bussola, also known as Hotel Bussola di Hermes, is a charming 3-star Mediterranean-style villa situated in the tranquil lanes of Anacapri on the island of Capri, Italy. The hotel features crisp white walls, vaulted ceilings, and a panoramic terrace overlooking the Bay of Naples. Located just a short walk from Anacapri's historical center, Hotel La Bussola is ideally positioned for exploring the island. Guests can easily access attractions such as the Casa Rossa, the bus stop for routes to Capri, Marina Grande, the lighthouse, and the Blue Grotto. The hotel also offers a free pick-up service from Piazza della Pace, ensuring a convenient arrival for guests.

itinerary.title: Venice
itinerary.description:
This morning, join us for an optional excursion:

CLASSIC: guided tour of the Doge's Palace (1) Also known as the Palazzo Ducale, the Doge's Palace is one of Venice's most emblematic buildings. Built in the 11th century as the residenceas the residence and seat of government of the Republic of Venice, it is renowned for its imposing architecture and richly ornate interior decoration. Stroll through the rooms of the palace and admire the paintings by Tintoretto and Veronese, before crossing the famous Bridge of Sighs to reach the "prison". Built in the 16th century, it was used to take prisoners from the courtroom to the dungeon. From the balconies and windows, you can also enjoy splendid views of the Serenissima and its canals. After the visit, enjoy some free time to explore Piazza San Marco.

DISCOVERY package: Venice and the Dorsoduro district.

A brief cruise through the Venetian Lagoon will bring us to Mazzorbo. Right after lunch, explore the island of Burano—known for its traditional lacemaking and picture-perfect homes that border the canals.

A private boat will bring you on an optional excursion for both packages to the island of Murano, famous for its glassworks. We’ll visit a studio to watch a glassblowing demonstration.

Our ship will cruise to Venice.

itinerary.description:
Join us on an excursion for both packages: Food tour of little-known neighborhoods in Venice. Savor Venetian delicacies during this guided walk. We'll stroll through the age-old San Polo area, where the Rialto Market has been held for almost 1,000 years.(2) The market is an authentic experience—from the daily catch to seasonal fruits and vegetables. Locals come here early in the morning for the best deals. It's a great place to lose yourself in Venice. The liveliest area is the fish market, with bountiful, colorful stalls full of fish and shellfish ready to be bought and cooked. Our next stop will be a typical osteria to enjoy a tasting of authentic Venetian finger foods known as cicchetti. You'll also discover buranelli, ring- or S-shaped butter biscuits flavoured with vanilla, rum or lemon, a speciality of the island of Burano in the Venetian lagoon. These tastings will delight your taste buds.

Return on board.

title: Sorrento And Sicily: A Rail Adventure Through Southern Italy
description:
Italian Journey: Sorrento & Sicily with Sleeper Train Adventure 

Experience the captivating beauty of southern Italy with this unique 7-night holiday combining coastal Sorrento with historic Sicily, connected by an enchanting overnight train journey.

Begin with three nights in Sorrento, perched above the stunning Bay of Naples. Explore this charming town at your leisure, perhaps venturing to nearby Pompeii or taking a boat trip along the spectacular Amalfi Coast. Your sea view room offers the perfect backdrop to unwind after days of exploration.

Your adventure continues aboard the Intercity Notte sleeper train from Naples to Syracuse. As you sleep in your comfortable cabin, your train crosses the Strait of Messina by ferry – a unique travel experience that maximises your holiday time.

Wake to the warm Sicilian sunshine as you arrive in Syracuse, where you'll spend three nights in the historic Ortigia district. Discover ancient Greek ruins, wander through Baroque piazzas, and perhaps relax on the local beaches before your journey home from nearby Catania.

This thoughtfully designed holiday offers the perfect balance of guided travel and independent exploration across two of Italy's most beautiful regions.

Solo travellers welcome from £799.

title: Lipari Island Between Sea and Fire
description:
Let yourself be embraced by the timeless magic of the Aeolian Islands, a natural paradise suspended between turquoise waters, volcanic landscapes, and endless sunsets. Our exclusive offer takes you to Lipari, the vibrant heart of the archipelago, for an unforgettable 4-night stay at Hotel A Pinnata, a property renowned for its unique panoramic location and authentic Aeolian hospitality.Staying in a beautiful sea-view room, you will wake up each day to the horizon where sky and water blend seamlessly, and enjoy a rich, delicious breakfast.

 Upon arrival, a welcome aperitif will introduce you to the warm, relaxing atmosphere of the hotel, overlooking the picturesque Pignataro harbor and surrounded by the vivid colors of the Mediterranean. The offer includes round-trip transfers with maritime passage directly to the hotel, ensuring a smooth and carefree journey. You will also experience something truly unforgettable: a full day in Stromboli, the island known for its “sciara di fuoco,” where you can witness the primordial power of the active volcano illuminating the night with spectacular eruptions.Between crystal-clear waters, whitewashed villages, volcanic scenery, and charming hospitality, this escape to the Aeolian Islands invites you to rediscover the genuine beauty of nature—enhanced by the elegance and comfort of Hotel A Pinnata. A holiday you’ll never forget.

title: Holidays to Trail Of Montalbano in Sicily (2019/2020)
description:
Sicily bursts with character and oozes history – a combination which sees even the most seasoned of travellers return to this fabulous destination year after year.

As the largest Mediterranean island and the ‘toe’ to Italy’s ‘boot’, Sicily is home to stunning wonders such as the Valley of the Temples and the glorious Palatine Chapel. Overlooking these cultural gems is the brooding, smoke-spewing Mount Etna, one of Europe’s highest active volcanoes.  

For a relaxing, peaceful four nights, the Hotel Danieli will be your home. Modern and elegant, this 4-star paradise is the full package; a glittering swimming pool and tropical gardens are a stone’s throw from the beach and the lively sea town of Pozzallo (where the hotel is nestled) invites endless wandering and an insight into authentic Italian life. Not to mention it is the perfect springboard for day trips to Scicli, Modica (and others) and from its port, trips to Malta are also possible.

When you’re not basking in the sun and taking advantage of your hotel’s tranquil atmosphere, we’ve lined up two excursions during your 4-night getaway to help you get to know the area.

First, visit the places where the famous Inspector Montalbano TV programme was filmed. And for those of you with a sweet tooth, a chocolate tasting tour in Modica might just be what the doctor ordered. Modica, a city in the southeast of Sicily and renowned for its Baroque buildings and museums, is beautiful to behold. 

Your second excursion will see you sample the Cioccolato di Modica, a specialty of the region and inspired by the Aztec original recipe for Xocolatl.

title: Tranquil Ischia Island Holiday with Half Board Basis
description:
Fancy crossing the brilliant blue waters of Italy to a sun-soaked paradise, including return flights,transfers, half-board and a four-night hotel stay? Then you have to head to the tiny Tyrrhenian island of Ischia, the most vibrant islet in the Bay of Naples.

Ischia faces the gulf of Naples and is part of the Phlegraean island group generated by powerful underwater volcanoes, along with Procida and the deserted Vivara. According to the Daily Mail it is “Ischia’s sense of La Dolce Vita which makes it so special.” The harbour town of Forio has retro Hollywood charm. It is easy to imagine the fifties jetset, such as Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton tanning themselves and strolling down the cobbled lanes to sip Campari at one of the delightful cafes and restaurants – this is island decadence at its best!

Throughout the year, the island acts as a backdrop for numerous events, folkloristic feasts and displays, classical and pop music concerts and theatre performances. Ischia is tradition, hospitality and undisputed beauty to be appreciated with your own eyes and enjoyed at your own pleasure. 

In this holiday, you will experience and discover the fantastic world that awaits you at Hotel Parco Dei Principi with the ancient scents of saltwater, the endless beaches, the glitter of shopping streets, the green paths, the land and sea cuisine, the oldest spa in the world starting at only £499 per person.

title: Cheap Holidays to Sorrento
description:
Italy is all about baroque statues, mouthwatering cuisine and quaint beachside havens. From enchanting canals of Venice to the Roman Colosseum and a relaxing beach holiday in Sorrento, this enthralling trip combines three of Italy’s greatest destinations. The tour starts in Venice, described by Lonely Planet as “undoubtedly the most beautiful city built by man”. Venice is elegant, precious, inimitable, entertaining, and romantic. Venice has been known as the "La Dominante," "Serenissima," "Queen of the Adriatic," "City of Water," "City of Masks," "City of Bridges," "The Floating City," and "City of Canals." In Venice, you will stay at The Smart Hotel Holiday which is a comfy design hotel located few minutes far from Venice city centre. Easy to reach from Venezia-Mestre highway exit, this hotel is the ideal base for all those who are travelling by car and want to visit the wonderful Venice and the other cities in the surroundings.

After Venice you will visit the Eternal City of Rome for two nights at the ARS Hotel. This boutique hotel is situated in the Citta Giardino residential area, in Rome’s quiet and green Monte Sacro district, which makes it a peaceful haven away from the bustle and noise of the hectic tourist areas.  With round-the-clock energy and jaw-dropping views, Rome offers everything you’ve been dreaming of.

After exploring Rome, you’ll take our unforgettable train ride to Sorrento. Nestled on Southern Italy’s rugged Amalfi Coast is Sorrento, a picture-perfect hilltop town overlooking the turquoise glow of the Bay of Naples. Here, the fresh scent of gnocchi all a Sorrentina wafts through the air, locals bustle about in quirky antique stores and tourists swarm to the glorious shores like bees to honey. Should they look out into the horizon, they’ll see the enormous shadow of Mount Vesuvius looming in the distance. The 4 Star Hotel Admiral Sorrento will be your home away from home for the last 2 nights. The hotel, located on the Bay of Naples in the Marina Grande, offers a tranquil and picturesque setting away from the central hustle and bustle of Sorrento. Its seafront position provides stunning views and a serene atmosphere. From the moment you arrive, to the time you wish you weren’t leaving, outstanding service makes for an unforgettable holiday.

title: Italy Multi Centre Holidays 2019
description:
Sorrento has one of the best locations in the Mediterranean. Its cliffs overlook the Bay of Naples to Mount Vesuvius, and it is at one end of the gorgeous Amalfi Coast. Bright, lively and very pretty, it is a terrific destination for a chilled holiday with mates, family or your other The town itself is adorned with classical Italian architecture accompanying a lively and colourful environment.

Spend a whirlwind 2 nights in Sorrento. Wander around the Piazza Tasso, splurge at the shopping district on Via San Cesareo
 and make sure you cap off your days with a bowl or two of sensational 
gnocchi alla sorrentina. For dessert, gobble up the typical cake of the 
region known as la pastiera and round off your evening with an ice-cold 
shot of Limoncelloin true Italian style. 

Then, spend a relaxing 4 nights in Calabria, a region oozing with rustic charm in southwest Italy and occupying the ‘toe’ to Italy’s ‘boot’. With undulating, mountainous landscapes, frozen-in-time villages and gorgeous beaches, Calabria offers ample opportunity for relaxing and exploring – whether that means splashing about in the crystal-clear waters of Grotta Azzurra, wandering the Museo Archeologico Nazionale or hopping to Tropea Isola Bella with its powder-white beaches. 

Next, we’ll whisk you off to Sicily for a glorious 2 nights baking under the Mediterranean sun. From its ancient Valley of the Temples to the Byzantine mosaics at the Cappella Palatina and the brooding Mount Etna, Sicily is an island where boredom simply doesn’t exist. 

Hike through the stunning Nebrodi Mountains, get up close to one of Europe’s highest active volcanoes and wander around glimmering Moorish-style seaside towns, such as San Vito Lo Capo. Whether you feel like wandering and combing the area for history or breathing in the salt-tinged coastal breeze on a sun lounger, Sicily caters to all sorts of tastes.

title: All Inclusive Sicily Holiday
description:
The Italian island of Sicily sits just off the “toe” of the “boot” of the mainland. It’s a sun-baked paradise of cerulean waters and landscapes characterised by ruins, temples and the active volcano of Mount Etna. 

As such, there are a wealth of activities for pleasure-seekers to choose from – whether you’re wandering the ruins of the ancient city of Agrigento, getting to know the capital of Palermo and its mosaic-ridden Cappella Palatina, or perhaps just sunning yourself on one of Sicily’s many beaches.

An extraordinary island like this warrants a hotel stay that’s equally as extraordinary – cue the Le Dune Beach Club. With swaying palms and glistening pools, the hotel is nestled in the Mortelle area of the small town of Torre Faro, just six miles or so from the city of Messina. 

It’s a great place to stay in Sicily; cosy bungalows are spaced out around a delightful garden and a private beach offers ample opportunity for swimming, canoeing and sailing. At mealtimes, after a day spent relaxing and sunning yourself, hunker down over Mediterranean and Sicilian specialities at the on-site restaurant.

description:
Capri’s lesser-known neighbour, Ischia, is actually one of Campania’s finest destinations. Famous for its natural beauty, Ischia is also renowned for its rich thermal-mineral waters. The prodigious properties of Ischia’s waters have been well-known since ancient Roman times and even then, the island was probably one of the most famous thermal stations for the healing of both body and soul. Ischia is tradition, hospitality and undisputed beauty to be appreciated with your own eyes and enjoyed at your own pleasure.

The island boasts delightful views over the sparkling Mediterranean and fine sandy beaches. Holidays to Ischia are ideal for those looking for a respite with the islands fantastic beaches and range of exclusive spas.

The sophisticated architecture of the 19th century building is perfectly matched by the excellence of the facilities provided. As a former aristocratic villa, the hotel has modernised yet preserved the elegance of its former life.

On leaving the lobby you will find yourself in the luxurious garden of the villa where smells and colours typical of the Island welcome you to two outdoor pools, one thermal water and one freshwater.

Staying at the Hotel Terme Mare Blu is the best way to discover Ischia, the island of timeless fascination.
