title: Rome, Sorrento & Sicily: The Ultimate Italian Rail Experience
description:
Discover
the Magic of Italy by Rail and Sea

Embark on a
unique 7-night adventure to three of Italy’s most alluring destinations: Rome,
Sorrento, and Sicily. Travelling primarily by train—featuring an extraordinary
overnight sleeper service from Sorrento to Sicily—you’ll witness the singular
spectacle of your carriage boarding a ferry to cross the Strait of Messina.

 

Rome

Begin in
the Eternal City, where layers of history unfold at every turn. Gaze upon the
grand Colosseum, stroll through ancient forums, and marvel at ornate basilicas.
Enjoy traditional Roman cuisine in lively trattorias, and meander along
cobblestone streets filled with timeless charm.

 

Sorrento

Next,
journey south to the clifftop town of Sorrento, perched above the shimmering
blue waters of the Mediterranean. Savour fresh seafood and the region’s famed
limoncello, or take a short trip to Pompeii’s haunting ruins or Capri’s
glamorous shores. In the evenings, unwind amid Sorrento’s laid-back ambience,
soaking up the gentle coastal breeze.

 

Overnight
Sleeper Train & Ferry Crossing

Depart
Sorrento in style aboard a comfortable overnight sleeper train bound for
Sicily. Drift off to the lull of the rails, then awaken to the remarkable sight
of your train being guided onto a ferry to cross the Strait of Messina. Step
out on deck to breathe in the sea air and witness the dazzling coastline as you
glide towards Sicily—a once-in-a-lifetime rail-and-sea experience.

 

Sicily

Arrive
refreshed in Sicily, an island of breathtaking beauty and cultural riches.
Explore Palermo’s vibrant markets, admire the dramatic landscapes around Mount
Etna, or discover Taormina’s Greco-Roman heritage. Embrace the island’s hearty
cuisine, influenced by centuries of diverse traditions, and immerse yourself in
Sicily’s warm hospitality.

 

Why Choose
This Journey?

Unique
Travel Experience: Enjoy the rare thrill of watching your overnight sleeper
train board a ferry for the scenic crossing into Sicily.

Cultural
Immersion: Encounter Italy’s layered history, from Rome’s ancient wonders to
Sicily’s blend of Greek, Roman, and Norman influences.

Coastal
Bliss: Unwind in Sorrento’s relaxed atmosphere, with easy access to Capri,
Pompeii, and the Amalfi Coast.

Hassle-Free
Connections: Benefit from seamless rail and ferry links, making for a smooth
and stress-free journey.

Secure Your
Place

Combine
history, coastal charm, and Sicilian splendour in one unforgettable holiday.
Reserve your spot now for a truly extraordinary Italian escape—travelling by
train, ferry, and the promise of endless discovery.

title: Half Board Ischia Holiday
description:
Fancy crossing the brilliant blue waters of Italy to a sun-soaked paradise, including half board, return flights, transfers and a seven-night hotel stay?  Then you have to head to the tiny Tyrrhenian island of Ischia, the most vibrant islet in the Bay of Naples.

Think mouthwatering views of the “sea, the distant horizon and the Epomeo Mountain”, tropical temperatures that reach as high as 38°C, a panoramic terrace with an outdoor swimming pool boasting a hydro massage and solarium. 

According to the Daily Mail it is “Ischia’s sense of La Dolce Vita which makes it so special.” The harbour town of Forio has retro Hollywood charm. It is easy to imagine the fifties jetset, such as Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton tanning themselves and strolling down the cobbled lanes to sip Campari at one of the delightful cafes and restaurants – this is island decadence at its best!

In the package you will visit the famous island of Capri (round trip transfers included) symbol of the Dolce Vita, you will spend a day in a luxuriant thermal park not far from the hotel. You will visit the Aragonese Castle, symbol of the island of Ischia with an expert guide and transfers included and finally you will refresh yourself with one of the specialties of Sant'Angelo, the organic granita made at the moment in a typical chiringuito.

Located in Sant'Angelo, Hotel Casa Giuseppina is a perfect starting point from which to explore Ischia Island. Both business travelers and tourists can enjoy the property's facilities and services. Service-minded staff will welcome and guide you at Hotel Casa Giuseppina. Comfortable guestrooms ensure a good night's sleep with some rooms featuring facilities such as closet, flat screen television, air conditioning, heating, desk. The property offers various recreational opportunities. Hotel Casa Giuseppina combines warm hospitality with a lovely ambiance to make your stay in Ischia Island unforgettable.

itinerary.title: NAPLES - ISCHIA ISLAND
itinerary.description:
Arrival in Naples Airport and transfer to Ischia, the largest island of the gulf of Naples. Ischia is known for its thermal properties since ancient times.

itinerary.title: TOUR OF ISCHIA BY BUS
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, your driver will accompany you in the discovery of this wonderful island through the villages, the lush hills and the breathtaking landscapes with sea views. Admire the majestic Aragonese Castle, the romantic village of Sant'Angelo.

itinerary.title: CITY OF NAPLES
itinerary.description:
Day at Leisure - we suggest after breakfast grab the ferry from Ischia to Naples. You can visit on your own the ancient Greek streets, Roman undergrounds excavations and visit squares that are pile of styles: many invasions and cultural influences gave to center of the city throughout a mixture of Pagan and Christian path that is still characteristic of the present life, like you will notice in both Piazza del Gesù and Piazza San Domenico Maggiore. In San Gregorio Armeno market you will notice this duality in all the artfacts of the typical shops but this typical double nature of the city is also expressed in the Baroque architecture of the Cathedral. 

You will also experience the view of medieval Angiò’s castle and one of the world’s best neoclassical theatre, Theatre of San Carlo. In front of San Carlo’s Theatre you will walk inside the liberty style shopping center known as Galleria Umberto I and than the historical location of Via Toledo and Piazza Plebiscito. We can book a table for you in a typical pizzeria where you will finally taste the real Neapolitan pizza.

In the afternoon return to the hotel & rest of the day will be at leisure.

title: Package Holidays to Ischia
description:
Kick-start your holiday with a sensational three nights spent in Sorrento. Sorrento has one of the best locations in the Mediterranean. Its cliffs overlook the Bay of Naples to Mount Vesuvius, and it is at one end of the gorgeous Amalfi Coast. Bright, lively and very pretty, it is a terrific destination for a chilled holiday with mates, family or your other The town itself is adorned with classical Italian architecture accompanying a lively and colorful environment.

After experiencing Sorrento, you’ll hop to Ischia for a further three nights’ stay. Ischia faces the gulf of Naples and is part of the Phlegraean island group generated by powerful underwater volcanoes, along with Procida and the deserted Vivara. 

Famous for its natural beauty, Ischia is also renowned for its rich thermal-mineral waters. The prodigious properties of Ischia’s waters have been well-known since ancient Roman times and even then, the island was probably one of the most famous thermal stations for the healing of both body and soul. Ischia is tradition, hospitality and undisputed beauty to be appreciated with your own eyes and enjoyed at your own pleasure.

The last 3 nights of your holiday will be spent in Capri, an island located on the south side of the Gulf of Naples in the Campania region. Once considered “the isle of sirens” in Greek mythology, charming Capri has been a popular coastal resort since the days of the Roman Republic (and it’s easy to see why!). The island provides a landscape very few can resist: Roman villa ruins, a dazzling harbor, stunning architecture and unparalleled beaches and coves.

title: Romantic Venice Historic Rome and Beaches of Ischia
description:
Venice is a city known for it beautiful architecture, art works and its stunning location. The city is listed as a World Heritage Site with its lagoon. It is known as the ‘Most romantic city in Europe’ as well as the City of Bridges, City of Water and the Floating City. The Smart Hotel Holiday is a comfy design hotel located few minutes far from Venice city centre. Easy to reach from Venezia-Mestre highway exit, this hotel is the ideal base for all those who are travelling by car and want to visit the wonderful Venice and the other cities in the surroundings.

The second half will be spent in Rome has an immensely rich historical heritage and its cosmopolitan atmosphere, makes it one of Europe's and the world's most visited and beautiful capital cities. The ARS Hotel has the character of a boutique hotel. It is ideally situated in the Citta Giardino residential area, in Rome's quiet and green Monte Sacro district, which makes it a peaceful haven away from the bustle and noise of Rome's hectic tourist areas. This hotel is housed in a beautiful four-storey villa surrounded by a small but beautiful garden that offers superb panoramic views. 

Lastly you have to head to the tiny Tyrrhenian island of Ischia, the most vibrant islet in the Bay of Naples. Ischia faces the gulf of Naples and is part of the Phlegraean island group generated by powerful underwater volcanoes, along with Procida and the deserted Vivara. Here you will experience and discover the fantastic world that awaits you at  Hermitage Resort & Thermal Spa, a real life oasis, courtesy of its well-kept gardens, thermal pools and top-of-the-range spa. This place is in a peaceful, pine-scented neighbourhood, a 20-minute walk from Ischia Porto’s harbour. It’s less than that to the beach, plus the hotel puts on a free shuttle bus there and back. The hotel draws on Ischia’s relaxing reputation, feeding its pools from the island’s underground springs, offering mud spa treatments and a hydrotherapy circuit with a difference.

title: Sorrento Holiday Deals
description:
Italy is all about baroque statues, mouth watering cuisine and quaint beachside havens. On this week-long twin-centre retreat, you’ll have the perfect balance – staying first in the city and then onto the Bay of Naples in south western Italy with its sandy/pebble beaches. Your Italian holiday will include transfers and train ride so you’ll have the unique chance to thunder towards the coast.

You’ll begin your fantastic break at the four-star Hotel Principe Torlonia. Located 10 min away from the city center in one of the most prestigious residential areas of the Eternal City, Hotel Principe Torlonia is surrounded by parks, embassies and elegant buildings. Friendly, attentive and helpful staff welcome each guest to a Neoclassical Villa that dates back to the early '900's, situated amidst lush gardens and surrounded by secular trees, offering all the modern comforts of an exclusive 4-stars boutique hotel.

After exploring Rome, you’ll take our unforgettable train ride to Sorrento. Here you will stay at the 4 Star Nastro Azzurro & Occhio Marino. It is a charming resort located in the sanctum of Southern Italy’s natural beauty and verdant hills of the Sorrento Peninsula with spellbinding panoramic views of the Gulf of Naples and Salerno. 

Luxuriate in a heavenly oasis with sprawling swimming pools and whirlpools surrounded by lush greenery. A true haven of tranquility to relax and spend an unforgettable stay. It’s the ideal location for a stress-free and romantic getaway.

title: Sardinia: A Journey To Tranquility And Beauty
description:
Nestled along the breathtaking coastline of Sardinia, Hotel La Coluccia offers a luxurious yet intimate escape, where the beauty of nature meets unparalleled comfort. With its idyllic setting on the Santa Teresa Gallura peninsula, this 4-star boutique hotel provides an exclusive getaway for those seeking relaxation, adventure, and a taste of Sardinian elegance.

A Serene Seaside Retreat Hotel La Coluccia is the perfect destination for those wanting to unwind by the sea. Surrounded by lush Mediterranean vegetation and crystal-clear waters, the hotel boasts stunning panoramic views of the Costa Smeralda and the La Maddalena Archipelago. Its tranquil atmosphere, combined with impeccable service, ensures guests enjoy a peaceful and rejuvenating stay.

Stylish Accommodations The hotel features elegant rooms and suites designed with a blend of modern comforts and traditional Sardinian charm. Each room offers a private balcony or terrace with breathtaking views of the sea or the surrounding countryside, ensuring every stay feels like a personal retreat. For those seeking the ultimate in luxury, exclusive suites with private plunge pools and direct access to the beach are also available.

World-Class Dining At Hotel La Coluccia, guests can indulge in exquisite Sardinian cuisine at the hotel’s refined restaurant, where fresh, locally sourced ingredients are transformed into mouthwatering dishes. From seafood delicacies to traditional island specialties, every meal is a celebration of Sardinia's rich culinary heritage. Guests can also enjoy al fresco dining on the terrace, surrounded by stunning sea views.

Wellness and Leisure Whether you seek total relaxation or an active adventure, Hotel La Coluccia caters to all tastes. Spend your days lounging by the infinity pool, enjoy the private beach, or take part in water sports like sailing, kayaking, and snorkeling. For those looking to unwind further, the hotel's spa offers a range of rejuvenating treatments, from massages to holistic therapies, ensuring a deep sense of relaxation.

Explore Sardinia’s Wonders Hotel La Coluccia is ideally located to explore the hidden gems of northern Sardinia. From the white sandy beaches and crystal-clear waters of La Maddalena to the charming streets of Santa Teresa Gallura, there’s no shortage of breathtaking sights. Take a boat trip to the La Maddalena Archipelago or hike through the scenic trails of the nearby mountains. Whether you're seeking culture, history, or nature, Sardinia offers a wealth of experiences just waiting to be discovered.

Perfect for Every Occasion Whether you’re looking for a romantic getaway, a family holiday, or a special celebration, Hotel La Coluccia offers an idyllic setting for every occasion. The hotel’s bespoke service ensures that each guest’s experience is tailored to their needs, making every stay unforgettable.

title: Sorrento And Sicily Twin Centre With Transfers
description:
During this twin centre holiday, you will stay in the beautiful town of Sorrento for four nights. Sorrento is located in a steep position on the Gulf of Naples, and offers exceptional panoramic views. During your stay you’ll have time to explore the many fascinating nearby attractions such as Pompeii and Herculaneum, as well as the mighty Mount Vesuvius. Here, you will be put up in a four star Hotel Jaccarino (Traveller's Choice 2020). The Hotel has commanded wide views over Sorrento and the Bay of Naples for more than 120 years from its spot in the little village of Sant’Agata sui due Golfi. The hotel leans towards the traditional side. Terracotta tiles and yellow walls offer a Mediterranean feel, while wall tapestries and Italian-crafted wooden furniture add an authentic touch.

From Sorrento you will fly to Sicily for the remaining four nights of your holiday. One of the largest Mediterranean islands, Sicily has its own unique culture and charm. It is one of the most beautiful places in the world. The scent of lemon groves fills the air while the stunning scenery that sees the juxtaposition of sea, volcano and mountain will take your breath away. In Sicily your stay will be at the 4 Star President Park Hotel (Travellers' Choice 2022). Located between the wonders of Acicastello and Acitrezza, the President Park Hotel dominates the hill, offering breath-taking views of the sea stacks and the Gulf of Capo Mulini. The President Park Hotel takes the form of a traditional amphitheatre, symbolising a great embrace towards the sea and offering vast outdoor spaces suitable and designed for any type of event.

title: Enchanting Tuscany Holiday With Wine Tasting
description:
Tuscany is located in central Italy and stretches from the Apennines to the Tyrrhenian Sea. Visitors to Tuscany come for many reasons. Many come in search of fine art, others to explore the extraordinary countryside. Gourmets and wine buffs descend on Tuscany to enjoy the simple yet wonderful cuisine and wine.

Tourists tend to flock like bees to honey to Florence, Pisa and Montecatini Terme and this trip is no exception. Montecatini is a charming town which is known to be the capital of spas and thermal treatments in the region. During this holiday, you will also explore Pisa, Chianti, San Gimignano, and enjoy a walking tour.

Marvel over the medieval castle of Monteriggioni; explore the architectural wonders of historic Siena; and admire the striking skyline of hilltop San Gimignano. Enjoy a light lunch in Siena and finish your tour with a wine tasting at a local winery in the Chianti region.

The famous Excelsior Spa and Redi Spa are open all year and can be reached in a few minutes on foot.

During this holiday, your stay will be at the 4 star Hotel Puccini situated in the heart of Montecatini, on the main street Corso Roma and just few steps away from the famous Kursaal and Spas.

itinerary.title: ARRIVE PISA
itinerary.description: After arriving at Pisa Airport, you’ll be transferred to your glorious hotel. The rest of the day will be spent at your leisure. You’ll have dinner and stay overnight.

itinerary.title: WALKING TOUR IN FLORENCE
itinerary.description:
After enjoying a scrumptious breakfast at the hotel, you will depart to Florence for walking tour. Here you will discover two thousand years of history of the cradle of the Renaissance through the eyes of an expert local guide, who will take you in an unforgettable journey to discover the most beautiful squares and monuments of Florence. With an expert guide you will enjoy a walk through the most fascinating and interesting places of Florence: the first stage of this enlightening guided promenade will be REPUBBLICA SQUARE, one of the most elegant squares in Florence, where the most refined cafés of the city are located. Follow your guide through the most characteristic streets and alleys until you reach the “LOGGIA DEL MERCATO NUOVO”, where you will discover how to win good luck caressing the nose of the famous “PORCELLINO” (wild boar) BRONZE STATUE. At a stone throw there is the suggestive “PONTE VECCHIO”, a true icon of the city, famous for hosting the most exclusive jewelry stores of Florence and for its unique structure, and also for being the only bridge of the city spared from the bombings during the Second World War. Follow your guide to the “ACCADEMIA DEI GEORGOFILI” and the UFFIZI SQUARE, and discover the beating heart of Florence, SIGNORIA SQUARE, “PALAZZO VECCHIO” and the magnificent LOGGIA DEI LANZI.

Return in Montecatini Terme by train.

Dinner and overnight in hotel.

itinerary.title: PISA
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel and departure by train to Pisa. Today we give you the opportunity to discover this wonderful city in total autonomy. The beautiful “PIAZZA DEL DUOMO” gathers, in an architectural complex unique in the world, not surprisingly called “CAMPO DEI MIRACOLI”, the main religious monuments of the city: the TOWER, the “DUOMO”, the BAPTISTERY and the “CAMPO SANTO”. in this square: just move a little to discover the artistic wonders that make it one of the most beautiful cities of art in Italy. 

Return in Montecatini Terme by train. 

Dinner and overnight in hotel.

itinerary.title: MONTECATINI & SPA DAY
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel and we advise you to discover the wonders of MONTECATINI which has been able to consolidate the fame of its thermal waters, known for centuries. We point out the famous “TERME TETTUCCIO” which offer a valid therapeutic complement. (payment on the spot) The large gardens ensure maximum relaxation and help to find the best psycho-physical balance of the organism and a real "remise en forme". Also interesting is the CHURCH OF S. PIETRO APOSTOLO, which preserves the signs of its Romanesque origin in the columns, capitals and façade. In the adjacent museum there is a Gothic reliquary, the head of the patron saint, “SANTA BARBARA”, a wooden MAJESTY AND A TRIUMPH OF CHRIST.

Dinner and overnight in hotel.

itinerary.title: CINQUE TERRE
itinerary.description:
Breakfast in hotel and day dedicated to visit Cinque Terre. A whole, intense, unforgettable day dedicated to discover one of the most enchanting landscapes in the world. Little villages, suspended between sea and land, hanging from sheer cliffs surrounded by hills and vineyards.
The visit begins with MANAROLA where you can admire the houses leaning one against the other and stroll along the narrow cobble alleyways and sheltered paths; later a local train will take us to VERNAZZA one of the most colorful and photographed fishing villages of the area, where you will have free time to sit on the tiny harbor and relax, breathing in the atmosphere of this unique area out of time. Next head to MONTEROSSO train: you will be awed by this ancient fishing village considered “the pearl of the Cinque Terre”, where you will be overcome by enchanting beaches and luxuriant vegetation that surrounds the little village. Here you will have free time to plunge into the crystal sea before taking boat to the last destination RIOMAGGIORE where you can have free time to explore the delicious seaside town surrounding a small natural port. The itinerary may be subject to variations due to force majeure. Return to Montecatini Terme.
Dinner and overnight in hotel.

itinerary.title: CHIANTI COLOURS
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel and the possibility of continuing to discover the authentic Tuscany. You’ll reach Florence by train from Montecatini.
Tuscany is world-renowned for its nature, small villages, vineyards and gentle hills. Your tour starts with a visit to a rustic WINE ESTATE, in the heart of the vineyards, where you will be greeted by the owners and led to their cellar to learn all the secrets of the Chianti wine making process. After, you will be offered an appetizing snack based on “crostini Toscani” paired with locally produced olive oil. Along with the snacks, indulge their high-quality “Chianti wine”. You will taste several wines and have the opportunity to purchase bottles to bring or send home!
Next, you will discover GREVE IN CHIANTI, which is without doubt one of the most famous and best known Italian Chianti wine villages! Here, you will have free time to independently explore the characteristic alleyways and the central square with its numerous medieval buildings and its picturesque, artisan shops. Our day is not over yet... In the heart of olive trees, gentle hills and vineyards, we will visit another enchanting wine estate together. You will be offered more enticing snacks and exquisite Chianti-made wines to taste. The owners of the wine estate will teach you more about their
wines, and by the end of the day, you will be a true Chianti wine expert! Don’t forget your camera as you
embark on this incredible journey through the fairytale land of Chianti... “Cheers!”

Dinner and overnight in hotel.

itinerary.title: TRANSFER TO PISA AIRPORT
itinerary.description:
Get ready to say arrivederci to Tuscany! You’ll be transferred to Pisa Airport after your last breakfast at the hotel. We hope you’ve had a wonderful holiday.

End of Tour

title: Greek Isles & Tuscan Treasures With Rome Stay
description:
Start your Mediterranean escape with 2 wonderful nights in Rome, the Eternal City. Wander through cobbled streets, discover ancient ruins like the Colosseum, toss a coin in the Trevi Fountain, and stand in awe beneath Michelangelo’s masterpiece in the Sistine Chapel — all before your cruise even begins.

Then set sail aboard the Norwegian Epic for an unforgettable journey through the heart of the Mediterranean. Departing from Civitavecchia, this itinerary offers a perfect mix of history, culture, and coastal beauty.

In Mykonos, soak up the laid-back island vibes before taking a short ferry to Delos, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the mythological birthplace of Apollo and Artemis. In Santorini, experience the postcard-perfect views of whitewashed houses perched atop volcanic cliffs and savour some of the region's finest wines.

Your voyage continues to Livorno, your gateway to Tuscany. Here, you can explore the Renaissance beauty of Florence, discover charming seaside towns, or simply enjoy the region's incredible food and wine.

title: Greek Isles: Santorini, Athens & Florence With Istanbul Stay
description:
Start your unforgettable journey with 2 nights in Istanbul, a city where continents and cultures meet. Discover iconic landmarks like the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia, stroll through the vibrant Grand Bazaar, and take in breathtaking views from the Bosphorus before setting sail.

Then, embark on a Mediterranean cruise aboard Norwegian Sky, exploring the sun-kissed Greek Isles and the cultural gems of France and Italy. From Mykonos, take a short ferry ride to Delos, the mythological birthplace of Apollo and Artemis, home to awe-inspiring ancient ruins.

Explore the heart of Ancient Greece in Athens, visiting the Acropolis and Parthenon. In Santorini, admire the dramatic cliffs, whitewashed villages, and some of the most spectacular sunsets in the world.

Sail on to Marseille, where you can explore the Old Port or journey to Avignon to see the historic Palace of the Popes. Then continue to Livorno, gateway to Tuscany’s stunning countryside and the Renaissance treasures of Florence.

Your adventure ends in Rome (Civitavecchia) — a city steeped in history and wonder. And if you want to keep the magic going, you can extend your stay in Rome to explore even more ancient sites, lively piazzas, and delicious Italian cuisine.

itinerary.title: Kusadasi, Turkey
itinerary.description: 02:00 PM : 09:30 PM :  Take a journey into the past in richly historic Ephesus. Once an ancient Greek city, Kusadasi was known for the famed Temple of Artemis, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Built, destroyed, and rebuilt again through several notably historical periods, Ephesus boasts abounding ruins and archaeological excavation sites. View what remains of the Roman Library of Celsus, the Gate of Augustus, the Tomb of John the Apostle, and the Basilica of St. John, among several other ancient remnants.

Add a reputation for beautiful beaches and you'll understand why Mykonos is the most popular island in the Cyclades. Explore the island in a 4 x 4 or take a ferry to the tiny island of Delos. Explore more of Mykonos on a European cruise!

Explore more of Athens on a European cruise!

Nestled between the mountains and the sea at the southeastern point of the famed Amalfi Coast, Salerno boasts sun-drenched beaches, nature reserves and parks, historic sites and delicious local cuisine.

title: Mediterranean Wonders: Italy, France & Greece With A Venice Escape
description:
Begin your unforgettable Mediterranean journey with a 2-night stay in a charming Venice hotel, where romantic canals, historic architecture, and the magic of St. Mark’s Square await. Then board the Norwegian Breakaway for a 10-Nights cruise through some of Southern Europe’s most iconic and picturesque destinations.

Departing from Trieste, explore the coastal beauty of Split in Croatia, where Roman history meets seaside charm. Stroll through the cobbled alleys of Corfu’s Old Town in Greece, steeped in Venetian elegance and local warmth. In Italy, dock at Civitavecchia and step back in time as you tour the wonders of ancient Rome, from the Colosseum to the Sistine Chapel. Discover the glitz and glamour of the French Riviera with its designer boutiques, sun-kissed beaches, and Mediterranean flair.

End your cruise in the vibrant city of Barcelona — and for those wishing to savour a little more sunshine and sangria, why not extend your stay and experience the Catalonian capital’s world-famous architecture, tapas, and nightlife?

The scenic port city of Trieste is steeped in history and natural beauty. Nestled atop a limestone plateau on a thin strip of land between the Adriatic Coast and Slovenia, the region has been ruled by multiple empires through the ages. This cultural fluidity is reflected in the awe-inspiring architecture and fusion of delicious cuisine found throughout the city. From touring museums and historic sites to strolling along its waterfront or reclining on a white-sand beach, this isolated, picturesque region of Italy boasts a wide range of attractions and activities.

Dubbed “the pearl of the Adriatic” by the poet, Lord Byron, this Croatian city exudes romantic charm and beautiful scenery with its shimmering marble streets, centuries-old buildings capped by bright orange roofs, and lovely beaches ensconced between awesome rocky ledges. Explore more of Dubrovnik on a European cruise!

It's a city designed to delight the senses: visit other-worldly Modernista churches like Gaudi's La Sagrada Familia, or treat yourself at a street-side cafe to Patatas Bravas or a Passion Fruit Mojito. Our diverse cruises from Barcelona not only offer a gateway to this captivating city but also serve as the perfect starting point for exploring the Mediterranean and beyond. Choosing cruises from Barcelona allows you to seamlessly blend the excitement of a vibrant city with the allure of a grand sea voyage. Explore more of Catalonia and beyond on a European cruise from Barcelona!

title: Cruise Amalfi Coast And Sicily With Naples Stay
description:
NAPLES - MILAZZO - VIBO MARINA - SORRENTO(1) or SALERNO - NAPLES 

Climb aboard an unforgettable cruise leaving from Naples, where each port of call transports you to another place and another time. Explore antique ruins in Pompeii and Herculaneum. Meander along the picturesque streets of Naples' Old Town.  Chill and admire the stunning scenery of Vulcano, Lipari, and Stromboli during an exceptional cruise alongside the Aeolian Islands—a volcanic archipelago listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Discover the authentic charm of Tropea—in Calabria—perched on a cliff overlooking the sea. Dive into all the splendor found on the Amalfi Coast. An enchanting voyage full of excitement and discoveries awaits.

itinerary.title: NAPLES
itinerary.description: Boarding at 6:00 p.m. We'll introduce our crew at a welcome cocktail before dinner on board. Enjoy an evening of entertainment.

itinerary.title: NAPLES
itinerary.description:
This morning, excursion proposed:

- Pompeii. A city frozen in time, which through its tragedy has become one of the most significant resources of information on Roman art, customs, trades, and life.

OR

- Herculaneum. Just like Pompeii, Herculaneum was also destroyed by the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD. Discover the wealth of archaeological finds, from ancient advertisements and stylish mosaics to carbonized furniture and inhabitants.

This afternoon, excursion proposed: Naples. Discover the must-see sites, masterful works, and unexpected treasures in Naples, such as its old town and royal palace. In the oldest section of Naples, enjoy a stroll down the Via San Gregorio Armeno, the famous pedestrian street where you can observe skilled craftsmen actually working on nativity figures as they carve and paint them. We'll visit the Cloister of Santa Chiara to admire the nativity scene with 18th-century figurines.

itinerary.title: The Aeolian Islands - MILAZZO (Sicily)
itinerary.description:
We’ll spend the morning cruising through the Aeolian Islands.(4) Rising from the cobalt blue sea along the Sicilian coast, the Aeolian Islands (Vulcano, Lipari, Salina, Panarea, Stromboli, Filicudi, and Alicudi) are listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The archipelago's name comes from Aeolus, who kept violent winds locked safely on his island, as recounted in Homer's epic poem, the Odyssey.
This afternoon, the excursion proposed is: Tindari. Discover the Sanctuary of the Black Madonna and the site of an ancient Greek town with stunning views of the Sicilian coastline. Enjoy some free time in the charming city of Milazzo, with its medieval citadel perched high above.

itinerary.title: MESSINA
itinerary.description: Excursion proposed:Full-day excursion to Mount Etna and Taormina. Mount Etna is the largest active volcano in Europe, and we’ll take you up to almost 6,400 feet (1950 m) to the Silvestri Craters near the top. The bleak lava wilderness around the summit of Etna is one of the most memorable landscapes you’ll ever see. We’ll then drive to Taormina. Nestled above the stunning Sicilian coastline, Taormina brings to life the legendary beauty of Sicily. Enjoy a tour of the area, including the ruins of its ancient Greek theater.

itinerary.title: VIBO MARINA
itinerary.description:
We’ll spend the morning cruising.
This afternoon, the excursion is: The Calabria. The Calabria region is at the toe of the boot in Italy, lapped by the splendid crystal-clear Ionian and Tyrrhenian Seas. Its warm climate, beautiful colors, rocky coasts, local food, and vestiges of its ancient origins make it a unique place to be enjoyed in both winter and summer. We'll discover Tropea, the pearl of the Calabria. Perched on a rocky promontory with a cliff-side view of the sea, this small city is a veritable jewel. We'll also enjoy a tasting of regional products.

itinerary.title: SALERNO
itinerary.description:
We’ll spend the morning cruising.
The excursion this afternoon is: Sorrento and the Amalfi Coast. Discover the charming, hillside city of Sorrento, surrounded by orange and lemon orchards and a spectacular panorama of the sea. We'll also enjoy a sampling of limoncello. Afterwards, we’ll continue our trip and visit the villages filled with colorful houses and elegant seaside resorts along the dramatic Amalfi Coast.
Tonight is our festive gala evening.

itinerary.title: NAPLES
itinerary.description:
Excursion proposed: Capri and Anacapri (Lunch included).(1) We’ll take an airboat to splendid Capri. On arrival, we’ll head to the village of Anacapri and visit the Villa San Michele, built at the turn of the last century by Swedish physician and author Axel Munthe. Anacapri is located at the highest part of the island. From the villa gardens, you’ll have a fantastic view of the city of Capri, the Gulf of Naples, and Mount Vesuvius. In addition to the amazing backdrop, the gardens themselves possess a rare beauty. Enjoy some time on your own this afternoon or visit the Gardens of Augustus, located on the top of a cliff with a stupendous view of the turquoise sea. We'll return to Naples by airboat.
The theme for this evening is "Neopolitan Songs and Dances."

Crete is the largest of the Greek islands – a colourful, characterful tapestry of historic treasures like the Bronze Age settlement of Knossos and the spectacular Arkadi Monastery. 

With sparkling, diverse landscapes punctuated by centuries-old ruins and glittery beachfronts, Crete is like catnip to both sun-seekers and history buffs. Whether you’re spending your time wandering through museums and ogling exhibits or bedding down on a lounger by the ocean, you might just fall head over heels for this paradisiacal Greek island. 

This package includes a relaxing seven nights’ stay at the Vasia Village Hotel in the picture-perfect fishing village of Sisi, overlooking the Cretan Sea. 

It’s the perfect place for a family getaway, offering a wealth of activities to excite the little ones and keep them busy. There’s an onsite water park (three adult slides and one children’s slide) and several swimming pools for energetic afternoons. 

When you’re not whizzing down water slides or sunning yourself, head out and explore the surrounding areas. For example, Vasia Village is just 15 minutes from the picturesque town of Agios Nikolaos – quaint, with smaller family beaches in the vicinity.

Santorini is an island in the Cyclades, and one of the most romantic, glamorous and popular tourist destinations in all of Greece. Santorini holidays promise sun, sea, history, and some of the most spectacular views imaginable.

Perhaps most famous for its sunsets, Santorini is also the place to go for beautiful beaches, excellent wines, and fascinating ancient history. Its blue domed churches are an iconic vision, making this Greek island seriously snappable.

Absolutely breathtaking views and a beachfront location make Santorini’s Veggera Hotel a top holiday choice for couples and families. Decorated in fresh pinks and white with blue accents, the smart hotel has bright, airy rooms – but with so much sunshine, it's likely you will spend far more time outside by the pools or on the beach.

With a bar set between the hotel's two pools, the only decision you will have to make is which pool to use! Either way, the bar is perfectly placed to order a refreshing drink to cool off in the sunshine. In the evening, watch as the pool area is specially lit, adding an extra touch of romance while you choose from the cocktail list.

If you want to keep up your fitness routine, or perhaps start, there's a gym, sauna, and hot tub for well-being and relaxation.

title: Experience Historic Crete
description:
With shiny blue waters and dramatic landscapes, the island of Crete (the largest of all the Greek islands) is the stuff of dreams – a firm favourite of sun-seekers looking to relax in an idyllic setting.  

The island’s terrain is varied and exciting; you can go from dipping your toes in cerulean lagoons to scaling Mount Ida to reach Ideon Cave (the birthplace of Zeus, according to Greek mythology) all in the same day. 

The archaeological sites, ruins and museums that inhabit the island also offer lots for history buffs and culture vultures to sink their teeth into; Heraklion, the island’s capital, is home to the exciting, time-ravaged Bronze Age settlement of Knossos. 

During your stay, you’ll spend a restful week at the four-star Creta Star Hotel – an all-inclusive, adults only paradise with Skaleta Beach right on its doorstep. 

Poised to deliver you a week of bliss, this cosy hotel boasts two swimming pools fringed by swaying palms and manicured gardens. Tan and relax to your heart’s content or work up a sweat playing tennis, archery, mini-golf or basketball. 

All-inclusive board basis gives you the chance to sample a range of different delicacies without even leaving your hotel. The buffet offers a wealth of Greek-style dishes and international food – so you can hunker down over halloumi or keep to your home comforts, depending on your preferences.

This exceptional Resort offers both style and a tropical elegance and combines a natural setting with sophistication offering a high quality holiday to couples & families with children of all ages.

title: Luxury Crete Holidays - Crete Holiday with Flights
description:
Crete is sheer magic- a portrait of the whimsical exuberance of splendid natural vistas, shrouded in a thin air of mystery, which has inspired travelers to throng to its shores since centuries. The mesmerizing sight of the sharp rugged mountains merging with the vast seas is a bliss for the wretched soul. The magnificent mountain ranges, sleepy medieval villages, long sandy beaches, swanky beach bars and the ebullient nightlife- the southernmost island in Europe has got everything!!!!

Crete’s natural beauty can be only rivaled by its historical richness. Steeped in history, historians consider the island to be the birthplace of the most advanced society on the European soil- the Minoans in around 2600 BC. The subsequent control of the Mycenaeans, Romans and the Byzantines has left its mark in the form of the rich architectural gems sprinkled all across the island. Witness the mythological landmarks such as the Ideon Cave, considered to be the birthplace of Zeus, the Greek god of sky and thunder!!

If you are a food connoisseur, you are at the right place!! For the Cretans, food is not a necessity, it’s a way of life. Indulge in a gourmet trail and delight your senses with delicious cheeses, aromatic wild herbs, world’s best olive oil, and some exotic spices and vegetables. Pair your meal with some fine wine, and live the Cretan way of life to its fullest!!!

The Rimondi Grand Resort & Spa is your week long Cretan abode. The stunning yet tranquil 4 star property is a luxurious hideaway, situated perfectly away from the maddening crowds on the slopes of an olive tree plantation. Soothe your senses with a blissful massage in the spa, or just grab a drink and relax in the beautiful outdoor swimming pool, as you watch the sun setting into the horizon and casting a shimmering gold dust on the pride of the Mediterranean!!!

Holidays in Kos offer miles of gorgeous, sandy coastline, meaning the hardest choice will be which one to relax on! A hotspot famous for attracting the party crowds is the island's capital of Kos Town, popular for its fabulous cocktails and fun-packed harbour.

The friendly Mitsis Family Village Beach Hotel is a 4-star hotel situated on the island of Kos and is only a 5-minute drive from the lively resort of Kardamena. The majority of the rooms at Mitsis Family Village offer a balcony or terrace with breath-taking views of the surrounding mountains or the glistening sea. 

A superb pebble beach is only a short stroll away, where you can enjoy the hot sun with the whole family. On top of that, the resort isn’t too far from the bustling resort of Kardamena, where there are many shops, bars and restaurants, ideal for guests looking to experience the culture and nightlife of this energetic island.

Ideal for families and couples alike, Zante holidays offer a taste of everything that’s great about Greece. From unspoilt countryside just begging to be explored on foot, horseback or bike - to beautiful beaches and lively entertainment along the coast, Zante has it all.

This beautiful Greek island in the Ionian Sea has been a firm favourite with holidaymakers for years – and it’s not difficult to see why. Surrounded by pristine beaches and lapped by crystal clear waters, Zante is exactly how a holiday island should be. From the buzzing nightlife of Laganas to the family-friendly vibe of Tsilivi, there are holidays in Zante to suit just about everyone. Discover rugged countryside, the pretty port and charming Greek tavernas, or just kick back and enjoy the sunshine, beaches and pools.

The snack bar is open to all guests, offering local and international dishes, carefully prepared by staff always serving you with the biggest smile from the heart, making you feel like home.

description:
The centre of the ancient world, Greece is the perfect destination to visit some of the world’s most ancient monuments in their natural setting. Fly to Athens and spend three nights in the historic Greek capital. Cradled around the Acropolis for over two millennia, Athens is a vibrant city with unique nightlife, unforgettable hospitality and delicious authentic Greek cuisine.

Located in a typical 30’s modernist building, renovated with respect to its past, in line with the present and an eye on the future, the Athens One smart hotel, seamlessly blends old school charm with cutting edge technology and contemporary cool; an arty disposition and a dash of audacity, with an intimately cozy feel.

A holiday in Greece would not be complete without a visit to one of its beautiful islands Santorini. So from Athens take a flight to Santorini, where you will spend the next three nights of your vacation. The whitewash buildings with bright blue colored roofs, the unique beautiful architecture, the red and black sand beaches, the scenic beauty of natural landscapes, the sparkling seas under sun rays couple with perfect weather makes Santorini one of the most romantic destination.

In Santorini, you will be staying at the 4-star Aegean Plaza Hotel (Travellers' Choice 2022). One of the most prestigious hotels in Kamari, Aegean Plaza Hotel is located just 30 meters from the black sandy beach, close to a marvelous coast line full of restaurants, cafes, bars and all kind of shops. Aegean Hotel is following the unique Cycladic architecture combined with modern facilities and strict specifications even for the most demanding guest.

title: Experience An All Inclusive Luxury Stay In Rhodes
description:
Rhodes is the most popular of all the Greek Islands – and for good reason. Much loved by families and history buffs alike, an all inclusive holiday to Rhodes is a breathtaking mixture of beautiful beaches, eclectic culture and ancient history, with plenty of fun and year-round sunshine in the mix too. This stunning island has a chequered and fascinating past but it's particularly known for its role during the crusades. Today, a cosmopolitan flair is evident across the island, so an all inclusive Rhodes holiday is stylish and sophisticated as well as memorable and relaxing.

description:
Discover romance in its fullest bloom in Santorini, the most alluring of all Greek islands. The mesmerizing sight of the whitewashed Cycladic houses with the blue domed rooftops would linger on in your conscience forever. Soak in the sun on the white pristine beaches, savor your taste buds at some of the most amazing restaurants, relive history at some of the islands’ancient villages, and get mesmerized by the captivating views of the enigmatic Aegean Sea.

In Santorini you will spend 3 nights at The Aegean Plaza Hotel (Travellers' Choice 2023). The hotel is in a prime spot just minutes from the lively streets of Kamari and its charcoal-coloured shore. You can take your pick from three cooling pools or simply relax and unwind in one of the bubbling hot tubs. Thanks to the stylish pool bar, you don’t have to stray too far from your comfy lounger for a cocktail. If day trips are your thing, you’ve got the island’s capital less than a 20-minute drive away. Aegean Plaza hotel has more than 120 rooms with a decoration style that combines the minimal lines of the Santorinian architecture with charmy details everywhere.

Later you will visit another beautiful Greek island Mykonos. It is an island that guarantees that its visitors will have fun, no matter if they are worshippers of night life and intense emotions or the kind of travellers that wish to get to know the place, to visit sights such as archaeological sites, monuments, churches, picturesque settlements and familiarize with the tradition and life of the residents. Mykonos offers all the above and covers all expectations. The visitor of Mykonos, can enjoy a unique natural environment. There are beautiful coasts, white rural houses, windmills and small pigeon houses, but above all, friendly and smiling people.

Your stay in Mykonos will be at the 4 Star Vienoula's Garden (Travellers' Choice 2023). It is a family run hotel that offers a friendly atmosphere for a relaxing holiday in Mykonos.Lying in the region of Vryssi, at close proximity to Mykonos Town, Hotel Vienoula’s Garden is a welcoming Mykonos Town hotel where you will enjoy original Mykonian hospitality and care. The Vienoula's Garden Hotel in Mykonos Town is built according to the traditional architectural style of the island, in shades of white and blue and offers you the advantage of staying in a peaceful environment, close to the hustle and bustle of Mykonos Town and a short distance from Ornos Beach and Platis Gialos Beach. It is this advantageous location that makes Vienoula’s Garden Mykonos Hotel one of the most preferable hotels in Mykonos Town.

description:
A holiday in Crete, the largest of the Greek islands is the perfect choice for those who like to relax, but who don’t want to be too far from a bustling town and a vibrant night life. Set on the largest of the Greek islands, Crete holidays offer everything you could ever want from your perfect beach break. White-washed houses and epic views across the glittering Aegean Sea mean Bali, Crete holidays are like stepping into a postcard. A holiday in Crete most certainly means a trip to one of Crete’s beautiful beaches.

Bali in Crete is ideal for those wanting to enjoy a relaxing holiday spent soaking up the sun and immersing yourself in the warm local culture. Located on the northern coast of Crete, it’s ideally located for those who want to explore the local area and visit the many nearby towns. So whether you want to lounge on the beach, indulge in delicious Greek favourites like tzatziki and delicious fresh seafood, soak up the history and culture or try hiking and walking in the surrounding hills, you’ll find it all on holidays to Bali, Crete.

If you are looking for ultimate relaxation during your holiday then head for the Filion Suites Resort and Spa (Travellers' Choice 2021).  Surrounded by olive trees in the heart of the Cretan countryside lies the gorgeous 5-star Filion Suites Resort & Spa, the perfect choice for a relaxing escape to the incredible Greek Island. With a choice of outdoor pools, fantastic food, and an enchanting spa, you’ll be hard pressed to find a more luxury resort in such a beautiful spot.

Take a dip in one of the freshwater pools and let the kids swim in one of the children’s pools, leaving you with some well-earned peace and quiet! By staying at this hotel, you’ll be close to the small town of Bali, where you can visit a wide range of shops, restaurants and bars for a change of scenery.

Characterised by turquoise waters and shimmering sands, Corfu is like a fairy tale – beautiful to behold and offering something for every type of traveller. 

Its undulating mountainous terrain and spaghetti-like medieval lanes are perfect for intrepid explorers, while the sun-bleached beaches sitting adjacent to the glistening Ionian offer the perfect escape for sun-chasers. 

So what better way to experience this beautiful island than with a stay at a cosy, accommodating hotel? The four-star family-run Mareblue Beach Resort is nestled on one of the most beautiful beaches in Corfu – so prepare for early morning ocean dips and late afternoon strolls along the shoreline to become part of your routine.

There are also three different restaurants on-site, each boasting superlative views of the Ionian and Adriatic so you can watch as the ripples twinkle beneath the stars in the evening.  

With plenty of different types of cuisine to tuck into too, you’ll never go hungry.

title: Relaxing 7 Nights In Corfu With All Inclusive Stay
description:
Corfu’s no slouch in the beach department, with plenty of sand and pebble sweeps cosied up to the Ionian Sea. Pretty olive groves and cypress trees take over as you follow your feet inland, and you’re never far from an historic dot on the radar. When you enjoy an all inclusive Corfu holiday, you can relax with the amazing cuisine or explore to your heart’s content – Corfu can be as lively or as quiet as you want it to be.

Barbati is located near Pantokratoras mountain and offers a marvelous view over Corfu old town, the Venetian fortress and the far Albanian mountains. Barbati is enriched of lovely bays and hidden caves, perfect place for scuba divers, and has a beautiful white stones beach. Tourists can explore both sea and mountain as the place has been developed into two different areas. One is higher along the coast road with its bars and shops. The second part of Barbati is more tranquil, is surrounded by olive trees, many paths to follow many ways to explore a different part of the beach.

The 4* Golden Mare Barbati's (Travellers' Choice 2021) set on a hillside, offering panoramic views of Corfu's coast and mountains. This 4-star hotel makes superb holiday retreat in Corfu. After its grand opening in 2018, holidaymakers have been flocking from across the globe to check out this jaw-dropping hotel and its amazing facilities. Perfectly placed at arm’s reach of the Ionian Sea and the Pantokratoras mountain, there’s no end to the camera-worthy vistas. Expect the best of the best with contemporary interiors and lavish rooms anticipating your arrival. The facilities here are state-of-the-art with cooking lessons, whirlpool baths, a lagoon-style pool and gourmet restaurants making up the hotel’s biggest draws. Guests can reach the clear waters of Barbati Beach in just over 10 minutes on foot, or take the hotel shuttle to get there even faster.

The miles of glorious coastline, easy cycling, relaxing hot springs, ancient ruins and a lively nightlife make Kos holidays a popular choice for families, couples and individuals.

title: Package Holidays to Halkidiki
description:
The Greek peninsula of Halkidiki is a unique holiday destination. The dramatic natural landscapes across the region make it a popular place for anyone looking to get out and explore the countryside. Along the way, you can see some of the local birds and wildlife, and take in the sights from the mountains that sweep down to the perfectly blue waters of the Aegean Sea.  It is especially known for its lovely beaches, blue waters and rocky stretches that grace the shoreline.

There are plenty of things to see and do during your holidays to Halkidiki. The combination of mountain and sea provides endless opportunities for all kinds of adventure sports, from snorkeling to trekking.

During this holiday, your stay will be at the 5 Star Eagles Palace. With its magnificent surroundings Eagles Palace soars with many accolades as one of the best five-star resorts in Halkidiki. title: Luxury Crete Holidays 2019/2020
description:
A historically rich island, chockful of artefacts and ruins redolent of Ancient Greece, Crete has it all – from pearly-white beaches where you can lay about like a starfish from dawn ‘til dusk, to centuries-old settlements, caves and ruins which feature in history books. Crete is Greece’s largest island, home to a range of diverse terrains running through its core and surrounded by the twinkling Mediterranean. It’s the perfect place for a seven-night getaway if relaxing and unwinding is one of your top priorities. 

Here, olive groves, vineyards and fruit orchards trickle down mountainsides while idyllic beaches pepper the coastline and tall mountains sprout from the sea like jagged daisies. When it comes to plant life, thick forests collide with arid, cacti-filled areas to create a real hodgepodge of scenery.

If you’re an avid history buff, seek out ancient Minoan ruins sprinkled across the island and offering visitors a window into the past, such as the Palace of Knossos and the ruins of Gournia to name a couple. Other timeworn artefacts can be found in the remotest of villages. Stray off the beaten touristy track in search of “folklore" or “traditional house" museums and you’ll feel yourself transported back to the 19th century.

Crete’s landscapes are also characterised by olive trees and most villages are home to an olive pressing factory. Olive oil is the island’s “liquid gold” – used for cooking a wide range of traditional dishes which you’ll no doubt sample while you’re there. Other specialties include Greek-style yoghurt, teamed with sweet, lip-smacking golden honey drizzled on top. 

Your home away from home on this seven-night tour will be the I Resort Beach Hotel & Spa, nestled on the coast in the gorgeous village of Stalida. itinerary.title: AT LEISURE OR AN OPTIONAL FULL-DAY TOUR OF SANTORINI
itinerary.description:
Today will be at leisure OR enjoy an optional day trip to the island of Santorini – a sun-splashed slither of paradise full of rugged landscapes, whitewashed houses and glorious beaches. You’ll spend the day exploring and sightseeing. 

At 8 am, you’ll leave the port of Rethymno/Heraklion and head to Santorini – arrival time will be between 10.15 and 10.45 depending on where you’re going from. Your first stop on this sightseeing tour will be Oia, chockful of world-famous sites such as the Kaldera, as well as traditional churches and houses. Depart for Oia between 10.30 and 11.00 (depending on your location) and arrive between 10.50 and 11.30. 

Then, at 13.30, make your way from Oia to Fira, Santorini’s capital. This journey will only take 15 minutes and you can stay in Fira for one or three hours depending on the tour you’ve chosen. Here, you can feast your eyes upon the Kaldera’s impressive rock cliffs, stroll through picturesque villages and relish in its traditional architecture. You’ll even have the chance to haggle at the local market. 

Visitors can remain in Fira or head to the pebble-strewn seaside town of Perissa at around 15.15. You can spend two hours here and then head back to Crete. Departure from Perissa to Santorini port will be at 16.40 and you’ll make your way to the port of Rethymno at 17.30 (arrival in Rethymno will be at 19.45). For the other tour, you’ll depart from Perissa to Athinios Port at 16.40 and expect to reach Heraklion at 19.15.

title: Holidays To Mykonos
description:
Mykonos is undoubtedly the most glamorous of all the Cyclade islands. It is suave, yet contemporary. Cosmopolitan, yet serene. The glimpse of the stunning whitewashed buildings amidst the azure Aegean Sea is a sight to behold. Whether you are a party freak or a history buff, the choices seem unending. Stroll along those charming lanes, go cruising in the sea, and be a part of some of the most famous and relentless beach parties. Or why not just warm up to the beat, sip your Martini, while the sun slides down beyond the horizon!!!!

Your stay is at the supremely situated above the wonderful and scenic bay of Ornos, just 250 meters away from the golden sands of Ornos Beach in Mykonos, Mykonos Essence Hotel is located in a central spot that overlooks Ornos Bay and offers an immense panoramic view, towards the crystal clear light blue waters of the Aegean Sea.

After Mykonos take a ferry to the magical island of Crete. The days spent in this stunning Mediterranean paradise would be nothing short of pure bliss, as the island is a splendid amalgamation of some of the most pristine beaches, sleepy villages and historical landmarks such as the Ideon cave, considered to be the birthplace of Zeus, the Greek god of sky and thunder.

Pamper yourself in the lap of luxury at the Sentido Vasia Resort & Spa. The 5 Star property lies in the picturesque village of Sissi, and boats of a breathtaking view of the Cretan Sea and the majestic Lassithi Mountains. With the Limani Beach just 200m away, and the ancient Palace of Malia a bit further, the location can’t get any better!!!!! Boasting 7 pools, 4 restaurants and a kid’s club, the Sentido Vasia has always been a firm favorite with families.

title: Enjoy 7 Nights Mykonos Cruise
description: This Athens to Mykonos cruise offers an unparalleled blend of adventure, relaxation, and vibrant Greek culture. Starting from Laurium, you'll sail to breathtaking islands like Kea, Siros, Mykonos, and Kythnos, each offering unique experiences. Swim in crystal-clear waters at hidden coves like Makronisos, Rhenia, and Kolona Beach, and enjoy lively onboard parties with music, cocktails, and unmatched views. Explore charming villages such as Kea’s Vourkari and Siros’ Ermoupoly, indulge in local delicacies like Loukoumi and fresh seafood, and immerse yourself in the iconic Cycladic architecture of Mykonos. The journey is capped with Mykonos’ legendary nightlife, private cove stops, and a farewell celebration back in Laurium. With its perfect balance of culture, relaxation, and nonstop fun, this cruise creates memories that will last a lifetime.

itinerary.title: Athens
itinerary.description:
On day one, we board the vessel at around 14:00, and have a couple of drinks, just to start off.
We then, start getting to know each other better and of course, start off with the partying!
While we are staying for the first night at Laurium, we can choose between roaming around Laurium’s famous bar strip, or staying onboard!
It’s up to you!
Note: On the rare occasion of any issues that may result from late arrivals, there is a possibility that we do not depart from Athens on Saturday, but on Sunday instead.

itinerary.title: Athens - Kea
itinerary.description:
After our first day, we will enjoy our lovely brunch as we depart, heading to Kea’s Island complex, of course, accompanied by great music and loads of excitement!
During our trip, we’ll make a stop at Makronisos, to enjoy our first swim-stop in the crystal clear waters of the Aegean.
The trip to Kea will include our first cove party, though a chance to explore Kea’s most beautiful village, Vourkari, as well!

itinerary.title: Kea - Siros
itinerary.description:
We will leave Kea behind, as we sail to Siros, the capital of the Cyclades with the dynamic character and cosmopolitan grace of a queen!
Syros Island is famous for its capital Ermoupoly, its excellent restaurants and its delicious local/traditional sweets, Loukoumi (Turkish delight) and Halvadopita (a soft kind of nougat).

During our stay at Siros, and of course, after our scheduled daily swim-stop, it’s time to let the DJ do his thing!
Nothing better than an onboard summer afternoon-party in Greece!!
Dive into the sea if you feel you need to cool off, or grab a cocktail and just relax onboard, with the best party-company out there, as we are just getting started!

itinerary.title: Siros - Mykonos
itinerary.description:
This is the day! We leave Siros and head to our trip’s main highlight, Mykonos!
The stunning aesthetic hits you in between the eyes, and the island’s aura is just exceptional. Mykonos is literally packed with high-end shops and stores, worldwide famous clubs and bars and it is the dream of every young person who loves to socialize, party and dance!!

The island of winds, as Mykonos is called, is particularly picturesque with stone-paved alleys, whitewashed houses, country chapels and windmills that ooze calmness and peace!
Before you reach the mainland, enjoy a swim-stop at Rhenia and get ready to experience a combination of, on and off-boat parties, that will make up for a day you will remember for sure!

itinerary.title: Mykonos
itinerary.description:
On the fifth day, we will see all the great aspects of this beautiful Aegean Island, as we will roam around its Island complex while partying non-stop!

We will make a couple of private stops, where we will create some moments and after all the “celebrations” we anchor at some cove, where we will make it for the night!

itinerary.title: Mykonos - Kythnos
itinerary.description:
For the sixth day, the plan is to leave Mykonos and travel to Kythnos.
On our way, we will stop at Kolona beach for a relaxing swim and some sunbathing.
The Island’s name derives from the ancient Greek word “Kefthemon”, meaning a dim place to hide, since Kythnos was chosen by many as a hiding place from intruders and pirates of nearby settlements, during old days!
Kythnos is also well known, for its great local Greek seafood!
Of course, during our stay at Kythnos, we will make it count, as we will be stopping at different coves, during the day, just to have even further fun!

itinerary.title: Kythnos - Athens
itinerary.description:
After Kythnos, we slowly start to end our trip, as we sail back from where we initially departed from, Laurium!
We arrive at the port, early in the afternoon, though the fun does not stop there, as we have one remaining night to create our last moments!

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
As we have successfully cruised, to and around Mykonos, this is our departure day..
We say goodbye to each other, exchange info with the ones we got close to, take some last photos and head back!
Hopefully, though, we will see you again. Until then, we wish you all the best!

title: Holidays To Crete
description:
Enjoy sun-kissed Greece on a holiday in Mykonos, Santorini and Crete. Your holiday with start with 2-nights in Mykonos, one of the most popular islands, a whitewashed paradise in the heart of the Cyclades. It is particularly famous for the cosmopolitan atmosphere, the exciting nightlife, the picturesque Cycladic architecture and the magnificent beaches that makes holidays in Mykonos a magnificent experience.

On Mykonos you will be staying at the Mykonos Essence Hotel, your Ornos “home away from home.” Mykonos Essence Hotel aims to make your visit as relaxing and enjoyable as possible.

Your next stop is Santorini for 2-nights. Santorini, or Thira, is the top destination in Greece and among the most romantic destinations in the Greek islands and also in the world.   Picturesque villages teeter on the rocky sides and whitewashed Cycladic houses perfectly complement the famous blue domed rooftops of Santorini. You will be staying at the Orizontes Hotel & Villas, ideally situated between the town of Fira and Pyrgos village offering breathtaking panoramic views of Santorini Island, the renowned Caldera and Volcano, Fira, Oia, Akrotiri and the crystal clear blue waters of the Aegean. The hotel is build on top of a hill surrounded by vineyards and combines the traditional architecture of the Cycladic islands with modern interior design.

And on to Crete for the last 4-nights of your Greek adventure where you will stay at the 5 Star Bella Beach Hotel on an All Inclusive Board Basis. Located on the beautiful beach of the Cretan Sea, the Bella Beach Hotel is a five-star hotel complete with lush gardens, 3 swimming pools, a giant outdoor chess set and a host of other onsite activities available. For the more active, why not check out the tennis or basketball courts, the well equipped Fitness Studio, or simply chill out by the waters edge or Wellness Centre, the Bella Beach is a luxury resort covering all holiday aspects.

Situated on the northern coast of Crete, near Anissaras, the hotel enjoys a prime location afoot one of the prettiest beaches of the Mediterranean.

Walk hand in hand with history and visit some of its architectural masterpieces like the Acropolis and the Parthenon temple. A visit to Athens would seem incomplete without a visit to its shining jewels, the Acropolis museum and the National Archaeological Museum.

In Athens we've chosen Travelers' Choice 2022 Polis Grand Hotel . Polis Grand Hotel (Travelers' Choice 2022 ) is a luxury 4-star hotel located right in the heart of Athens. With its privileged location, Polis Grand provides unique accessibility to the historic sights and attractions of Athens.

After Athens, you will visit Santorini, possibly the most romantic and picturesque Greek Island, born from an ancient volcanic eruption, whose stupendous cliffs rise 900 feet from a half-moon caldera which also makes it a fascinating island to explore. Picturesque villages teeter on the rocky sides and whitewashed Cycladic houses perfectly complement the blue domed rooftops. In Santorini, you will be staying at the Aegean Plaza Hotel. It is ideally situated between the town of Fira and Pyrgos village offering breathtaking panoramic views of Santorini Island, the renowned Caldera and Volcano, Fira, Oia, Akrotiri and the crystal clear blue waters of the Aegean. The hotel is build on top of a hill surrounded by vineyards and combines the traditional architecture of the Cycladic islands with modern interior design.

The last 5 nights will be spent in Crete at the Travelers' Choice 2022 Hersonissos Hotel. The 4-star Heronissos Hotel is located in the mesmerising part of Hersonissos, close to Aquaworld Aquarium & Reptile Rescue Centre. Boasting close proximity to Church of Saint Paraskevi, this venue with air-conditioned rooms is ideal for fans of billiard, ping pong and golf or those willing to enjoy themselves in massage treatments, a wellness area and a spa area.

title: Enjoy 7 Night Corfu Cruise With Transfers
description:
Kick off your Greek island-hopping tour on the mainland of Corfu, taking some time to explore its Old Town (a UNESCO World Heritage Site) and picture-perfect architecture before setting sail to Mourtos, a small village on mainland Greece. 

Shortly after, you’ll proceed to Sivota, a tiny cluster of islands that are home to lush landscapes and the famous Blue Lagoon Bay.

You’ll then head to picturesque Parga, a resort town known for its natural environment. Feast your eyes on the crystal-clear bays fringing its main town and its iconic Venetian fortress before sampling local wine during a tasting session. 

After that, you’ll become acquainted with the sparkling beaches and bays of Antipaxos (a small yet breathtakingly beautiful island all the same) before heading to nearby Paxos and spending the following two days sampling sensational seafood at local taverns, whiling away the hours in Lakka village and soaking up the sun at the beach.

Wine and dine in traditional Greek taverns and enjoy a daily breakfast aboard the boat, as well as a delicious captain’s dinner

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN CORFU
itinerary.description:
We’ll set sail from the Old Port (NAOK Marina) after sunset, giving you plenty of time to explore Corfu Island during the day beforehand. Visit the UNESCO World Heritage town of Kerkyra (Corfu Old Town) and marvel at its cultural heritage. From the towering fortresses to narrow medieval streets, there are plenty of layers to Corfu’s history to unravel. If you have time to see more of the island, head to the fishing village of Agni Bay, the dramatic cliff drops of Cape Drastis, the picturesque channel of the Canal d’Amour and the community of Palaiokastritsa, a serene village that sits tucked away.

In the evening, you’ll settle into your home away from home for the next week, kicking off your stay with a delicious dinner in front of ocean views as we start sailing towards Kassiopi.

itinerary.title: MOURTOS AND SIVOTA ISLANDS
itinerary.description:
Today we’ll sail to the village of Mourtos and Sivota Islands, stopping off to marvel at their lush, verdant landscapes. There are thick forests, natural coves, green hills and olive groves that merge with crystalline waters and golden beaches.

You’ll have the chance to visit the striking Papanikolis Cave and the famous Blue Lagoon Bay where you can stop off for a swim. There’s also the option to go on a coach tour to Acheron River. Here, beside breathtaking landscapes and river views, learn how to prepare delicious traditional dishes (Moussaka and Tzatziki) during an optional cooking lesson with an expert chef. 

In the evening, you can stroll around the port village, wine and dine in one of the taverns lining the promenade and watch the sunset bleed into the horizon.

itinerary.title: PARGA
itinerary.description:
Today we’ll visit Parga, nestled on the Ionian coastline and described as one of the region’s most beautiful villages. It boasts two crystal-clear bays fringing its main town as well as an iconic Venetian fortress. 

The natural environment here is stunning and there will be ample opportunity for you to head to one of the beachside hangouts or try your hand at water sports (especially towards the west of Parga town). 

We’ll then have lunch on board and explore the town a little more during the evening, tucking into some of the region’s specialties. There’s also an optional wine tasting session today, taking place in an area of the museum and featuring five different wine types (red, rose, white, dry and sweet) to cater to everybody’s tastes. All of the wines will come from the islands of the Ionian Sea and the Western and North Western part of Greece – regions that are well-known for their wine production.

Please note: if we’re able to dock in the port, we won’t need to use a water taxi. However, if we do have to use one, this cost is not covered in the overall package.

itinerary.title: ANTIPAXOS
itinerary.description:
We’ll visit Antipaxos today, a small island near the larger island of Paxos. You’ll tuck into a delicious lunch before stopping off at some of the island’s beaches and bays, including Voutoumi and Vrika. 

Snorkel through beautiful blue waters, stroll along scenic clifftop routes and pay a visit to one of the three main towns (Gaios, Loggos and Lakka). 

We’ll then have some food at a pop-up beach tavern in a secluded bay before watching the starry sky from the deck of the yacht later on.

itinerary.title: PAXOS PT. 1
itinerary.description:
We’ll then venture to Paxos, home to white pebble-strewn shores, striking blue water and lush countryside. We’ll dock at Gaios Port and explore the island for a whole day, seeking out secluded coves, marveling at Venetian architecture and sampling the world-renowned olive oil native to the island’s groves. 

In addition to seeing how the fishermen operate day to day, you’ll also hunker down over “the best catch of the day” (some of the best and freshest seafood) at one of the local taverns.

itinerary.title: PAXOS PT. 2
itinerary.description:
Today, we’ll explore a different part of Paxos Island. First, enjoy lunch on board while we head towards the bustling Lakka, the second largest village on the island and set in a horseshoe bay against a backdrop of olive and cypress trees. 

Visit the pebble-strewn Kanoni Beach and sandy beach of Harami before strolling along the seafront promenade. There are plenty of bars and traditional taverns here in Lakka, giving the village a very authentic Greek feel. 

We’ll dock overnight at a picturesque bay here and in the evening you’ll enjoy a captain’s dinner. 

Please note: the vessel can’t dock in the marina here.

itinerary.title: BENITSES BEACH AND VILLAGE
itinerary.description:
Before making our way back to the mainland of Corfu, we’ll pay a visit to Benitses Beach and village on the east coast of the island, tucking into a tasty lunch on the way. 

Today you’ll also have the chance to go on a bus tour of Corfu. If you do decide you’d like to go on this tour, your first stop will be the KOUM KOUAT Distillery where you’ll watch a short presentation of the distilling process of the koum kouat (kumquat). 

You’ll then stop off at Achilleion Palace, a 19th century summer palace that boasts spectacular gardens. Afterwards, head to the Mouse Island viewpoint and then drive through Corfu Town, witnessing sites such as the Old Harbour, the Old Venetian Castle and Esplanade Square. There will be some free time at the end of the tour for you to explore Old Corfu. 

After strolling through the romantic Old Town, we’ll reach Markas, one of the oldest taverns in the Old Town and then watch traditional dancing while sampling some of Corfu’s local dishes during optional “Corfu Greek Night”. 

Spend the night in the marina of Corfu Old Town.

itinerary.title: RETURN TO CORFU MAINLAND
itinerary.description: Our tour ends today as we arrive back at Corfu mainland again. We hope you’ve enjoyed the cruise and fallen head over heels for the Greek islands!

accommodations.name: Ionian Cruise
accommodations.description:
Ionian Cruise

 The beautiful motorised ocean vessel accommodate up to 25 passengers with 11 cabins – operates the Ionian Cruise. We will spend a week at sea, exploring the very best of this island cluster paradise, stopping in Sivota, Parga, Antipaxos, Gaios and Lakka in a round trip from Corfu.

This trip is best suited for those who want to set sail for discovery, heritage and historical sightseeing, the best of nature and deserted beaches, on-deck sea-view unwinding and the friendly atmosphere of a small ship cruise.

The friendly crew will attend to all your needs along the way. There are freshly prepared meals (Breakfast and Lunch), and all cabins include a private bathroom and air-conditioning.

title: Luxury All Inclusive Stay In Beautiful Kos
description:
Situated in the southeastern waters of the Aegean Sea, Kos is the third largest of Greece's Dodecanese islands. From the sleepy resort of Kefalos, to the relaxed town of Tigaki, or the thriving party towns like Kardamena, a holiday to Kos offers a wealth of choice and variety. Holidaymakers love Kos' great weather and beaches, but those are not the only reasons to visit the Greek island. Kos features amazing ancient ruins like the 14th-century fortress at the entrance of Kos' main harbour. There is also ancient Agora, which was a marketplace once considered as one of the world's largest.

Blue Domes Resort & Spa, a member of Mitsis Premium Collection, is a 5-star plus hotel opened in 2010, offering an incredible range of leisure facilities, superb cuisine and 499 beautifully furnished guest rooms, bungalows, villas, family rooms and maisonettes all combined to make an ideal holiday hideaway for discerning travelers.

The hotel is located just a one minute walk from the beach and for those looking for a livelier atmosphere, Kardamena Town is less than five miles away. The hotel boasts a comprehensive animation program and four a la carte restaurants (including Greek, Italian, Asian and Mexican). With an additional six standard restaurants, plus loads of activities for children, it’s clear to see why the Mitsis Blue Domes Resort & Spa is much more than your typical all inclusive holiday resort.

title: Enjoy 7 Night Zante Cruise
description:
Located just off the west coast of mainland Greece, Zakynthos enjoys a reputation as both a party destination and a family-friendly getaway. Packed with foreign tourists along its eastern and southeastern coastline, the island also features numerous tranquil pockets in its central region of forested mountains and rolling hills.

The northern capes of the island also offer the calmest waters, which lap a string of developed beaches with plenty of modern facilities.

Kick off your Greek island-hopping tour on the island of Zante, taking some time to explore the wonders of Zante Island. In the evening, with a view of the ocean sail towards Agios Nikolaos. Shortly after, you’ll proceed to centrally located, beautiful and unspoilt Agia Ethimia.

You’ll then head to Ithaca (Vathi) and after that will visit Meganisi where you can enjoy snorkelling in the turquoise waters, feel the pebbles under your feet.

After Meganisi head to Fiskardo which is one of Greece’s best-kept secrets. Later you will visit Poros, Greece’s well-kept secret. Full of bars and tavernas Poros is the epitome of old school Greek charm.
