itinerary.title: ARRIVE BUENOS AIRES
itinerary.description:
Your journey of a lifetime begins in Buenos Aires. On arrival at the airport, you’ll be met with a friendly “Hola” from your Argentine host and transferred to the hotel for a memorable stay. It is recommended that you spend your first day at leisure recovering from your international journey.

Buenos Aires is la Capital, where a sultry tango heats up the “milongas” (dance halls), young men holler at gargantuan soccer stadiums, and taxis dart across the world’s widest avenues; if you’re looking to for escapism and culture, then nowhere does it better than this elegant metropolis, where the porteños, as the inhabitants are called, move to a rhythm of their own. On this journey, you will experience the very essence of South America and its heady potion of Latino romance and excitement. 

OVERNIGHT IN BUENOS AIRES

itinerary.title: BUENOS AIRES
itinerary.description:
Buenos Aires defines “sizzle”… and you’ll see why when a local guide on a half day tour shows you the city, also known as “Paris of South America”. After breakfast, you will start your adventure by arriving at the monumental Palacio del Congreso (National Congress Palace), whose great dome looms above a tapestry of patriotic sculptures and époque fountains. Next up is a visit to the Civic Centre at Plazo de Mayo, Metropolitan Cathedral and Casa Rosada (Pink House) where you’ll see the balcony made famous by Evita Perón. You will also visit the grand Cabildo, used during the colonial era. 

Proceed to the Teatro Colon, ranked the third best opera house in the world by National Geographic.

San Telmo offers a fascinating contrast: here, you will walk the narrow, cobbled streets and pass the colonial-style homes and hip bars. Stop at the La Boca neighbourhood, which is both a working class “barrio” and artist colony. Walking the city’s youngest and least conventional barrio, Puerto Madero, you'll see that the old brick warehouses have been converted into some of the city’s trendiest buildings. Continue to the botanical wonders of Palermo Gardens and the fashionable shops in Recoleta.

OVERNIGHT IN BUENOS AIRES

itinerary.title: BUENOS AIRES
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, enjoy the entire day at leisure to immerse in the cultural splendours of this fascinating city setting as you wish. Why not spice up your evening with our optional Tango show? Experience one of the best tango shows in Buenos Aires, along with a traditional Argentine feast. The passionate, sensual dance will sweep you away as you learn about the history of the tango show, its music and traditions. The satin dress rises and falls, flows and ebbs, creating light and shadows across the stage, like waves on the shore. During this precious moment, the world stops as body and soul become one.

OVERNIGHT IN BUENOS AIRES

itinerary.title: BUENOS AIRES – FOZ DO IGUACU
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, take a private transfer to Buenos Aires Airport and board your flight to Puerto Iguazu . Arrive at Cataratas del Iguazú International Airport, where you’ll be transferred with a guide to the hotel. We will do the Iguazu Falls visit on Day 5 from the Brazilian side (inclusive in the price) however, you also have the opportunity to join our optional tour below to witness the fall from the Argentinian side.

Experience the Energy of Iguazu Falls in Argentina

Before crossing the border into Brazil, you can opt to experience the Argentinian side of Iguazu Falls. Enjoy a walk along the Falls Trail and view the waterfall from different angles until you arrive at the walkways that give you a close up look at La Garganta del Diablo (Devil’s Throat). This is just the beginning of what is to come: 275 falls of raging water and splendid grandeur!

OVERNIGHT IN FOZ DO IGUACU

itinerary.title: FOZ DO IGUACU
itinerary.description:
“Unlike Any Waterfall on Earth” – CNN

Iguazu translates as “the big water” in the language of the Tupi-Guarani natives and in a hidden corner of Paraná, facing 275 falls of raging water that rise dramatically from the Iguazu River, the city of Iguaçu is set against a backdrop of great natural beauty.

You might have visited other magnificent waterfalls before, but nothing will prepare you for when you come face to face with the world’s largest waterfall system. Taller than Niagara Falls and twice as wide, Iguazu Falls, named a UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site, claimed another title as one of the “New Seven Wonders of Nature” by the New Seven Wonders of the World Foundation in 2011. 

Magic is in the air as we arrive at the Visitors’ Centre. Discover one of nature’s greatest wonders as you behold the sight of a rainbow stretching its transparent rays over the group of monsters frothing at the mouth. Even the late U.S First Lady Eleanor Roosevelt was so impressed when she saw the spouting giants that she said “Poor Niagara!” Explore the splendour of the falls, walking along grated walkways of metal and climbing steps as you view the thundering water.

OVERNIGHT IN FOZ DO IGUACU

itinerary.title: FOZ DO IGUACU– RIO DE JANEIRO
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, you will get transfer to Foz do Iguaçu International Airport for a flight to Rio de Janeiro Airport. On arrival, you will be picked up by guided private transfer to Copacabana. When it comes to Rio de Janeiro, there is no better way to describe the magic of this enchanting Brazilian city then with the words of composer Andre Filho; “Rio de Janeiro is filled with thousands of charms”. As you make your way into the Wonderful City, breathtaking vistas appear; a mystical landscape headed by the towering Corcovado Mountain, adorned with the 30 metres tall Christ the Redeemer, with outstretched arms welcoming you to the dazzling treasures below.

OVERNIGHT IN RIO DE JANEIRO

itinerary.title: RIO DE JANEIRO
itinerary.description:
Great travel writer, Jan Morrison, wrote on her first visit to the city, “Great God! I will swap you a dozen prim and thrifty boroughs for one such lovely great heart!” Now it’s your turn to be seduced.

After breakfast, set off via transfer and drive to the summit of Corcovado, where Christ himself stands high above, arms outstretched over truly inspiring views of the city and sea. The journey takes you through the Tijuca Atlantic Forest en route to your hilltop destination, brimming with flora and fauna. Soak up the view of the beaches below, smeared with the haze of spray that half obscures the islands beyond. Look down at the white yachts appearing and disappearing into the Atlantic.

OVERNIGHT IN RIO DE JANEIRO

itinerary.title: RIO DE JANEIRO
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, enjoy an excursion to the  Sugarloaf: A Panoramic Adventure from City to Peak

Rio’s zest for life is reflected in this panoramic tour. Discover the city’s passion for “Carnaval” at the Sambodrome and stop at the Metropolitan Cathedral which stands like a pyramid 300 feet high. Stroll through traditional Cinelândia Square. Finally, we’ll head to Urca to visit the world famous Sugar Loaf Mountain.

Accessible only by cable car or climbing routes from the neighbourhood of Urca, Sugarloaf Mountain is a captivating 395 metre peak that will surely bring out your photography skills. Guanabara Bay’s gin-clear waters flow below and over rocky slopes whilst views encompass emerald-clad hills, the open waves of the Atlantic Ocean and Rio’s sparkling beaches. A two-stage cable car ride will whisk you to the summit. First stage leaves street level to the top of the Urca Hill for a closer look of the city. Taking a second cable car, the final stage is completed with views that will take your breath away!

OVERNIGHT IN RIO DE JANERIO

itinerary.title: RIO DE JANEIRO
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, today is dedicated to reclaiming your sense of self. Whether choosing to chill out on the white sands of Copacabana or Ipanema beach, chilling at the hotel’s pool or claiming a sunbed for the day, this is the ideal place for drifting off within an oasis of pure magic. Alternatively, you may wish to visit the Botanical Gardens or the beautiful Rodrigues de Freitas Lagoon.

In the evening, you may choose an optional Ginga Tropical Show. Enjoy a perfectly Brazilian combination of dinner followed by a Ginga show. Round trip transportation also be provided from hotel.

OVERNIGHT IN RIO JANERIO

itinerary.title: RIO DE JANERIO – UK
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, enjoy a day at leisure. If you’re feeling energetic, step outside into the legendary fizz of Rio. On the steps of the Teatro Municipal, you will surely find a band striking up with dancers hips swaying in time to the rhythm…the perfect ending to your South American odyssey! It is time to head home via transfer to the airport for a flight back to the UK.

END OF TOUR

title: Wonders of Ecuador and the Galapagos
description: This 12-day Ecuador and Galapagos adventure begins with arrival in Quito, a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its colonial charm and cultural significance. After acclimating and receiving a welcome briefing, the journey continues with a flight to the Galapagos Islands, exploring Isabela Island’s volcanic landscapes, snorkeling through lava tunnels, hiking the Sierra Negra volcano, and kayaking around Tintoreras Islet. Visits to the Charles Darwin Research Station and the Santa Cruz highlands offer insights into conservation efforts and encounters with giant tortoises. Returning to mainland Ecuador, the itinerary includes exploring Quito, hiking around Cotopaxi Volcano, and experiencing Baños with activities like biking through cloud forests and visiting the iconic Swing at the End of the World. The adventure intensifies with canyoning and jungle treks in the Amazon, staying with a Kichwa indigenous family, followed by thrilling whitewater rafting on the Jatunyacu River. The trip concludes with a relaxing soak in the Papallacta hot springs before departure, leaving travelers with unforgettable memories of Ecuador’s diverse landscapes and vibrant wildlife.

itinerary.title: Arrival In Quito
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Quito! The largest, best-preserved colonial city of America – declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1978. The city is considered the Cultural Capital of South America and is located on the equator in a valley at the foothills of the Pichincha volcano.

Depending on arrival time, you can spend your day exploring the old town of Quito and the surrounding area. We can help you to organize a day trip (please request in advance). In the evening, one of our trip leaders will meet you at the hotel’s lobby for a welcome briefing at 18:00 hours. At this time we will discuss the details and questions you may have regarding the adventure. Our first day is an acclimation and information day.

itinerary.title: Arrive In Galapagos - Isabela Island
itinerary.description:
Today we get ready to explore the most amazing archipelago in the Pacific coast and the place where Charles Darwin based his theory on the evolution of species. We will board a morning flight from Quito to the island of Baltra. Once we arrive, we head to the town of Puerto Ayora, the largest town in the Galapagos. From here we will take a quick boat to the largest island in the archipelago and where most of the volcanic activity in the Galapagos is reported. The island was formed by six shield volcanoes, Alcedo, Cerra Azul, Darwin, Ecuador, Sierra Negra and Wolf; five of them are still active which makes the island one of the most volcanically active places on earth.

Galapagos Islands are located 600 miles (965.6 km) from the coast of Ecuador, it is really important to understand that you will have to take air, road and sea transportation to get there.

itinerary.title: Snorkel at Lava Tunnels
itinerary.description:
Explore the amazing formations of lava created by the last eruptions of the volcanic island along the seashore. This magical place has historically been filmed by BBC and National Geographic for their documentaries. It is a labyrinth of lava arches made of crystal clear water full of sea turtles, eagle rays, sea lions, sharks and more. The turtles navigate their own highway from the mangroves to the open sea through “Los Tuneles”. Here, we will have the best snorkeling opportunity with all these beautiful animals, including the curious Galapagos penguins playing around.

Before or after the trip, you can enjoy some optional activities such as snorkeling at “Concha de Perla”, biking or just relaxing on the exotic white-sand beaches of Isabela Island. We recommend you to take some time to visit the giant tortoise breeding center located walking distance from the hotel.

itinerary.title: Hike Sierra Negra And Kayak In Las Tintoreras
itinerary.description:
After driving up from Puerto Villamil to the trail head, we will prepare our backpacks for the hike into a young forest ecosystem, a world of recent geological history. Our destination is the rim of Sierra Negra Crater, an active volcano which last erupted in June 2018.

Upon arrival, we take in breathtaking views and explore the circumference of the massive, lava-filled crater, a caldera that is over six miles across at its widest point. If we feel energetic enough, we can continue our hike to Volcan Chico, a secondary crater that has a wild landscape of puffing fumaroles and colorful lava formations; great examples of the dramatic geological events that have formed the Galapagos Islands over millennia. In the afternoon we will visit Tintoreras Islet, located at a short distance from Puerto Villamil and home to a great variety of wildlife. Its turquoise, crystalline waters are inhabited by white-tipped reef sharks, Galapagos Penguins, marine turtles and sea lions. One of its beaches, surrounded by mangroves, is one of the few sites where marine iguanas can reproduce successfully.

itinerary.title: Charles Darwin Research Station - Highlands
itinerary.description: In the morning, traverse from Isabela to Santa Cruz Island to visit the Charles Darwin Research Station. Once we arrive, we will check in at the hotel. We will then visit the Charles Darwin Research Station to Learn more about many of the endemic species seen in the wild, as well as the ongoing conservation and management efforts on the Galapagos Islands. In the afternoon, we will head to the ‘Primicias’ reserve in the highlands of Santa Cruz, home to the famous Galapagos tortoises. Hiking through Primicias’ beautiful landscape with these lumbering giants is an unforgettable experience! We will also see other highland wildlife such as pintail ducks, egrets, flycatchers, finches and frigatebirds, which gather to wash the salt off their feathers at a freshwater lake. Afterwards, return to Puerto Ayora to spend the evening in Galapagos’ most populous town.

itinerary.title: Flight Back To Quito
itinerary.description: After our final breakfast on the Galapagos Island and the last photos taken of sea lions, we have a transfer to Baltra’s airport in time to catch the flight back to the mainland.

itinerary.title: Free Day In Quito
itinerary.description: Today is a day on your own to explore the beautiful surroundings of Quito or We can help you to organize a day trip like COLONIAL CITY TOUR & THE EQUADOR LINE MINDO CLOUD FOREST OTAVALO MARKET FAIR.

itinerary.title: Hike in Cotopaxi
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, we leave Quito driving southwards along the gorgeous Avenue of Volcanoes, getting the chance to see the colorful Andean fields. On our way, we will reach 12,000 feet. (3657 meters). After arriving at the Cotopaxi National Park, we will go hiking around Limpiopungo lagoon of the foothills of the Rumiñahui volcano. From here, we have the best views of Cotopaxi, the highest active volcano in the world.

In the afternoon we continue our drive towards the Llanganates National Park, known as the sacred mountain, until we reach the town of Baños, located at the entrance of the Amazon. Here we can enjoy the best night life by drinking cocktails and dancing salsa.

itinerary.title: Biking In The Cloud Forest
itinerary.description:
This morning we cross country mountain biking from the Llanganates National Park down to the Pastaza River Canyon, enjoying the beauty of the special cloud rainforest climate. The road brings us through some Andean farms and a great canyon with many waterfalls.

While descending into the jungle, we will have a breath-taking view of Baños, a town well known for its spectacular location right at the foothills of the Tungurahua volcano, which has been active since 1999. The volcano is the main attraction of this region. In the afternoon we will have some time to explore the town and also go to The Swing of the End of the World, where the winner of the 2014 National Geographic photo contest took his photo.

itinerary.title: Canyoning In The Amazon - Pimpilala
itinerary.description:
This morning we will hit the road of the waterfalls. The first stop will be at the Bride’s Veil waterfall, where we will take the Tarabita (cable car) to get across the Pastaza River. Then we will hike down to the Pailon del Diablo waterfall, the second highest in Ecuador.

Later, we will go deeper into the jungle inside the Llanganates National Park. The name “llanganates” comes from “beautiful mountain” in the local native language. Here, 600 years ago, the Incas hid their golden treasures. Many explorers have spent years looking for these treasures, some have even disappeared with no luck in this dense pristine jungle.

During a hike through the tropical rainforest, we will climb through several waterfall canyons. Our local native guide will teach about the incredible flora and fauna that thrive in this unequaled habitat.

We will spend the night at the Local Basic Jungle Lodge run by a kichwa indigenous family.

NOTE – This is a very basic accommodation, you will have your own room but will have to share the bathroom. The rooms are very clean and all the beds have mosquito nets. There is no electricity in the room but there is a social area where you can have access to power to charge your batteries.

itinerary.title: Rafting In The Amazon
itinerary.description:
We greet the day by preparing our gear to paddle the wild waves of the Jatunyacu River, located just a 5 minute drive from the homestead. The beauty of this river will inspire you and reveal the magic of the Amazon rainforest. After a very important safety briefing from our rafting guides, we will start our class III rafting expedition down the Jatunyacu River, well known for its clear waters and awesome rapids. We will have a lot of fun playing some games and also exploring one of the canyons. The end of the journey offers us a stop for a picnic, prepared by our guides.

We conclude our day with a drive back up to the Andes to a spot called Papallacta, where we will stay the night and recharge in the volcanic hot springs high in the midst of the cool Andes.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: International departures, end of services. Take with you memories and photos and leave a piece of your heart, as you will want to return to Ecuador soon to experience more of this enchanted land. We wish you a “buen viaje”!

description:
A trip to Morocco wouldn’t be complete without a visit to Marrakech or the “Red City”. The name given from the ancient red walls which surrounds the city. This lively city, with its maze-like Medina (old quarters), is also home to the largest traditional market in the world, including the famous Djemaa el Fna, Koutoubia Mosque, Saadian Tombs and some of the renowned UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Famously known as the city of palaces, tombs, markets and various entertainments, Marrakesh is a great treat for the senses. Immerse yourself in its many alleys and markets, and the action packed Djemaa El-Fna square at the city centre on this Marrakech holiday, which is enough to keep you busy and entertained for an entire day.

Your stay during this holiday will be at the 4 star The Riad Fatouma. The Riad Fatouma is a real gem when it comes to finding that perfect affordable holiday to Marrakech. Located within close proximity of the city centre, guests won’t have to venture too far to find many of the top attractions on offer here. Better still, this hotel ensures that guests experience a touch of luxury with high-quality accommodation, a hearty breakfast each morning and a level of service that will leave guests relaxed and at ease. If guests are looking for the perfect base from which they can explore the wonders of Marrakech, then the Riad Fatouma has it all covered.

description:
Vibrant, colourful and fantastically diverse, Morocco represents a heady potion of cultural explosions, authentic simplicity, visual delights and everlasting tradition. No place represents Morocco better than Marrakech, “Morocco’s most intoxicating city”. A city packed with potion sellers, snake charmers, acrobats, colourful spices and smoky aromas drifting out from the souks.

The “Red City” is an exotic fusion of sizzling nostalgia and passion with images of scarlet sunsets and Aladdin carpets. Its rouge-coloured walls lead to a rich textured landscape of the Erg Chebbi’s desert and the mountain valleys and gorges of Dades.

Cater to every desire by catching a free shuttle bus to the dazzling Djemaa el Fna’s, where stalls of silver lamps glisten with genies inside waiting to lavish riches for wishes. Ramble along the Medina’s intricate medieval streets, before discovering the palaces of Fes and Meknes.

This charming 5-star resort hypnotizes with its beautiful design that draws inspiration from 10th century palaces. The most striking elements are the two superb lounges with carved stucco Domes, intricate zellij patterns, white marble and bohemian crystal that make a breath-taking ensemble. The hotel’s lavishly decorated guestrooms are spread over 6 riads built around lush courtyards replete with aromatic flowers and shimmering fountains.

title: Explore Kenya’s Bush Beaches And Cities (Nairobi Mombasa)
description:
Kenya Beach Holidays - During this ten day African adventure, you’ll experience Kenya in all its glory, hopping from the cities of Nairobi and Mombasa to the rolling plains of the Masai Game Reserve and Lake Nakuru National Park (and hopefully making some furry friends along the way!).  

Kenya is a bold, unparalleled and majestic land where beasts roam, birds soar and plants glitter beneath the glare of the African sun. Wedged between Somalia to the north east and Tanzania to the south, Kenya is widely recognised as a hotspot for wildlife viewing and safaris, offering visitors an unforgettable glimpse into how the local animals operate in their natural habitat. 

Once you’ve touched down in Kenya, your first stop will be Nairobi, the undisputed safari capital of Africa. On the second day of your trip you’ll head to Masai Mara.  Wonderful creatures await you in the Masai Mara Game Reserve (the northern extension of the Serengeti) whose rolling plains form a playground for the “Big Five”; lions, leopards, elephants, rhinos and buffaloes. These breath-taking beasts will stalk their prey or frolic playfully before your eyes, doing so to a soundtrack of chirps from the some 470 different species of birds which are present in the Masai Mara. Keep your eyes peeled for leopards and cheetahs during your safari drives too and prepare for the guide to talk your ear off about all these wonderful species.

After Masai Mara visit Lake Nakuru National Park which hosts the largest population of rhinos, as well as huge colonies of flamingos which often turn the shores a bright shade of pink. An overnight stay in this glorious park will give you plenty of time to marvel at the Makalia waterfalls and spot Thomson gazelles, impalas, leopards and buffaloes lurking in the thicket.

Next you’ll spend a full four days in the enchanting metropolis of Mombasa, Kenya’s second largest city whose border with the Indian Ocean makes for some out-of-this-world beaches, spellbinding marine life and high-end hotel stays. Lest you be bound to a strict itinerary, your time in Mombasa can be spent however you please (with the option of a city tour available if you so desire). Whether you choose to meander around the Old Town, try your hand at bird watching at Mtwapa Creek or catch the latest Bollywood smash hit at the Nyali Theatre, Mombasa has something to please everyone in your party. It is also home to golden, sandy beaches and swaying palms – perfect for anyone who puts R and R at the top of their holiday priority list!

itinerary.title: NAIROBI TO MASAI MARA GAME RESERVE
itinerary.description:
After a hearty breakfast check out from the city hotel and gather at the reception for safari briefing from the guides. The drive from Nairobi to Masai Mara via Narok passes down the Rift Valley through Kikuyu escarpment with fine views of the Kedong Valley and Mounts Suswa and Longonot. Enjoy stopovers at the scenic Great Rift Valley viewpoint and Narok town. Arrive in Masai Mara Game Reserve and enjoy a short game before you check in to your hotel. After lunch, relax before embarking on your afternoon game-drive in the park lasting until evening at 6pm when the Reserve closes.

Optional Afternoon Visit to a Masai Cultural Village: This afternoon release your inner Masai dancer! Sport some traditional African costumes alongside the rest of the dancers and move to the rhythm of African beats, a refreshing and welcome change from the usual chart-toppers you’re used to.

LUNCH, DINNER & OVERNIGHT IN MASAI MARA

itinerary.title: FULL DAY IN MASAI MARA GAME RESERVE
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel you’ll head off for three game drives with picnic lunch boxes. Make the most of morning, afternoon (with lunch) and evening game drives in the Masai Mara Game Reserve. The Mara is the northern extension of the Serengeti and houses hundreds of exotic species and intriguing wildlife, deep within its rolling plains. You’ll stay overnight at the Mara Simba Lodge and will have breakfast, lunch and dinner in the Masai Mara OR take an optional Masai Mara Balloon Ride: If you do decide to head off on a balloon safari, you’ll go in the early morning after being picked up from your hotel by the Balloon Company at 5.30 am. You’ll drive to the balloon launch site and take off gliding over the plains, while the sun slowly trickles over the horizon. After about an hour you’ll land and have breakfast nearby. Feast your eyes on a platter of bacon, sausages, eggs, exotic Kenyan fruits and homemade pastries, topped off with a glass of bubbly to toast the flight, a tradition initiated by the Montgolfier brothers.

OVERNIGHT IN MASAI MARA

itinerary.title: MASAI MARA GAME RESERVE TO LAKE NAKURU NATIONAL PARK
itinerary.description:
Enjoy an early morning game drive before a hearty breakfast at the hotel.  You’ll depart for Lake Nakuru National Park, famous for its population of vibrant pink flamingos which adorn the shores. The lake is shallow, alkaline and located in Kenya’s Rift Valley, boasting an area of 62 km2. As you make your way from Masai Mara to Lake Nakuru, you’ll pass by the Rift Valley and marvel at views of the Kedong Valley and Mounts Suswa and Longonot. You will enjoy a late morning Game Drive upon arrival in Lake Nakuru.

With picturesque landscape consisting of rocky cliffs, squelchy marshlands and areas of sedge, you’ll soon be falling in love with this beautiful African country. Post lunch, head for another game drive in Lake Nakuru.

You’ll stay overnight and have lunch and dinner in Nakuru, feasting on superb African delights.

title: Stunning South Africa Getaway
description:
From its fabulously lush national parks to its world-famous vineyards around Stellenbosch and Franschhoek, South Africa is a destination in a league of its own. Home to a whopping seven World Heritage Sites and one-of-a-kind flora and fauna, South Africa harbours plenty of must-sees and thrill-seeking activities.Mingle with terrifying Great White Sharks in Gansbaai, attend the distinctively South African social gathering known as the “braai” or gaze at the gentle giants of the ocean at Hermanus.

First we’ll drop in to Johannesburg, the largest city in the country and probably the world’s largest man-made urban forest with around 6 million trees wedged amongst iron-clad, bulbous skyscrapers. Tours around the Jo’burg metropolis include driving through Lion Park for some game viewing of big majestic cats and visiting the Gold Reef City amusement park before setting off for the captivating Kruger National Park, one of Africa’s largest game reserves.

Covering an area of 7,523 square miles, Kruger promises plenty of animal eye-candy and photo opportunities. Venturing down to the southern part of the park will place you directly in “Big Five” territory. (And if you’re unfamiliar with that term, the “Big Five” refers la crème de la crème of African flora and fauna, including lions, leopards, elephants, rhinos and buffaloes.)

Next, we’ll make our way to Cape Town, perched on the Western Cape Province and replete with sprawling plazas and burgeoning nightlife. Named “the best place in the world to visit” in 2014 by The New York Times and The Daily Telegraph, Cape Town plays host to the 36-hectare Kirsten Bosch National Botanical Garden (a UNESCO World Heritage Site) and the colourful Bo-Kaap neighbourhood or “Malay Quarter”.

But perhaps its most iconic feature, one which is plastered over postcards far and wide, is the glorious Table Mountain which you’ll scale via cable car during one of our breath-taking tours. You’ll also visit scenic Robben Island off the coast of Cape Town and chock-full of perky African penguins frolicking about in the water – a real treat to see!

itinerary.description:
After a hearty hotel breakfast, proceed for the Lesedi Cultural Village Tour (Lunch included). Experience this tour full of traditional culture. On this visit, you will discover the Zulu's and why they like the fighting sticks, the Xhosa with their trademarks blankets and the drums and whistles of the Pedi people just to mention a few. Once at Lesedi the atmosphere changes to a traditional set up where you get to see the homesteads in their historical designs. Finally, you will experience an amazing multi-cultural dance show. As the sun sets over the African bush, you’re escorted to the Boma for a very interactive affair of traditional singing and dancing, which depict stories dating back to the days of their ancestors. Thrill to the amazing spectacle of Lesedi`s Giant Ngoma, a multi-cultural dance display that will teach you more about our fascinating traditions. Return back to the hotel and relax.

OVERNIGHT IN JOHANNESBURG

itinerary.title: JOHANNESBURG -  HAZYVIEW (NEAREST TOWN TO KRUGER NATIONAL PARK)
itinerary.description:
Take a private transfer to Hazyview, the nearest town to Kruger National Park.We’ll set off for Kruger National Park after breakfast, one of Africa’s oldest and largest reserves and boasting a tremendous variety of game, including “The Big Five”. Watch elephants, giraffes, zebras, buffalo, lions, hyenas, warthogs and impalas frolic within the plains. You should also see baboons, hippos, kudus, monkeys, water bucks, wildebeest, bush babies, mongooses, duikers, steenboks, klip springers and bats too. There’s a chance you might also catch sight of leopards, wild dogs, cheetahs, antelopes, foxes, rhinos, honey badgers, porcupines, rebooks, aardvarks and aardwolves. Upon arrival you’ll check in to the lodge.

OVERNIGHT IN HAZYVIEW

itinerary.title: KRUGER NATIONAL PARK
itinerary.description:
Today you’ll get a closer look at some of the mesmerizing animals mentioned above during a full-day game drive. Take plenty of photos and prepare for your jaw to hit the floor as you get up close to some of Africa’s most beautiful wildlife. 

OVERNIGHT IN HAZYVIEW

itinerary.title: HAZYVIEW  - JOHANNESBURG - CAPE TOWN
itinerary.description:
Following breakfast you’ll head to OR Tambo Airport ready for your flight to Cape Town. Upon arrival, one of our representatives will meet you and take you to the hotel.

OVERNIGHT IN CAPE TOWN

itinerary.title: CAPE TOWN - CITY TOUR
itinerary.description:
Breakfast will be followed by a half-day tour of Mother City, kicking off with a scenic coastal drive through Clifton and Sea Point and later passing the Houses of Parliament, the Castle and the SA Museum. You’ll also see District Six, Bo-Kaap, Slave Lodge and Green market Square before taking a cable car ride (entrance is included) up the exquisite Table Mountain (should the weather be too bad this will change to Signal Hill), offering breath-taking views of the city. Then return to your hotel and enjoy an overnight stay. 

OVERNIGHT IN CAPE TOWN

itinerary.title: CAPE TOWN - PENINSULA TOUR
itinerary.description:
After a delicious hotel breakfast, you’ll set off on a full-day tour of the Cape Peninsula to witness la crème de la crème of this marvellous region, dubbed often as the Fairest Cape. You’ll make your way past Sea Point, Camps Bay and the famous beaches of Clifton and Llandudno towards Hout Bay, driving along the Atlantic Seaboard and passing through Noordhoek and Scarborough. 

Afterwards, you’ll visit the Cape of Good Hope Nature Reserve and enjoy a funicular ride aboard the “Flying Dutchman” and its spectacular views. You’ll also be able to take some pictures at the second southernmost tip of the African continent and also stroll along the exquisite Boulders Beach, home to a colony of Jackass Penguins. 

You’ll have a quick stopover at the naval port of Simon’s Town and learn about the Royal Navy’s Great Dane Dog, “Able Seaman Just Nuisance”, before returning to the hotel.

OVERNIGHT IN CAPE TOWN

itinerary.title: CAPE TOWN – ROBBEN ISLAND TOUR
itinerary.description:
You’ll kick off today with a hotel breakfast and a tour of the Robben Island museum (weather permitting) before heading back to your hotel. 

OVERNIGHT IN CAPE TOWN

itinerary.title: CAPE TOWN
itinerary.description:
After having breakfast at the hotel, you’ll be able to rest and unwind at your hotel for the remainder of the day. Should you decide you’d like to see more of the Cape Town area OR you may also choose an optional sky diving or wine tasting available at an additional supplement.

OVERNIGHT IN CAPE TOWN

itinerary.title: DEPARTURE
itinerary.description:
You’ll be escorted to Cape Town International Airport after breakfast OR you may extend your trip by taking an optional tour to Victoria Falls.  

We hope you’ve enjoyed exploring stunning South Africa!

END OF TOUR

title: Southern Africa Aboard The African Dream Travel To The Ends Of The Earth
description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey through the breathtaking landscapes and rich cultural tapestry of Southern Africa with CroisiEurope's "Travel to the Ends of the Earth" tour. This carefully curated expedition combines luxurious river cruising with immersive land excursions, offering a comprehensive exploration of the region's natural wonders and vibrant communities.

 Key Highlights:

 • Chobe River Cruise: Navigate the serene waters of the Chobe River aboard a comfortable riverboat, witnessing diverse wildlife such as elephants, hippos, and crocodiles along the riverbanks. 

• Safari Adventures: Experience thrilling game drives in renowned national parks like Chobe National Park, where you can observe Africa's Big Five in their natural habitat. 

• Victoria Falls Excursion: Visit the majestic Victoria Falls, one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World, and feel the awe-inspiring power of "The Smoke That Thunders." 

• Cultural Encounters: Engage with local communities to learn about traditional customs, music, and crafts, enriching your understanding of the region's heritage.

 Tour Features:

 • Luxury Accommodations: Enjoy stays in upscale lodges and aboard a modern river cruise vessel, ensuring comfort throughout your adventure.

 • Expert Guides: Benefit from the knowledge of experienced guides who provide insights into the ecology, history, and cultures of Southern Africa. 

• Gourmet Dining: Savor a variety of local and international cuisines prepared by skilled chefs, highlighting regional flavors and specialties. 

Experience Summary:

 This tour offers a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation, catering to travellers seeking both the thrill of wildlife encounters and the serenity of scenic landscapes. From the thundering falls and vast savannahs to the dynamic cityscapes, the "Southern Africa: Travel to the Ends of the Earth" tour presents an all-encompassing journey that captures the essence of the African continent.

 Ideal For:

 • Wildlife enthusiasts eager to see diverse animal species in their natural environments. 

• Cultural travellers interested in authentic interactions with local communities.

 • Adventure seekers looking for a mix of river cruising and land-based exploration.

 • Those who appreciate the convenience of an all-inclusive, expertly managed travel experience.

 Embarking on this tour promises a deeply rewarding experience, leaving you with lasting memories of Southern Africa's unparalleled beauty and charm.

itinerary.title: Johannesburg (South Africa)
itinerary.description: We’ll meet up at the hotel at 11:30 a.m. We’ll have lunch before visiting the Apartheid Museum which opened in 2001. It is famous the world over for being the first museum centering on South African history in the 20th century, and more particularly on Apartheid (the Museum is open from Wednesday to Sunday. In case of a visit a Monday, this museum will be replaced by the Mandela House. On Tuesday, it will be replaced by the Hector Pieterson Museum). Afterwards, we’ll set off for a panoramic tour of the city. In addition to being South Africa’s financial capital, Johannesburg is also the city of superlatives. It is indeed the richest town in Africa, with the tallest buildings and widest social discrepancies, but is also infused with one of the best atmospheres you’ll ever come across. We’ll arrive at our five-star hotel LS where you’ll be welcome to settle into your rooms before dinner. You’ll spend the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Johannesburg - Kasane - Arrival at LODGE (South Africa-Botswana-Namibia)
itinerary.description: We’ll take a regular flight from Johannesburg to Kasane, Botswana. You’ll be transferred from the airport to your CroisiEurope lodge on board a small private boat. Take advantage of your trip to observe the numerous bird species living among the flooded flatlands. You may even catch a glimpse of a few hippos or crocodiles basking in the sun! You’ll be greeted by our crew upon arrival and settle into your comfortable lodge. We’ll have dinner and spend the night at the lodge in absolute tranquility at the heart of the wilderness.

itinerary.title: LODGE: Chobe National Park (Namibia-Botswana)
itinerary.description: We’ll journey out on a full-day safari in Jeeps to explore the Chobe National Park that is home to more than 1/4 of the total elephant population in Africa. Enjoy lunch in a “floating restaurant” in the middle of the river where the views of the surrounding nature are unparalleled. Afterwards, we’ll board a small private boat and sail off on Chobe River all the way to Sedudu Island and its marshes. We’ll have dinner and spend the night at the lodge.

itinerary.title: LODGE: Impalila Island (Namibia)
itinerary.description: Join us for a trip to authentic villages on Impalila Island, Namibia, to discover the traditional Namibian houses, culture and customs. We’ll return to our lodge for lunch. This afternoon, you can enjoy time at leisure at the lodge, taking advantage of the pool and comfortable fittings, or join us for a discovery of the Zambezi River on a small private boat. We’ll have dinner at the lodge. Tonight, let your guide tell you all about the traditions of this particular island. We’ll spend the night at the lodge.

itinerary.title: Kasane
itinerary.description: Enjoy one last water safari in the Chobe National Park area. After lunch along the water, we'll set out for the Kasane airport. On board small private planes, you'll discover the stunning panoramas over Lake Kariba during your flight from Kasane to Kariba. You'll be transferred to board the ship and comfortably settle into your cabins. We'll start sailing across the lake. We'll have dinner and spend the night on board.

itinerary.title: Kasane
itinerary.description: At sunrise, we'll set sail through Lake Kariba. We'll set out on a small private boat to discover the small waterways going into the Matusadona National Park and their unique wildlife. We'll return on board for lunch. This afternoon, we'll sail towards Palm Bay. Later, we'll set out on small private boats to admire the sunset. We'll have dinner and spend the night on board.

itinerary.title: Kasane
itinerary.description: We'll journey out this morning on a safari to discover the area around Matusadona National Park and its numerous wild animals. We'll enjoy lunch on board and start sailing again. During this time, a round table will be the opportunity to learn more about the creation of the Lake, its inhabitants as well as its ecosystem. We'll have dinner and spend the night on board.

itinerary.title: Victoria Falls
itinerary.description: At sunrise, we'll set sail towards Kariba to disembark and journey out to the airport. We'll discover the gigantic Kariba Dam which was created to form Lake Kariba before flying out to Victoria Falls on board private planes. Lunch cruise on the Zambezi River. This afternoon, enjoy a tour on foot of the falls. Tonight, enjoy dinner and spend the night at a four-star hotel LS.

title: Indian Golden Triangle With Holi Colours
description:
Experience the essence of India on this 7-day Golden Triangle with Holi Celebration Tour, a journey that takes you through the country’s most captivating destinations — Agra, Jaipur, and Delhi. Blending history, romance, and vibrant culture, this itinerary showcases the best of North India while immersing you in the joyful spirit of Holi, the festival of colors.

Your adventure begins with a warm welcome in Delhi, India’s bustling capital, before heading to Agra, the city of eternal love. Here, witness the breathtaking Taj Mahal, one of the Seven Wonders of the World, as it glows in the morning light. Explore the imposing Agra Fort, an architectural masterpiece that echoes tales of Mughal grandeur.

Continue to the royal city of Jaipur, known as the Pink City, famed for its regal palaces, vibrant markets, and majestic forts. Visit the Amber Fort, perched on a hilltop, offering panoramic views and a glimpse into Rajasthan’s royal past. Discover the City Palace, a blend of Mughal and Rajasthani architecture; admire the intricately designed Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds); and explore the fascinating Jantar Mantar, an ancient astronomical observatory.

A highlight of your journey is the Holi Celebration in Jaipur — a joyful and colorful experience where you’ll join locals in playing with natural colors, enjoying music, dancing, and savoring festive sweets and delicacies. This unforgettable event offers a truly authentic connection to India’s vibrant traditions and warm hospitality.

After celebrating Holi, travel back to Delhi, where the old and new worlds blend beautifully. Explore Old Delhi’s historical landmarks such as Raj Ghat and Chandni Chowk, where you’ll enjoy an exciting rickshaw ride through its bustling lanes. In New Delhi, visit the towering Qutub Minar, the serene Lotus Temple, Humayun’s Tomb, India Gate, and the stately President’s House (Rashtrapati Bhavan).

Conclude your journey with cherished memories of India’s rich heritage, royal architecture, and festive spirit. With expert-guided tours, comfortable stays, private transfers, and authentic cultural experiences, this Golden Triangle itinerary promises a perfect blend of history, celebration, and unforgettable color.

title: 11 Days Keralan Odyssey
description:
"Every journey is in itself a pilgrimage. Because wherever you go, you see what God created."

– An ancient Chinese proverb.

When you find yourself in the backwaters of Kerala, in southern India, you'll be astounded at how appropriate that saying is with the scenery before you. It’s not without reason that Kerala is known as‘God’s own country’. A paradise, nestled between the Western Ghats and the overwhelmingly beautiful Arabian Sea and Indian Ocean, Kerala has a little bit of everything that India has to offer.

"Right from the pristine beaches full of colourful and rich culture to delectable cuisines for you to savour, this is one holiday you must make to not just experience but rejuvenate yourself." – Lonely Planet, India 2011.

This incredible journey begins with return international flights from the UK, taking the hassle out of your travel planning. You'll enjoy a two-night stay in the vibrant city of Kochi, giving you ample time to explore the rich culture and attractions of Kerala's dynamic city. From there, you'll head to the serene tea fields of Munnar for a two-night stay in a Superior Tea View Room. In Munnar, you'll take a tour of the Tea and Spice Plantation, complete with tea tasting, and visit a tea museum. Then, it's on to Thekkady, where you'll stay for two nights, enjoying access to the lush Periyar Sanctuary. Don't miss the chance to experience wildlife up-close on a bamboo raft or motor boat!

 

The trip continues with a unique night aboard an air-conditioned houseboat, where you'll be treated to all three meals, including a complimentary bottle of wine. You will experience the local culture by attending performances of Kathakali dances and Kalaripayattu martial arts in Munnar. Afterwards, you'll head to the picturesque town of Poovar for a rejuvenating three-night stay. While there, pamper yourself with a full-body massage and keep yourself fit with an hour of trekking.

 

Throughout the journey, your sightseeing and transfers will be handled by a private air-conditioned sedan car, driven by an English-speaking chauffeur. An English-speaking local guide will be available for certain excursions to ensure you don't miss any details. Entrance fees for monuments and sightseeing places are covered as part of the package. During your hotel stays, breakfast and dinner are included, and you'll receive one mineral water bottle per person each day to keep you refreshed. Attractions such as Fort Kochi Beach, Chinese fishing nets, Mattancherry Palace, and the Jewish Synagogue are also included in this immersive itinerary.

And when you can do all of this for as little as only £1299 per person, that's almost half what it usually costs, you surely need no reason to pack your bags and find yourself on the ultimate holiday.

itinerary.title: KOCHI
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Kochi, the most fascinating city of Kerala. On arrival at Kochi International Airport, you will be met and transferred to the hotel. Enjoy the rest of the day at leisure.

Kochi is the magnificent entry to Kerala and has been featured in National Geographic Travellers “50 greatest places of a lifetime.” Spread over several islands and historically rich in culture with booming industries, the city is a fantastic beginning to exploring the vivacious diversity of Kerala. 

OVERNIGHT IN KOCHI

itinerary.title: KOCHI
itinerary.description:
Unlock Kochi’s history by embarking on a morning sightseeing tour that will take you into the heart of this magnificent and beautiful city. The Dutch, British, French and Portuguese have all left their outstanding imprint with beautiful architecture. You will visit Fort Cochin, which has been a cherished sea port for centuries, Vasco Da Gama Square and Santa Cruz Basilica. Continue to St. Francis’ Church, considered to be India’s oldest European church, built by Portuguese Franciscan Friars.  Vasco da Gama was buried here before being taken to Lisbon. Proceed to the VOC Gate, Dutch Palace, Jewish Synagogue and marvel at Mattancherry Palace’s murals depicting the Ramayana and Puranic legends. 

Intriguingly, the only traces of China’s influence are the gigantic nets, ‘cheenavalas’ from 1350. According to Diplomat Ma Haun, “The fishermen are tourist-friendly and will happily let you join them.” And his observation still rings true today. You will learn about their very unusual fishing method, operated from the shore. In the afternoon, experience your very own pièce de résistance with a cooking class from a renowned local TV personality. At lunch, enjoy the flavours of Keralite cooking. 

OVERNIGHT IN KOCHI

itinerary.title: KOCHI – MUNNAR
itinerary.description:
Check out after a hearty breakfast and drive to Munnar over rugged hills, rolling oceans of tubby green tea bushes, through luscious grasslands, before passing the Pallivasal tea estates. This will be your first glimpse of Munnar. On arrival, check-in at the hotel.

At a height of 1,500 metres, set amidst mountains once known as the High Range of Travancore, Munnar is a bustling hub of tea plantations.  Prepare to be captivated by its dense carpet of tea, sprinkled with Acacias and Red Gum trees, and delighted by its freshly brewed cuppas.

Enrote to Munnar take a break for Spice Plantation tour - Munnar is the heaven of spices and this spice tour will leave your senses tingling with joy. Wander in the captivating farms and witness the plantation of spices like black pepper, cardamom, ginger, curcuma, cinnamon, etc.

OVERNIGHT IN MUNNAR

itinerary.title: MUNNAR SIGHTSEEING
itinerary.description:
Continue with a full day sightseeing of Munnar, watching the mountain goats in the Rajamalai wildlife Sanctuary. Then head to the the Kannan Devan Hills, the perfect getaway with panoramic views of the Munnar Tea Estates and the lake. After lunch you will proceed to Mattupetty, with the rare chance of seeing a herd of wild elephants on the way to Mattupetty Dam. 

Next up is the Tea Museum’s photographs and machinery during the revolution of the industry, which includes the original tea roller, the ‘Rotovane,’ and the ‘Pelton Wheel’. Today you will also experience the Kathakali & Martial Arts show.

OVERNIGHT IN MUNNAR

itinerary.title: MUNNAR- THEKKADY
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive to the spice capital and check into your next hotel. Along the way you will also explore Thekkady. The afternoon is at your leisure. Feel free to walk through the spice market in the Kumily Village. Make sure you leave room in your suitcase for the finest cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg and mace!

First up is the Kathakali, a mixture of art, music, dance and drama, with majestic costumes, elaborate makeup, and mythological stories. Kalaripayattu is the oldest form of martial arts, with elaborate movements and the sounds of slashing swords. Return to the hotel.

OVERNIGHT IN THEKKADY

itinerary.title: EXPLORE THEKKADY
itinerary.description:
Post breakfast at the hotel, step out for a blissful day in the natural heaven for wildlife. 

Tourists rush from all over the country to experience the exotic wildlife at the Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary which is amidst dense forests and make way for thrilling mountain walks. Experience boating in the lake where you can spot many more interesting species of animals as you admire the beauty called Thekkady.

After spending quality time with nature, head to the Tribal Heritage Museum which features different types of artifacts displaying the culture, dressing, rituals, etc. of the Mannan settlement. You can also check out the spice market in the Kumily Village and pick fresh aromatic cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg and mace from the market.

OVERNIGHT IN THEKKADY

itinerary.title: THEKKADY-ALLEPPEY
itinerary.description:
Post breakfast, check out of the hotel and depart to Alleppey via Kuttikanam which is a hill station in Idukki district and is best known for trekking and adventure sports.

You can explore the cardamom and tea plantations which surround the entire place. Later head to Alleppey and experience the memorable cruise through the iconic backwaters of Kerala. Alleppey is the most popular backwater cruising destination in Kerala and is termed as “Venice of the East”. Kerala claims its title as ‘God’s Own  Country’ due to its captivating charm and wonder.

Your comfortable and luxurious house boat will take you through paddy fields and lined up coconut trees. Indulge in some traditional Kerala cuisines served on board made with various tasty spices and flavours.

Marvel the Chinese fishing nets, ancient temples, rustic buildings, paddy fields and swaying coconut trees along the coastline. Having experienced an overnight stay in a houseboat, you have lived a perfect vacation in Kerala.

OVERNIGHT ON THE HOUSEBOAT

itinerary.title: ALLEPPEY-- KOVALAM-- POOVAR
itinerary.description:
After a mesmerising stay in the houseboat, it’s time to check out and proceed to the hotel in Poovar (Enroute to Poovar visit Hawa Beach in Kovalam).

Ever imagined ending your holiday on an island paradise of your own? Here in Poovar that is exactly what you will find. This nirvana is tipped as one of the ‘50 must visit’ places in India by ‘National Geographic Traveler’, with its coconut trees and endless golden sands. Shrouded in pristine Kerala backwaters, flanked by the Arabian Sea on the East and the enchanting towering Ghats to the West, along with a heavenly beach, Poovar Island is your very own Indian Idyll. How about reclining on the gorgeous nearby beach, swimming in translucent waters or simply unwinding with a relaxing body massage? Your perfect end to India!.

OVERNIGHT IN POOVAR

itinerary.title: EXPLORE POOVAR
itinerary.description:
Spend a full day at leisure sunbathing on the golden sands of Poovar Beach. The estuary shimmers in spades of wow factor where the river, sea and lake meet the land.

A complimentary hour long boat can be organised at Poovar Lake, where you can find golden sandy beaches meeting the estuaries and mangroves.

OVERNIGHT IN POOVAR

itinerary.title: EXPLORE POOVAR
itinerary.description:
Breakfast is at the hotel with the rest of the day at leisure. End your holiday on this wonderful paradise by treating yourself to an Ayurvedic Massage, where the body is revived and the soul replenished. Included is a full body session at the hotel or a nearby spa. Please book your slot.

OVERNIGHT IN POOVAR

itinerary.title: POOVAR--TRIVANDRUM AIRPORT AND DEPART TO UK
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel. A beautiful souvenir is the perfect way to end such a magical holiday. Take home a silk sari or handmade version, its motif conveying Kerala’s everlasting memories.

BOARD YOUR RETURN FLIGHT HOME

title: 10 Nights Keralan Odyssey
description:
"Every journey is in itself a pilgrimage. Because wherever you go, you see what God created."

– An ancient Chinese proverb.

When you find yourself in the backwaters of Kerala, in southern India, you'll be astounded at how appropriate that saying is with the scenery before you. It’s not without reason that Kerala is known as‘God’s own country’. A paradise, nestled between the Western Ghats and the overwhelmingly beautiful Arabian Sea and Indian Ocean, Kerala has a little bit of everything that India has to offer.

"Right from the pristine beaches full of colourful and rich culture to delectable cuisines for you to savour, this is one holiday you must make to not just experience but rejuvenate yourself." – Lonely Planet, India 2011.

This incredible journey begins with return international flights from the UK, taking the hassle out of your travel planning. You'll enjoy a two-night stay in the vibrant city of Kochi, giving you ample time to explore the rich culture and attractions of Kerala's dynamic city. From there, you'll head to the serene tea fields of Munnar for a two-night stay in a Superior Tea View Room. In Munnar, you'll take a tour of the Tea and Spice Plantation, complete with tea tasting, and visit a tea museum. Then, it's on to Thekkady, where you'll stay for two nights, enjoying access to the lush Periyar Sanctuary. Don't miss the chance to experience wildlife up-close on a bamboo raft or motor boat!

The trip continues with a unique night aboard an air-conditioned houseboat, where you'll be treated to all three meals, including a complimentary bottle of wine. You will experience the local culture by attending performances of Kathakali dances and Kalaripayattu martial arts in Munnar. Afterwards, you'll head to the picturesque town of Poovar for a rejuvenating three-night stay. While there, pamper yourself with a full-body massage and keep yourself fit with an hour of trekking.

Throughout the journey, your sightseeing and transfers will be handled by a private air-conditioned sedan car, driven by an English-speaking chauffeur. An English-speaking local guide will be available for certain excursions to ensure you don't miss any details. Entrance fees for monuments and sightseeing places are covered as part of the package. During your hotel stays, breakfast and dinner are included, and you'll receive one mineral water bottle per person each day to keep you refreshed. Attractions such as Fort Kochi Beach, Chinese fishing nets, Mattancherry Palace, and the Jewish Synagogue are also included in this immersive itinerary.

And when you can do all of this for as little as only £1299 per person, that's almost half what it usually costs, you surely need no reason to pack your bags and find yourself on the ultimate holiday.

title: 10 Days Golden Triangle and Goa
description:
For 5 nights the Golden Triangle circuit, comprised of Delhi, Jaipur and Agra, will be your home. All three of these spellbinding cities bring something different to the circuit and you’ll hop from one to the other via dedicated vehicle for our passengers, safe from the glare of the Indian sun. Delhi, the Indian Capital, is home to three World Heritage Sites, the Qutab Minar, Red Fort and Humayun’s Tomb, as well as the India Gate and Lotus Temple, most of which will feature on your itinerary. Its bustling streets and lively ambiance will mean there’s never a dull moment, but if you’re set on experiencing life like a true Delhite, be sure to h    itch a ride on a rickshaw during your stay. 

Your next stop is the “Pink City” for Agra and it’s Mughal-era architecture, containing tombs and mausoleums left behind by the Mughal empire. Located in the northern  state of Uttar Pradesh, Agra is also home to the UNESCO World Heritage Sites of Agra Fort , however its most noteworthy definitely has to be the phenomenal Taj Mahal, a veritable symbol of India which is breath taking to behold. Later you will visit aipur, the capital of the Indian state of Rajasthan and a vibrant hub of art and flamboyancy. The honey-colored Hawa Mahal, the impressive astronomical observatory of Jantar Mantar and the World Heritage Site of Amer Fort are three important landmarks which perhaps helped Jaipur gain the status of number one Indian destination in 2015 by Trip Advisor. 

The next leg of your trip will be spent in Goa. Although India’s smallest state, Goa makes up for its size with idyllic beaches, raucous nightlife and ancient churches and temples. Goa’s two World Heritage Sites, the Bom Jesus Basilica and the churches and convents of Old Goa, are definitely worth a visit, not to mention the various forts of Aguada, Tiracol and Chapora. History buffs can satisfy their appetites at the Naval Aviation Museum or in the cultural quarter of Fontain in Panaji, while thrill-seekers can while away the hours enjoying Goa’s myriad of water sports at Bagatelle and Calangute Beaches. Then, dance the night away in a place that is ranked 6th in the top 10 nightlife cities in the world by National Geographic, or get to grips with typical culinary delights in swanky restaurants  beneath the soft glow of the moonlight. Whatever your tastes,  your four nights spent here are guaranteed to be both memorable and jam-packed. 

Upgrade Goa beach stay to All Inclusive in Whispering Palms Beach Resort from an additional £169 per person!

itinerary.title: ARRIVE DELHI
itinerary.description:
Your journey of a lifetime begins in New Delhi. Arrive at the international airport, where you’ll be met and transferred to your hotel. It is recommended that you spend your first evening at leisure in your hotel to recuperate from your international journey. Few places on earth combine beauty, history and escapism to such dazzling effect as the great city of Delhi- the sprawling and fascinating capital of India. The title “A Tale of Two Cities” is apt as Delhi bridges together two different worlds. The Old Delhi, once the capital of Islamic India, contrasts with the British-built centre of New Delhi. On this journey you will discover a land sprinkled with dazzling gems of India’s “golden” legacy. 

OVERNIGHT IN DELHI

itinerary.title: DELHI
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, your visit will include a tour of Old Delhi and the immense Jama Masjid, the greatest mosque in India. You will also see the legendary Red Fort and Raj Ghat where Mahatma Gandhi was cremated. Finally, awaken the senses with a thrilling rickshaw ride through the busy markets of Chandni Chowk. 

Also visit Rajghat - memorial of Mahatma Gandhi & go on a rickshaw ride through the silver street in Chandni Chowk. New Delhi offers a fascinating contrast: here, you will walk the wide, straight boulevards and pass the monuments of the Empire. Walking the imperial residence, Rashtrapati Bhavan, to the mighty arch of India Gate, designed by Edwin Lutyens in the 1920s, the eternal flame burns day and night to remember the soldiers in the Indo-Pakistan war. Continue to the Laxmi Narayan Temple, Humayun’s Tomb and the Qutub Minar. Another highlight is the Bahai Temple with its lotus dome.

title: 10 Days Charming North Kerala
description:
This 10-day immersive tour through North Kerala is a beautifully curated journey that weaves together the region’s rich cultural heritage, diverse landscapes, and deep-rooted traditions. Beginning in the historic port city of Kochi, you’ll step into a world shaped by centuries of Portuguese, Dutch, and British influence. The cobbled streets of Fort Kochi, the centuries-old synagogues, ornate churches, Chinese fishing nets, and the vibrant spice markets provide an evocative introduction to Kerala's colonial and maritime legacy. From there, the route traces the Muziris Heritage Trail, where stops at the Jewish Heritage Museum in Paravur and St. Thomas Church in Kodungallur offer a powerful glimpse into the state’s ancient Christian and Jewish past.

The tour then unfolds into the vibrant coastal city of Calicut (Kozhikode), the historic landing site of Vasco da Gama, where you can walk along Kappad Beach, soak in the sunset, and savor local seafood in the very place where global trade once flourished. From the coast, your journey ascends into the mist-covered hills of Wayanad, a green paradise tucked away in the Western Ghats. Here, nature and culture converge—tranquil lakes, tea plantations, and forested tribal villages provide a deeply authentic experience. You’ll meet local tribespeople, witness eucalyptus oil being made, go on a scenic trek, and enjoy a thrilling jeep safari through Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary, where elephants, panthers, and rare birds roam freely.

Next, you descend to the untouched coastline of Thottada Beach, a quiet retreat nestled near Kannur. The experience here is both rejuvenating and culturally rich—you'll visit Tellicherry Fort, drive along the unique Muzhappilangad Beach (Asia’s only drive-in beach), and witness the awe-inspiring Theyyam performance, a traditional temple ritual that blurs the line between theatre and spirituality. The handloom villages of Kannur further immerse you in the artistry and rhythm of local life.

The final leg of your journey leads to the serene Nileshwaram backwaters, where a peaceful country boat cruise takes you past palm-fringed canals, local fishermen, and flocks of native birds. You'll end the trip with a visit to Bekal Fort, Kerala’s largest and most majestic seaside fort, and the stunning Kappil Beach and Kodi Cliff, where the backwaters meet the Arabian Sea in a breathtaking panorama. With a perfect mix of historic exploration, cultural encounters, natural beauty, beachside relaxation, and wildlife adventure—combined with comfortable stays, private transfers, and expert local guidance—this tour is designed to offer an unforgettable and holistic Kerala experience that touches both the senses and the soul.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Kochi
itinerary.description: Upon arriving at Kochi International Airport, you will be greeted by a representative and comfortably transferred to your hotel. The rest of the day is at leisure, allowing you to relax after your journey or explore the vibrant local markets, taste some authentic Kerala cuisine, or simply unwind and soak in the tropical ambiance of the city.

itinerary.title: Kochi Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, you’ll set off on a fascinating tour of Kochi, a city shaped by centuries of colonial influence. Begin at Fort Kochi, a coastal area steeped in Portuguese, Dutch, and British history. Walk along Vasco da Gama Square and visit the beautifully preserved Santa Cruz Basilica and St. Francis Church—the oldest European church in India. Explore the charming lanes of Mattancherry, where you’ll see the VOC Gate, the Dutch Palace with its intricate murals, and the centuries-old Jewish Synagogue. Later, head to the seafront to witness local fishermen skillfully operate massive Chinese fishing nets—a signature image of Kochi. In the afternoon, travel to the serene village of Kumbalangi, where you’ll enjoy lush green surroundings, traditional fishing demonstrations, and a tranquil country boat ride. This experience offers a glimpse into the authentic rural lifestyle of Kerala.

itinerary.title: Kochi to Calicut via Paravur
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and begin your journey towards Calicut (Kozhikode), making enriching stops along the way. First, visit the Jewish Heritage Museum at Paravur, housed in a historic synagogue that showcases the long-standing Jewish presence in Kerala. Continue to St. Thomas Church (Marthoma Pontifical Shrine), built on the banks of the Periyar River, which is believed to be one of the earliest centers of Christianity in India and houses a sacred relic of St. Thomas the Apostle. After this spiritual and historical immersion, drive to Calicut, a coastal city that was once the gateway for spice traders from across the globe. In the evening, visit the historic Kappad Beach where Vasco da Gama first landed in 1498. Enjoy a peaceful stroll, watch migratory birds, and indulge in local seafood delicacies at nearby beach shacks.

itinerary.title: Calicut to Wayanad
itinerary.description: Today, you’ll leave the coast behind and ascend into the misty hills of Wayanad—a lush green region nestled in the Western Ghats. The drive offers scenic views of spice plantations, forested hills, and winding mountain roads. On arrival, check into a luxury farm resort surrounded by nature. Spend your afternoon at leisure—walk through nearby villages, interact with locals, or just relax while taking in the sights and sounds of the countryside.

itinerary.title: Exploring Wayanad
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a visit to a pristine freshwater lake, hidden amidst dense forest and sloping hills—a perfect spot for serene reflection. Then, head to tribal hamlets like Nellarachal, where you’ll meet indigenous communities and experience their way of life. Witness tribal weapon-making, traditional cooking, and eucalyptus oil production, while enjoying the hospitality of the locals. In the afternoon, embark on an exciting Jeep safari through Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary, where you may spot elephants, panthers, tigers, wild boar, and a diverse array of bird species amidst the thick jungle canopy.

itinerary.title: Wayanad to Thottada Beach (near Kannur)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, bid farewell to the hills and descend towards the coastal beauty of Thottada Beach, a lesser-known paradise near Kannur. This 800-meter stretch of golden sand is bordered by palm groves and offers tranquility and natural beauty far from the crowds. Later, visit the historic town of Tellicherry, where you’ll enjoy a traditional Kerala lunch before exploring the colonial-era Tellicherry Fort and the elegant St. John’s Anglican Church. The town’s rich heritage and seaside charm make for a delightful afternoon.

itinerary.title: Muzhappilangad Beach & Kannur Culture
itinerary.description: Start your day with a visit to the majestic St. Angelo’s Fort, a 16th-century structure built by the Portuguese, offering panoramic views of the Arabian Sea and Mopilla Bay. Then, drive along Muzhappilangad Beach—India’s only drive-in beach—where the packed sand allows for a unique driving experience along the shoreline. Later, explore Kannur’s handloom villages, renowned for their traditional weaving practices. As evening falls, witness a live performance of Theyyam—an extraordinary ritual art form combining music, dance, and elaborate costumes that narrate mythical stories and local folklore.

itinerary.title: Thottada Beach to Nileshwaram Backwaters
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head north to the peaceful backwaters of Nileshwaram, a hidden gem of North Kerala. Upon arrival, set out on a two-hour country boat cruise through coconut-lined canals, watching local fishermen at work and spotting water birds in their natural habitat. The unhurried pace and scenic beauty of this region offer a deeply relaxing experience.

itinerary.title: Nileshwaram & Bekal Exploration
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning at your beach resort before departing for Bekal in the afternoon. Visit the iconic Bekal Fort, Kerala’s largest and best-preserved fort, perched dramatically beside the Arabian Sea. Take in panoramic views from its high walls, then unwind at the nearby Bekal Beach. End your day with a visit to the unspoiled Kappil Beach and a short hike to Kodi Cliff, from where you can soak in the sweeping views of the coast and backwaters merging into the sea.

itinerary.title: Departure from Calicut
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and begin your return journey to Calicut International Airport for your onward flight. With hearts full of memories and bags packed with spices, stories, and souvenirs, your unforgettable Kerala adventure comes to an end.

Journey through the heart of North India, exploring the iconic trio that forms the 'Golden Triangle': Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur. Each city offers a unique blend of old-world charm and modern dynamism, serving as a testament to India's rich history, diverse cultures, and the promise of its future.

Delhi: Begin in the capital city, where ancient landmarks coexist with bustling bazaars and modern infrastructure. Explore the Red Fort's grandeur and the Lotus Temple's serene  nvironment. Dive deep into local life at the vibrant Chandni Chowk. Pay respects at Rajghat, the memorial of Mahatma Gandhi.

Agra: Venture to the city of eternal love. Marvel at the timeless beauty of the Taj Mahal. Visit the Agra Fort, showcasing Mughal architectural splendour. Browse through local markets with exquisite marble handicrafts and traditional sweets.

Jaipur: Dive into the regal vibes of the Pink City. Revel in the majesty of the Amber Fort with its breathtaking hilltop views. Wander through the pink-hued streets and visit the iconic Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds). Experience local art and craft workshops, understanding the intricate art of block printing and gemstone cutting.

Goa Finale: As the tour ends, take a flight to the western coast, settling in the lap of Goa - a paradise that combines pristine beaches with a laid-back, bohemian ambience. 

Concluding your tour in Goa, the melange of experiences from the culturally rich triangle to the serene vibes of the Arabian Sea promises a journey that touches every facet of India's
vast and vibrant tapestry.

Full details of this tour can be seen below and in the itinerary section.
