itinerary.title: LUANG PRABANG
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Laos! Our tour guide and driver will meet you upon your arrival at Luang Prabang airport and then transfer you to your hotel for check-in. During the rest of the day, you’re free to do as you please. 

Whether you opt for relaxing and wandering around the resort or catching a free shuttle bus to the downtown area to explore, we’re sure your first day in Laos will be a lovely one. 

At 17.00 you’ll head to the dock on the bank of the Mekong River (either by walking or by tuk tuk) and get ready to board the Nava Mekong Cruises boat for an incredible 3-hour sunset cruise. We’ll moor near a traditional village opposite the town of Luang Prabang and watch in awe as typical Lao dancers perform interpretations of the royal ballet, rural life, folk tales and legends. Dinner served will be a collection of typical Lao dishes which are tasty and nutritious. The boat will return to shore for 20.00 and a free shuttle bus will escort you back to your hotel.

Special note: Nava Mekong operates in the months of January-May and October-December on Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays and Sundays. It is closed from the 1st-30th June 2019 and from the 1st July-30th September. Dinner cruise is available for charter only. 

OVERNIGHT IN LUANG PRABANG

itinerary.title: LUANG PRABANG-UPSTREAM MEKONG CRUISE TO PAK OU CAVE (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
Excursion by boat to Tham Pak Ou Caves (5-6 hours). 

After a hearty breakfast, spend the rest of the morning however you please before boarding the shuttle bus and heading to the downtown area for another lovely cruise upstream the Mekong River.

You’ll be left spellbound by the beauties of Pak Ou Cave and the scenic landscape along the banks of the river. After a two-hour upstream cruise, you’ll arrive at Pak Ou, home to the famous Tam Ting Cave with its thousands of gold lacquered Buddha statues of varying shapes and sizes.

En route, stop off at the village of Ban Xang Hai where potent rice wine whisky known as ‘lao lao’ is produced. (It’s open from 6am to 3pm and closed on every major Buddhist holiday.)

Afterwards, you’ll visit the weaving village of Ban Xang Khong, a stone’s throw from Luang Prabang and known for its traditional handwoven cotton and silk, as well as the production of local mulberry paper. Then, you’ll be escorted back to your resort. 

OVERNIGHT IN LUANG PRABANG

itinerary.title: LUANG PRABANG / KUANG SI WATERFALL (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, head to Ban Xom, a lowland Lao hill tribe village which is renowned for its production of cotton. After briefly wandering  around the village, make your way to the source of the Kuang Si Waterfalls where you’ll spend the rest of the day, marvelling at the fierce rush of water over multi-tiered limestone formations. 

You’ll also have the chance to visit a local village (Ban Ou or Ban Na Ouane) before returning to Luang Prabang by car and spending the afternoon at leisure. While away the hours at the resort or stroll around Luang Prabang.

You may also choose an optional evening tasting and traditions tour at an additional cost. This optional tour will see you participate in a traditional Baci Ceremony, designed to commemorate momentous occasions in an individual’s life (such as birth or marriage) or honour important visitors and guests.  This touris available on request and can be booked in advance only.

After this you’ll make your way to the city centre and watch as the locals gather to play their favourite game of Petanque during the evening. Feel free to join in and try your hand at this traditional game played far and wide across the country. To say thank you to the groups, we’ll take some snacks and ‘beerlao’ and then have a Laotian meal at a typical restaurant. 

OVERNIGHT IN LUANG PRABANG

itinerary.title: LUANG PRABANG–SIEM REAP
itinerary.description:
After breakfast you’ll have some free time to do as you please before your transfer to the airport to catch a flight to Siem Reap. Our representatives will extend a warm welcome to you upon your arrival and will escort you to your hotel for check-in. 

OVERNIGHT IN SIEM REAP

itinerary.title: SIEM REAP–ANGKOR TOUR (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
Enjoy breakfast and then at 8am a shuttle bus with a tour guide will pick you up from your hotel for a full-day sightseeing tour.

Angkor Wat is the national symbol of Cambodia. It is the largest, best preserved and most religiously significant temple in all of the Angkor complex. Approaching the temple, you’ll  go across the large moat and  along a broad causeway lined with ‘naga’ balustrades. Ascend through a series of galleries and courtyards after entering the main building and reach the central sanctuary’s beautiful viewpoint. 

Here, feast your eyes on intricate stone carvings, including the 1,700 apsaras (celestial dancers).The best time to see the wonderful Angkor Wat is at sunrise and sunset. Covering an area of 10 square metres, the fortified city of Angkor Thom is home to many of Angkor’s most popular sights. You’ll first wander through the South Gate of Angkor Thom via the Naga Bridge.

Then, head to the Bayon Temple through a passage of big trees and playful monkeys and explore Baphuon, Elephant Terrace, Leper King Terrace, the Royal Enclosure and Phimeanakas. 

Then, proceed to Ta Prohm, one of Angkor’s most popular attractions because its jungle and monuments look practically the same as when European explorers first discovered them. 

Watch the sunset bleed its golden glow over the Cambodian countryside from the upper terraces of an ancient Angkor temple – be sure to have your cameras at the ready! 

OVERNIGHT IN SIEM REAP

itinerary.title: SIEM REAP – AT LEISURE OR OPTIONAL TOUR (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, you’re free to spend the day at leisure – whether that’s taking a ferry ride on the Tonle Sap Lake or unwinding with a massage. 

OPTIONAL TOUR 1: Paddle through a village in the Floating Forest

Step back in time with this wonderful excursion to a floating village on the great Tonle Sap Lake. You’ll drive 22km from Siem Reap to Kompong Phuk , and board a traditional boat for an hour’s cruise. 

The buildings of this floating town can be accessed by small boats and rickety ladders and are home to both villagers and their livestock. 

Support the local economy by taking a canoe ride with one of the villagers to explore the surrounding mangrove forest. The peaceful labyrinth of waterways play host to a whole range of species, including water-birds and crab-munching macaques.

Special Note: The tour is from 8am to 12pm or 2pm to 6pm. It doesn’t operate during the dry season (March to July) due to low water level. It is recommended for customers aged 12+ years. 

OPTIONAL TOUR 2: Boat excursion to Chong Kneas floating village

Enjoy a boat ride to Chong Kneas Village and feast your eyes upon the beautiful scenery and intriguing life of the residents. 

Visit Psah Chah Market, originally destroyed by the Khmer Rouge in 1975 and restored in 1996. It offers travelers the chance to stock up on knickknacks and snacks at its food stalls and souvenir shops. 

Special Note: The tour is from 8am to 12pm or 1pm to 5pm. Also this optional tour is available upon request and can only be booked in advance.

OVERNIGHT IN HO CHI MINH CITY

itinerary.title: SIEM REAP-PHNOM PENH BY BUS (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast get ready for a coach journey from Siem Reap to Phnom Penh (Giant Ibis Bus – 314km). Upon arrival, you will meet one of our representatives and transfer to your hotel in Phnom Penh where you can spend the afternoon at leisure OR you may also choose any of the below mentioned optional tours at an at an additional cost.

1) Phnom Penh City Tour

The tour begins with a visit to the dazzling white and gold complex of the Royal Palace and the adjacent Silver Pagoda. The Royal Palace is still King Norodom Sihamoi’s official residence while the Silver Pagoda is also known as the Pagoda of the Emerald Buddha. 

Next, venture to the Museum of Genocide, the former Tuol Svay Prey High School, which the Khmer Rouge set up as a prison in May 1976, to detain those accused of opposing the Pol Pot regime. 

Please note that the tour is from 2pm to 6pm. 

2) Take photos in Phnom Penh

Heading out on foot, you’ll explore the sights of a local community and witness the transformation of this central urban neighbourhood through the work of street artists. Feast your eyes upon diverse murals painted by the likes of Lisa Mam, Cambodia’s first female urban street artist, and Chifumi, a French artist whose style is characterized largely by pop art style paintings of gesturing hands. Take some photos of the vibrant concrete canvases and learn more about local life.

Special Note: The tour is from 3pm to 5pm. It’s advisable to wear comfortable walking shoes, sun protection (sunglasses, sun screen, parasol) and you will be informed of the meeting point once booking has been confirmed.

OVERNIGHT IN PHNOM PENH

itinerary.title: PHNOM PENH AT LEISURE
itinerary.description:
Following breakfast, you’re free to spend the day at leisure – whether that’s relaxing at the hotel, exploring Phnom Penh or opting for one of the optional tours below. 

OPTIONAL TOUR 1: Cycling on Silk Island 

Today you’ll cycle into the outskirts of the city, first reaching the island of Koh Dach after two ferry crossings. At Koh Dach (also known as Silk Island) watch as the villagers produce silk using weaving methods handed down through generations. 

Afterwards, go by bike along the narrow paths, whizzing past the beautiful pagoda, the local school and vegetable and fruit plantations. Residents of the area also earn a living by growing beans, corn, bananas, mangoes and sesame.

Stop off at the shaded huts along the river for  a local Khmer-style lunch before boarding a wooden boat in the afternoon for a cruise back to Phnom Penh.

Special Note: Tour is from 9am to 4pm and includes lunch. The distance is 40km and requires a moderate amount of energy. During the rainy season (May to September), cycling can be a bit more of a challenge because of the road conditions.

OPTIONAL TOUR 2:  Oudong excursion

Setting off northeast from Phnom Penh, you’ll make your way to Oudong – the former capital of Cambodia between 1618 and 1866. Phnom Oudong features several stupas containing ashes of former Khmer kings.

After exploring the temples, you’ll stop off at the ethnic Cham Village and ‘silversmithing’ village of Kompong Luong. Take a quick tour of a local workshop led by the Cambodian Craft Cooperation (a German NGO) and then return to Phnom Penh.

Special Note: Please note that the tour is from 8am to 12pm or 2pm to 5pm and does not include lunch.

OPTIONAL TOUR 3: The Killing Fields

The Killing Fields of Choeung Ek sit just outside of Phnom Penh and provide a moving reminder of the atrocities committed during the Pol Pot regime. This is the site where thousands of people were killed and buried in mass graves between 1975 and 1978. 

Spe

itinerary.title: PHNOM PENH–HO CHI MINH CITY (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, we’ll escort you to Phnom Penh bus station ready for your departure to Saigon (Ho Chi Minh) by bus. When you reach your destination, you’ll be taken to your hotel for check-in. Time permitting, you’ll stroll around the downtown area of this commercial, financial and cultural centre.

You may also choose any of the below mentioned optional tours:

OPTIONAL TOUR 1: Foodie tour in Saigon

Heading to Ben Thanh Market in the early evening, immerse yourself fully in the bustling foodie heaven of Saigon. Accompanied by a guide, you’ll visit the local hangouts and sample popular dishes. Then, cap off the evening with a cocktail at one of the rooftop bars.

Special Notes:

Tour is from 5.30pm to 9.30pm and operates daily. Walking distance is 5km but can be shortened (please inform us in advance). This is a child-friendly tour and the recommended age for taking part is 8+ years.Please let us know if you have any food allergies. The dress code to visit the Air Sky Bar is smart casual. Certain adjustments can be made to the tour depending on weather conditions.Transfer to/from hotel is not included and the excursion does not operate during the Lunar New Year or on public holidays. OPTIONAL TOUR 2: Discover Saigon at night time by Vespa

Soak up the liveliness of Saigon with a nighttime vintage Vespa ride. Starting your evening with drinks at the popular Zoom Café, you’ll get to know your drivers for the night before whizzing off through Old Saigon. 

Breathe in the mouth-watering scents wafting out from restaurants, pass by important historical sites such as the Notre Dame Cathedral, the Post Office and the City Hall, and stop off for seafood appetizers in local eateries before hunkering down over a delicious barbecue dinner with southern rice pancakes and fresh spring rolls. 

Cap off the evening with a visit to hidden cafes and bars.

Special Notes: The tour is from 6pm to 10pm and includes dinner. Customers wishing to book

itinerary.title: HO CHI MINH CITY HALF-DAY TOUR & CU CHI TUNNELS (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
Half of today will be spent discovering the hidden gems of Ho Chi Minh City, particularly near the town centre. En route to the Reunification Palace, we’ll pass by the now-demolished wartime American Embassy. The Palace was the former residence of the President of Southern Vietnam up until 1975 and nearby you’ll find some impressive French colonial structures including the Notre Dame Cathedral and the old Saigon post office. 

Next, you’ll be whisked off to the Jade Emperor Pagoda and the War Remnant Museum, reminiscent of a turbulent time in Vietnam’s history. We’ll round up the sightseeing tour with a walk around Ben Thanh Market where there are bargains aplenty! 

In the afternoon, you’ll take a transfer of about 30km north-west of Ho Chi Minh City to Cu Chi Town. The Cu Chi tunnels served as the base for the Vietnamese operations during the Tet Offensive of 1968 and stretch over 200km. These tunnels contain living areas, weapon factories, hospitals and command centres. During your excursion, you’ll be provided with an insight into how these tunnels operated, as we take you through a widened section of the underground network and offer you the chance to fire off rounds from an AK47 or MK16 at a nearby rifle range. 

OVERNIGHT IN HO CHI MINH CITY

itinerary.title: HO CHI MINH CITY–HANOI (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
You will take a flight to swap the hustle and bustle of Ho Chi Minh City for the quieter streets of Hanoi. After reaching Noi Bai Airport, our tour guide will extend a warm welcome and transfer you to your hotel for check-in. 

The afternoon can be spent however you please. 

OVERNIGHT IN HANOI

itinerary.title: HANOI–FLAMINGO CRUISE
itinerary.description:
Between 07.30 and 08.30 you’ll be whisked off from your hotel by shuttle bus with a tour guide (only applicable for those who use our shuttle bus service). Then, at 10.30 you’ll stop off at Hai Duong City, a haven of hand-made Vietnamese handicraft products.  At 12.30 you’ll reach Tuan Chau Marina Pier (Tuan Chau Island) where a variety of different activities await:

08:15 -08:30: Our shuttle bus with tour guide will pick you up at your hotels(Note: This pick-up is just applied for those who use our shuttle bus service)10:30: Stopover in Hai Duong City where you can experience our hand-made Vietnamese handicraft products.
12:30: Arrive in Tuan Chau Marina Pier (Tuan Chau Island). Followed by activities such as:  boarding Luxury Flamingo Cruise for departure, Welcome drink will be served and cruise briefing, safety instructions, check-in cabins by Cruise Manager13:30: Great lunch is served while cruising passing by islets.15:00: Kayaking around Pearl Farm Village, visit Titop Island. Free choice of activities such as sunbathing, swimming and conquering the peak of the biggest island in Halong and taking panoramic photos of Halong bay in the afternoon.17:30: Happy Hour. Buy 2 beverage get 1 for free18.00: Cooking Class. Our Chef will demonstrate the preparation of a particular Vietnamese cuisine in the dining room. Our guide will let you know what item will be prepared and will explain the process during the demonstration. Duration about 20 – 30 minutes18:30: Enjoy Sunset Party with fruits and tea19:30: Under the magnificent night sky, our luxury set menu dinner is served with variety of Vietnamese and Asian foods21:00: Joining the squid fishing on boat with our crews and can enjoy the squid cooked with assistance from our chef or laze yourself with our happy-hour drinks at the bar.OVERNIGHT ON THE FLAMINGO CRUISE

itinerary.title: CRUISE -  HANOI  (BREAKFAST & LUNCH INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
After waking up early to witness the beautiful sunrise, you’ll kick-start your day.

06:15: Tai Chi class on the Sun-Dec                                                                                                                                                           

07:15: Have light breakfast with Coffee, tea, and bakeries on board     

 07:45: Arrive at the Surprising cave, the biggest cave in Ha Long Bay with 10,000 square meters, when you visit the cave like our Vietnamese house with three chambers as lobby, dining room and bedroom with most beautiful stalagmites and stalactites. We will tour the cave for about 60 minutes.        

09:00: Upon return to the boat you will have time to freshen up and finish packing. When checking out please remove all of your belongings from the cabins, you may leave heavy luggage outside of the cabins.   

10:00: Relaxing on the sundeck or in the dining room enjoying the bay scenery as we approach the pier  10.45: Brunch is served. After brunch, Relax on the sundeck or in the dining room enjoying the bay scenery as we approach the pier.                         

11:45: Disembark at Marina coffee – Gate 26 in Tuan Chau New Marina.

itinerary.title: HANOI HALF DAY CITY WALKING TOUR
itinerary.description:
After enjoying breakfast at the hotel, get ready for a jam-packed day. You’ll be escorted to visit the Ho Chi Minh complex where you can visit the final resting place of Ho Chi Minh himself. Then, continue to the Temple of Literature and gaze at its walled courtyards and graceful gateways, founded in 1070 and dedicated to Confucius, before taking a stroll through the Old Quarter’s narrow network of alleys and shops known as ‘the 36 streets’. Soak up the sun and enjoy a Vietnamese coffee at a local café, before visiting the Ancient House on Ma May Street. You’ll also be able to enjoy an hour’s foot massage at a spa, spending the afternoon at leisure.

OVERNIGHT IN HANOI

itinerary.title: HANOI–UK DEPARTURE
itinerary.description:
Post-breakfast, relax and enjoy your morning until our guide and driver pick you up and transfer you to Noi Bai Airport for your departure flight back to the UK. We hope you’ve had a wonderful time in Southeast Asia! 

END OF TOUR

In addition to prov

title: 13 Night Solo Trip Southeast Asia: Thailand, Cambodia And Vietnam
description:
In Thailand you can discover how the Grand Palace and the temples effortlessly entwine with the frenetic streets. Visit Bangkok and be swept along in the crowds and weave through traffic in a tuk tuk before venturing to Wat Phra Kaew or the Temple of the Emerald Buddha which is regarded as the most important Buddhist temple in Thailand.

Located in the historic centre of Bangkok, within the grounds of the Grand Palace, it enshrines Phra Kaew Morakot (the Emerald Buddha), the highly revered Buddha image meticulously carved from a single block of jade. End this thrilling adventure by crossing over the waters of the Chao Phraya River where in 1782 King Rama I built some of the world’s most beautiful temples with the canals earning Bangkok its nickname, “Venice of the East”.

During this fantastic trip, undergo an exhilarating renovation of the senses. Venture into the jungle’s vines and creepers towards Angkor Wat, the 12th century temple and shrine of Khmer art and architecture, a Cambodian mascot with its sculpted towers of lotus blossom and stately surroundings worshiped by Buddhists monks.

Next up is Vietnam with are breathtaking destinations of diverse delights. Travelers are gripped by the sights and sounds, bewitched by their geniality and divine cuisine, captivated by fast-moving cities like Ho Chi Minh, the Mecca in which Vietnam flourishes, and enlightened by  the palaces, cathedrals and the thousands of stalagmites of Sung Sot cave.

Such a concoction of history, French colonial influences, and tales of past upheaval ensures a majestic holiday. This trip also includes Cruise in the Halong Bay, a UNESCO world heritage Site. Lunch on Board with a Free Bottle of Wine, with a lot of Sights & activities along the way.

itinerary.title: ARRIVE BANGKOK--DAY AT LEISURE
itinerary.description:
This day will be at leisure in Bangkok. You can marvel at the gleaming temples, catch a tuk tuk along the bustling Chinatown or take a longtail boat through floating markets. Food is another Bangkok highlight, from local dishes served at humble street stalls to haute cuisine at romantic rooftop restaurants.

OVERNIGHT IN BANGKOK

itinerary.title: GRAND PALACE AND EMERALD BUDDHA TOUR
itinerary.description:
The Grand Palace was established at the same time as Bangkok in 1782, by the first king of the ruling Chakri dynasty. Each subsequent monarch has added their own contribution to the complex, so that it represents the full range of royal architecture of the Rattanakosin (Bangkok) period. Some of the buildings represent traditional Thai themes, whilst others have distinct European features. Within the palace grounds one can find the temple commonly called Wat Phra Kaew, which houses the small but holy figure of the Emerald Buddha (actually fashioned from a type of jadeite). The figure was discovered in a Chiang Rai temple in 1436 and has traveled since to Lampang, Chiang Mai, Luang Prabang and Vientiane. The tour concludes with a visit to a jewelry retailer.

OVERNIGHT IN BANGKOK

itinerary.title: BRIDGE OVER THE RIVER KWAI TOUR
itinerary.description:
Kanchanaburi Province, one of the largest and hottest of all Thai provinces, lying to the west of Bangkok and adjacent to Myanmar separated mostly by a mountainous border broken by the Three Pagodas Pass. Kanchanaburi sits on the banks of the Kwae Yai and Kwae Noi rivers, surrounded by limestone outcrops and fields of sugar cane. One less pleasant aspect of its history was the prisoner of war camp during the Second World War, when this area was the site of a railway line intended to stretch throughout British Burma to India. 

Visit the Jeath war museum, which is housed in the same sort of huts the POW's used and is filled with exhibits telling their story. Visit the War Cemetery as well as the Bridge on the River Kwai, restored after the war and still carries the railway today.Take a ride along a pleasant section of the unpleasantly named Death Railway.

OVERNIGHT IN BANGKOK

itinerary.title: ARRIVE SIEM REAP--DAY AT LEISURE
itinerary.description:
You will be received with a warm welcome at Siem Reap International airport and transferred to the hotel. The evening is free for you to relax at the hotel. In case you wish to explore the city, you can choose to visit Pub Street which is famous for its quality yet economical restaurants and bars. Enjoy Khmer dinner on the day of arrival.

OVERNIGHT IN SIEM REAP

itinerary.title: FULL DAY ANGKOR TOUR
itinerary.description:
After a sumptuous breakfast at the hotel, you’ll enjoy a full-day tour of the Angkor complex. You must not miss the antique capital of Angkor Thom. With sites like the South Gate with its huge statues depicting the churning of the ocean of milk; the Bayon Temple, unique for its 54 towers decorated with over 200 smiling faces of Avolokitesvara; the Phimeanakas; the Royal Enclosure; the Elephants Terrace and the Terrace of the Leper King; 

Angkor Thom has so much to offer.

The most famous of all the temples on the plain of Angkor is Angkor Wats. The temple complex covers 81 hectares and is comparable in size to the Imperial Palace in Beijing. Its distinctive five towers are emblazoned on the Cambodian flag and the 12th century masterpiece is considered by art historians to be the prime example of classical Khmer art and architecture.

Other sites that deserve a mention are: Prasat Kravan, also known as ‘The Royal Baths’, the site was once used for ritual bathing; Banteay Kdei, surrounded by 4 concentric walls; Neak Pean, a fountain built in the middle of a pool; Preah Khan temple, built by the King Jayavarman VII.

OVERNIGHT IN SIEM REAP

itinerary.title: SIEM REAP - --DAY AT LEISURE OR OPTIONAL BOAT TRIP
itinerary.description:
After eating breakfast at the hotel, your day will be at leisure or you may head out to enjoy an optional boat ride on the Tonle Sap Lake. This beautiful fresh-water lake is the largest in South-east Asia and flows into Tonle Sap River, joining the Mekong in Phnom Penh. Built on the lake, is a wondrous ‘floating village’ with floating schools, floating police station, et al. The ‘village’ moves from place to place following water levels and current.

OVERNIGHT IN SIEM REAP

itinerary.title: SIEM REAP - PHNOM PENH
itinerary.description:
After breakfast get ready for a coach journey from Siem Reap to Phnom Penh. On arrival, you will meet one of our representative and transferred to your hotel in Phnom Penh.

Continue your journey in the Pearl of the Orient, Phnom Penh, visiting by yourself the dazzling white and gold complex of the Royal Palace and the Silver Pagoda. Feel free to visit the Genocide Museum or venture to the former Tuol Svay Prey High School, which the Khmer Rouge set up as prison in May 1976, to detain those accused of opposing the Pol Pot regime. Be prepared to be shaken by this moving reminder of the genocide that occurred during Cambodia’s Khmer Rouge regime.

OVERNIGHT IN PHNOM PENH

itinerary.title: PHNOM PENH - HO CHI MINH CITY
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, we depart to Ho Chi Minh City by morning bus (Giant Ibis). Upon arrival at Ho Chi Minh City, you are transferred to the hotel. If there’s time, you must stroll around the downtown part of the bustling Ho Chi Minh City to explore the different local ways of life. Ho Chi Minh City, still called Saigon by many locals, is a centre of commerce, finance, culture and tourism in Vietnam. As opposed to its northern counterpart, this metropolis is filled with automobiles, numerous shopping areas and sidewalk cafes.

OVERNIGHT IN HO CHI MINH CITY

itinerary.title: HO CHI MINH CITY SIGHTS & CU CHI TUNNELS EXCURSION
itinerary.description:
The plan is to devote half of today to exploring captivating Ho Chi Minh City. We pass by the now-demolished wartime American Embassy on our way to the Reunification Palace. This famous edifice was a former residence of the President of Southern Vietnam until end of April 1975. We also visit some striking French colonial structures including the Notre Dame Cathedral and the Old Saigon Post Office.

Post this, we head to the Jade Emperor Pagoda and the War Remnant Museum. We conclude our sightseeing session with a walk around the retail Ben Thanh Market where anything and everything is for sale!

 In the afternoon, we travel about 30 km North-West of Ho Chi Minh City to Cu Chi town.

Cu Chi tunnels were used as the base from which the Vietnamese mounted their operations of the Tet Offensive in 1968. The incredible underground network in Cu Chi stretched over 200 kilometres and became legendary during the American war. The extensive tunnels have been specially constructed with living areas, weapon factories, filed hospitals, command centres, plus accommodation. We visit an exposition hall and a widened section of the tunnels to get a feel of the underground life.

There are also possibilities to fire off rounds from an AK47 or MK16 at the nearby rifle range.

OVERNIGHT IN HO CHI MINH CITY

itinerary.title: SAIGON - HANOI--EVENING AT LEISURE
itinerary.description:
Step back in time as you fly from the buzzing, modern city of Ho Chi Minh to Hanoi. Upon arrival at Noibai Hanoi Airport, you’ll be met by our tour guide & transferred to your hotel in Hanoi. Afternoon / Evening at leisure to explore the evening sights on your own.

OVERNIGHT IN HANOI

itinerary.title: HANOI - HALONG PIER - FLAMINGO CRUISE
itinerary.description:
An Early morning Start today to get you to the Halong Pier,  you will be picked up from your hotel with a packed breakfast. We arrive at Halong tourist wharf. Halong Bay has been recognized by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site since 1994. The islands in Halong Bay are mainly limestone and schist islands. Karst, the result of repeated rising and lowering of the continent, underwent full erosion and weathering to create the unique Halong Bay in the world. 

We travel to Flamingo Cruise where you are welcomed by a fresh drink, cruise briefing & safety instructions before setting you free on the deck to explore this Natural wonder. After Sightseeing you will be served with a Vietnamese sea-food lunch & Wine, while cruising towards Surprising Cave. In the evening you will disembark the Cruise for your road trip back to Hanoi. 

 Evening is at leisure to stroll past the Hoan Kiem Lake or enjoy drink and dinner at one of the specialized Singles Pub.        

OVERNIGHT IN HANOI

itinerary.title: HANOI
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, you will enjoy a walking tour of the Ho Chi Minh complex, the Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum - the final resting place of Vietnamese great father; President Ho Chi Minh’s stilt house - where Ho lived on and off from 1958 to 1969.

The next place is One Pillar Pagoda, a group of structures consisting of a pagoda and a tower built in the middle of a square pond. From there, leave for the Temple of Literature, the first college of Vietnam. While heading back to Hoan Kiem Lake, have a brief stopover at Ngoc Son Temple. Thereafter, you can take a Cyclo tour around the Old Quarter Streets.

OVERNIGHT IN HANOI

itinerary.title: HANOI--DAY AT LEISURE
itinerary.description:
Have a leisurely breakfast at the hotel. The day is at leisure to walk around the lake. You can choose to visit the Church, the famous red bridge. In the evening, you will enjoy the Water Puppet Show near the lake (Tickets will be provided).

OVERNIGHT IN HANOI

itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, you can devote the entire day to shopping and buying souvenirs for friends. As the hotel is located in central Hanoi, all the shopping areas are not too far. Then, according to your flight schedule, you shall be driven to the airport.

FLIGHT BACK TO UK

Experience the perfect balance of cultural immersion and light adventure, while enjoying the authentic Mekong River charm. With an emphasis on personalized service, cultural exploration, and a touch of adventure, our program promises to deliver an unforgettable cruising experience and makes a perfect match for the Toum Tiou 2.

itinerary.title: Arrive Saigon
itinerary.description: Upon Arrival at airport proceed to hotel.

itinerary.title: HO CHI MINH CITY (Saigon)
itinerary.description:
Meet at the restaurant of the Hotel Liberty Riverside between 11:30 a.m. and 12:30 p.m. Lunch at the hotel. After lunch, we will explore the local Chinatown and experience the daily life of the people. we will also visit the Giac Lam Pagoda, which is over 300 years old and is the oldest pagoda in Ho Chi Minh City. Lastly, we will visit the Flower Market and Binh Tay market for a 15-minute walking tour to explore how locals buy and sell local food and products.
Transfer to the ship.
After comfortably settling into your cabins, we will introduce our crew at a welcome cocktail, have dinner and spend the night on board downtown. "Saigon After Dark" is a part night excursion, part street/local food adventure from 6pm to 10pm. Guests experience the nightlife of Saigon the way locals do. An evening excursion with a culinary adventure. On the back of a vintage Vespa scooter, you'll enter the heart of Saigon's nightlife. From stop to stop, you'll sample local flavors, including cocktails, seafood tastings, cold drinks and Vietnamese creperies. After this, the tour will bring you to a live music venue to enjoy the drinks with live music.

itinerary.title: HO CHI MINH CITY (Saigon)
itinerary.description: Enjoy a tasty breakfast onboard before our Ho Chi Minh City tour. Take a short downtown drive to the city. Walking tour commences and stop for some photographs at notable sites like Reunification Palace, Notre Dame Cathedral, Municipal Post Office, City Square and the Opera house all of which were heavily influenced by French colonialism in the 19th century. Enjoy the vibrancy of this city by foot and explore the city's green space enjoying the beautyof nature in the middle of this dynamic city. Experience the local coffee scene - Vietnam is famous for producing high-quality coffee and coffee shops are a common sight in the downtown. Transfer back to ship for lunch. After lunch we will then proceed to the War Museum to learn more about the history of Vietnam before returning to the ship. Ship leaves Saigon for My Tho and dinner on board. Night on board.

itinerary.title: MY THO - CAI BE
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board and cruise the magnificent Chao Gao canal, where you will experience the lively and vibrant canal full of ships activity, yet still feel close to the life on shore. A must-see part of the cruise and that we're the only cruise line offering this unique passage. Arrival in My Tho. In My Tho we will kick off with a local boat pick-up that will take us on a boat cruise to Thoi Son Island where we will have the opportunity to explore the daily lives of the local people and enjoy seasonal fruits. We will also take a Sampan ride along the scenic canals for a closer look at the Mekong Delta and its unique features. Later we will go biking on our own and explore the village to see firsthand how the local people live and to admire the magnificent fruit orchards in the area. This is the perfect chance to connect with the locals and witness their way of life. Back to ship. Ship leaves for Cai Be and we will enjoy lunch whilst cruising. Arrival at Cai Be. Start Cai Be with a local boat trip to cruise along the Mekong River. Disembark to visit the craft village where you can witness how the local products are made. Continue cruising on the boat. Get off at the fruit orchards comprising of many kinds of fruits such as: jack-fruit, durian, guava, rambutan, longan etc... drink hot tea, eat fresh fruits and enjoy a live local music performance. We will then enjoy a kayaking adventure. Don't worry if you are a first-time paddler, it is not difficult. This is a unique experience in the Mekong Delta providing a unique aquatic perspective of the surrounding natural beauty. Then there is the opportunity to explore the countryside by mountain bike providing another view of the local scenery. Whichever of the activities you do, you will get a distinctive glimpse into the beauty and authenticity of the Mekong River. Ship leaves Cai Be for Sa Dec. Dinner during cruising and night on board.

itinerary.title: SA DEC
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board. Local boat pick-up for a short panoramic tour of Sa Dec, including a visit to the Trung Vuong primary school (will close on Saturday, Sunday, holiday and New Year) where you will get a chance to learn more about the local education system. Afterward, we will enjoy a promenade at Sa Dec market on the riverbank. (Local market will be closed on Lunar New Year) where you can experience local commerce. This is a perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in the local culture and enjoy the charming river surroundings. Ship leaves Sa Dec for Chau Doc, lunch and dinner on board during cruising.

itinerary.title: CHAU DOC - PHNOM PENH
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board. Located on the border between Cambodia and Vietnam, the prosperous town of Chau Doc has developed around fishing and fish farming. We’ll then transfer to Tra Su Forest. We’ll experience this beautiful forest with small local boats, where you can witness this incredible and diverse flora and fauna. Return to the boat for lunch. In the afternoon, we will board a cable car and embark on an unforgettable journey to Sam mountain. You will enjoy breathtaking panoramic views as the ride unfolds. Upon the summit of Sam Mountain, we will embrace spectacular views. We will pay a visit to the Ba Chua Xu Temple before heading back to the ship. Continuation to the Vinh Xuong border. Customs clearance and entry formalities into Cambodia. Set sail for Phnom Penh, which you will reach in the evening. Dinner on board, overnight at anchor.

itinerary.title: PHNOM PENH
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board.We will enjoy a tour of the fabulous Royal Palace, one of the most impressive examples of Cambodian architecture, and its Silver Pagoda. Onward to visit the National Museum. Enjoy an afternoon tour of the area by "tuk-tuk," for an authentic and immersive experience like no other. Visit the beautifully renovated Art Deco Central Market and experience the local shopping scene firsthand. Known as "Phsar Thmei" locally the market is a bustling hub for clothing, food and souvenir shopping. After exploring the market, we will stroll through the city"s off-the-beaten-path alleyways, where you will have a chance to engage with the locals and see how they live their daily lives in the city. Observe and experience the locals enjoying their coffee while playing Cambodian-style chess and see the local food in its most authentic form, learning about the way of live in this vibrant city. Continue your visit to the city's namesake, Wat Phnom. Founded in 1373, the pagoda was built to house Buddhist relics washed ashore by the river. From there, we will enjoy a short walk to the French Quarter, where you will get a glimpse of the city's colonial era while admiring the beautiful architecture. The area boasts a number of Belle Époque and Art Deco houses and public buildings dating from the French Protectorate (1863-1953). As we get back on board, we will enjoy an Apsara dance show. Dinner and overnight on board, in the port of Phnom Penh. Free evening.

itinerary.title: UDONG - KAMPONG TRALACH
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board. The ship then departs to Udong, Cambodia's former capital. We will dock at Koh Chen and transfer by van to Udong. On arrival, first we visit the colorful Vipassana Dhura Buddhist Meditation Center where you will hear about the school of Vipassana or Insight Meditation. After that walk up the steps to the various temples and the three large stupas where the ashes of three former kings are preserved. You will be rewarded by wonderful views of the plains below. After returning on board, start cruising towards Kampong Tralach. Lunch on board. We will visit the beautiful Vihara at the Wat Kampong Tralach Leu pagoda. To access the pagoda, we need to cross the village of Kampong Tralach in ox carts, moving along a small road that runs perpendicular to the river in the middle of magnificent rice fields. We then offer clients to return to the ship by enjoying a mountain biking experience through the stunning countryside to witness the beauty of the rice fields surrounding the area before returning to the ship. Set sail to Kampong Chhnang and dinner and night on board.

itinerary.title: KAMPONG CHHNANG - KOH CHEN
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board. Visit Kampong Chhnang, one of the largest fishing ports on the Tonle Sap Lake. Here they also have many fish farms. The region is also known for its traditional pottery combining ancient knowledge with modern techniques - Chhnang itself means "pot." We will enjoy a tasting of regional products before returning on board. Option: For those seeking more activity, there will be an option at Kampong Chhnang to cycle alongside the riverside and then to the pottery village to explore this area. Return to the ship, lunch on board whilst cruising to Koh Chen. We will have a farewell dinner and spend the night on board.

itinerary.title: SIEM REAP
itinerary.description: After breakfast, passengers will be transferred by air-conditioned coach from Koh Chen to the hotel Lotus Blanc(1) in Siem Reap (5-6 hours bus ride). Drop off at the meeting point. End of our journey around 12:30 p.m.

title: The Mekong In A Different Way Between Adventure And Must See Sites
description:
This itinerary takes you on an immersive journey through Bangkok and Cambodia, blending vibrant city life with awe-inspiring cultural and natural experiences. Begin your adventure in Bangkok, where you'll be warmly welcomed and have time to unwind or explore the lively streets. Spend the next day discovering the city's iconic landmarks and hidden gems at your leisure. On Day 4, fly to Siem Reap, the gateway to Cambodia’s stunning Angkor temples. Over two days, delve into the remarkable Angkor complex, visiting highlights such as Ta Som, East Mebon, Ta Prohm, and the Roluos Group, marveling at the blend of history and nature. Then venture to Phnom Kulen Mountain, the birthplace of the Khmer Empire, with its sacred carvings, reclining Buddha, and refreshing waterfalls. Conclude with a visit to the exquisite Banteay Srei temple, renowned for its intricate pink stone carvings, before returning to Siem Reap. This journey offers a perfect mix of relaxation, exploration, and cultural discovery.

Our itinerary includes a range of activities like biking, kayaking, sampan rides and walking tours that provide opportunities to discover the hidden treasures of the Mekong River, including traditional village visits and climbing the stunning Udong Hill. Moreover, we'll take you on a motor & rowing boat tour of the magnificent Tra Su Forest, where you'll witness incredible flora and fauna of this beautiful natural environment. Experience the perfect balance of cultural immersion and light adventure, while enjoying the authentic Mekong River charm. With an emphasis on personalized service, cultural exploration, and a touch of adventure, our program promises to deliver an unforgettable cruising experience and makes a perfect match for the Toum Tiou 2.

itinerary.title: Grand Circuit Angkor Temples - Roluos Group
itinerary.description:
"After breakfast we continue explore other Angkor temples in Grand Circuit including: Ta Som temple is a captivating and charming temple. It was built in the Bayon style and has been well restored. Like Ta Prohm, there is a tree growing through part of the structure which provides excellent photo opportunities.

 East Mebon is a mountain temple which was built in the middle of the 10th century. It was built by King Rajendravarman II and dedicated to Shiva. Mebon is a pyramid of terraces with stunning sculptures and statues, including the 2m high elephants which sit on each corner. Pre Rup is a 10th century Hindu temple built by King Rajendravarman. The temple mountain is underrated and not as widely visited as other temples in the area. However, the beautiful brick structure is a must-see for anyone visiting region.

 Continue visiting the jungle covered temple of Ta Prohm. There are enormous fig trees and gigantic creepers which embrace themselves in the stone foundations of the structure giving the impression of man’s creation being reclaimed by the powerful forces of nature. Takeo temple, a mountain temple built in pyramid shape to represent Mount Meru, the mountain of centre of the world in Hindu mythology.

 Afternoon, visit Banteay Samre which is believed to be built around the same time as Angkor Wat, because the architecture is of the classic art of the same period though not much inscription has been found for this temple. After that visit Roluos Group of Monuments featured with the three main temples Bakong, Lolei and Preah Ko which are located about 11 km southeast of Siem Reap town, dated back from the late ninth century and is the ealiest sites of Angkor Period with simimar characteristics of architecture, decoration, materials and construction methods which combine to reveal the beginning of the Classic Period of Khmer art. Return to Siem Reap late afternoon/evening. Overnight in Siemreap."

itinerary.title: Siem Reap – Phnom Kullen – Banteay Srei Temple
itinerary.description: "After breakfast at hotel, drive nearly 2 hours out of the city to visit Phnom Kulen Mountain. Belonging to Kulen National Park, Phnom Kulen means literally Mountain of the Lychees. This mountain become a sacred place for Cambodian people as it is the birthplace of the ancient Khmer Empire. King Jayavarman II claimed independence from Java there in 802 A.D. The visit begins with seeing the river with the 1000 Lingas carvings where is not so far from the parking. Then continue to visit a modern style pagoda that offers stunning views over the national park. Climb up to visit the eight-meter-tall statue of a reclining Buddha on the top and wash your hands at the Linga statue to purify your mind and body. After that taking a short drive and bend your way to fresh up at the magnificent waterfall and cool off in the stream and pool if you want. On the way back, drive to explore the less visited temples at the remote places including Banteay Srei or the Citadel of Women, a temple boasts a remarkable preservation of excellent stone carvings in pink color. Return to the town in the evening. Overnight in Siem Reap."

We'll enjoy a tasting of regional products before returning on board and beginning to cruise to Kampong Tralach. Option: For those seeking more activity, there will be an option at Kampong Chhnang to cycle alongside the riverside and then to the pottery village to explore this area. We'll have dinner and spend the night on board.

itinerary.description: Breakfast on board. We will set out to visit the beautiful Vihara at the Wat Kampong Tralach Leu pagoda. To access the pagoda, we need to cross the village of Kampong Tralach, moving along a small road that runs perpendicular to the river in the middle of magnificent rice fields. We then offer clients to return to the ship by enjoying a mountain biking experience through the stunning countryside to witness the beauty of the rice fields surrounding the area before returning to the ship. Lunch on board. The ship then departs to Udong, Cambodia's former capital. On arrival, first we visit the colorful Vipassana Dhura Buddhist Meditation Center where you will hear about the school of Vipassana or Insight Meditation. After that walk up the steps to the various temples and the three large stupas where the ashes of three former kings are preserved. You will be rewarded by wonderful views of the plains below. After returning on board, start cruising towards Phnom Penh. Enjoy a performance of classical Khmer dancing and music then dinner. Night on board.

itinerary.title: Phnom Penh
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board. We'll enjoy a tour of the fabulous Royal Palace, one of the most impressive examples of Cambodian architecture, and its Silver Pagoda. Onward to visit the National Museum. Enjoy an afternoon tour of the area by "tuk-tuk," for an authentic and immersive experience like no other. Visit the beautifully renovated Art Deco Central Market and experience the local shopping scene firsthand. Known as "Phsar Thmei" locally the market is a bustling hub for clothing, food and souvenir shopping. After exploring the market, we will stroll through the city's off-the-beaten-path alleyways, where you'll have a chance to engage with the locals and see how they live their daily lives in the city. Observe and experience the locals enjoying their coffee while playing Cambodian-style chess and see the local food in its most authentic form, learning about the way of live in this vibrant city. Continue your visit to the city's namesake, Wat Phnom. Founded in 1373, the pagoda was built to house Buddhist relics washed ashore by the river. From there, we will enjoy a short walk to the French Quarter, where you'll get a glimpse of the city's colonial era while admiring the beautiful architecture. The area boasts a number of Belle Époque and Art Deco houses and public buildings dating from the French Protectorate (1863-1953). We'll return on board for dinner in the evening and start sailing towards Vietnam. Night on board.

itinerary.title: Chau Doc
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board. Arrival at Vinh Xuong border. Customs clearance and entry formalities, departure for Chau Doc. Situated on the border between Cambodia and Vietnam, the prosperous town of Chau Doc has developed around fishing and fish farming. We’ll then transfer to Tra Su Forest. We’ll experience this beautiful forest with small local boats, where you can witness this incredible and diverse flora and fauna. Return to the boat for lunch. In the afternoon, we will board a cable car and embark on an unforgettable journey to Sam mountain. You will enjoy breathtaking panoramic views as the ride unfolds. Upon the summit of Sam Mountain, we will embrace spectacular views. We will pay a visit to the Ba Chua Xu Temple before heading back to the ship. Continuation to Sa Dec, dinner and overnight on board.

itinerary.title: Sa Dec - Cai Be
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board. Local boat picks up for a short panoramic tour of Sa Dec, including a visit to the Trung Vuong primary school (will close on Saturday, Sunday, holiday and New Year) where you'll get a chance to learn more about the local education system. Afterward, we will enjoy a promenade at Sa Dec market on the riverbank. (Local market will be closed on Lunar New Year) where you can experience local commerce. This is a perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in the local culture and enjoy the charming river surroundings. Ship leaves Sa Dec for Cai Be. Cai Be offers many exciting attractions, activities, and excursions. Nature lovers will enjoy the lush natural landscape and those interested in local culture will love meeting the very hospitable local people and discovering the way of the life in this region. Arrive Cai Be, take a local boat trip to cruise along the Mekong River. Disembark to visit the craft village where you can witness how the local products are made. Continue cruising on the boat. Get off at the fruit orchards comprising of many kinds of fruits such as: jack-fruit, durian, guava, rambutan, longan etc... drink hot tea, eat fresh fruits and enjoy a live local music performance. Head to the local restaurant by boat, attend a cooking class with local chef, then enjoy your lunch. After lunch, take a rest, then enjoy a kayaking adventure. Don't worry if you are a first-time paddler, it is not difficult. This is a unique experience in the Mekong Delta providing a unique aquatic perspective of the surrounding natural beauty. Then there is the opportunity to explore the countryside by mountain bike providing another view of the local scenery. Whichever of the activities you do, you will get a distinctive glimpse into the beauty and authenticity of the Mekong River. Ship leaves Cai Be for My Tho. Dinner during cruising and night on board.

itinerary.title: My Tho - Ho Chi Minh City (Formerly Saigon)
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board. In My Tho we will kick off our day with a local boat pick-up that will take us on a boat cruise to Thoi Son Island where we will have the opportunity to explore the daily lives of the local people and enjoy seasonal fruits. We will also take a Sampan ride along the scenic canals for a closer look at the Mekong Delta and its unique features. Later we'll go biking on our own and explore the village to see firsthand how the local people live and to admire the magnificent fruit orchards in the area. This is the perfect chance to connect with the locals and witness their way of life. Lunch on board and cruise the magnificent Chao Gao canal, the entrance to Saigon where you will experience the lively and vibrant canal full of ships and activity, yet still feel close to the life on shore. A must-see part of the cruise and that we're the only cruise line offering this unique passage. Arrive in Saigon, dinner on board. Night on board. "Saigon After Dark" is a part night excursion, part street/local food adventure from 6pm to 10pm. Guests experience the nightlife of Saigon the way locals do. An evening excursion with a culinary adventure. On the back of a vintage Vespa scooter, you'll enter the heart of Saigon's nightlife. From stop to stop, you'll sample local flavors, including cocktails, seafood tastings, cold drinks and Vietnamese creperies. After this, the tour will bring you to a live music venue to enjoy the drinks with live music.

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.description: Enjoy a tasty breakfast on board before our Ho Chin Minh city tour. Take a short downtown drive to the city. Walking tour commences and stop for some photographs at notable sites like Reunification Palace, Notre Dame Cathedral, Municipal Post Office, City Square and the Opera house all of which were heavily influenced by French colonialism in the 19th century. Enjoy the vibrancy of this city by foot and explore the city's green space enjoying the beauty of nature in the middle of this dynamic city. Experience the local coffee scene - Vietnam is famous for producing high-quality coffee and coffee shops are a common sight in the downtown. Transfer back to ship for lunch. After lunch, we'll explore the local Chinatown and experience the daily life of the people. We'll also visit the Giac Lam Pagoda, which is over 300 years old and is the oldest pagoda in Ho Chi Minh City. Lastly, we'll visit the Flower Market and Binh Tay market for a 15-minute walking tour to explore how locals buy and sell local food and products.Transfer to the ship to enjoy our farewell cocktail and dinner onboard. We'll remain in port overnight.

title: 7 nights Split Between Bangkok And Phuket With City Sightseeing Tour
description:
Nestled in Southeast Asia, Thailand is a country bursting at the seams with dream-like beaches and jaw-dropping temples and monuments. To ensure your holiday here is as diverse and interesting as possible, we’re offering a getaway that’s equal parts sightseeing and sun-chasing – split between the bright lights of Bangkok and sun-drenched Phuket. 

Stopping off first in Bangkok, you’ll spend three nights at the W22 By Burasari Hotel. Close to all the major attractions, it’s a great springboard for exploring during your time in the capital. Included in your package is a sightseeing tour of the city, where you’ll stop in at historical treasures like the Grand Palace and Emerald Buddha, accompanied by an expert English-speaking guide. 

After three nights in the hustle and bustle of Bangkok, you’ll head to Phuket for a four-night stay at the 4-star Dinso Resort. The island oozes colour – the emerald hue of the limestone karsts collides with azure waters and golden sands, creating an idyllic, relaxing setting. 

Bed down on a lounger by the pool or head to the beach to do some snorkelling. Whatever you spend your time doing, we doubt you’ll be disappointed with Phuket.

title: 9 Nights Thailand Twin Centre With Transfers and Breakfast
description:
Bangkok, although a prime back-packer destination, offers so much more than just raucous nightlife and inexpensive trinkets. Rub shoulders with locals and tourists alike at the river market of Chao Phraya, brimming with boats and the chatter of merchants as they hustle through to the early hours. Make your way to Wat Pho Temple and the Reclining Buddha and then to the Royal District and The Palace, a successful blend of urban meets ancient. 

Next, you’ll swap the lively streets of Bangkok for the sparkling island of Phuket, sitting only an hour’s plane journey away, thus not biting into your holiday time too much. Palms sway on white, sandy beaches, a rain forest stirs in the middle, and around it you’ll find a plethora of villages, quiet spots, busy spots, places for diving, surfing, sunbathing and chilling - the options really are endless! The fresh and varied cuisine is to die for (make sure you try barbecued and fried seafood, sticky ribs and Pad Thai) and the prices are inexpensive and affordable for both local dishes and beer.

title: 9 Nights Stay In Bangkok and Hua Hin With Breakfast
description:
Lonely Planet describes Bangkok as “a city where the familiar and the exotic collide like the flavors on a plate of pat tai” and this couldn’t be more true. Although a small trading post once upon a time, Bangkok is now a destination of total diversity which continues to prosper.

Observe how the Grand Palace and glorious temples intertwine with Bangkok’s busy streets and head off weaving through traffic in as tuk tuk before venturing to Wat Pho, home of the reclining Buddha. Then, cross the Chao Phraya River and stand in awe at some of the world’s most beautiful temples which make up the scenery of the “Venice of the East.” These temples were built around 1782 by the King Rama I and will do their best to leave you absolutely spellbound. 

Next, hop to Hua Hin, Thailand’s oldest resort and ultimate beach-hopping destination with golden sands and swaying palms. History and creativity are abundant in this fascinating town and ornate temples are ten a penny, making for attractive and unparalleled scenery. Then, lounge about on a sunbed, mojito in hand, gazing at the blue ocean ripples beneath a backdrop of forested peaks.

title: Bangkok and Phuket Triple Centre Deals
description:
Kick start your whirl winding Thai panorama in the City of Angels. Bangkok is a vibrant metropolis waiting to captivate your imagination with its amalgamation of fast pace and a subtle charm. Few cities can rival the Thai capital in terms of its contrast and unpredictability. Experience the divinity of the Emerald Buddha at What Phra Kaew, get smitten by the grandeur of the Grand Palace or sway across the numerous canals of the Chao Phraya. Let the flashes of its bustling streets blow away your mind, as you make your way forward in search of its hidden cultural gems. After all, you are in Bangkok, the melting point of action and serenity.

In Bangkok, you will stay in the centrally located 5 Star Well Hotel Bangkok. Located in the heart of Sukhumvit, Well Hotel Bangkok offers accommodation with easy access to the city's famous shopping malls, restaurants and must-see attractions.

You’ll also be whisked away to the wonderful city of Chiang Mai, founded in 1296 as the seat of the Lanna Empire. For 3 nights you’ll settle in at the 5 Star Siripanna Villa Resort. Siripanna located in the middle of a natural habitat, offers a family-like service in the typical Lanna style, which will enchant you through all it has to offer during your stay.

Later move on to the emerald island of Phuket, probably Thailand’s most famous beach destination. Befriend the sun, sand and the azure blue waters. When you are in Phuket, you are spoilt for the choices. Head to its biggest town, Patong for the glittery nigh life, swanky bars, heavenly spa sessions or a lazy walk along its busy beach. Hop on the ferry and sail across to the Phi Phi islands, immortalized by Leonardo Di Caprio’s ‘The Beach’. Get your snorkeling gears on and get mesmerized by the breathtaking underwater world. The laid back can just lie on the sand, capture the beautiful setting and hope the time stays still

Located overlooking Panwa Beach, My Beach Resort is a luxury 5-star seafront resort, allowing guests to experience breathtaking views of sea and mountains. The elegant guest rooms at this luxury Cape Panwa hotel are exquisitely designed with muted earth tones, generous spaces and thoughtful layouts, the ultimate in contemporary style.

title: 10 Days Getaway To The Exotic Islands of Thailand
description:
First, you’ll touch down on Phuket Island, nestled on Thailand’s Indian Ocean coastline and boasting world-class beaches and an exotic climate which will have you donning swimwear every chance you get. A hotspot for travellers and tourists, Phuket’s beauty not only lies in its crystal-clear waters but also in its colourful history and plump, karst islands sprouting from the sea.

With waters as transparently turquoise as these, swimming, sunbathing and snorkelling are firm features on most visitors’ to-do lists when they come to Phuket. Lounge about on radiant beaches, try your hand at surfing or get up close and personal with mesmerizing marine life in the shallow reefs of Patong, Karon and Kata beaches. Phuket is also one of the most popular spa destinations in the world, so get ready to wave goodbye to those aches and pains!

One of your evenings in Phuket will be spent watching Siam Niramit, a spectacular performance of Thailand’s artistic and cultural heritage. With more than 100 performers dressed in lavish costumes against a backdrop of fabulous set designs and special effects, this promises to be a night to remember.

Next, you’ll spend 2 nights in Ko Phi Phi. This is the name given to a small archipelago of six islands in Southern Thailand whose beauty and idyllic scenery are world-renowned. Phi Phi Bayview Resort is a paradise holiday destination on a remote tropical island where the turquoise waters and powder soft white sands are just steps away from the charming accommodation. Situated on a gently sloping hillside of lush jungle overlooking the sparkling shores of Laem Hin Beach, the Phi Phi Island resort is a tranquil hideaway for nature lovers and romantics.

With a plethora of beaches to choose from, you’ll leave Phi Phi feeling well-rested and spoiled. Yao Beach boasts stunning views with plenty of scuba-worthy coral reefs and Laem Tong, located in the north of the island, gives visitors a chance to unwind on a quaint beach against a backdrop of remarkable vistas.

After spending some time in Phi Phi Don, the coastal province of Krabi, bursting with dazzling beaches and intricate caves and waterfalls, awaits you. Settle in at the Holiday Inn Express on Ao Nang Beach for 4 nights, partake in a spot of beach-hopping and soak up the sun alongside turquoise waters. Start at Fossil Shell Beach, one of only 3 fossil shell beaches on the planet, and then proceed to the bustling Rai Leh Beach, the heart of Thailand’s rock climbing scene.

 For thrill-seekers, venture off to do some hiking at Khao Ngon Nak, the highest mountain in the Krabi region, or whizz off on a 1-day rip-roaring safari by speedboat to Hin Daeng and Hin Muang if gazing at whale sharks and manta rays floats your boat. Plus, with a range of boat trips on offer which will take you to all of Krabi’s secluded beaches and mini islets, the choices are endless!

title: Thailand Holiday Package
description:
Situated in Southeast Asia, Thailand is a beautiful tapestry of eclectic cuisine, dazzling beaches and azure waters dotted with plump limestone karsts which sprout from the surface like green geysers. This tropical kingdom provides visitors with a welcome break from the dizzying madness of back home in the form of colourful sacred spaces, soothing massages and a rural heartland which contrasts with the roaring cities which surround it. 

Your holiday of a lifetime begins in the capital city of Bangkok where culinary flair and urban jungle collide. A veritable concoction of old-meets-new, Bangkok is a place where regal-looking temples are perched beside ironclad skyscrapers, and 200-year-old rickety village homes rub shoulders with colossal shopping centres containing quirky keepsakes and bejeweled designer gear. 

Spend some time at the Grand Palace, home to the Wat Phra Kaew, Thailand’s most sacred Buddhist temple, and marvel at the divine Emerald Buddha statue. Kick back and relax in Silom’s Lumphinin Park if you’re looking to escape the city’s hustle and bustle or take a TukTuk tour, an age-old symbol of the city which offers a speedy (if a little shaky) tour of the city’s hidden crevices. 

Two nights beneath the bright lights of Bangkok will be followed by a stay in Kanchanaburi, a peaceful province which is home to the Bridge over the River Kwai and infamous “Death Railway”. The chilled-out riverside vibe running through the core of Kanchanaburi and its significant WWII importance may provide a welcome breather from Bangkok’s frenetic back-alleys. 

Staying at the Hintok River Camp, this leg of your trip will provide an emotional insight into the horrific conditions prisoners of WWII underwent during the construction of the “Death Railway.” Visit the Hellfire Pass Memorial and Thailand-Burma Railway Centre to catch a glimpse into the ghastly goings-on of this tumultuous era.

Your next destination will be Phuket, a twinkling paradise nestled on Thailand’s Indian Ocean coastline which abounds with fluorescent coral reefs begging to be explored. Home to jet-skiing, snorkeling, diving, yachting and parasailing, much of Phuket’s beauty lies on or beneath its shiny ocean surface.  

If you’re not satisfied with beach-bumming and cocktail-guzzling, take yourself off on a speedboat tour of the islands around Phuket, such as Phang-nga Bay and Phi Phi Island. With turquoise waters and playful marine life frolicking about beneath the ocean’s ripples, you might find a spot of island-hopping will wash all your troubles away.

After zipping through crystal-clear waters and being rewarded with ocean scenery you’ll recognize only too well from holiday brochures or Hollywood flicks, take some time out to rest up at one of Phuket’s many renowned spas.With fabulous massages and unlimited pampering opportunities, you’ll leave Thailand feeling refreshed and well-rested, ready to wax lyrical to friends and family back home about this beautiful part of the world.

itinerary.title: ARRIVE BANGKOK
itinerary.description:

itinerary.description:

We recommend a half-day tour for first-timers to the city, involving a visit to the most popular Buddhist temple and landmark in the “city of angels” (this is not included). 

Stop off at the Royal Grand Palace – a real must-see! This architectural powerhouse served as a royal residence from the 18th to the mid-20th century and is possibly the most visited royal monument of Thailand. The building is also home to Bangkok’s most sacred temple, the “Wat PhraKaew” and the famous Emerald Buddha.

OVERNIGHT IN BANGKOK

itinerary.title: BANGKOK - KANCHANABURI
itinerary.description:

You’ll be whisked off to the Kanchanaburi province (128km west of Bangkok) where you’ll visit the famous Bridge over the River Kwai and take a train ride along the scenic and historic Death Railway route. Get off the train and chow down on a delicious lunch at a local restaurant, proceeding then to the Hellfire Pass Memorial. When you reach Hintok River Camp you’ll check in and have dinner. Overnight in the resort with breakfast, lunch and dinner included.

itinerary.title: KANCHANABURI
itinerary.description:

Watch as the locals offer food and alms to the Buddhist monks and discover this naturally beautiful and wonderfully serene area. Overnight in the resort in Kanchanaburi with breakfast, lunch and dinner included.

itinerary.title: KANCHANABURI - BANGKOK
itinerary.description:
After breakfast you’ll check out from the hotel and head off on a long-tailed boat tour to the River Kwai Jungle Rafts. The route will take you alongside untouched verdant jungle landscape and to an ethnic Mon Tribal Village. Optional: bike tour as you exit the bamboo jungle trek (300 Baht pp) or relaxing Thai massage (not included). As you venture away from the village, proceed to the Thailand-Burma Railway Centre, both an interactive museum and research facility dedicated to preserving the history of the Thailand-Burma Railway. It’s an educational and moving experience for all who visit (plus there’s air conditioning!). 

Next, visit the Allied War Cemetery, a memorial to some 6000 allied prisoners of war who perished along the Death Railway line. You’ll be transferred back to your hotel in Bangkok city centre. Overnight with breakfast and lunch included.

OVERNIGHT IN BANGKOK

title: 12 Days Island Hopping Thailand Holiday
description:
Save £600 per person!

This 12-day Thailand island-hopping adventure takes you through some of the country's most stunning tropical destinations, blending relaxation, adventure, and cultural exploration. From the towering limestone cliffs of Krabi to the unspoiled beaches of Koh Lanta, the turquoise waters of Koh Phi Phi, and the vibrant charm of Phuket, this journey offers a perfect balance of leisure and excitement. 

The trip begins in Krabi, where you’ll be greeted and transferred to your hotel for a relaxed start. From there, you'll travel to Koh Lanta, a peaceful island known for its serene beaches and laid-back atmosphere. With ample free time, you can explore at your own pace, whether it’s sunbathing on the beach, snorkeling in crystal-clear waters, or discovering local villages. 

Next, you'll head to the world-famous Koh Phi Phi, an island paradise renowned for its breathtaking scenery, hidden lagoons, and vibrant marine life. Here, you can enjoy thrilling water activities like snorkeling and diving, or simply relax and take in the island’s postcard-perfect beauty. The journey continues to Phuket, Thailand’s largest island, where you can choose to explore the cultural charms of Phuket Old Town, visit an ethical Elephant Jungle Sanctuary, or simply enjoy the island’s renowned nightlife and pristine beaches. 

Throughout the trip, you'll experience seamless travel with scenic ferry rides, comfortable accommodations, and optional excursions that allow for customization based on your interests. Whether you seek adventure, cultural immersion, or pure relaxation, this itinerary offers the ultimate tropical escape, with unforgettable moments at every turn. From exploring lush jungles and limestone caves to dining by the ocean under breathtaking sunsets, this trip is designed to showcase the very best of Thailand’s island life.

A half-day package to the Elephant Jungle Sanctuary offers visitors an enjoyable opportunity to spend quality time with elephants in their natural home, as well as gain an insight into their history and behavior, and create cherished lifelong memories of their time spent with these amazing animals. Visitors to the Sanctuary will witness stunning views of the surrounding jungle while interacting personally with friendly, happy elephants in a safe and sustainable environment. On the morning of your visit, you will arrive at the Sanctuary, meet your English-speaking guide, and learn a little about the elephants. After being allocated bananas and sugar cane to feed to the elephants, you will walk with your guide through the Sanctuary, where you will find free-roaming elephants and hear their individual stories. You can touch, feed, photograph, and interact with the elephants at your leisure while you learn about their lifestyle and behaviors. After you have met all the elephants, you will accompany them to a nearby mud spa. Get muddy with the elephants as you apply a healthy cosmetic mud treatment to their skin. Next, you will walk with the elephants to a nearby pool and join them in the water for a refreshing bath. Take a swim and help bathe and brush the elephants while they wade through and play in the water. Once the elephants are clean, you can take some final photos with them, and then it will be time to part ways with your new friend and change into some dry clothes. Finally, enjoy a delightful Thai buffet before saying one last goodbye to your new friends before departing from the camp.

OVERNIGHT IN PHUKET

The wonderful mixture of historical insights, Old Phuket Town invites visitors to experience its architecture, commerce, dress, and way of life. Surrounded by Sino-Portuguese buildings on both the sides, it is one of the best places in Thailand to discover and experience the history of Phuket. Get ready to explore the architectural wonders along with delicious Thai foods and walk along the streets full of styled houses. Your journey begins in the bustling metropolis of Bangkok, Thailand's capital, where you'll be swept away by the exotic and diverse charms of this westernized Asian city. title: Central Hotel Stays In Bangkok, Chiang Mai And Koh Samui
description:
Head off on the journey of a lifetime to three of Thailand’s treasures: Bangkok, Chiang Mai and Koh Samui. Kick back and relax at high-end hotels, dip your toes into emerald waters and drift between dazzling temples. The holiday of your dreams is only a click away… 

You’ll kick-start your adventure like a true A-Lister with a 2 nights’ stay in one of Bangkok’s 5 star hotels. Luxurious and centrally located, the Ramada Plaza has received a Certificate of Excellence from Trip Advisor and provides a perfect base for exploring the often dubbed “Venice of the East.” First, cross the Chao Phraya River and marvel at a plethora of splendid temples and other cultural landmarks which outline Bangkok’s history and heritage. Then, swap the sightseeing for some serious pampering at the hotel’s signature spa or head out and explore Bangkok’s vibrant nightlife. 

Next, an internal flight will whisk you off to blissful Chiang Mai, a far cry from the crowds and bright lights of Bangkok, where you’ll stay for 2 nights at a 4 star hotel. With golden temples galore, an unparalleled cuisine and a bustling night market, your time in Thailand’s northern capital promises to be memorable.

Last but not least, you’ll touch down on the island of Koh Samui, whose soft and silky sand sits idly behind a backdrop of aquamarine water. The island’s glittering ocean provides ample opportunity to cool off from Koh Samui’s average temperature of 28 degrees Celsius. Your home for 5 nights will be the 4 star Pavilion Samui Resort, nestled within acres of beautifully landscaped gardens and offering ultimate rest and relaxation to all its guests.

title: Thailand in Style Cities Jungles and Beaches
description:
Trade in your dull 9-5 routine for the bright lights of touristy Bangkok and an eye-opening visit to ancient Chiang Mai. Then, spoil yourself at the exquisite beaches of Koh Lanta, and explore the luxurious island of Phuket. With flights, transfers, tours and top-class hotels included, what more could you want out of a package holiday?  

Thailand is a rich haven of diversity where beaches merge with cities to create a much sought-after concoction of surf and shopping. This bespoke multi-centre tour will see the trip of your dreams become a reality as you hop between four of the country’s most happening hot spots, offering a first-hand look into the hectic yet bustling life of this Southeast Asian gem. You’ll start off in Bangkok, your home for two nights will be the five-star Montien Hotel Surawong Bangkok - SHA Extra Plus. Set about a 5-minute stroll to Wat Hua Lamphong, comfortable 5-star Montien Hotel Surawong Bangkok is located near Patpong and is a popular choice amongst travelers in Bangkok, whether exploring or just passing through. 

The second leg of your trip will take you to the ancient city of Ayutthaya, which you’ll reach by coach. From there, you’ll take an overnight train ride to Chiang Mai, a stunningly ancient city teeming with Buddhist temples. After enjoying a full-day trip to one of the best trekking sites in northern Thailand, you’ll be able to rest your weary feet at the four-star Novotel Chiangmai Nimman Journeyhub Chiang Mai Hotel for two nights, where sumptuous cuisine, great service and a pleasant atmosphere are part of the norm. 

Then, make your way to Krabi by plane, before being transferred to Koh Lanta, a small pearl lying on the western shores of Thailand where you’ll spend three nights at the five-star Avani Plus Koh Lanta Krabi Resort - SHA Extra Plus. The hotel offers a private beach, luxury accommodation, and extensive services. It is ideally situated on an elevated peninsula in Ko Lanta, offering views of Andaman Sea.

Last but not least you’ll hop to Phuket Island by plane and spend a night lapping up the luxury at the five-star Andaman Sea View Resort. This hotel, overlooking the ripples of the ocean and the rustling of the trees in the surrounding forest, is merely a short stroll from the lively Karon Beach where visitors can try their hand at water sports or remain perched on a sun-lounger sipping an ice-cold Singha. The hotel’s spa facilities offer ample opportunity to pamper yourself before you head home, and the mouth-watering delights served in the two restaurants will have you sweet-talking the chef for the recipes. With two exquisite swimming pools in various parts of the grounds too, it goes without saying your stay in Phuket will be a memorable one. 

For more information, please see inclusions below and tour details via the itinerary tab.
