itinerary.description:
Welcome to Thailand! Upon arrival at Bangkok Airport, one of our representatives will be there to meet you and show you to your coach transfer. Travel to your hotel (unaccompanied) for check-in and spend the rest of the day at leisure. 

OVERNIGHT STAY IN BANGKOK.

itinerary.title: BANGKOK AT LEISURE (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
Spend the entire day exploring Bangkok at your own pace, as there is no set itinerary today. 
However, if you’re keen to do some sightseeing, you can book onto an optional tour. We’d recommend doing a half day tour of the most popular landmarks of the area such as the Royal Grand Palace. Used as a royal residence from the 18th century to the mid-20th century, it is one of Thailand’s most visited monuments and also home to the sacred temple of Wat Phra Kaew. Inside, you can find the famous Emerald Buddha Statue. 

OVERNIGHT STAY IN BANGKOK.

itinerary.title: BANGKOK AT LEISURE
itinerary.description:
Today you’ll be able to explore the city at your own pace again, as there is no set itinerary. Bangkok is an eclectic, vibrant hub – there’s so much to see and do so we recommend picking out a few things you didn’t manage to do the day before and crafting a day’s itinerary around those. 

OVERNIGHT STAY IN BANGKOK.

itinerary.title: FULL DAY TOUR OF ANCIENT AYUTTHAYA WITH OVERNIGHT TRAIN JOURNEY (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
Tuck into a hearty hotel breakfast and then check out, making your way to the province of Ayutthaya – Thailand’s former capital for around 417 years and located 76 kilometres north of Bangkok. 

During this tour, you’ll get to see some of the area’s main sights and delights:

Wat Sri Sanphet – a monastery used as a presidential palace when King Ramathibodi I reigned. 
Wat Phananchoeng – another monastery that dates all the way back to before Ayutthaya was even founded. 
Wat Yai Chaimongkhol – a monastery boasting one of the largest chedis, built by King Naresuan. 
Bang-Pa-In – the former summer residence of the royals, a great example of traditional Thai architecture. 

You’ll be dropped off at Ayutthaya train station in the evening and take the overnight train to Chiang Mai (unaccompanied). 

Please note:  Make sure you pack light so that your luggage is easy to carry
Train company will confirm departure and issue your ticket 60 days in advance
Travel is provided by the State Railway of Thailand – book with your tour operator to avoid booking onto a service that’s fully booked
Train ticket is non-refundable once issued 

OVERNIGHT STAY IN BANGKOK.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN CHIANG MAI (BREAKFAST AND WELCOME SET MENU DINNER INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
You’ll reach Chiang Mai train station at around 07:15 and a driver will be waiting to transfer you to your hotel. Upon arrival, leave your luggage with the hotel’s front office and have some breakfast at a food exchange restaurant. You’re free to do as you please up until 2pm which is when you’ll be able to check in. 

Please note:
Early check-in (i.e. before noon) is not included.

OVERNIGHT STAY IN CHIANG MAI

itinerary.title: DAYTIME TREK IN CHIANG MAI (BREAKFAST AND LUNCH INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
After having breakfast at the hotel, head off via local truck or van to the area of Mae Win where you’ll commence your trek. Walk for an hour and a half to a waterfall and spend some time swimming and relaxing – after which, you’ll head to Karen Village for a tasty lunch at a local restaurant. 

Then, go bamboo rafting along the Mae Win River for about an hour (dependent on water levels). In the late afternoon, head back to your hotel via local truck/van. 

Please note:
You’ll travel by local truck/van with an English-speaking guide. Itinerary can be changed/modified depending on weather conditions. We recommend bringing comfortable, non-slippery walking shoes, as well as protective, water-resistant bags so that any electronic devices don’t get wet during trekking/rafting. It’s also advisable to bring a swimsuit, towel, sunglasses, mosquito repellent and any personal medication you might need.

OVERNIGHT STAY IN CHIANG MAI.

itinerary.title: CHIANG MAI – KRABI – KOH LANTA (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
Have breakfast at your hotel before transferring to Chiang Mai Airport to board your flight to Krabi (airfare not included). Upon arrival in Krabi, head to Koh Lanta to check in to your hotel.

OVERNIGHT STAY IN KOH LANTA.

itinerary.title: KOH LANTA AT LEISURE (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a full day of leisure in beautiful Koh Lanta. Our local representative is on hand to give you recommendations for structuring your day (by request only) but we definitely suggest trying out some of the best dive spots. The area boasts an intricate system of reefs, islets and underwater caves, teeming with colourful sea creatures for you to ogle. 

Then, cap off your day with some mouthwatering fresh seafood – some of which will surely get taste buds tingling with its spicy flavours. 

OVERNIGHT STAY IN KOH LANTA.

itinerary.title: KOH LANTA AT LEISURE (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
You can spend today at leisure too. Whether you’re sampling delectable seafood, sunbathing on the shore or trying out other dive sites in search of kaleidoscopic marine life, make sure you take some time out to appreciate the heavenly surroundings of Koh Lanta. 

OVERNIGHT STAY IN KOH LANTA.

itinerary.title: KOH LANTA – PHUKET (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
After having breakfast at the hotel, you’ll transfer from Koh Lanta to Phuket by coach. Upon arrival there, check in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

OVERNIGHT STAY IN PHUKET.

itinerary.title: DEPARTURE FROM PHUKET (BREAKFAST INCLUDED)
itinerary.description:
Tuck into a reinvigorating breakfast and then take some time to relax until your transfer to Phuket Airport to board your flight home (airfare not included). We hope you’ve had a wonderful stay in Thailand! 

END OF TOUR

itinerary.title: Bangkok Temples Tour
itinerary.description:
You cannot leave Thailand without taking this half-day tour visiting three of the most significant temples in Bangkok renowned for their cultural values and Buddhist sacredness.

The first stop of the day is the Wat Trimit, known as the Temple of the Golden Buddha. This modern temple was built to house the famous the 3-metre tall Buddha statue crafted from 5.5 tons of solid gold. This gleaming Sukhothai style statue was accidently discovered after a painted and decorated statue was being moved to a new location, when it was accidently dropped, revealing a beautiful solid gold Sukhothai style Buddha.

As you pass through Chinatown you will come across one of Bangkok´s oldest temples, Wat Pho, known as the Temple of the Reclining Buddha. At 46 metres in length and 15 metres high the Buddha is the largest in Bangkok and illustrates the passing of the Buddha into nirvana. This beautiful temple complex is home to Thailand´s largest collection of Buddha images, the first university and was the birthplace of traditional Thai massage.

The third and final temple is the Wat Benchamabophit, also known as the Marble Temple. This monastery was built out of white Italian marble from Carrara in the 19th century and houses one of the country's most beautiful Buddha images.

title: City Lights to Island Nights Bangkok Bali Lombok and Singapore
description:
Discover
the Enchanting Treasures of Southeast Asia

Embark on an unforgettable journey through three of Southeast Asia’s most captivating destinations, staying in luxurious 5-star hotels at every stop. This carefully curated tour offers a seamless blend of urban flair, cultural immersion, and tropical bliss—all with flights included (featuring both cabin bag and a generous 20kg hold allowance).

Itinerary Highlights

3 Nights
in Bangkok

Begin your adventure in Thailand’s vibrant capital, where modern skyscrapers and ancient temples exist side by side. Stay in a prestigious 5-star hotel with breathtaking city views, and indulge in the local street food, vibrant shopping districts, and the iconic Grand Palace.

3 Nights
in Ubud, Bali

Next, journey to the heart of Bali’s cultural gem: Ubud. Renowned for its lush rice terraces, serene temples, and thriving arts scene, Ubud offers a peaceful escape in a luxurious resort set amidst tropical foliage. Treat yourself to holistic spa treatments, explore local artisan crafts, and take in the area’s spiritual heritage.

3 Nights
in Lombok

Continue to the sun-kissed shores of Lombok, where pristine beaches and crystal-clear waters await. Spend your days lounging by the pool, snorkelling vibrant coral reefs, or discovering hidden waterfalls. By night, enjoy sumptuous dining experiences in your exclusive 5-star haven, savouring the island’s tranquillity and natural beauty.

2 Nights
in Singapore

Conclude your journey in the clean, cosmopolitan city of Singapore. Stay at a luxury 5-star hotel along the scenic waterfront. Enjoy world-class shopping on Orchard Road, take in the futuristic beauty of Gardens by the Bay, and savour a blend of cultures through the city's renowned culinary scene.

Go Solo fr. £1999

Why not add a trip to see the Komodo Dragons fr. £699pp? Ask your consultant for more details.

title: From Neon Nights To Tropical Dreams Hong Kong Kl Bali In 13 Days
description:
This 13-day multi-destination adventure takes you through three of Asia’s most exciting and contrasting destinations – the dazzling cityscapes of Hong Kong, the cultural and spiritual heart of Kuala Lumpur, and the serene tropical beauty of Bali.

Your journey begins in Hong Kong, a city where East meets West in a spectacular skyline of soaring skyscrapers and bustling harbor views. A hop-on hop-off bus tour gives you the freedom to discover Hong Kong’s iconic landmarks, charming neighborhoods, and vibrant markets at your own pace.

From there, travel to Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia’s lively capital, where tradition blends with modernity. The highlight is an unforgettable excursion to the Batu Caves, one of the most revered Hindu shrines in the world, where the striking golden statue of Lord Murugan stands guard over ancient limestone caves. You’ll also enjoy enriching cultural stops, from pewter craftsmanship at Royal Selangor to colorful batik artistry and sweet treats at Beryl’s Chocolate Gallery.

Finally, immerse yourself in the tranquility of Bali, one of the world’s most sought-after island getaways. With six full days at leisure, you can choose between ultimate relaxation and active exploration. Whether it’s sunbathing on golden beaches, indulging in a Balinese spa retreat, venturing into Ubud’s lush rice terraces, witnessing sunset at sea temples, or taking an island-hopping trip to Nusa Penida – the choice is yours.

This well-balanced itinerary seamlessly blends city excitement, cultural discovery, and island bliss, making it perfect for travelers who want to experience the best of Asia in a single, unforgettable holiday.

title: 9 Nights In Kuala Lumpur Bali and Singapore
description:
Save £400 per person!

Embark on an enchanting journey, delving into Southeast Asia's vibrant cultures, stunning landscapes, and thrilling urban experiences with our specially curated holiday package.

 Your adventure begins with two nights in the mesmerizing city of Kuala Lumpur, where you'll enjoy the comfort and luxury of the 4-star Verdant Hill Hotel Kuala Lumpur. Just a stone's throw away from the city centre, the hotel allows you to immerse yourself in the energetic city life and iconic attractions of Kuala Lumpur. Explore the architectural marvel of the Petronas Twin Towers, relish the kaleidoscope of street food at Jalan Alor Night Market, and discover the spiritual tranquillity at the Batu Caves, all while knowing a peaceful retreat awaits you.

 From the urban excitement of Kuala Lumpur, you'll transition to the serene beauty of Bali for a five-night stay at Villa Coco, it is a boutique villa resort located in Seminyak, one of Bali’s most vibrant areas. It offers a mix of traditional Balinese-style bungalows and luxury private pool villas—perfect for couples, families, and groups. The property is set in lush tropical gardens, providing a peaceful retreat just steps from Seminyak's bustling streets. 

Your holiday culminates with two nights in Singapore, staying at the stylish and contemporary Village Hotel Katong. Strategically located in the city's heart, it offers easy access to its top attractions. Delight in the futuristic wonders of Gardens by the Bay, savour the panoramic views from Marina Bay Sands Skypark and dive into the rich cultural tapestry of Little India and the historic Lau Pa Sat food centre.

 Our holiday package offers unique experiences, interweaving cosmopolitan luxury, cultural immersion, and idyllic relaxation. Uncover the soul of Southeast Asia and create unforgettable memories with us on this carefully planned and exceptionally executed holiday journey.

accommodations.description:
Nina Hotel Tsuen Wan West

 Nina Hotel Tsuen Wan West is a genuine Hong Kong landmark that presides over the Kowloon Peninsula’s Western edge. Standing between Tai Mo Shan mountain and the Rambler Channel, it was originally planned to be the world’s tallest building. However, its proximity to the airport flightpath led to it becoming the two sparkling sister towers of today. This Nina’s location is packed with appeals. Firstly, getting here is easy. It’s less than 20 minutes by road from Central, Tsim Sha Tsui is a 12 minute train ride, and the international airport is 25 minutes by the highway. So you see, it’s an efficient base from which to explore. But be warned, you may not want to leave.

title: Holidays to Bali - Luxury Bali Break (2019/20)
description:
You’ll fall in love with this Indonesian island the moment you lay eyes on it. Twinkling coastlines border smouldering volcanic landscapes and temple-ridden towns to create a picture-perfect island and unforgettable holiday destination.

Wash up on Bali’s shores and you’ll stumble across no end of things to do. Seminyak surf schools will teach you the ways of the wave-chaser, spirited hikes across blackened terrain up to the grumbling Mount Batur will have you working up a sweat, and the inhabitants of the Ubud Monkey Forest will try their hardest to steal your heart (and possibly your lunch).

On “the Island of the Gods” there is no room for boredom. This seven night getaway spent in Nusa Dua, Bali’s southern belle and hot spot for beach-hopping and sight-seeing, will have you flitting between the crystal-clear waters of Geger Beach to sacred spaces such as Puja Mandala. A whole heap of historical heritage and culture is begging to be explored if you can tear yourself away from your sun lounger for long enough… 

Fill your mornings with visits to the Pasifika Museum where Bali and Southeast Asia’s art scene comes to life. A lesser-known touristy gem filled with Polynesian artefacts, an Indochinese exhibition and the works of both local painters and well-known artists from around the world, the Pasifika Museum is an art buff’s dream come true.

Scuba diving, surfing, snorkeling and diving are all popular pursuits around Nusa Dua, offering visitors the chance to get up close and personal with the multi-coloured marine life present within the Coral Triangle, an enchanting patch of ocean within which Bali happens to be conveniently located. And if water-based activities don’t exactly float your boat, Nusa Dua is also home to the most popular golf course in Bali.

While basking in Bali’s sun, you’ll spend a blissful seven nights at the Nusa Dua Beach Hotel & Spa. Located on the island’s southern peninsula, this hotel is la crème de la crème of Bali’s deluxe resorts and has welcomed kings, queens and presidents over the years. Its 9 hectare tropical gardens sit peacefully beside three sun-soaked pools and swaying palms, while the salty spray of the ocean is just a few paces away. 

Your 5 Star Balinese palace sits upon 200 metres of glowing coastline, meaning that morning strolls along the shore and afternoon paddles in the shallows are a popular pastime. Wander through manicured gardens, relax by one of the three outdoor pools and make sure you head to the hotel’s award-winning spa.

In true Balinese style, beautiful spa facilities offer traditional island treatments which leave you feeling revitalized and energized. Get rid of those aches and pains with sensational massages, open up those pores in a sweaty sauna session or take a cool dip in the 25-metre plunge pool. 

And after a relaxing hour or two (or three) spent at the spa, sink your teeth into an extraordinary meal at one of the hotel’s many restaurants. Choose from Mediterranean, Balinese and Asian cuisine to set your taste-buds tingling and then round off your evening with a stroll along the pearly-white shore against a blood-orange sunset.

With guided tours, scenic landscapes, and a perfect mix of activity and leisure, this tour offers a complete Indonesian island experience.

itinerary.title: ARRIVE BALI
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport in Denpasar, Bali, you will be welcomed by an English-speaking guide and transferred to your hotel in Seminyak or Kuta. After check-in, the rest of the day is yours to relax and recover from your journey or start exploring the local surroundings at your own pace. You’ll spend the night at your hotel in Seminyak/Kuta.

itinerary.title: Seminyak/Kuta – Ubud and surrounding with waterfall – Seminyak/Kuta
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day tour to explore Ubud and its lush surroundings. Your first stop is the serene Sumampan Waterfall, accessible via a scenic trail and nearly a hundred steps down through tropical greenery. At the base, admire unique stone carvings created by a local artist, blending nature and culture beautifully. Next, visit Goa Gajah, or Elephant Cave, a 9th-century meditation sanctuary featuring a dramatic stone entrance. Continue north to the iconic Tegalalang Rice Terraces, where you can stroll through the emerald landscape and optionally try the famous jungle swing (at an additional cost). Lunch is served at a scenic coffee plantation overlooking a peaceful valley, where you’ll enjoy Balinese crispy duck. In the afternoon, visit Tirta Empul, a sacred water temple where locals have come to purify themselves for centuries. After a day immersed in nature and culture, return to your hotel in Seminyak/Kuta for the night.

itinerary.title: Seminyak/Kuta – beaches hopping – Uluwatu Kecak Dance – Seminyak/Kuta
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before setting off for a day of beach hopping along Bali’s stunning southern coast. Relax at your choice of three beautiful beaches—Thomas Beach, Balangan Beach, and Padang Padang—each offering its own charm, from secluded sands to cliffside views and surfing vibes. You may spend as much time as you like at each, or skip one if preferred. In the evening, make your way to the cliffs of Uluwatu Temple to watch the dramatic Kecak fire dance performance against the backdrop of a fiery sunset over the Indian Ocean. Return to your hotel in Seminyak/Kuta for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Seminyak/Kuta – Free at leisure
itinerary.description: Today is free for you to enjoy as you please. You can relax at your hotel, explore Seminyak’s boutiques and cafes, or choose from two optional full-day tours. The first option is a trip to Nusa Penida, including speedboat transfers, snorkeling at pristine spots known for manta rays and vibrant reefs, a visit to iconic Kelingking Beach, Broken Beach, and Angel’s Billabong, with lunch included at a beach club. The second option is a customized private tour with a guide, tailored to your interests—whether that’s temples, rice terraces, beaches, or cultural landmarks. You’ll spend the night again in Seminyak/Kuta.

itinerary.title: Seminyak – Speed boat to Lombok - Senggigi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you’ll be privately transferred from your hotel to Padang Bai Harbor on Bali’s east coast. From there, take a speedboat across the Lombok Strait to reach Lombok Island. As Bali fades into the distance, enjoy views of the ocean and small surrounding islands. Upon arrival at Senggigi Harbor, meet your local team and transfer to your hotel in Senggigi. The rest of the day is at your leisure to relax and settle in. Overnight in Senggigi.

itinerary.title: Senggigi – Day at leisure
itinerary.description: Spend the day at your own pace, soaking up the serene beauty of Lombok. After a leisurely breakfast, you may choose to swim in the crystal-clear waters, snorkel along the nearby reefs, or simply lounge by the beach or pool. This is a perfect opportunity to recharge and enjoy the peaceful surroundings. Overnight in Senggigi.

itinerary.title: Senggigi – Three Island with snorkeling - Senggigi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on an exciting island-hopping adventure to the famous Gili Islands—Trawangan, Meno, and Air. Depart from Teluk Nara by speedboat to Gili Trawangan, where you’ll board a glass-bottom boat for your first snorkeling stop at a stunning blue coral site. Continue to Gili Meno to snorkel around the enchanting underwater statues and possibly spot sea turtles. The final island, Gili Air, offers another beautiful snorkeling location, followed by a delicious lunch served on the island. You’ll have free time to relax, walk, or bike around before returning by boat to Lombok. On the way back, stop at Malimbu Cliff and Nipah Beach to enjoy a scenic sunset and a grilled seafood dinner. Overnight in Senggigi.

itinerary.title: Senggigi – Day at leisure
itinerary.description: This is another free day to enjoy the laid-back charm of Senggigi. Whether you want to pamper yourself with a spa treatment, explore local markets, or simply relax on the beach, the day is yours. Overnight in Senggigi.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy some final moments of leisure before your transfer to Lombok International Airport for your flight back home. Hotel check-out time is at 12:00 PM.

title: Bali Dream Escape Private Villas, Poolside Bliss
description:
Bali Dream Escape - Save £600 per person!

Bali Dream Escape: Two Worlds, One Perfect Journey

Where Ancient Rainforests Meet Golden Shores

Escape to the enchanting island of Bali for an unforgettable 7-night luxury retreat that captures the soul of this mystical island through its most captivating contrasts. This isn't just a holiday – it's a journey between two distinct worlds, each offering its own magic.

Ubud: Heart of the Sacred Rainforest (4 Nights)

Begin your odyssey in Ubud, where emerald rice terraces cascade down volcanic slopes and ancient Hindu temples emerge from mist-shrouded jungle. Your sanctuary awaits at the serene Seres Hotel & Resort, where your One Bedroom Pool Villa becomes your private retreat amidst nature's cathedral.

Here, in Bali's spiritual heartland, mornings begin with the distant chanting from village temples and the gentle rustle of bamboo in tropical breezes. This is where Balinese culture thrives in its purest form – where master artisans still carve intricate sculptures, where traditional markets burst with exotic spices and tropical fruits, and where the ancient practice of wellness and healing has been perfected over millennia.

Your Ubud Experience:

 Wake to views of terraced rice paddies that have fed Balinese families for over 1,000 years

Discover hidden waterfalls cascading through pristine jungle

Explore the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary, where ancient temples lie hidden among towering trees

Indulge in world-class spa treatments using traditional Balinese healing techniques

Savor farm-to-table cuisine featuring ingredients grown in the fertile volcanic soil


Jimbaran: Where Ocean Dreams Come Alive (3 Nights)

Your journey then sweeps you south to Jimbaran's sun-kissed shores, where the Indian Ocean stretches endlessly toward the horizon. At the sophisticated Cross Bali Breakers, your Deluxe One Bedroom Pool Villa becomes your oceanside sanctuary – an oasis of contemporary luxury where modern design meets traditional Balinese elegance.

Jimbaran Bay, with its crescent of golden sand and calm turquoise waters, has been the island's premier fishing village for generations. As evening falls, witness one of Bali's most magical moments: traditional jukung fishing boats silhouetted against spectacular sunsets that paint the sky in brilliant oranges and purples.

Your Jimbaran Experience:

Dine on the beach with fresh-caught seafood grilled over coconut husks 

Explore the famous Jimbaran Fish Market at dawn, alive with the day's catch

Discover nearby Uluwatu Temple, perched dramatically on clifftops 70 meters above crashing waves

Watch traditional Kecak fire dances performed against stunning ocean backdrops

Unwind with beachside massages as gentle waves provide nature's soundtrack

 Seamless Luxury Throughout

With private air-conditioned transfers whisking you effortlessly between destinations, every moment is designed for pure indulgence. Daily breakfasts showcase both international favorites and authentic Balinese specialties, while your luxurious accommodations provide the perfect base for exploration – or simply for savoring those precious moments of
poolside tranquility.

This is Bali as it was meant to be experienced: intimately, luxuriously, and authentically. Whether you're drawn to ancient temples hidden in jungle mists, the healing powers of traditional spa rituals, the thrill of discovering hidden waterfalls, or simply the bliss of watching perfect sunsets from your private villa – this journey captures the very essence of the Island
of the Gods.

Two sides of paradise. One unforgettable escape.

title: Spend 10 nights touring all of Nepal’s hot spots
description:
Located in Southern Asia, Nepal is a touristy bubble bursting with spectacular hiking routes and eight of the world’s highest peaks, including Everest. Lush, green mountains and sparkling lakes make for a concoction that’s irresistible to tourists and visitors, who find themselves drawn in by its cultural charm and religious heritage. Temples are ten a penny and the lifestyle is so unique and rich with flavor and age-old customs that it’s hard not to fall in love with the Nepalese way of life.  

Beginning in Kathmandu, Nepal’s capital, your trip will lead you deep into the very heart of Nepali culture. As you mingle with the monkeys at the Monkey Temple, one of the most sacred Buddhist sites, and pay a visit to the Boudha Stupa, one of the largest stupas in the world, you’ll come to understand why this country has such a rich history. You’ll step foot into the Hindu temple of Pashupatinath, the Lord of Animals, and then wander Durbar Square’s palaces and temples, including the Kasthamandap, also known as the “Wooden House.” The square, sprinkled with merchants and devotees during the early hours, is Nepal’s most popular UNESCO World Heritage Site (and rightly so!).

Then, swap the urban vibes of Kathmandu with Chitwan. you will visit Chitwan National Park, whose 932 square kilometers are a haven for Bengal tigers, leopards, crocodiles, monkeys and more. Keep your eyes peeled for these sensational beasts, as well as the endangered one horn rhinos, which roam the plump grassland. In addition to marveling at the colorful flora and fauna, you can also go on elephant rides, jungle canoeing, nature walks and tiger and rhino viewing. Here you will spend 2 nights at the Jungle Villa, a leafy location right in the thick of all the glorious flora and fauna.

When you finally tire of Chitwan National Park charm, you’ll head to Pokhara, the second largest city in Nepal. As the starting point for many of the treks to the Annapurna Mountain Range, Pokhara is a lively hub of culture vultures and hiking enthusiasts. It is also home to the Phewa Lake, one of Nepal’s most idyllic spots, perfect for rowing across and gazing at the mesmerizing views of the towering peaks and dense forests which surround it.

After Pokhara, you’ll head to Bandipur, another hill-top town offering an abundance of hiking routes and fabulous views from elevated viewpoints. The quaint Old Inn in Bandipur will also be your home for a night, before hitting the road to Nagarkot where you’ll settle for 2 nights.

Nagarkot, a town located 32 km from Kathmandu which offers maybe the best views of the Himalayas in all of the Bhaktapur District, as well as a panoramic view of the Kathmandu Valley. At sunrise, watch as Mount Everest and other peaks of the Himalayan range come into view, startlingly crystal clear, and then head off for a hike into the heart of all of this incredibly beautiful nature.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN KATHMANDU
itinerary.description:
The adventure begins today as you fly to Kathmandu. One of our friendly representatives will greet you at the airport and transfer you to your hotel. Upon arrival, you’ll be formally introduced to your guide for the next few days, the person who will lead all of your activities and ensure you are all well-informed and having a great time. It’s a good idea to pay attention to the safety aspects of the briefing too, and then you’ll have the opportunity to ask any questions and clear up any doubts you may have. You’ll stay overnight at the hotel.

DINNER & OVERNIGHT IN KATHMANDU

itinerary.title: KATHMANDU
itinerary.description:
Kathmandu City:

Get ready to visit the temple of the Living Goddess, one of
the most important in Nepal. The Kumari Goddess dwells on her balcony
regularly, acknowledging the greetings of the devotees, after having moved into
the temple with her family. She leaves the temple only to attend a few
festivals each year and her reign lasts only until puberty, when she becomes a
regular girl again. From Durbar Square you can see the Hanuman Dhoka Palace,
the ancient residence of the Nepalese Royalty.

Swayambhunath:

Associated with the birth of the Kathmandu Valley
civilization, Swayambhunath is a supremely important site of culture and
religion in Nepal. Located on a serene hilltop in the southwest, this enormous
dome around 2000 years old is surrounded by other temples and religious sites
for both Hindus and Buddhists, displaying the peaceful co-existence between
people’s differing religious beliefs in Nepal. Swayambhunath is also known as
the “Monkey Temple,” since it is surrounded by troops of monkeys, as well as
indigenous plant species and forest. Its high elevation also makes it a perfect
viewpoint, so make sure you keep a look-out for the Himalayas sitting idly in
the east, as well as the Kathmandu Valley.

Patan or Yala:

One of the three main cities of the Kathmandu Valley is
Patan (otherwise known as Yala), located on the southern banks of the Bagmati
River. Famous for its temples, palace courtyards and public baths, Patan was
established by the Kirat Dynasty and was supposedly the first settlement in the
Valley. Its abundance of temples and monuments (there are more than 1000)
dedicated to a mixture of Buddhist and Hindu gods, are breathtakingly
elaborate. Definitely pay a visit to Patan Durbar Square, as it is one of the
seven Monument Zones which make up the UNESCO World Heritage Sites of Kathmandu
Valley. You’ll stay overnight at the hotel. 

OVERNIGHT IN KATHMANDU

itinerary.title: KATHMANDU–CHITWAN
itinerary.description:
Leave the beauty of Kathmandu behind and venture to Chitwan. Upon arrival, you’ll check into a wildlife lodge and be briefed about your stay in Chitwan. 

You will enjoy a guided village walk and a walk on the banks of the Rapti River to watch the charming sunset views in the sub-tropical jungle. 

In the evening, Dinner with cultural program by ethnic tribal people with their stick dance and tribal drums.

OVERNIGHT IN CHITWAN ON FULL BOARD BASIS

itinerary.title: ESCAPING TO THE JUNGLE OF CHITWAN
itinerary.description:
Today will be spent entirely within the park. You will also visit to the National Park Visitor's centre where you can learn more about the history of the National Park and about wildlife.

You will have a chance to see four different kinds of deer, rhinoceros, wild boar, monkey, leopard, sloth bear, the Royal Bengal Tiger (If you are lucky) and will encounter many other smaller mammals that have made Chitwan their home.

You will also have an excellent opportunity for Bird Watching and for seeing the 2 rare species of crocodiles; the Marsh Mugger and the fish eating Gharial. Experience Jungle Walk & on the way back one can enjoy the elephant bathing.

In the evening, enjoy Tharu cultural dance presentation (which you will also participate in) by the local villagers.

OVERNIGHT IN CHITWAN ON FULL BOARD BASIS

itinerary.title: CHITWAN—POKHARA
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a delicious breakfast. After, you’ll proceed to Pokhara. 

Pokhara does its best to leave all its visitors spellbound by the end of their trip. There are mountains, rivers and lakes, including the peaceful Phewa Lake and grandiose Machha puchhre which make for an impressive landscape. 9km northwest of Pokhara, you’ll find Sarangkot, one of Nepal’s primary tourist destinations. Its high elevation (1592m) means it is blessed with priceless views and terrific scenery, including a fabulous panorama of the entire Annapurna mountain range and the rustic settlements sitting peacefully below. At a 700m drop from the top of Sarangkot, you’ll find the Pokhara Valley and Phewa Lake. After taking an evening walk around the lakeside, you’ll stay overnight at the hotel. 

OVERNIGHT IN POKHARA

itinerary.title: POKHARA SIGHTS
itinerary.description:
Davis Falls:

Davis Falls is a rather spectacular waterfall lying 2km from the centre of Pokhara city. The water gushes directly into a deep, narrow canal which seemingly has no end, and which supposedly took the life of a tourist called David who fell in, and thus was named The Davis Waterfall (other names include Davy’s Fall, David’s Fall or Davis’ Fall).

Gupteswor Mahadev Cave:

Step foot into one of the longest caves in Nepal. On the way to the cave, you’ll marvel at an array of shining stones, as well as the temple stone which resembles a snake’s head and tortoise. This is said to represent the image of the Lord Shiva. Next, you’ll see more beautiful, sparkling gems and a plethora of different rocks shaped like beehives.

Bindebashini Temple:

The Bindebashini Temple is located in the area of the Bazaar and is one of Pokhara’s oldest temples. Legend has it that when Pokhara was part of the Kaski Kingdom, Goddess Durga, the temple’s main deity, was brought from India. On a clear day, you may even be able to catch sight of the Himalayas from this temple, before heading to the old bazaar.

The Fewa (or Phewa) Lake:

The Fewa Lake is the second largest lake in Nepal and is shrouded by mountains whose snowy caps reflect against the glistening ripples of the water. You’ll find an abundance of hotels, tour companies and places to unwind in front of a delicious meal while lapping up the unparalleled landscape. You’ll also get to head out on a boat ride for an hour and visit the Barahi Temple, situated in the middle of the lake. As your boat ride comes to an end, you’ll be dropped back at the Pokhara lake side and stay overnight at the hotel. 

OVERNIGHT IN POKHARA

itinerary.title: POKHARA – BANDIPUR
itinerary.description:
Bandipur offers plenty of hiking routes, elevated viewpoints and panoramic views of the Annapurna Mountain Range when the clouds have subsided. It was first established as an agricultural village by the Magar Kingdom, but was later colonized in the 18th century and began to achieve success as a centre for trading and textiles. Its new residents, the Newars of Bhaktapur, favored the architectural styles of the Newari heartlands in the Kathmandu Valley. The main square is surrounded by temples and shrines, including Khadga Devi Mandir, which supposedly contains a sword given to an early Magar King by Lord Shiva.

OVERNIGHT IN BANDIPUR

itinerary.title: BANDIPUR--–KATHMANDU---NAGARKOT
itinerary.description:
After an early morning breakfast make your way to Nagarkot via Kathmandu.  Nagarkot is situated 32 kilometers east of Kathmandu at an altitude of 2.175 meters. When you reach Nagarkot you’ll be blown away by a panoramic view of the major peaks including Mount Everest. It is an outstanding hilltop that offers great views of Himalayas, breathtaking mountain scenery and the most impressive views of sunrise and sunset.

OVERNIGHT IN NAGARKOT

itinerary.title: NAGARKOT—AT LEISURE
itinerary.description:
Today will be at leisure and you can enjoy the green hills, clean and fresh environment and the unobstructed views of Langtang range which are the main features of Nagarkot.

In the evening enjoy free farewell dinner at the hotel.

OVERNIGHT IN NAGARKOT

itinerary.title: DRIVE BACK TO KATHMANDU
itinerary.description:
Breakfast will be followed by a drive back to Kathmandu. Upon arrival, you’ll be taken to your hotel. In the evening you will visit Pashupatinath Temple & Boudhanath Stupa and then stay overnight OR extend your stay by choosing any of the optional hiking and trekking trip:

1)  CHANGU TO TELKOT

After breakfast we start leisurely from Nagarkot around 8 AM or 9 AM and drive for around an hour to the trail head  Changunarayen. Here you will visit the historical Changunarayen Temple built on 5th century. It is a lovely old temple with important historical writings on copper plates and stones here and there , and speaks well about Nepal's civilization that time. The temple is also a world heritage site declared by UNESCO.  After visiting temple  you will be taken on the relaxed walking trail to the village of Tilkot. Will stop on the way for lunch. The two hour walk takes you through forests and villages so that you can experience life in the more rural areas of Nepal. The views down to the Valley can be stunning, as paddy fields and brick-making chimneys mingle before snowy peaks of the distant Himalayas on clear days.

OVERNIGHT IN KATHMANDU

2)  PANAUTI - NAMOBUDDHA - DHULIKHEL  ( 1 NIGHT STAY)

DAY 1

After breakfast drive to Panauti which is 33 kms away (approx 1 hr) from Nagarkot. From there, hikers start the walk by following the dirt road along the river and passing the town’s Hindu temple. For the next two hours, the way leads more or less evenly through small villages and rice fields. Depending on the season, you can see the locals planting, harvesting rice and other crops and get a great insight into the village life in Nepal. Tea shops along the way invite to rest and have a refreshing cup of Chia ( Tea).

On the way experience breathtaking views of the monastery and the Stupa in the distance. And also the hundreds of thousands of prayer flags attached to a pole at the highest point are unmistakable.

After two hou

itinerary.title: DEPARTURE
itinerary.description:
It’s time to go! After breakfast you’ll make your way to the airport, ready to catch your flight back home. We hope you’ve enjoyed your holiday.

END OF TRIP

title: Amazing Costa Rica
description: Uncover Costa Rica during this twelve-day amazing adventure. Beginning and ending in the capital, San Jose, this tour offers you the chance to discover different aspects of this emblematic destination. Spend precious time visiting the Tortuguero canals. Learn how Costa Rica’s unique climate and diverse landscapes provide perfect growing conditions for gourmet coffee beans. Enjoy the sweetest rainforest experience, discovering the ancient secrets of chocolate: from its discovery and use, in tropical America, to the processing of the product we know and enjoy today. Hike on the Arenal Volcano, with astonishing views, ear-catching information, unbelievable stories and the chance to meet the local wildlife, will remain your favourite memories of Costa Rica after this experience.

highlights: Tortuguero: Tortuguero, is one of Costa Rica's most popular ecotourism destinations. This destination is your "must stop" while in Costa Rica. Discover its Network of canals, lagoons and dense rainforests.

Arenal: This region is considered by many to be one of the most spectacular ones in the country. La Fortuna area is recognized worldwide for being one of the most prominent wellness tourism destinations in the world.

Monteverde: A true nature lovers paradise with a marvellous diversity of wildlife and plant life. Monteverde Cloud Forest is a unique area to observe exotic highland bird species or to explore the cloud forest canopy.
Manuel Antonio: This picturesque national park is the smallest one in Costa Rica but it is full of wild animals, lush vegetation, and beautiful beaches.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL SAN JOSE (20km – 30min)
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Costa Rica! Our representative will greet you at the airport; assist you with your luggage and private transfer to the hotel in San Jose. 

Overnight in San Jose.

itinerary.title: SAN JOSE
itinerary.description:
Wake up to breakfast at the hotel and then join our Classic Coffee Tour. The expert will guide you through the lifecycle of gourmet coffee. Begin in the nursery and follow the beans starting with their growing cycle through careful collection and selection of the finest beans. Next, the aromas of the roaster will enchant you where you will discover how different roasting techniques affect the beans and the brew. We will reveal our roasting and packing secrets that enable them to deliver the best coffee from the Costa Rican plantation to your cup. Learn how experts “break the cup” by using techniques to taste or “cup” coffee to identify and grade the characteristics that qualify a gourmet coffee. Finally, surrounded by an outdoor tropical paradise and while listening to traditional music, you will have an option of savoring a buffet lunch featuring local ingredients at Don Prospero Restaurant (not included). 

Overnight in San Jose.

itinerary.title: SAN JOSE – TORTUGUERO (120km – 3hrs)
itinerary.description:
At the agreed time in the morning, transportation will pick you up at the hotel to transfer you to your next destination, Tortuguero, one of the most famous conservation areas in Costa Rica, located in the north Caribbean. Breakfast included en-route. Arrive at the dock to board a boat that will take you to the lodge in Tortuguero. Around midday, have a delicious lunch at the lodge. During the afternoon, discover its network of canals, lagoons and dense rainforests through a boat tour guided by an expert naturalist guide. Abundant wildlife inhabits Tortuguero, including 57 species of amphibians, 111 species of reptiles, and 60 species of mammals. In the evening, savour dinner at the lodge. 

Overnight in Tortuguero.

itinerary.title: TORTUGUERO
itinerary.description:
Meet your guide for a mid-morning walk along the trails and discover the tropical rain forest of Tortuguero. In the afternoon, visit the enchanting village of Tortuguero; the town a small population of around 500, no cars, and is located on a relatively narrow spit of land between the beach and a canal. Take a closer encounter with the Caribbean culture; discover its people and lifestyle walking through this colourful town.

Overnight in Tortuguero.

itinerary.title: TORTUGUERO – ARENAL (220km – 4hrs)
itinerary.description:
Breakfast included at the hotel and then proceed to checkout. Afterwards, be ready to continue your trip. Shared transfer by boat and land from Tortuguero to the Restaurant located in Guapiles, where you will enjoy the lunch (included). Then, a transfer will take you to your next destination, La Fortuna, home of the colossus Arenal Volcano and a place that gives to its visitors amazing views and a big range of attractions and beautiful nature. Afternoon at leisure to enjoy hotel facilities and relax. 

Overnight in Arenal.

itinerary.title: ARENAL
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel. Today, discover the natural beauty of the Arenal region on a peaceful guided hike through the El Silencio Trail, one of the best places to experience rainforest, wildlife, and spectacular views of the Arenal Volcano. This tour is perfect for nature lovers who want a relaxed, immersive encounter with Costa Rica’s tropical environment. Your guide will lead you along well-maintained forest paths surrounded by towering trees, volcanic rock formations, and a wide variety of flora and fauna. Along the way, you may spot birds, monkeys, frogs, and other wildlife that inhabit the foothills of the volcano. The guide will share insights about the area’s ecosystems, volcanic history, and the natural processes that shaped this iconic landscape. The trail leads to open areas with impressive panoramas of Arenal Volcano, offering excellent opportunities for photography, especially on clear days. The experience combines gentle hiking, wildlife observation, and educational interpretation in a serene and uncrowded environment.

Overnight in Arenal.

itinerary.title: ARENAL – MONTEVERDE (100km – 2.5hrs)
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel and then proceed to checkout. At the agreed time, continue to your next destination: the magical Monteverde cloud forest. This service, half tour – half-shared transfer is a scenic and fast way to go from La Fortuna to the Monteverde area. You will board into a very comfortable and safe pontoon boat for a 30 to 40 minutes (approx.) ride to Rio Chiquito, a little town on the other side of the lake. Once at Rio Chiquito, we will leave the boat and take a short break to stretch the legs, after, another 1.5hr bus ride to get to the hotels in the Monteverde area (during the rainy season this transfer could take longer) Duration approx. of 3.5 hours (Land and boat).The rest of the afternoon at leisure.

Overnight in Monteverde.

itinerary.title: MONTEVERDE
itinerary.description:
After breakfast spend your morning at Selvatura Park. Here you will experience closer the mysteries of the cloud forest by enjoying a great combination of suspension bridges and platforms that offers you an opportunity to explore the forest from the top in a safe and easy manner. Afternoon free at leisure.

Overnight in Monteverde.

itinerary.description:

Overnight in Manuel Antonio.

title: Thailands Tranquil Trio Exploring Bangkok Embracing Elephant Hills And Relaxing In Khao Lak
description:
Discover
Thailand's Tranquil Trio & Save £400 Per Person!

Embark on an enchanting 10-nights journey through Thailand's diverse landscapes and cultures. Start with the vibrant streets of Bangkok, where tradition meets modernity amidst stunning temples and bustling markets. Then venture into the lush wilderness of Elephant Hills to connect with nature, before unwinding on the serene beaches of Khao Lak. This perfectly paced holiday combines the excitement of the city, the adventure of the jungle, and the tranquility of the beach, making it an ideal getaway for those looking to experience the best of Thailand.

Luxurious Bangkok Stay: Dive into luxury with a three-night stay at a prestigious 5-star hotel in Bangkok. Indulge in elegant accommodations and wake up to a delightful breakfast spread each morning, setting the tone for your day of exploration in the bustling metropolis.

Elephant Hills Adventure: Embark on a two-night escapade at Elephant Hills, nestled in the heart of the Thai jungle. Here, you'll forge unforgettable connections with gentle giants during ethical elephant encounters and immerse yourself in the natural beauty of the rainforest through guided treks and immersive experiences.

Khao Lak Stay: Escape to a tropical paradise with a luxurious five-night stay at a stunning beachfront resort in Khao Lak. Nestled on the serene coastlines of the Andaman Sea, this idyllic retreat offers the perfect blend of relaxation and natural beauty, all on a bed and breakfast basis. Whether you're seeking a peaceful getaway or an enchanting beachside adventure,
Khao Lak provides an exquisite backdrop for an unforgettable holiday.

This holiday package offers a perfect blend of excitement, adventure, and relaxation, tailored to give you a comprehensive taste of Thailand's rich offerings.

title: Magical Advent On The Rhine With Dusseldorf Stay
description:
Enjoy the view of a wintry landscape while you get to know the advantages of a comfortable river cruise on board. Your journey begins in Düsseldorf - a city that impresses with its mix of romantic old town, quaint pubs and modern architecture. Stroll along the Rhine promenade or let yourself be enchanted by the lively flair of Königsallee.

In Cologne, the city with the famous cathedral, you will discover more than just the famous carnival. Experience the contemplative side of the Rhine metropolis with festively decorated streets, traditional Christmas markets and cultural highlights such as the Ludwig Museum. Here, living history and modern joie de vivre merge in a special way.

A place of relaxation awaits you on board. While the ship glides leisurely along the Rhine, you can relax in the cozy warmth, be it with a hot drink in the panorama lounge or a soothing visit to the spa area. Recharge your batteries for your varied shore excursions.

Another highlight is Koblenz, where the Moselle and Rhine flow together. The city invites you to take a stroll through the old town, past historic buildings and the imposing Kaiser Wilhelm Monument at the Deutsches Eck. Ehrenbreitstein Fortress offers a magnificent view over the valley.

For the Advent finale to your trip, Bonn welcomes you - with its atmospheric Christmas market, culinary delights and traces of German history, for example in the house where Beethoven was born. A journey that combines tranquillity, culture and festive magic.

itinerary.title: Düsseldorf
itinerary.description: Rhenish lifestyle between tradition and modernity - Düsseldorf inspires with diversity! Here art and culture lovers get just as enthusiastic as shopping enthusiasts, here the Media Harbor impresses with contemporary architecture as well as the historic Old Town. The old town makes Düsseldorf with more than 250 cozy pubs to the "longest bar in the world". The traditional Altbier is not the only tasty thing here! A stroll along the Königsallee, the world-famous strolling mile, is something one does not want to miss - or rather a visit to one of the numerous sympathetic flea markets? And in the middle of it all: lots of Green and the Rhine with its riverside promenade to breathe easy . No wonder the VIVA Cruises family feels right at home here!

Cologne

Cologne is an independent city in North Rhine-Westphalia, which is one of the few cities in the Federal Republic of Germany with over a million inhabitants. The Cologne Cathedral is the landmark of the city, which is located directly on the banks of the Rhine and the main train station. A cable car runs across the Rhine, providing a fantastic view of the city. The local zoo and stadium are a real attraction for young and old. The carnival is an important part and is just as much a part of it as a typical brewery.

itinerary.title: Coblenz - Bonn
itinerary.description:
Koblenz already impresses with its unique location at the confluence of the Rhine and Moselle rivers. The first port of call when visiting the city should therefore also be the so-called "German Corner" with its imposing Kaiser Wilhelm monument. Since 2002, it has been part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site "Upper Middle Rhine Valley". A beautiful view of Koblenz and its two rivers opens up during a visit to Ehrenbreitstein Fortress. Perched 120 meters above the Rhine, the 16th-century fortification is the second largest fortress still standing in Europe. Spectacular is already the ascent in a gondola of the cable car..

Bonn

Bonn is an independent city in North Rhine-Westphalia, which is the former capital of Germany. The banks of the Rhine are inviting for a walk and offer well-developed inline and bike paths. The old town offers traditional stores and branches of large brand chains. Not far away is the cathedral Münster. Bonn is considered a university city. The botanical garden of the local university is not only used for research purposes, but is also open to visitors. The "House of History" is accessible free of charge and tells about German history..

title: 6 Nights Best Cities Of Italy Rome Florence And Venice
description:
One of the joys of traveling through Italy is discovering that it is a dream destination - Debra Lavinso

Every heart beats for this capsule of bygone and changing times. Italian art, architecture and culture have left an unforgettable mark on many. And now the Italian Dream is yours! Why not visit Rome Florence and Venice in just one fantastic trip with 4 Star hotels throughout? 

First up, we fly you to the Eternal City of Rome for two nights at the 4 star The Raganelli Hotel. With round-the-clock energy and jaw-dropping views, Rome offers everything you’ve been dreaming of. Hiding more secrets than its many emperors, from the centre of civilisation to the Roman Empire, this glam city is the hub of awe and wonder.

After thundering across the open vast plains of Italy, your train stops in Florence for a two night hotel stay. In Florence, your stay will be at the 4 Star Hotel Torre Guelfa Palazzo Acciaiuoli.
 Just 100 m from Ponte Vecchio and the Uffizi Gallery you will find this elegant hotel, set in a delightful, 13th-century building. Set in the heart of historic Florence, Hotel Torre Guelfa Palazzo Acciaiuoli mixes old-world charm with modern facilities. Its tower, the tallest in Florence, gives you a unique view over the city and the surrounding hills. Relax with a glass of wine on the terrace after a busy day in Florence.

Our grand voyage concludes with a two night hotel stay in Venice, described by Lonely Planet as “undoubtedly the most beautiful city built by man”. The Smart Hotel Holiday is a comfy design hotel located few minutes far from Venice city centre. Easy to reach from Venezia-Mestre highway exit, this hotel is the ideal base for all those who are travelling by car and want to visit the wonderful Venice and the other cities in the surroundings.

Discover once-in-a-lifetime bespoke Italian experiences with 4 Star hotels for 6 Nights from £329 pp!

title: Southern Rhine Nature Experience
description:
Highlights of the Rhine Cruise

No wonder that the Rhine has so much to tell.

From Cologne to Rüdesheim, Germersheim (Speyer), Breisach, Strasbourg (Kehl), Mainz and Koblenz to Cologne.

The Rhine is the chameleon of the world’s rivers. Sometimes it seems wild; indeed, in the past it was dangerous, particularly at the Lorelei rocks. At other times it appears vast, as when it joins the Moselle in Koblenz. The romantic meadows of Rastatt invite you to picnic after an afternoon of rowing. And at other times human beings have tamed the river and turned it into an ornamental companion for elegant riverside promenades in cities such as Basle. It’s the perfect match for Baroque and Gothic architecture, and it looks amazing in photos. But its true home is between wild cliffs and dense forests, and between knights’ castles and winemaking villages whose vineyards it has made fertile over the course of its history.

Mainz : Halfway between Lake Constance and the North Sea, the Rhine meets Mainz. This carnival city is known for its cheerful atmosphere and its hospitality. Why not go for a stroll along the tranquil riverbank or enjoy a good glass of local wine while you’re there? You could also visit the city’s main landmark: Saint Martin’s Cathedral. It boasts one of the richest church interiors in the Christian world. Another important building in Mainz is the Kurfürstliche Schloss (Electoral Palace). This is a prime example of the German Renaissance style of architecture.

Strassburg : The Roman commander Drusus founded Strasbourg as a military outpost in 12 BCE. Today it is a thriving metropolis that has maintained many small half-timbered houses and an historic old town. Even the briefest glance at Strasbourg Cathedral will tell you that you are standing before one of the most important of its kind in Europe – and one of the largest sandstone buildings in the world.

Basel : Many people have only driven through or passed by the ‘Gateway to Switzerland’. Now, as your Rhine cruise takes you along the southern Rhine, you’ll get to know Basel much better. The city is home to Switzerland’s oldest university. Its other highlights include the medieval old town with its staircases and the Gate of Spalen – plus 27 museums.

itinerary.title: Cologne
itinerary.description: We will set off on our exciting Rhine cruise from here, heading for the northern or the southern Rhine. But you shouldn’t miss out on the opportunity to explore this cathedral city, with its wealth of monuments and attractions. The best way is to arrive the day before your cruise departs, so that you can relax – or simply extend your stay in Cologne after the cruise has ended.

itinerary.title: Rüdesheim
itinerary.description: The town describes its biggest attraction, the world-famous Drosselgasse, as ‘144 metres of joie de vivre’. This centre of Rhine Romanticism once inspired poets and musicians – it was here that Brahms composed his Symphony No. 3. Rüdesheim is the best-known spot in the Rheingau and has plenty of cultural attractions, including stately homes and fortifications. And no visit to the towns and countryside of this area of the Rhine would be complete without a Rüdesheim coffee, which was invented here.

itinerary.title: Germersheim (Speyer)
itinerary.description: Welcome to the Upper Rhine. Germersheim is only about 20 km from the city of Speyer, which is over 2000 years old. Speyer is Germany’s oldest planned medieval town. Speyer’s most prominent monument is its cathedral. As one of the country’s most important High Romanesque cathedrals, it is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. You are sure to have an enjoyable day in Speyer.

itinerary.title: Breisach
itinerary.description: The little town of Breisach perches on a steep cliff along the Rhine, to the south-west of the Kaiserstuhl hills. Its main landmark is the cathedral, Münster Sankt Stephan. Set high above the town on a hill (Latin name: Mons Brisiacus), the church overlooks the Rhine valley, housing an impressive collection of artworks. Geldermann, a well-known producer of sparkling wine, is also based here. A visit to Breisach is an absolute must during your Rhine cruise.

itinerary.title: Strasbourg (Kelh)
itinerary.description: Today your Rhine river cruise will call at Strasbourg – a centre of European policymaking. With its medieval half-timbered houses and its elegant city palaces, Strasbourg really stands out from the crowd. But the highlight is the cathedral. From its viewing platform, the city’s half-timbered houses appear as small as pieces from a model railway set. Enjoy your day in the French part of the Rhine region!

itinerary.title: Mainz
itinerary.description: Mainz bleibt Mainz (or ‘Mainz is always Mainz’) is more than a carnival motto. It is an expression of the easy-going way of life that makes the locals proud of their city, makes it easy for non-locals to settle in and helps visitors to enjoy their stay here. With 2,000 years of history, Mainz is not just one of the oldest cities in Germany – it is also a place where you can see history come alive wherever you turn.

itinerary.title: Koblenz
itinerary.description: Discover Koblenz during your Rhine cruise. Its history dates back over 2,000 years, making it one of Germany’s oldest cities – and one of its most picturesque, with a wealth of sights and cultural attractions. Marvel at Koblenz’s palaces, stately homes, grand townhouses, narrow lanes and romantic corners. And watch as our A-ROSA ship sails close to the famous Deutsches Eck headland.

itinerary.title: Cologne
itinerary.description: After an exciting cruise on the Rhine, you will be docking back in Cologne today. However, before you set off on your journey home with a thousand memories of your trip, why not use the day to explore North Rhine-Westphalia and the city of Cologne? The imposing cathedral of Cologne is a must-see. See you soon and ahoy!

accommodations.name: A-ROSA BRAVA
accommodations.description:
A-ROSA BRAVA

 River cruise on the Rhine with A-ROSA BRAVA

Cruising on a river is certainly not the fastest mode of transportation. And the countless meanders of the Rhine, Danube and Rhône are not the fastest way to get from A to B either. But that’s precisely what we want to give you: a little time for you to relax and unwind. As you leisurely take in the breathtaking riverscape, you can really take time for yourself. Make yourself comfortable in your cosy cabin or simply daydream in SPA-ROSA and on the sun deck. If you like, you can also take part in our many exciting activities. Our A-ROSA BRAVA has been a popular choice among German-speaking guests in the past, but she offers a warm and welcoming atmosphere for all who seek to explore the beautiful Rhône and Saône Rivers.

title: 7 Nights India Golden Triangle With Breakfast
description:
The Golden Triangle is a circuit that connects the cities of Delhi, Agra and Jaipur – three of India’s most popular destinations due to their abundance of history and culture (hence the aptly titled “golden” triangle). 

As such, travelling around the circuit is a great way to experience the many different facets of this magical country – so we’ve crammed in as much as possible into this week-long getaway. 

Kicking off with a two-night stay in Delhi (India’s capital territory), you’ll enjoy back-to-back visits to the old-fashioned and new-fangled parts of the city. Get up close to the Mughal-era Red Fort, the imposing India Gate and then take a rip-roaring rickshaw ride through Chandni Chowk Market. 

Then, spend another two nights on the banks of the Yamuna River in the magical city of Agra, home to the iconic Taj Mahal. Travellers flock here like bees to honey – such is the allure of this white marble mausoleum which you’ll get to see on day four of your trip.

The “Pink City” of Jaipur will be your home for the last leg of this trip. This sun-soaked city, bleached a dazzling pinkish colour, is the Rajasthan state’s capital. It’s home to opulent courtyards, gardens and royal buildings – not to mention the sandy-coloured Amer Fort that has its own light and sound show.

title: 6 Nights in San Francisco and Las Vegas Twin Centre
description:
Explore Two Iconic Cities: San Francisco & Las Vegas 

San Francisco: Start your journey in San Francisco, a city celebrated for its rich history, diverse neighborhoods, and cosmopolitan culture. Walk across the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, explore the vibrant streets of Fisherman's Wharf, and navigate the famous Lombard Street, the crookedest street in the world. Immerse yourself in the artistic vibe of downtown San Francisco, visiting numerous galleries, museums, and the lively theatre district. In the evenings, relax at a jazz bar or indulge in the culinary delights of the Mission District and Union Square, where a variety of bistros and restaurants showcase the city's diverse flavors.

 Las Vegas: After exploring San Francisco, take an internal flight to Las Vegas, the ‘Entertainment Capital of the World.’ Spend 4 unforgettable nights at the Stratosphere Hotel & Casino. Experience the glitz, glamour, and neon brilliance that define this iconic city. Try your luck at the casinos, dine at world-class restaurants, and enjoy spectacular shows that make Las Vegas the ultimate entertainment destination.

title: Malaysia Wonders Cities, Rainforests & Wildlife
description:
This 10-day journey offers the perfect blend of city excitement, cultural discovery, and natural wonders. Begin in Malaysia’s capital, Kuala Lumpur, where modern skyscrapers stand beside colonial landmarks, vibrant temples, and bustling street life. Fly onwards to Kuching in Sarawak, the gateway to Borneo, where you’ll explore charming riverside streets, experience a sunset wildlife cruise in search of dolphins, monkeys, crocodiles, and fireflies, and encounter endangered orangutans at the Semenggoh Wildlife Centre. Discover the unique traditions of Borneo’s diverse ethnic groups at the award-winning Sarawak Cultural Village.

Continue your adventure to Sabah’s Kota Kinabalu, with an excursion to the spectacular Kinabalu National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site home to Mount Kinabalu, exotic flora, and rich birdlife. Finally, unwind at the luxurious Shangri-La’s Rasa Ria Resort, where pristine beaches and lush landscapes provide the perfect setting for relaxation.

This well-balanced itinerary showcases Malaysia’s modern icons, cultural treasures, and natural wildlife—ideal for travelers seeking a mix of urban exploration, cultural immersion, and eco-adventure.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Kuala Lumpur International Airport, you will be greeted by a local representative and transferred to your downtown hotel. After check-in at the Concorde Hotel, the remainder of the day is free at leisure for you to relax and recover from your journey or begin exploring the vibrant city at your own pace. Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, set out for a guided half-day city tour of Kuala Lumpur. Begin with a visit to the iconic Petronas Twin Towers Skybridge (or KL Tower if closed) for sweeping views of the city skyline. Continue to Independence Square (Dataran Merdeka) to admire the Sultan Abdul Samad Building, Royal Selangor Club, and St. Mary’s Church. Stroll to the historic Jamek Mosque and see the River of Life project before heading into lively Chinatown. Here, visit the Sin Sze Ya Temple, the city’s oldest Taoist temple, followed by the richly decorated Sri Mahamariamman Temple, the oldest Hindu temple in Kuala Lumpur. After the tour, return to the hotel with the rest of the afternoon free at leisure. Overnight in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur at Leisure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the hotel. The entire day is free for your own arrangements. You may wish to indulge in shopping at the world-class malls, explore street markets, or opt for an optional tour such as Batu Caves, Putrajaya, or a cultural evening. Overnight in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur to Kuching
itinerary.description: This morning, check out after breakfast and transfer to the airport for your domestic flight to Kuching, the capital of Sarawak in Borneo. On arrival, meet your guide and transfer to the Sheraton Kuching Hotel. After check-in, the rest of the day is at leisure to relax or take a gentle walk along Kuching’s scenic waterfront. Overnight stay in Kuching.

itinerary.title: Kuching City & Santubong Wildlife Cruise
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided sightseeing tour of Kuching. Drive past colonial landmarks such as Fort Margherita, the Square and Round Towers, the Colonial Courthouse, and the General Post Office. Visit the Tua Pek Kong Temple, the city’s oldest Chinese temple, and explore India Street, Malay villages, and traditional shop-houses. Take a walk along the lively waterfront and watch sampans ferrying locals across the Sarawak River. Later in the afternoon, head out for the Santubong Wildlife Cruise. Cruise through mangrove forests and estuaries in search of Irrawaddy dolphins, rare proboscis monkeys, crocodiles, and fireflies. Enjoy the magical sight of fireflies illuminating the mangroves at dusk before returning to Kuching. Overnight stay in Kuching.

itinerary.title: Semenggoh Orangutan Sanctuary & Sarawak Cultural Village
itinerary.description: Today begins with a visit to the Semenggoh Wildlife Centre, a renowned orangutan rehabilitation facility within the Semenggoh Nature Reserve. Here, you may witness orangutans emerging from the rainforest during feeding time, a truly unforgettable encounter with these endangered primates in their natural habitat. Continue to the Sarawak Cultural Village, an award-winning living museum nestled at the foothills of Mount Santubong. Explore authentic replicas of traditional homes representing seven major ethnic groups of Sarawak, interact with local artisans, and enjoy a vibrant multi-cultural dance performance. Return to Kuching for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kuching to Kota Kinabalu
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Kota Kinabalu, the lively capital of Sabah. On arrival, transfer to Le Meridien Kota Kinabalu for check-in. The rest of the day is free to explore the city’s bustling markets, seafront promenade, or simply relax at the hotel. Overnight stay in Kota Kinabalu.

itinerary.title: Kinabalu National Park Excursion
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for a full-day excursion to Kinabalu National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Drive through picturesque mountain countryside to reach the park, home to Mount Kinabalu – Southeast Asia’s highest peak. Explore the lush rainforest with a guided walk along one of the park’s nature trails, where you’ll discover unique flora such as orchids, pitcher plants, and rhododendrons, as well as exotic birdlife. Visit the Mountain Garden, which showcases the park’s rare and endemic plants. Later, transfer to the luxurious Shangri-La’s Rasa Ria Resort, where you’ll check in and enjoy leisure time by the beach. Overnight stay at the resort.

itinerary.title: Kota Kinabalu at Leisure
itinerary.description: Today is free to relax and enjoy the facilities of Shangri-La’s Rasa Ria Resort. You may lounge by the beach, indulge in spa treatments, or join optional resort activities such as water sports, horse riding, or jungle trekking. Overnight stay at the resort in Kota Kinabalu.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kota Kinabalu
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy leisure time until check-out. Later, transfer to Kota Kinabalu International Airport for your onward flight.

Nestled between Bukit Bintang and KLCC, the hotel offers an excellent location for both business and leisure. title: Amazing Costa Rica for Single Travellers
description:
Uncover Costa Rica during this twelve-day amazing adventure. Beginning and ending in the capital, San Jose, this tour offers you the chance to discover different aspects of this emblematic destination. Spend precious time visiting the Tortuguero canals. Learn how Costa Rica’s unique climate and diverse landscapes provide perfect growing conditions for gourmet coffee beans. Enjoy the sweetest rainforest experience, discovering the ancient secrets of chocolate: from its discovery and use, in tropical America, to the processing of the product we know and enjoy today. Hike on the Arenal Volcano, with astonishing views, ear-catching information, unbelievable stories and the chance to meet the local wildlife, will remain your favourite memories of Costa Rica after this experience.

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS

Tortuguero: Tortuguero, is one of Costa Rica's most popular ecotourism destinations. This destination is your "must stop" while in Costa Rica. Discover its Network of canals, lagoons and dense rainforests.

Arenal: This region is considered by many to be one of the most spectacular ones in the country. La Fortuna area is recognized worldwide for being one of the most prominent wellness tourism destinations in the world.

Monteverde: A true nature lovers paradise with a marvellous diversity of wildlife and plant life. Monteverde Cloud Forest is a unique area to observe exotic highland bird species or to explore the cloud forest canopy. 

Manuel Antonio: This picturesque national park is the smallest one in Costa Rica but it is full of wild animals, lush vegetation, and beautiful beaches.
