itinerary.title: ARRIVAL SAN JOSE (20km – 30min)
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Costa Rica! Our representative will greet you at the airport; assist you with your luggage and private transfer to the hotel in San Jose. 

Overnight in San Jose.

itinerary.title: SAN JOSE
itinerary.description:
Wake up to breakfast at the hotel and then join our Classic Coffee Tour. The expert will guide you through the lifecycle of gourmet coffee. Begin in the nursery and follow the beans starting with their growing cycle through careful collection and selection of the finest beans. Next, the aromas of the roaster will enchant you where you will discover how different roasting techniques affect the beans and the brew. We will reveal our roasting and packing secrets that enable them to deliver the best coffee from the Costa Rican plantation to your cup. Learn how experts “break the cup” by using techniques to taste or “cup” coffee to identify and grade the characteristics that qualify a gourmet coffee. Finally, surrounded by an outdoor tropical paradise and while listening to traditional music, you will have an option of savoring a buffet lunch featuring local ingredients at Don Prospero Restaurant (not included).  

Overnight in San Jose.

itinerary.title: SAN JOSE – TORTUGUERO (120km – 3hrs)
itinerary.description:
At the agreed time in the morning, transportation will pick you up at the hotel to transfer you to your next destination, Tortuguero, one of the most famous conservation areas in Costa Rica, located in the north Caribbean. Breakfast included en-route. Arrive at the dock to board a boat that will take you to the lodge in Tortuguero. Around midday, have a delicious lunch at the lodge. During the afternoon, discover its network of canals, lagoons and dense rainforests through a boat tour guided by an expert naturalist guide. Abundant wildlife inhabits Tortuguero, including 57 species of amphibians, 111 species of reptiles, and 60 species of mammals. In the evening, savour dinner at the lodge. 

Overnight in Tortuguero.

itinerary.title: TORTUGUERO
itinerary.description:
Meet your guide for a mid-morning walk along the trails and discover the tropical rain forest of Tortuguero. In the afternoon, visit the enchanting village of Tortuguero; the town a small population of around 500, no cars, and is located on a relatively narrow spit of land between the beach and a canal. Take a closer encounter with the Caribbean culture; discover its people and lifestyle walking through this colourful town.

Overnight in Tortuguero.

itinerary.title: TORTUGUERO – ARENAL (220km – 4hrs)
itinerary.description:
Breakfast included at the hotel and then proceed to checkout. Afterwards, be ready to continue your trip. Shared transfer by boat and land from Tortuguero to the Restaurant located in Guapiles, where you will enjoy the lunch (included). Then, a transfer will take you to your next destination, La Fortuna, home of the colossus Arenal Volcano and a place that gives to its visitors amazing views and a big range of attractions and beautiful nature. Afternoon at leisure to enjoy hotel facilities and relax. 

Overnight in Arenal.

itinerary.title: ARENAL
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel. Today, discover the natural beauty of the Arenal region on a peaceful guided hike through the El Silencio Trail, one of the best places to experience rainforest, wildlife, and spectacular views of the Arenal Volcano. This tour is perfect for nature lovers who want a relaxed, immersive encounter with Costa Rica’s tropical environment. Your guide will lead you along well-maintained forest paths surrounded by towering trees, volcanic rock formations, and a wide variety of flora and fauna. Along the way, you may spot birds, monkeys, frogs, and other wildlife that inhabit the foothills of the volcano. The guide will share insights about the area’s ecosystems, volcanic history, and the natural processes that shaped this iconic landscape. The trail leads to open areas with impressive panoramas of Arenal Volcano, offering excellent opportunities for photography, especially on clear days. The experience combines gentle hiking, wildlife observation, and educational interpretation in a serene and uncrowded environment.

Overnight in Arenal.

itinerary.title: ARENAL – MONTEVERDE (100km – 2.5hrs)
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel and then proceed to checkout. At the agreed time, continue to your next destination: the magical Monteverde cloud forest. This service, half–boat–half–shared transfer is a scenic and fast way to go from La Fortuna to the Monteverde area. You will board a very comfortable and safe pontoon boat for a 30 to 40-minute (approx.) ride to Rio Chiquito, a little town on the other side of the lake. Once at Rio Chiquito, we will leave the boat and take a short break to stretch our legs. After another 1.5-hour bus ride, we will get to the hotel in the Monteverde area (during the rainy season, this transfer could take longer). Duration approx. 3.5 hours (Land and boat).The rest of the afternoon at leisure.

Overnight in Monteverde.

itinerary.title: MONTEVERDE
itinerary.description:
After breakfast spend your morning at Selvatura Park. Here you will experience closer the mysteries of the cloud forest by enjoying a great combination of suspension bridges and platforms that offers you an opportunity to explore the forest from the top in a safe and easy manner. Afternoon free at leisure to explore on your own or join some of our optional activities (not included).

Don Juan Coffee Tour: Take our coffee tour and take a glimpse of Costa Rica´s coffee, chocolate, and sugar cane production (with the emphasis on coffee!). The tour offers an interesting opportunity to learn about coffee and its production as well as to get close to the fascinating Costa Rican folklore

Overnight in Monteverde.

itinerary.title: MONTEVERDE – MANUEL ANTONIO (190km – 4hrs)
itinerary.description:
Breakfast included at the hotel. At the agreed time, transfer to the beach area of Manuel Antonio in the Central Pacific Coast. The rest of the day is free to enjoy the hotel facilities. 

Overnight in Manuel Antonio.

itinerary.title: MANUEL ANTONIO
itinerary.description:
Breakfast included at the hotel. Enjoy your free time to relax in this fantastic region. Or you can choose to go on the following Optional Tour (not included):

Catamaran Adventure: Set sail towards the horizon aboard a catamaran, admiring the marine life as well as islands and rock formations close to the coast, bordering Manuel Antonio National Park. You will board your catamaran at the pier in Quepos, the Marina Pez Vela, and sail off bordering the coast. Have your cameras ready to capture the beautiful scenery during the journey. Your guide will be available to point our notable wildlife and vegetation as you admire the islands, cliffs and other natural formations. Enjoy the beverages and snacks available onboard. After touring the coastline, the captain will set anchor at Biesanz Bay where you can snorkel or simply rest onboard. You are most likely to spot parrotfish, starfish, and angelfish and dolphins sometimes follow the boat. A tasty barbecue lunch is served on board.

Kayaking Tour at Damas Island: Gently row along the soft currents under a verdant forest canopy, to explore the wonders of the unique Costa Rican mangrove ecosystem. Kayak through natural canals and keep your eyes wide open to spot a variety of bird species, reptiles, anteaters and white-faced monkeys. Your guide´s knowledge will instruct you through the biodiversity of this habitat, and his trained eye will seek out herons, kingfishers, ospreys and frigate birds. Navigate through the brackish waters and catch glimpses of Damas Island as you pass beneath natural tunnels created by tree growths. Lunch is provided before or after the kayaking adventure, depending on varying tides.

Jungle Night Walk: Explore a forest's natural habitat with all kinds of creatures such as frogs, lizards, mammals, insects, spiders, snakes, birds and much more. The beautiful symphony of a tropical rainforest at night is one of the most exciting experiences; turn off the lights for a moment and listen to all the secret sounds. This unique Jungle Walk is a 2 hours guided adventure where you will have the opportunity to be part of one of the most interesting and important ecosystems of Costa Rica, the Nocturnal Tropical Wet Forest. You will have the experience to be in contact with many nocturnal inhabitants in our amazing jungle.


Overnight in Manuel Antonio.

itinerary.title: MANUEL ANTONIO
itinerary.description:
Breakfast included at the hotel. Enjoy your free time to relax in this fantastic region. 

Overnight in Manuel Antonio.

title: Discover Japan Cities Culture and Cuisine
description:
This 10-day Japan tour offers a perfect introduction to the country’s rich culture, modern cities, and iconic landscapes. Begin your journey in Tokyo, where cutting-edge technology blends seamlessly with traditional temples and vibrant neighborhoods. Enjoy a full-day excursion to Mount Fuji and Hakone, showcasing Japan’s natural beauty and scenic views.

Travel by the world-famous Shinkansen bullet train to Kyoto, the cultural heart of Japan, where historic temples, imperial landmarks, and traditional streets reflect centuries of heritage. With guided sightseeing and leisure time, you can explore the city at your own pace before continuing to Osaka, Japan’s lively culinary capital.

In Osaka, experience the city’s famous street food culture and energetic atmosphere, along with free days for shopping and sightseeing. With comfortable hotel stays, efficient transportation, guided tours, and ample leisure time, this itinerary is ideal for first-time visitors seeking a well-balanced and memorable Japan experience.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tokyo
itinerary.description: Arrive in Tokyo, where you will be welcomed by our representative at the airport and transferred to your hotel. After check-in, the rest of the day is free for you to relax and recover from your journey or take a short walk around the neighborhood to get a first glimpse of the vibrant city.

itinerary.title: Mount Fuji and Hakone Full-Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart on a full-day excursion to Mount Fuji and Hakone. Visit the Mount Fuji 5th Station (weather permitting) to enjoy breathtaking views of Japan’s most iconic peak. Continue to the Hakone region, where you will experience a scenic Lake Ashi cruise and enjoy panoramic views from the Hakone Ropeway. In the evening, return to Tokyo by motorcoach.

itinerary.title: Tokyo at Leisure
itinerary.description: Today is free for you to explore Tokyo at your own pace. You may choose to visit famous areas such as Asakusa, Shibuya, Akihabara, or Ginza, explore local markets, enjoy shopping, or experience the city’s unique food culture.

itinerary.title: Tokyo to Kyoto by Bullet Train
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to the station to board the high-speed Shinkansen (bullet train) to Kyoto. Enjoy the smooth and efficient journey through the Japanese countryside. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure, discovering Kyoto’s traditional atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Kyoto Morning City Tour
itinerary.description: This morning, enjoy a guided city tour of Kyoto’s most famous landmarks. Visit Nijo Castle, known for its historic architecture, followed by the stunning Kinkaku-ji Temple, also called the Golden Pavilion. itinerary.title: Osaka at Leisure

title: Legendary Turkey
description:
Enjoy first-class service and guided transportation through the historical and picturesque sites of Istanbul, battlefields of Gallipoli, the Trojan Horse of Troy, Pergamon offers one of the Seven Churches of St John from the Bible before reaching the ancient city of Ephesus, the white calcium hot pools of Pamukkale, beautiful views of the Mediterranean coast in Antalya.

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS

Istanbul: a major city in Turkey that straddles Europe and Asia across the Bosphorus Strait. Its Old City reflects the cultural influences of the many empires that once ruled here. In the Sultanahmet district, the open-air, Roman-era Hippodrome was for centuries the site of chariot races, and Egyptian obelisks also remain. The iconic Byzantine Hagia Sophia features a soaring 6th-century dome and rare Christian mosaics.

Sirince: a village of 600 inhabitants located about 8 kilometres east of the Ephesus ancient city. The area around the village has a history dating back to the Hellenistic period (323–31 BC). Today the village prospers through agriculture (olive oil, peaches, wine) and tourism. It is well protected, rare and attractive example of Ottoman Christian architecture.

Pamukkale: (Cotton Castle) is a town in western Turkey known for the mineral-rich thermal waters flowing down white travertine terraces on a nearby hillside. It neighbours Hierapolis, an ancient Roman spa city founded around 190 B.C. Ruins there include a well-preserved theater and a necropolis with sarcophagi that stretch for 2km. The Antique Pool is famous for its submerged Roman columns, the result of an earthquake.

Antalya: Before Antalya became one of Turkey’s top summer resort towns, it was the ancient city of Attalia, founded during the Hellenistic period, later becoming part of the Roman Empire. As such, Antalya’s old town is one of its most important sights harking back to its rich past.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL ISTANBUL (45km – 50 min)
itinerary.description:
Upon arrival at the airport meet our representative and transfer to your hotel. Check in and spend the rest of the day at leisure exploring Istanbul. 

Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: ISTANBUL: CITY TOUR
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, start the Istanbul City Tour with the visit of the Hippodrome. Ancient Hippodrome was the scene of chariot races, with the three monuments; the Obelisk of Theodosius, the bronze Serpentine Column and the Column of Constantine. Then, visit Sultanahmet Imperial Mosque. Across from Hagia Sophia Grand Mosque, it was built in the 16th century by the architect Mehmet, is known as the Blue Mosque because of its magnificent interior decoration of blue ‘’Iznik’’ tiles. Next, visit Hagia Sophia Grand Mosque, previously known as the Church of Divine Wisdom, simply the best of its kind! Hagia Sophia Grand Mosque is the greatest surviving example of Byzantine Architecture. For 1000 years, it was once the largest church in the world, decorated with stunning 6th century golden mosaics. After lunch, the guide will take you to the Ali Pasazade with a unique atmosphere and reasonable prices for your shopping. Here you will find; exotic spices and herbs, traditional Turkish sweets and coffee, souvenirs and many other goods in souvenir shops and stores. After the tour transfer back to your hotel. 


Optional Dinner Cruise on the Bosphorus Tour: Tonight between 19:30 to 23:30 you can join an optional entertaining dinner cruise program on the Bosphorus, where Europe and Asia are connected. You will spend an unforgettable night on the Bosphorus with dinner, unlimited local alcoholic and non-alcoholic & soft drinks, belly dance show, Turkish Folklore show, DJ Performance and great entertainment on Bosphorus Dinner Cruise. End of the entertainment at about midnight, transfer to your hotel.


Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: ISTANBUL – GALLIPOLI TOUR – CANAKKALE (350 km – 5 hrs)
itinerary.description:
Early in the morning, we depart for Gallipoli to visit the battlefields. On the way, we will have a short break in a restaurant area where you can have your breakfast and relax before we continue the journey. Upon arrival in Gallipoli enjoy your lunch break in a local restaurant and relax before departing for the battlefields. Visit Gabatepe Museum, then the fields with Ariburnu Cemetery and Anzac Cove, the places where the war had started. Continue to Beach Cemetery, Lone Pine and Chunuck Bair. After the tour drive to your hotel for check in and enjoy your dinner in the hotel. 

Overnight in Canakkale.

itinerary.title: CANAKKALE – TROY – PERGAMON – KUSADASI (420 km – 6 hrs)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast check out and depart for Troy. Visit the famous archaeological and mythological site of Troy, home of the Trojan Horse and Helen of Troy. After the Troy tour, 3-hour drive to Pergamon. First, we stop for a lunch break in a local restaurant and after lunch depart for a tour of the magnificent Bergama Museum. It is an impressive Museum, and you may see many important relics from Ancient Pergamon. Pergamon is famous for its jewellery, stones and silver so on the way, we will visit a jewellery center. Later we arrive at Kusadasi for check in and dinner at the hotel. 

Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: KUSADASI – EPHESUS – SIRINCE – KUSADASI (55 km – 1.5 hrs)
itinerary.description:
Today after breakfast we depart for a fully guided tour of Ephesus, one of the best preserved ancient sites in the world en-route, visiting the Temple of Artemis, Curetes street, famous Roman baths, Celsus Library and Grand theatre. After the lunch break we will visit a place which continues to perform one of the oldest arts of Turkey; a carpet weaving centre. Then, we will continue to the Turkish village Sirince with Anatolian Greeks construction style. The houses on the slope are all original with their white paint. Sirince Village also has a fantastic reputation for making some of the best wines in Turkey - especially fruit wines. There will be some free time to explore the area of the village. On the way we will visit one of the famous leather production centers of the region, where you will have the opportunity to get a good factory rate. On this guided tour, you will avoid the constant nagging and sometimes bullying that is well known in the markets of Turkey. Enabling you to enjoy the shopping experience whilst gaining the knowledge of the ancient craftsmen. Return to your hotel where your dinner will be served.

Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: KUSADASI – PAMUKKALE TOUR (190 km – 3 hrs)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, we depart for Pamukkale. Upon arrival check in at the hotel and enjoy your lunch. Afterwards we shall visit the calcium terraces of Pamukkale (cotton castle) and the ruins of Hierapolis, then walk around this natural phenomenon and have the option of lying in the waters of the natural springs. Return to the hotel where your dinner will be served. 


Optional Tandem Paragliding: Make your Pamukkale Tour unforgettable by participating in Pamukkale Tandem Paragliding experience. Enjoy a flight over the stunning and infamous White Mountain in Pamukkale and observe spectacular views over this unique area's attractions. Tandem Paragliding in Pamukkale is an ideal alternative experience for those who wish to feel some exciting moments. It can also be the perfect way to explore the attractions from above and appreciate the beauty of the natural scenery. This tour will end at approximately 17.30 and then you will be back at your hotel.


Overnight in Pamukkale.

itinerary.title: PAMUKKALE – ANTALYA (250 km – 3.5 hrs)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, we depart for Antalya. On arrival check in at the hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure. Enjoy dinner served at the hotel.


Optional Hot Air Balloon Tour: we will pick you up from your hotel early in the morning for the take off at 05:30 am before sunrise. On the Balloon, you will witness the magnificent and unique view of nature by viewing the morning sunrise over the ancient city of Hierapolis and Cotton White Travertines which is listed as one of the best 7 wonders of the world and registered in the UNESCO heritage list. After the Hot Air Balloon excursion, we will celebrate our landing with a champagne ceremony and return to the hotel for a delicious breakfast (Please confirm with your guide the day before as the optional tour starts early in the morning).


Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: ANTALYA OLD TOWN TOUR & WATERFALLS
itinerary.description:
Today after breakfast we will visit Antalya old City (Kaleiçi) Marina, Clock Tower, Hadrian's Gate, Broken Minaret and Hidirlik Tower. Kaleici is a small historic part of Antalyas modern city. In history it was once the sprawling modern Roman town, then the Byzantine Empire, then Seljuks, and finally the Ottoman Turkish town. The Hadrian's Gate also known as The Three Gates is a triumphal arch which was built in the name of the Roman emperor Hadrian. Antalya's broken wonder is the Broken Minaret of the Korkut Mosque, which itself was built originally as a Roman temple in the 2nd century AD, and thus did not have a minaret at all. Hidirlik Tower is a landmark tower of tawny stone in Antalya, Turkey, where Kaleiçi meets Karaalioglu Park. It is believed to be built in Hellenistic era on a square plan and later turned into circular tower in 2nd century AD and was either used as a fortification or a lighthouse in the past. We have lunch then depart for Duden waterfalls. All the streams of the region aim at finding their way into the Mediterranean and they pour down the slopes of the Taurus, sometimes overland sometimes underground and reaching their destination, result in lovely waterfalls, of which there are more than twenty. After the tour come back to hotel and rest of day free at leisure. Dinner will be served in the hotel.

Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: ANTALYA – ISTANBUL DEPARTURE (70 min by flight, not included)
itinerary.description: Depart for Antalya airport for your domestic flight to Istanbul (not included) and then back home. We hope your tour was a memorable one and we would like to see you in the future on one of our tours again.

accommodations.description: The historical near-period Ottoman style combined with today's modern living philosophy and came to life in The Central Palace. Beyoğlu, the centre of art, history, culture, and taste stops, is waiting for you with its original structure and all its splendour. Offering you the most luxurious, spacious, and comfortable rooms in Istanbul and even in Europe, The Central Palace is only two minutes walk from Taksim Square, the heart of Istanbul. It hosts your happiness with its unique architecture, comfort, and hospitality. The rooms, which attract attention with their decoration reflecting the recent Ottoman interior architecture, promise a comfortable stay with their high ceilings and spacious environment. You can start the day with pleasure in the centre of the city, work as you wish in your room, which turns into an office environment with a desk & armchair and internet connection, make your online meetings with peace of mind, and end the day by falling into a deep sleep on the comfortable beds in the rooms. The Central Palace Taksim's rooms, which are designed in different shapes, have been preserving its feature of being a living space where comfort meets aesthetics for its guests for years.

accommodations.name: Pam Thermal Hotel & Clinic Spa

Surrounded by pine forests and green gardens, this thermal hotel is situated on a hillside. The hotel feature a spa centre, outdoor pool, which is heated in winter, and thermal spring travertines with healing red water.

The air-conditioned rooms of Pam Thermal Hotel are furnished in style with modern furniture. They all feature a balcony with forest, garden or pool views.  Spa baths with thermal water are also offered in each room.

title: 10-Day Buenos Aires & Complete Patagonia Experience
description:
Experience the best of Argentina on this 10-day journey through Buenos Aires and Patagonia. Discover the charm of the capital with its rich history, vibrant culture, and passionate tango. Continue to Ushuaia, the southernmost city in the world, to explore the stunning Tierra del Fuego National Park. Conclude your adventure in El Calafate, home to the majestic Perito Moreno Glacier, one of nature’s true wonders. A perfect combination of urban elegance and breathtaking natural beauty.


TOUR HIGHLIGHTS

Buenos Aires: Argentina’s vibrant capital is a city of contrasts, where European elegance meets Latin American spirit. From the colorful streets of La Boca to the grand avenues of Recoleta and the lively markets of San Telmo, Buenos Aires offers a captivating blend of history, culture, and contemporary energy.

Ushuaia: The world’s southernmost city, Ushuaia is a captivating destination framed by the snowcapped Andes and the Beagle Channel. Explore its charming streets, discover its maritime heritage, and enjoy the unique atmosphere of a city that serves as the gateway to Antarctica.

Tierra del Fuego National Park: Experience Argentina’s southernmost protected area, where dramatic coastal landscapes meet rugged Andean peaks. Explore serene lakes, glacier-carved valleys, and dense sub-Antarctic forests home to native wildlife such as the Fuegian red fox and a variety of bird species.

El Calafate: Nestled on the southern shore of Lake Argentino, El Calafate serves as the gateway to Patagonia’s icy frontier. Enjoy its charming atmosphere, local cuisine, and artisan shops, or simply relax and take in the stunning views of the steppe and surrounding peaks.

Perito Moreno Glacier: One of the most famous natural wonders in Patagonia, the Perito Moreno Glacier is a constantly advancing ice giant that dazzles with its sheer scale and power. Walk along panoramic walkways for breathtaking views of its towering ice walls, and listen to the thunderous sound of ice blocks calving into the turquoise waters of Lake Argentino.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL BUENOS AIRES
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Aeroparque Jorge Newbery in Buenos Aires. Upon arrival, a representative will be waiting to greet you and the transportation service will take you to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at your leisure in Buenos Aires.

Note: For arrivals at Ezeiza Airport (Ministro Pistarini International Airport), transfer is not included (available as an optional extra).

Overnight in Buenos Aires.

itinerary.title: BUENOS AIRES: CITY TOUR & DINNER WITH A LIVE TANGO SHOW
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, set off on a guided city tour to explore Buenos Aires’s most iconic landmarks and neighborhoods. Beginning with the expansive Tres de Febrero Park, the city’s largest green space, along with the historic racecourse and prestigious polo field. Visit Plaza Italia and make photo stops at Plaza de Mayo, where key events in Argentine history unfolded, as well as in the traditional neighborhoods of San Telmo and the colorful streets of La Boca. A stop in Recoleta invites you to visit its world-renowned cemetery (optional entrance), home to ornate mausoleums and famous figures from Argentina’s past. Nearby, admire the architecture of Iglesia del Pilar and the Metropolitan Cathedral. Throughout the tour, you’ll travel along the city’s grand avenues – Corrientes, De Mayo, 9 de Julio, Alvear, and Del Libertador – and explore diverse districts such as elegant Palermo, historic Recoleta, and the modern waterfront of Puerto Madero. You'll also see landmarks like the Obelisk, Lezama Park, the Ecological Reserve, and key commercial and financial zones that shape the city’s rhythm.

In the evening (around 6:00 PM), you will be picked up from your hotel for an unforgettable night of tango, folklore, and fine dining – a true immersion into the magic of Buenos Aires. The experience takes place at El Aljibe, a beautifully restored early 20th-century conventillo (tenement house) that preserves the spirit of the city’s immigrant roots. During its careful restoration, a 17th-century well was discovered, adding a unique historical touch to the venue. The evening features a vibrant Tango & Folklore Show with 15 performers on stage, including a live quartet led by maestro Carlos Buono, a singer, three couples of dancers, and a thrilling malambo act with traditional boleadoras, ponchos, and drums. Enjoy a delicious three-course meal featuring classic Argentine and international cuisine, paired with local wines. At the end of the show, a transfer will take you back to your hotel.

Overnight in Buenos Aires.

itinerary.title: BUENOS AIRES
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a full day at leisure to explore Buenos Aires at your own pace. Take this opportunity to revisit your favorite spots, shop for local crafts, or simply relax and soak in the city's atmosphere. Alternatively take advantage of the available experience (not included).

Half-Day Delta Classic: Boat Navigation & Tigre City Experience: (pick-up at 8:00 am, duration 5hrs) Escape the buzz of Buenos Aires and explore the natural beauty of the Tigre Delta on this half-day adventure, perfect for all ages. Enjoy a one-hour boat ride through a maze of rivers and lush islands, where you’ll pass traditional stilt houses, schools, churches, and get a glimpse into the unique lifestyle of the island communities. An audio guide onboard shares fascinating facts about the Delta's history, ecosystem, and culture as you cruise along its calm waters. Back on land, continue your journey through the charming city of Tigre. Stroll along Victorica Avenue, explore the Puerto de Frutos market, admire the historic City Council building, and walk through the picturesque gardens of the Tigre Art Museum, surrounded by waterfront cafés and restaurants. This relaxed yet enriching tour offers a refreshing contrast to the city – a perfect getaway just outside Buenos Aires.

Overnight in Buenos Aires.

itinerary.title: BUENOS AIRES – USHUAIA (3.5hrs by flight, not included)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, you will be transferred to Jorge Newbery Airport (AEP) to board your flight to Ushuaia (not included). Upon arrival, meet your local guide and transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to relax and start taking in the charm of this unique Patagonian destination, surrounded by mountains, forests, and the Beagle Channel.

Note: If your departure is at Ezeiza (Ministro Pistarini International Airport), please check the supplement price in the Optional section.

Overnight in Ushuaia.

itinerary.title: USHUAIA: TIERRA DEL FUEGO NATIONAL PARK
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, set out on a half-day tour to discover the southernmost protected area in Argentina, the only National Park in the country that combines coastal and mountainous landscapes. Traveling along National Route No. 3, just 11 km from Ushuaia, you will explore highlights such as Río Pipo, Monte Susana, Lago Acigami, Alakush Visitor Center, Laguna Verde, and Bahía Lapataia, the iconic endpoint of the Pan-American Highway.

Along the way, enjoy short walks and photo stops (weather permitting) while admiring the Park’s striking geography of mountains, valleys, rivers, and lakes that reach the Beagle Channel coast.

The sub-Antarctic Forest is home to native wildlife such as the Fuegian red fox and a great diversity of birds, including the cachaña, giant woodpecker, rayadito, Patagonian thrush, and the emblematic cauquén caranca, symbol of the Park.

Overnight in Ushuaia.

itinerary.title: USHUAIA
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, enjoy a full day at leisure to explore Ushuaia at your own pace. Take time to stroll through the city, admire its unique setting between the Andes and the Beagle Channel, or simply relax at your hotel. For those wishing to enrich their experience, we also offer a selection of optional excursions (not included) that allow you to further discover the natural beauty and cultural charm of the region.

Full-Day Tour to Fueguinian Lakes: (hotel pick-up at 8:30 am, duration 8hrs) transfer to Mirador Valle Carbajal, where you’ll admire vast peat bogs and breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains and glaciers. A brief stop will be made at a winter center before continuing along Route 3 towards Paso Garibaldi, the southernmost crossing of the Andes Mountains. By mid-morning, you’ll arrive at Puesto La Carmen to enjoy a hot drink and take a leisurely walk along the shores of Lake Fagnano, known by the Ona people as “The Rest of the Horizon” due to its striking interruption of the mountain skyline. Around midday, the journey continues to the Garibaldi Pass viewpoint, offering panoramic views of Lake Escondido, nestled in a deep valley surrounded by mountains.

Half-Day Private City Tour with Martial Glacier: (Min 2 pax, hotel pick-up at 8:00 am, duration 4hrs) Discover the charm of Ushuaia through a guided city tour that reveals its history, culture, and stunning natural surroundings. The excursion includes key highlights such as the Mirador Las Hayas viewpoint, Ushuaia Bay, La Misión Anglicana neighborhood, Bahía Encerrada, Avenida San Martín (the main shopping street), Nuestra Señora de la Merced Church, the End of the World Museum, and the Maritime Museum (former prison). The experience concludes with a visit to Martial Glacier, where you’ll enjoy breathtaking views of the city and the Beagle Channel, making it an unforgettable way to connect with the southernmost city in the world.

Overnight in Ushuaia.

itinerary.title: USHUAIA – EL CALAFATE (2hrs by flight, not included)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your hotel. At the scheduled time, you will be transferred to Malvinas Argentinas International Airport (USH) to board your flight to El Calafate, gateway to the magnificent glaciers of southern Patagonia. Upon arrival, meet your local guide and transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to relax and enjoy the serene beauty of this lakeside town.

Overnight in El Calafate.

itinerary.title: EL CALAFATE
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, enjoy a full day at leisure in El Calafate. Stroll through the charming town, discover local shops and cafés, or simply relax while admiring the surrounding Patagonian landscapes. Optional excursions are available for those who wish to further explore the region’s natural wonders (not included).

El Calafate Balcón Experience: (Min 2 pax, hotel pick-up at 11 am, duration 4hrs) Ascend the hills behind El Calafate to reach an impressive natural viewpoint offering sweeping views of the town and Lake Argentino. The trail leads through classic Patagonian landscapes, revealing spectacular vistas of the glacier accumulation zone and, on clear days, the iconic Fitz Roy and Torre mountains in El Chaltén. Along the way, discover unique geological formations such as the Laberinto de Piedras, a maze of Cretaceous rock dating back 85 million years, and the fascinating Piedra de los Sombreros, rare iron concretions found in only four places in the world. alike.

El Chaltén with Viewpoints and Lunch: (Min 2 pax, hotel pick-up at 8 am, duration 12hrs, avail. Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday and Sunday) Depart early from El Calafate and travel along the legendary Ruta 40, following the shores of Lake Argentino and the Santa Cruz River. Make a stop at the historic La Leona Inn, once visited by famous explorers, where you can enjoy a hot drink and homemade cakes before continuing the journey. Arrive at El Chaltén, the trekking capital of Argentina, and enjoy lunch at a local restaurant. In the afternoon, take a moderate 45-minute walk to the Mirador de los Cóndores, offering panoramic views of the surrounding mountains, the Río de las Vueltas Valley, and the town of El Chaltén. Continue to the Mirador de las Águilas, with breathtaking views of Lake Viedma, Bahía Túnel, and Cerro Pirámide.

Overnight in El Calafate.

itinerary.title: EL CALAFATE: PERITO MORENO GLACIER
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, depart from your hotel for a full-day excursion to the spectacular Perito Moreno Glacier, the only glacier in the world that continues to advance. The scenic drive (approx. 80 km) follows the southern shore of Lake Argentino, passing rivers, lakes, and the rolling foothills of the Andes. Along the way, spot floating icebergs before arriving at Los Glaciares National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Enjoy time to walk along the panoramic walkways, admire the glacier’s towering ice walls, and witness the breathtaking sound and sight of ice breaking into the lake. Lunch is available at the onsite restaurants or snack bar (not included). If you’d like to explore further, you can also book an optional tour (not included).

Nautical Safari: (duration 1 hour) Sail across Lago Rico for an unforgettable close-up view of the Perito Moreno Glacier. Departing from Bajo de las Sombras Port (approx. 7 km from the glacier), this one-hour cruise offers a unique perspective of the glacier’s towering ice walls and the dramatic calving of icebergs into the lake. At just 400 meters from the glacier’s southern wall, the boat pauses to give you time to admire and photograph this natural wonder at its closest and most impressive point.

Return to El Calafate in the afternoon.

Overnight in El Calafate.

itinerary.title: EL CALAFATE DEPARTURE
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel. At the scheduled time, a private transfer will take you from your hotel to Comandante Armando Tola International Airport for your departure flight. Take with you unforgettable memories of Patagonia’s breathtaking landscapes and natural wonders.

title: Bulgaria at a glance: Sofia City Break
description:
Breathe the aromas of the colourful bouquet, called Bulgaria, only for 4 days. Take part in this city break, centred in Sofia and learn more about its culture and traditions. Explore the capital of Bulgaria, a modern and buzzing city which keeps impressive history from Antiquity to nowadays. Take a drive to the imposing Rila Monastery and learn more about the medieval Boyana Church, both part of the UNESCO World Heritage sites. Have your free time to reveal the secrets of unknown Bulgaria.    

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS

Sofia: the capital and largest city of Bulgaria will offer you a great variety of attractions: from ancient remains, rich museums and typical architecture to a pedestrian zone with numerous cafes, restaurants and fashion boutiques. 

Rila Monastery: hidden deep in the mountain, the monastery and its premises keep stories and legends tightly connected with Bulgarian history and the Revival period.

Boyana Church: one of the most remarkable medieval monuments in the world with especially fine wall paintings in the interior - from the 11th, 13th, 15-17th and 19th centuries.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL SOFIA (10km – 30min)
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Bulgaria! Arrive at Sofia International Airport. Upon arrival, you will be met and transferred to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at your leisure enjoying the highlights of Sofia. You may stroll around the city centre and visit the biggest Orthodox Cathedral in Bulgaria - St.Alexander Nevski, with an impressive gold-plated cupola and rich interior. Your walk may continue with the most significant sights in the centre – St. George Rotonda, the Russian church St. Nikolay, and the National Theatre Ivan Vazov. Do not miss having a cup of coffee on the pedestrian street Vitoshka and feel the atmosphere of this vibrant city. Alternatively, you can choose to end the day with the following Optional Tour (not included):

Dinner with Folklore and Nestinari Dances (shared basis):

Celebrate the start of the trip by being part of a typical Bulgarian night with a delicious welcome dinner and folklore program. Songs, dances… what a magical night full of unforgettable moments. The Nestinari dances, a barefoot dance on smouldering embers, part of the UNESCO intangible cultural heritage will leave you speechless. This ritual will lead you back to the mystery of Eastern Orthodox beliefs together with the older pagan traditions from the Strandza Mountains.

Notes: Included: Dinner in a typical restaurant four-course menu, including a glass of wine; folklore program, and Nestinari Dance* (*performed only if the weather conditions allow). Dinner starts at 20:00h and ends at 23:00h. Not included: guide, transfers.

Overnight in Sofia.

itinerary.title: RILA MONASTERY AND BOYANA CHURCH EXCURSION (260km – 4hrs)
itinerary.description:
Start your day with a nice breakfast at the hotel and head to the meeting point for your “Rila Monastery& Boyana Church” sightseeing tour (included). Starts at 09:00h from the parking behind Alexander Nevski Cathedral. Please be sure to organize your travel to the meeting point and be there at least 15 minutes in advance. Rila Monastery is definitely a must-see sight if you are in Bulgaria. The arcaded balconies, the unique frescoes – a work of one of the most famous Bulgarian Revival Period painters, the gilded iconostasis, the fabulous mountain views… and the unique combination of them all, makes the visit to the monastery extraordinary and memorable one. You will have around an hour of free time at the Rila Monastery to explore the most visited UNESCO site in Bulgaria, enter the main church and the narthex’s gallery, admire the exhibits in the History Museum of the Monastery, try the tasty "mekitsi" (Bulgarian doughnuts) with delicious buffalo’s yoghurt (a local speciality) or even have a short walk in the area. Then, drive back to Sofia, where the next UNESCO Monument is awaiting you. The Boyana Church's frescoes bring epochal change in the mural painting and are considered predecessors of the European Renaissance. The majority of more than 240 figures depicted there have individuality, vitality, and psychological depth. 

Overnight in Sofia.

itinerary.title: SOFIA
itinerary.description:
After your delightful breakfast at the hotel, you can continue exploring the capital of Bulgaria at your own pace. Sofia offers a great variety of museums that could meet almost every taste. We recommend you to visit the National History Museum, the largest one in Bulgaria that hosts more than 650,000 artefacts. Other important museums, worth visiting, are the National Museum of the Bulgarian Fine Art and the National Ethnographic Museum, both found in the building of the former Royal Palace on Alexander I Square, the National Museum of Natural History, the Earth and Man National Museum with its collection of precious stones and minerals, and many more. If you wish to travel within the country, you can book our shared Optional trip to the European City of Culture for 2019, Plovdiv (not included) 

Plovdiv tour (shared basis, available only on Mondays and Fridays):

Take this tour and explore the cultural capital of Bulgaria. Plovdiv is the second biggest city in the country and the oldest European continuously inhabited town with a history that goes back for more than 6 000 years. Have a walk on the cobbled-stone streets of the Old town and stop by the awe-inspiring Roman Theater, the old-style houses, the Nebet Tepe fortifications, the Ancient Stadium, street art, galleries, old churches, ornamented mosques, exotic cafés, and chic bars. Enjoy and really get to know the city with our expert guide on your side. On this unforgettable tour, you will learn a lot of intriguing stories, funny urban legends, and striking historical facts.

Notes: Included: English-speaking guide, modern A/C equipped vehicle and all transportation costs along the way. Not include any entrance fees, personal expenses, food, beverages, and gratuities.

Overnight in Sofia.

title: Turkish Cities & Culture, Small Group Tour
description:
This seven-night classic tour lives up to its name with an itinerary packed full of Turkey’s must-sees, from the mosques and museums of Istanbul to the ancient city of Ephesus. Stroll beautifully arranged streets and visit fascinating ruins and museums, get closer to history and culture, indulge in delicious foods and enjoy panoramic views during this fascinating round-trip tour.

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS

Istanbul: a major city in Turkey that straddles Europe and Asia across the Bosphorus Strait. Its Old City reflects the cultural influences of the many empires that once ruled here.

Pamukkale: (Cotton Castle) is a town in western Turkey known for the mineral-rich thermal waters flowing down white travertine terraces on a nearby hillside. 

Hierapolis: an ancient Roman spa city founded around 190 B.C. Ruins there include a well-preserved theater and a necropolis with sarcophagi that stretch for 2km. The Antique Pool is famous for its submerged Roman columns, the result of an earthquake.

Antalya: Before Antalya became one of Turkey’s top summer resort towns, it was the ancient city of Attalia, founded during the Hellenistic period, later becoming part of the Roman Empire. As such, Antalya’s old town is one of its most important sights harking back to its rich past. 

Ancient cities: Explore the mesmerising ancient cities of Troy, Pergamon and Ephesus, and visit their impressive temples and monuments, while learning about fascinating legends.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL ANTALYA
itinerary.description:
Upon arrival at the Antalya Airport hop on a transfer to your hotel. Check in and spend the rest of the day at leisure exploring the area. At the end of the day enjoy dinner at the hotel. 

Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: ANTALYA – EPHESUS – IZMIR
itinerary.description:
Today revolves around Ephesus – Turkey’s largest archaeological area. During the 1st century AD, Ephesus was the second-largest city in the world after Rome, boasting a population of over 250,000 citizens. You’ll learn all about it on a tour before heading to Izmir. Cross the Taurus Mountains and drive through the fertile valley to reach the largest archaeological site in the country, Ephesus. There, you will explore the theatre, the marble street, the Library of Celsus, Hadrian's Temple, and many other historic structures.

Overnight in Izmir.

itinerary.title: IZMIR – PERGAMON – TROY – CANAKKALE
itinerary.description:
After a tasty breakfast, we will visit two more UNSECO-stamped ancient cities – Pergamon and Troy. In Pergamon once stood the famous altar of Zeus. On the Acropolis Hill, you will see the steep theatre, the ruins of the library and the partially rebuilt temple of Trajan. Next, drive on to Troy along the charming coastal landscape. The afternoon is dedicated to Troy and Homer. Discovered by Heinrich Schliemann, it is considered the most famous of the ancient sites in Turkey. Dinner and overnight stay in Canakkale.

Overnight in Canakkale.

itinerary.title: CANAKKALE – ISTANBUL
itinerary.description:
Today, you will leave the ancient world behind, as you travel by car and ferry to the cosmopolitan Turkish city of Istanbul. After crossing the legendary Dardanelles by car ferry, you will reach your new destination: Istanbul the cosmopolitan city on 2 continents. You will visit one of Istanbul's greatest sights, the Topkapi Palace, which was the seat of the Ottoman sultans for 400 years. The individual parts of the palace are today a museum. Among other things costume, porcelain and weapons collections. In the early evening, you will have free time to stroll through the "Grand Bazaar", one of the oldest and biggest covered markets in the world made up of 61 streets and over 4,000 shops.

Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: ISTANBUL
itinerary.description:
Today after breakfast enjoy a full-day city tour through the lively metropolis, which was once called Byzantium. First stop at the Hippodrome, the ancient horse racecourse. This ancient arena in Sultanahmet Square was mainly used for chariot races. It was the centre of everyday life for men in the Byzantine period. You will then visit the "Blue Mosque" – named after the blue tiles that decorate its interior. Built in the early 1600s, it’s the only mosque in Istanbul with six minaret towers. At the end, we visit the UNESCO-listed Hagia Sophia. This renowned building began as a church approximately 1,500 years ago, later transitioned into a mosque, and eventually became a museum. The afternoon is free at your leisure.

Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: ISTANBUL – PAMUKKALE
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Asia! Today you will leave the European continent and reach Asia via the fourth-longest suspension bridge in the world. After a drive through the Central Asian highlands, you arrive in Pamukkale. Treat yourself to a thermal bath at your hotel. 

Overnight in Pamukkale.

itinerary.title: PAMUKKALE – ANTALYA
itinerary.description:
Today we will visit Pamukkale’s thermal pools and stop at an ancient Roman city before making tracks back towards Antalya. The limestone terraces of Pamukkale, today a UNESCO natural monument, are the result of thousands of years of millennia of sedimentation. Next, on to the Ancient Hierapolis which offers the best-preserved necropolis from the Roman period.

Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: ANTALYA DEPARTURE
itinerary.description: After breakfast transfer will be waiting to take you to Antalya Airport. It’s time to say farewell to Turkey today as your tour comes to an end.

 The Seeko'o Hotel Bordeaux is a contemporary, upscale boutique hotel located in the heart of Bordeaux, France. The name "Seeko'o" is derived from the Inuit word for "iceberg," a fitting reference to its design and form.

The building features large windows, angular lines, and a clean, modern layout, creating a visually impressive environment that appeals to design enthusiasts.

title: Exploring Greece with Athens, Delphi, Meteora, Mykonos and Santorini
description:
Join this exciting nine-day tour and explore some of the most beautiful places in sunny Greece. Begin by strolling the streets of Athens, one of the most historic cities in the world. Catch sight of its stunning landmarks, letting yourself conquered by the imposing architectural masterpieces, learn about the impressive Greek civilization, and surprise your taste buds with the mouthwatering traditional Greek dishes. Admire Delphi, the inspiring place once considered the centre of the world, and enjoy a spiritual experience while visiting the magical Meteora monasteries. Wander around the narrow cobble-stoned streets, admiring the traditional house and picturesque landscapes of Kalambaka, catch a glimpse of the explosive nightlife in Mykonos, and explore the romantic, crescent-shaped Santorini Island. Join this mesmerising tour to have an authentic journey and see the real beauty of Greece!

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS 

Parthenon: Dedicated to the patron of the city, the well-known goddess Athena Parthenos, this fascinating landmark is one of the most magnificent creations of Athenian democracy. 

Acropolis Museum: Learn about the impressive past of the city while visiting the remarkable Acropolis Museum. 

Delphi, the Center of the World: Once considered the centre of the world by the Greeks, Delphi is still an important place that promises to impress you. 

Meteora Monasteries: Enjoy a breathtaking spiritual journey while visiting a stone forest decorated with historical monasteries and included on the Unesco's World Heritage List.

Mykonos: Visit magical Mykonos and explore its world-famous party scene, with modern vibrant clubs and exciting beach bars. 

Santorini: Relax, visit its hidden gems, indulge in the delicious local dishes, and enjoy wandering around one of the most romantic Greek islands.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL  ATHENS
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Athens airport where our representative will meet and transfer you to your hotel for check-in. Enjoy the rest of the day at leisure, strolling the beautifully arranged streets of charming Athens. Perhaps enjoy a walk in the picturesque Plaka area, indulge in a tasty coffee at one of the inviting cafes in Agia Eirini Square, or adventure into a souvenir shopping session on Adrianou Street. You can end this memorable day with a mouthwatering dinner(not included) in one of the many traditional restaurants spread throughout the city. And if you want to catch a glimpse of the city under the mesmerising moonlight, enjoy an optional night out in Athens. 

Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: ATHENS CITY TOUR
itinerary.description:
Begin your day with a mouthwatering breakfast at your hotel, preparing to observe the striking contrasts that make Athens such a fascinating city, during a memorable city tour. Our expert guide will take you to see the Panathenaic Stadium, where the first Olympic Games of modern times were held in 1896. Stop for a few moments and then continue your tour passing by the Prime Minister's residence- the former Royal Palace, guarded by the Euzones in their colourful uniform. Then, see the Temple of Olympian Zeus, Hadrian's Arch, the Parliament, the memorial of the Unknown Soldier, the Academy, University, National Library, and the lovely Constitution Square (Syntagma). Go to Acropolis to visit the Architectural Masterpieces of Athens' Golden Age: The Propylaea, Temple of Athena Nike, the Erechtheion, and finally "the harmony between material and spirit" and the monument that "puts an order in mind"- Greece's imposing Parthenon. Last, but not least, admire the wonders of the classical era at The Acropolis Museum. Return to your hotel in Athens for overnight.

Overnight in  Athens.

itinerary.title: ATHENS – DELPHI – KALAMBAKA (420 km - 5.5 hrs)
itinerary.description:
After a delicious breakfast, leave for Delphi via Thebes, Levadia, and the picturesque village of Arachova, on the slopes of Mount Parnassus. Wander around spellbinding Delphi, and visit the interesting Archaeological Site. Afterwards, depart for beautiful Kalambaka, passing through the picturesque villages and spectacular towns of Central Greece. Proceed to Kalambaka for a delightful dinner and overnight.

Overnight in Kalambaka.

itinerary.title: KALAMBAKA – ATHENS (350 km - 4.15 hrs)
itinerary.description:
Indulge in a luscious breakfast at your hotel. Then, head towards Meteora, one of Greece's most famous landmarks that earned a special place on UNESCO’s list of World Heritage Monuments. Enjoy the breathtaking scenery and get closer to the Greek glorious history and culture. Admire the ageless Monasteries, standing between earth and sky, atop huge rocks, and containing priceless historical and religious treasures. Return to Athens via Trikala, Lamia, and Thermopylae. Have a short stop to see, across the road, the Leonida's Monument, and arrive in Greece´s capital city early in the evening.

Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: ATHENS – MYKONOS (5 hrs by ferry)
itinerary.description:
Begin your day with a tasty breakfast at the hotel. Then, enjoy an early transfer from the hotel to Piraeus port to take the ferry boat to Mykonos. Arrive on the beautiful island. Then transfer to your hotel for check-in and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure, enjoying the hotel amenities or exploring the beautiful surroundings. 

Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: MYKONOS
itinerary.description:
Have a delightful breakfast at the hotel and get ready to adventure yourself into discovering the beautiful island, on your own. Known for being a meeting point of the international jet set and a piece of heaven for travellers who want to relax on amazing beaches and enjoy a unique nightlife. Stroll the lovely streets, relax on the warm sand, and enjoy a few cocktails in one of the lively beach bars. 

Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: MYKONOS – SANTORINI (3 hrs by high-speed ferry)
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a tasty breakfast at your hotel before transferring to the port of Mykonos to catch the high-speed ferry boat to Santorini. Arrive on the beautiful island of romance, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel for check-in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, relaxing at the hotel, sunbathing, or exploring the paths of charming Santorini.

Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: SANTORINI
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a delicious breakfast at the hotel, and get ready to discover the island of Santorini, on your own. Stroll the delightful alleys, and admire the white Cycladic houses lining the cliff tops. Perhaps, get in touch with history while visiting the Akrotiri site, known also as the Pompeii of Greece. Maybe visit Canava, admiring its vineyards and distillery. Then, indulge in the incredible local food. The number of great restaurants is impressive, and the traditional dishes promise to amaze your taste buds. Late in the afternoon, you can visit the fascinating, little village of Oia to watch a hypnotizing sunset. 

Overnight  in Santorini.

itinerary.title: DEPARTURE SANTORINI
itinerary.description: After breakfast at the hotel, checked-out and get ready for your transfer to the airport or port of Santorini Island.

title: Island Hopping Greek Islands Delights: Mykonos, Paros, Santorini
description:
Join our eight-day tour and indulge in the island beauty of Greece! Lay back and relax on the white sandy beaches in Mykonos and get a glimpse of its vivid nightlife while having a drink at one of its clubs. Rural life of the Paros´ local villages will welcome you with the hospitality and invite you to try traditional olive oil and cheese, and romantic essence of Santorini, with its awe-inspiring sunsets upon the white-washed buildings and the local dishes and wine will be the best way how to wrap up your Greek discoveries.

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS

Mykonos: Mykonos is the party animal of the Cycladic islands, Greece’s answer to Ibiza, with bronzed bodies thronging its beaches by day and basslines pounding through its super clubs until dawn. However, there is more to Mykonos than the dazzling sand and insatiable revellers. Chora village and the “Little Venice” are the most picturesque site of the island.

Santorini: A precious gem of the Aegean which consists of Thíra, Thirassiá, Asproníssi, Palea, and Nea Kaméni. The whole complex of Santorini islands is still an active volcano whose crater is in the sea and the contrast it creates with the white-washed buildings set against the vibrant blue sky is what makes it so unique.

Paros: Cyclades Island that sits in the heart of the Aegean sea and offers a mix of traditional Cycladic architecture, vivid nightlife, magical beaches, enchanting rural villages, and historical monuments.

itinerary.title: MYKONOS ARRIVAL
itinerary.description:
Upon arrival at Mykonos Airport or Port, you will be met and transferred to the hotel for check-in. The afternoon is free at leisure to start exploring this cosmopolitan island. Stroll down the whitewashed streets of the Chora (the capital town) and get involved in the Mediterranean spirit by dining in one of the local taverns or drinking your first cocktail at one of the waterfront beach bars (own expense). 

Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: MYKONOS DISCOVERY
itinerary.description:
Enjoy your breakfast at the hotel before you stroll down the Chora streets to begin with your Cycladic discoveries. The architecture of the narrow marble streets is astonishing and whitewashed houses with colorful doors and window frames, bougainvillea trees in red bloom and hidden churches will spark your curiosity about the Cycladic heritage. Pay a visit to the church of Panagia Paraportiani, the Townhall and the castle situated above the harbour and don’t miss the Archaeological, Folklore and Maritime Museums to take in a little history. Wander around the pedestrian shopping streets of the Chora. Stop at glamorous Maoyanni Streets to shop at one of the brand name stores or just enjoy a drink at one of the dazzling cafés or restaurants. On the lively waterfront, admire a fleet of fishing boats casting colourful reflections in the azure waters and do not miss Kazarma building, personal residence of Manto Mavrogenous, the heroine of the Greek Revolution. Continue to Ano Mera village. The big square in the middle of the village with all traditional café and restaurants and the big marble fountain, the Monastery of Panagia Tourliani with the unique icon of holy Mary, makes Ano Mera the most attractive and traditional village of Mykonos. Lay back and relax at the most famous beaches of the island like Kalafatis, Agios Stefanos and Agios Giannis with the perfect view to Delos, just before returning back at your hotel full of experiences. 

Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: MYKONOS
itinerary.description:
Wake up to breakfast at the hotel and enjoy the full day at leisure at this Mediterranean paradise. Bask under the healing sunshine and soak up the alluring sights and sounds of a truly enchanting island in the tropics. Lie down on the alluring beach and get seduced by the softness of the golden sand. 

Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: MYKONOS – PAROS (1.5 hrs, by hydro boat)
itinerary.description:
Begin your day with a tasty breakfast at your hotel, and then hop on the transfer to the port of Mykonos to catch the hydro boat to Paros. You will be met and transferred to your hotel for check in. This evening is free at leisure on this dazzling island of Paros. Explore and enjoy all that the island has to offer. History and nature combine to make Paros unforgettable.

Overnight in Paros.

itinerary.title: PAROS
itinerary.description:
Start the day with a tasty breakfast at the hotel and enjoy your full day at leisure while exploring Paros and nearby villages. Discover the Marpissa and Prodromos´s curiosity in their interconnected houses, or drive to Parion, where the local Greek family makes traditional yogurt, fresh myzithra and xynomyzithra cheese, and piquant kefalotyri cheese, all produced from local cow’s milk using traditional methods. Once you cross the Prodromos´s arch, you will be amazed by blazes of colour from the well-tended courtyards full of geraniums, bougainvillea and basil plants and a number of churches built in 16th century style. The mountainous surrounding of Lefkes village offers fascinating views over the island and its charming alleys, typical old Greek houses and traditional tavernas, cafés and shops make this village very scenic and pleasant stopover.

Overnight in Paros.

itinerary.title: PAROS – SANTORINI (3 hrs, by hydro boat)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast at the hotel, get ready for your transfer to the port of Paros to catch the hydro boat to Santorini. Once in Santorini, you will be met and transferred to your hotel for check in. Rest of the day is at leisure. Lay back and relax at the white long beaches or head out to explore the island´s history and fascinating landscape. Late in the afternoon, you can visit the picturesque, little village of Oia to watch a romantic sunset.

Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: SANTORINI DISCOVERY
itinerary.description:
Wake up to breakfast at the hotel and enjoy another experience in the Mediterranean paradise. Stroll down delightful alleys of Santoniri and admire the white Cycladic houses lining the cliff tops. Perhaps, get in touch with history while visiting the Akrotiri site, known also as the Pompeii of Greece. Explore the local viticulture and vineyards, by visiting a Canava, admiring its vineyards and distillery and tasting volcanic wines. Then, get a glimpse of delicious local food. The number of great restaurants is impressive, and the traditional dishes promise to leave you speechless. When the sun comes down do not miss to enjoy the magical sunset from the Oia village. A spectacular view over the volcano and the island of Thirassia from here is absolutely amazing!

As soon as the sun sets, descend to Ammoudi Bay to enjoy a romantic dinner in a restaurant of your preference. Alternatively, you can embark on a sunset cruise and enjoy this romance of sunset wile sailing on the sea. Most of the harbours of the island run regular sunset cruises and it is a sheer delight to be on board and witness the ethereal sunset.

Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.description: After one last breakfast at your hotel, bid farewell to Greece as you hop onto a comfortable transfer to Santorini Airport or Port, where you will catch your flight to your following destination. We hope the memories of this trip will stay with you for a lifetime – have a safe journey!

title: Island Hopping, Summer on the Greek Islands: Mykonos, Santorini, Crete
description:
Welcome to Greece's most famous cosmopolitan islands, a whitewashed paradise in the heart of the Cyclades. The crescent-shaped Santorini Island is its most precious gem. Crete is the largest island in Greece, where you can admire the remnants of brilliant civilizations, explore glorious beaches, impressive mountain escapes, fertile valleys and steep gorges, and become part of the island’s rich gastronomic culture. 

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS

Mykonos: set out on a trip to discover the beauties of the island, particularly its sun-kissed beaches.

Chora: It is one of the best examples of Cycladic architecture. Stroll around its narrow marble streets and admire whitewashed houses with colourful doors and window frames, bougainvillaea trees in red bloom and hidden churches.

Santorini: formed by the eruption of the volcano 1600 BC. The sight is the most breathtaking of all Greek islands and perhaps of the world.

Heraklion: the perfect base for exploration, as it is close to two of the most important monuments in Crete: Knossos Palace and Phaistos Palace.

Crete Island: In Crete, you will find the oldest wine-producing area in continuous use on the European continent.

itinerary.title: MYKONOS DISCOVERY

Indulge in a delicious breakfast. Today we suggest you start getting a bit familiar with Mykonos Island and Chora. Pay a visit to the church of Panagia Paraportiani, the Townhall and the castle situated above the harbour. Don’t miss to visit the Archaeological, Folklore and Maritime Museums to take in a little history. Wander around the pedestrian shopping streets of the Chora. itinerary.title: MYKONOS – SANTORINI (3hrs, by hydro boat)
itinerary.description:
Begin your day with a tasty breakfast at your hotel, and then hop on the transfer to the port of Mykonos to catch the hydro boat to Santorini. You will be met and transferred to your hotel for check-in and settlement. This evening is free at leisure on this amazing island of Santorini. Explore and enjoy all that the island has to offer. History and nature combine to make Santorini unforgettable.

Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: SANTORINI DISCOVERY
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a rich breakfast at the hotel. Start your day by visiting one of the hundreds of beaches found on the island. On the southern part of Santorini, you will find one of the most distinctive beaches of the island, the Red Beach. The contrasting colours of the red lava cliffs and the clear blue waters combine to make a perfect setting. Since you will already be there, visiting the White Beach in the nearby area is a must. Don’t miss the chance to also pay a visit to the archaeological site of Akrotiri as it’s considered as one of the main attractions of the island due to its association with the Minoan civilization. The end of the day shall find you in one of the many restaurants in the area serving fresh fish and other traditional delicacies (own expense). 

Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: SANTORINI, THE SUNSET
itinerary.description:
Recharge your energies with a delicious breakfast at the hotel before enjoying a slow day of rest and relaxation. But in the evening do not miss the sheer beauty of Santorini's sunset view, one of the best places on earth as far as sunset viewing is concerned. Oia village where you will view the sunset from is situated on top of an impressive cliff and offers a spectacular view over the volcano and the island of Thirassia. As soon as the sun sets, descend to Ammoudi Bay to enjoy a romantic dinner in a restaurant of your preference (own expense). Most of the harbours of the island run regular sunset cruises and it is a sheer delight to be on board and witness the ethereal sunset (not included).

Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: SANTORINI – HERAKLION/CRETE (2hrs, by hydro boat)
itinerary.description:
After a delectable breakfast, transfer to the port of Santorini to catch the hydro boat to Heraklion. You will be met and transferred to your hotel for check-in and settlement. Rest of day at your own leisure at Heraklion.  

Overnight in Heraklion.

itinerary.title: HERAKLION, CITY EXPLORATION
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a delightful breakfast at your hotel. Today is free at leisure to start discovering Heraklion city. Strolling around Heraklion town, you will come across Koules fortress, at the Venetian port, Turkish and Venetian fountains, Venetian buildings, the Venetian Loggia and museums, such as the Archaeological Museum, the Historical Museum and the Museum of Natural History. If you are not a big fan of sightseeing, though, you should head to the beautiful beaches! The northern and southern coasts of the Heraklion region are fringed with former hippies’ paradise beaches, Matala beach, Agia Pelagia and Malia.

Overnight in Heraklion.

itinerary.title: HERAKLION, HISTORY AND ART
itinerary.description:
Charge your batteries with breakfast at the hotel. Today you may be wondered by Heraklion history and art. Being over 20,000 square meters big, the Minoan Palace of Knossos is the largest of all Minoan palatial structures. The remains of colourful murals, imposing red columns and the glorious throne room will make you feel transported into the Minoan Era. The Minoan Palace of Phaistos is the second most important Minoan site, after Knossos. It is located on the east side of Kastri hill, boasting a beautiful natural setting. Do not miss to visit one or both of them. Alternatively, you can choose to go on the following optional tour: 

Knossos Palace private tour in Crete Island (requires min participation of 2 persons) : Includes 3hr private taxi transportation, private English speaking guide for 3hrs, entrance fee for Knossos Palace. Does not include: any meals or drinks.

Overnight in Heraklion.

We hope the memories of this trip will stay with you for a lifetime – have a safe journey!

title: Essential Costa Rica - Package with Guanacaste
description:
Uncover essential Costa Rica during this 10-day exotic adventure. Beginning and ending in the capital, San Jose, this tour offers you the chance to discover different aspects of this emblematic destination.  Visit the most predominant natural areas of Costa Rica, including Arenal Volcano National Park, and the cloud forest of Monteverde. Spend precious time in mesmerising Tamarindo, one of Costa Rica’s most famous beaches, indulging in the fun surf town atmosphere and getting closer to the inspiring local culture and adventurous spirit.

 

TOUR HIGHLIGHTS:

San Jose: Costa Rica’s vibrant capital city was founded in the mid-18th century, boasting great cultural and historical landmarks. Visit its museums, the European-inspired National Theatre, and stroll the charming alleys of its historic neighbourhoods.

Tortuguero: This park is home to the nesting grounds of the green sea turtles, offering spectacular beaches and fantastic opportunities to spot wild animals and birds.

Arenal: Admire one of the most beautiful volcanoes in the country and its mesmerising park, dotted with trails and rich in wildlife. 

Monteverde: Settled by American Quakers in the 1950s, this primary cloud forest is made out of six unique ‘life zones’, hosting many endangered species, as well as a variety of fascinating plants.

Tamarindo: This busy beach resort is great for a night out, surfing, and exploring the bustling restaurant scene.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL SAN JOSE
itinerary.description:
Upon arrival to bustling San Jose, our representative will meet and greet you and then direct you to your transport, which will drop you off at your hotel in San Jose for your night in Costa Rica.

Overnight in San Jose.

itinerary.title: SAN JOSE – TORTUGUERO (135km – 4 hrs by road / 2 hrs by boat)
itinerary.description:
Your day begins early with a morning departure, travelling by bus through the Braulio Carrillo National Park towards the Caribbean plains to enjoy the spectacular mountain scenery and quaint villages. Indulge in a tasty breakfast en route and continue through the jungle by boat, cruising the rivers and canals of Tortuguero National Park. Arrive at your eco-lodge and enjoy a tasty lunch. Board the boat again for a visit to Tortuguero village, where you will get to walk around town, stroll along the beach, and experience the locals’ way of living. During the turtle hatching season, we will look for the baby turtles trying to find their way down to the ocean. Nesting is from July to September and hatching from September to December. Enjoy the rest of the day relaxing at the hotel, surrounded by the beautiful tropical forest and wildlife. Lunch and Dinner included

  • Overnight in Tortuguero.

itinerary.title: TORTUGUERO NATIONAL PARK
itinerary.description:
Today you will have some free time to relax by the pool and experience the Tortuguero National Park on a three-hour trip. Observe over 350 protected species of birds, monkeys, crocodiles, and sloths, as well as lush vegetation. During the July to September season, you can join an optional late night turtle nesting tour, purchasable directly at the lodge. Lunch and dinner included.

  • Overnight in Tortuguero.

itinerary.title: TORTUGUERO – ARENAL (210km – 5 hrs by road / 2 hrs by boat)
itinerary.description:
Early in the morning depart by boat back to Guapiles. From there, take the ground transportation to the restaurant for lunch. After a tasty meal, you will be picked up in a shared transfer and taken to the Arenal area. Enjoy the day at leisure to explore on your own or participate in an exciting optional activity.

Termas de Tabacón Option: Live the Tabacón experience that has swimming pools and a river of hot springs that come from the veins of the majestic Arenal Volcano. Explore the wonders of the tropical forest surrounding this beautiful resort and enjoy mineral waters with different temperatures, surrounded by warm waterfalls and tropical gardens. The Tabacón hot springs are recognized throughout the world, and without a doubt, immersing yourself in them will make you feel relaxed and rejuvenated, due to the minerals present in the volcanic waters.

Includes: transportation, bilingual guide, entrance, dinner

Ecotermales Hot Springs Option: Escape to the natural paradise, with all the necessary amenities to make your experience a memorable experience, surrounded by the peace and serenity of the rainforest, and protected by the impressive Arenal Volcano, which heats and nourishes the waters of Ecothermal During your stay, you will enjoy the pleasure of feeling the natural energy coming from the veins of the Arenal Colossus; heats the fountains where thermal water pools are born, ranging from 37 ° C to 41 ° C (99 ° F to 106 ° F). That when combined with the pool and the cold water waterfall, they perform a relaxing massage throughout the body.

Includes: transportation, bilingual guide, entrance, dinner

Departure approx: 15:00 hrs | Duration approx: 6 hrs

  • Overnight in Arenal.

itinerary.title: ARENAL VOLCANO NATIONAL PARK
itinerary.description:
Today after breakfast, take a guided walking tour in Arenal Volcano National Park. During the tour, the guide will explain the periods of activity the once very active volcano experienced. Enjoy the verdant landscapes and the backdrop of the now-dormant volcano, as you keep a lookout for the wild animals living in this national park. You have the chance to spot sloths, howler monkeys, anteaters, and many others. 

Afterwards, return to the hotel with the afternoon at leisure to participate in an optional activity, either adventure or nature.

Optional extras:

Zipline Adventure: Costa Rica zip line tour is a genuine must in a vacation. You will have doses of fun and adrenaline filled adventure that you will remember forever. You will start the tour as you arrive at the base of the Ecoglide Arenal Park and your professional guide give you the instructions and some safety tips. The zipline tour consists of 13 cables of two wires traveling in parallel and 15 platforms, most of which are in the trees so that visitors can have more contact and closeness with nature, flora, and fauna of the rainforest. Within the tour, you will also discover the Tarzan Swing where you will swing from a platform into the forest feeling the adrenaline raising levels.

Inclusions: Transportation, Bilingual Guide, Entrance Fee, Equipment  

Departure aprox: 07: 40 hrs / 09:40 hrs / 11: 40 hrs / 13:40 hrs / 15:20 hrs | Duration aprox: 3 hrs.

La Fortuna Waterfall: This tour begins by descending the 500-meter trail to the magnificent Waterfall, renowned for its 60 meter (197 feet) high falls and its crystal-clear waters. Along the trail, you will observe plants, trees, and animals, which inhabit the area. You can choose to swim in its refreshing waters, take amazing photographs, or simply relax and take in all the beauty of the La Fortuna Waterfall. When you visit the La Fortuna Waterfall you not only get to enjoy this marvellous natural wonder, you will be helping to Support the Development Association of the community 100% of the entrance fee goes towards social projects to benefit schools, nutritional centres, the orphanage, our roads and more.

Inclusions: Transportation, Bilingual Guide, Entrance Fee 

Departure aprox: 08:00 hrs / 13:00 hrs | Duration aprox: 3 hrs.
