itinerary.title: ARENAL – MONTEVERDE (60km – 2.5 hrs by road / 45 min by boat)
itinerary.description:
Begin the day with an early breakfast at the hotel, followed by check-out and head towards Monteverde. Transfer down to Arenal Lake where you will board a boat that will take you across towards Monteverde. Once on the other side, a vehicle awaits to take you up to Monteverde. Admire the transition of the rainforest to the cloud forest where you will reach an altitude of 1,200 metres above sea level. Located in the Puntarenas province, Monteverde is a place of cloud forests and mist, coffee plantations, monkeys, and friendly locals. The town of Santa Elena is small and quaint, filled with inviting restaurants and folksy artisan shops, while the nearby rainforest hosts a remarkable amount of biodiversity. Enjoy the day at leisure to explore on your own. Enjoy the day at leisure to explore on your own or participate in an exciting optional activity like the Selvatura Treetop Walkway guided tour, what includes a 3-hour hike along a network of trails and suspension bridges in the cloud forest of Monteverde. Be on the lookout for birds, monkeys, sloths, insects, and interesting plants of all shapes and sizes. The Selvatura Treetop Walkway guided tour takes you through and above the rainforest. A series of eight suspension bridges, connected by trails for a total 3 km in length, provides a bird’s-eye view of the rainforest canopy! 

If adventure is not something you are interested in, join the interesting Don Juan Coffee Tour to understand Costa Rica´s coffee, chocolate and sugar cane production (with the emphasis on coffee!). The tour offers an interesting opportunity to learn about coffee and its production as well as to get close to the fascinating Costa Rican folklore

The optional tours are not included

  • Overnight in Monteverde.

itinerary.title: MONTEVERDE
itinerary.description:
.After a nourishing breakfast at the hotel, enjoy a hike through the Monteverde Cloud Forest Reserve. Founded in 1972, the Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological Reserve is world-famous for its outstanding biodiversity, conservation actions and contributions, as well as scientific research. The reserve is home to 2.5% of the world’s biodiversity, and it is one of the most important private reserves, not just in Costa Rica but the world. It hosts hundreds of species of mammals, birds, butterflies, amphibians, reptiles, insects and arachnids, as well as a large variety of flora, such as mosses, vines or the autochthonous trees of the cloud forest. You can enhance today´s experience by joining one of the memorable tours you missed yesterday. Whether you choose to explore the cloud forest during the Selvatura Treetop Walkway guided tour, or you prefer getting closer to the fascinating Costa Rican culture while on the Don Juan Coffee tour, your day will be unforgettable. Selvatura Treetop Walkaway and Don Juan Coffee tours are not included.


 

  • Overnight in Monteverde .

title: Dalmatian Highlights Split and Dubrovnik Region Cruise old bokun
description:
Unique cruise among a thousand islands, with extremely indented coastline adorned with numerous magical islands, Croatia is a place made for cruise trips. Join us on an unforgettable island-hopping journey while we explore natural wonders scattered around the Adriatic Sea.

Trogir: Small-sized but famous for its rich history and unparalleled beauty, this Croatian treasure is waiting for you with standout landmarks such as palaces, churches, ancient walls, and a superb castle.

Split: Surrounded by imposing mountains and crystal-clear waters, the paradisiacal city of Split is famous for its picturesque views, as well as for hosting some of the best Roman ruins in the world.

Island Brac: Steep cliffs, pine forests and crystalline water gathered to create a dramatic landscape on one of the largest Croatian islands, Brač. This magnificent island is wildly famous for radiant white stone used to build some of the most famous historical monuments and Zlatni rat, golden pebble beach.

Island Korcula: Korčula offers up Croatia at its most authentic, with tiny communities and ancient fishing villages dotted amongst pine forests and vineyards.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL TROGIR PORT – SPLIT PORT
itinerary.description:
Our journey starts in Trogir for those who will board between 12:00 to 2pm (passengers that arrive later can embark on the boat in the port of Split). The captain and the crew will give you a warm welcome and during lunch snack we will take off to one of the bays on the island of Čiovo. After having enjoyed swimming and sunbathing, we will set sail for Split, our first port of call. Split is Croatia’s second largest city and the capital of Dalmatia. The 1700-year-old city was once the palace of the Roman Emperor Diocletian and is today a UNESCO-protected site. After a guided city tour, you will have the rest of the evening at your disposal to discover the old town on your own and to enjoy the bustling Mediterranean atmosphere on the famous promenade of Split.

*In exceptional circumstances, it may not be possible to call at Split due to reconstruction work in the port of Split, so that guided tour of Split will not be organized.

Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: SPLIT – ISLAND HVAR
itinerary.description:
Today we will leave Split, heading to the island of Hvar known for its mild climate and fragrant lavender fields. On our way to Hvar, we will stop in a secluded bay for a swim. After having reached Hvar, we will anchor in the port of Hvar, the homonymous capital of the island. The port lies at the foot of an impressive fortress, which offers spectacular views of the offshore islands “Pakleni otoci”. Provided that the number of boats anchoring in the small port of Hvar allows us to do so, we will stay here overnight. Otherwise, we will approach Hvar already in the afternoon and you will have enough time to explore the islan’s capital before we head for a nearby bay to spend the night there.

Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: ISLAND HVAR - ISLAND MLJET
itinerary.description:
Sailing along the south coast of the island of Korčula, we will stop at one of the numerous bays for a swim, before heading to our next port of call – Pomena or Polače, on the island of Mljet. Part of the island was declared a National Park – two saltwater lakes (in the larger of the two lakes you will find a small island with a former monastery) are connected to the sea by a narrow channel. Do not miss the opportunity to visit the National Park (entrance not included). We recommend a swim in the saltwater lakes, where the temperature is always 2°C above the temperature of the sea.

Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: ISLAND MLJET - DUBROVNIK
itinerary.description:
We leave the island of Mljet and continue our journey. After a swimming break at the Elafiti Islands, we will enter the port of Dubrovnik around 4:00 pm. Dubrovnik is also called the “Pearl of the Adriatic”, since in the Middle Ages the city counted among the most important economic and cultural centres of the Mediterranean area. Today, the Old City unfolds a unique open air museum with countless attractions. After arriving in Dubrovnik, we are invited to enjoy a guided tour through the historic town with its impressive walls. It takes only a few minutes by bus to get to the old town. The bus stop is located right next to the port, the bus leaves every 10 minutes (tickets are available from the kiosk or on the bus). After the guided city tour, you will have plenty of time to discover the gems of Dubrovnik on your own. Stroll through the famous “Stradun”, take a walk along the massive city walls and visit the numerous unique sights or take the cable car to the 415 m high mountain Srđ, from which you can enjoy a unique view of the old town and the sea.

Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: DUBROVNIK – ISLAND KORČULA
itinerary.description:
Continuing our cruise in a northwestward direction, we will first stop in a bay of the Elafiti Islands for swimming and sunbathing, before heading to the island of Korčula – our today’s port of call. Korčula boasts one of the most beautiful old towns in Dalmatia and because of its fortress-like appearance it is often called “Little Dubrovnik”. Overnight stay in the birthplace of the famous sailor and explorer Marco Polo.

Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: ISLAND KORČULA – ISLAND BRAČ
itinerary.description:
Passing the mountainous Pelješac Peninsula, we head towards the island of Brač. On our way to Brač, we will stop in one of the beautiful secluded bays of this area for swimming and sunbathing. The island of Brač is not only well-known for its white limestone. Even world-famous buildings like the White House in Washington and the Reichstag building in Berlin are built with stone, which still today is exported to countries all over the world. Brač is also known for being one of the largest islands in the entire Adriatic Sea. Overnight stay in one of the lovely places in the northern part of the island – the perfect setting for tonight’s Captain’s Dinner.

Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: ISLAND BRAČ - TROGIR
itinerary.description:
We leave the island of Brač and after a swimming break in a bay on the island of Čiovo, we will bid farewell to the Dalmatian islands and return to the starting point of our journey, Trogir, with its beautiful old town, protected by the UNESCO and also called “the Museum City”. Enjoy the experience of a guided walking tour through the winding streets and discover impressive walls, towers, churches, frescoes and vaults. Do not miss out on taking a look into the unique old yards. Enjoy the last evening of your cruise with a romantic dinner at one of Trogir’s numerous restaurants (own expense).

Overnight on board.

title: Danube Delta From Vienna
description:
Experience the fascinating adventure of a journey on the Danube, which takes you from Vienna through the untouched beauty of the Danube Delta. Your journey begins in the imperial city of Vienna, whose majestic architecture, magnificent palaces and diverse museums will transport you back to centuries past. After an enjoyable start, your ship glides on to Belgrade, the pulsating capital of Serbia, which delights with a fascinating mix of Ottoman heritage, communist past and modern city life.

In the small, charming towns of Harsova, Golubac and Vukovar, you can experience the Danube at its most authentic. Green hills, fortified castles and wide floodplain landscapes characterize the picture here. The tranquil atmosphere of these places conveys a feeling of peace, freedom and space.

Another highlight of your journey are the stops in Solt and Bratislava. While Solt scores with Hungarian country life, wine tradition and hospitality, Bratislava surprises with a successful symbiosis of baroque old town, creative art scene and modern architecture.

As a highlight, the route takes you deep into the green heart of the Danube Delta. This unique biosphere reserve, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, impresses with its breathtaking biodiversity, windingwatercourses, dense reed beds and rare birdlife. Here you can experience nature in its purest form - far away from everyday life.

This river cruise is more than just a journey: It is a homage to the Danube and an invitation to discover culture, nature and history along one of Europe's most important rivers in all its facets.

title: Rhine Main and Danube (Viva - Summer Magic from Basel to Vienna)
description:
Experience summer along the majestic waterways of Europe - the Rhine, Main and Danube - in a very special way. Your journey begins in Basel, where the Rhine flows gently out of the Alps. Surrounded by snow-capped peaks, blooming meadows and green valleys, a city rich in culinary and cultural delights awaits you, making it the perfect place to start.

In Strasbourg, the heart of Alsace, marvel at the impressive Gothic cathedral and enjoy a stroll through the picturesque tanners' quarter as the city glows in warm sunlight. Continue on to Frankfurt, where glass skyscrapers coexist harmoniously with old half-timbered houses - an exciting contrast between tradition and modernity.

Würzburg impresses with its baroque residence, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and a magnificent view of the vineyards. In Nuremberg, medieval city walls, romantic squares and lively summer festivals bring history to life.

Your journey continues to Linz, where modern art and traditional culture come together. In Melk, the magnificent Melk Abbey, situated high above the Danube, impresses with a fantastic view of the summery river landscape.

The crowning glory of your trip is Vienna - the city of music and Empress Sisi. Stroll through the magnificent palace gardens, be enchanted by a concert or enjoy a glass of wine in a cozy pub garden. This trip is a true summer dream along the Alps and the great rivers of Europe - full of beauty, history and unforgettable moments.

title: Royal Waterways
description:
Rhine, Main & Danube — A Grand European Journey

Few river journeys can rival this — a sweeping voyage along three of Europe's greatest waterways, the Rhine, Main and Danube, connecting iconic cities, timeless landscapes and centuries of history in one remarkable itinerary.
Your adventure begins in Amsterdam, a city of golden-age elegance where canal reflections, world-class museums and an irresistibly vibrant street life set the tone for the journey ahead.

Heading south, Koblenz marks one of the Rhine's most dramatic moments — the Deutsches Eck, where the Rhine meets the Moselle, overlooked by the formidable Ehrenbreitstein Fortress and a beautifully preserved medieval old town. In Mainz, half-timbered facades, a towering Romanesque cathedral and the celebrated Gutenberg Museum tell the story of a city that helped shape the modern world.

Würzburg captivates with its exuberant baroque character — none more so than the Prince-Bishop's Residenz, a UNESCO World Heritage Site of breathtaking scale and grandeur. Nuremberg follows, its imperial castle and centuries-old craft traditions conjuring a vivid sense of medieval Germany, while Regensburg — another UNESCO treasure — charms with its ancient Stone Bridge and one of Central Europe's most intact historic centres.

At the confluence of three rivers, Passau surprises with its unexpected Italian character: sun-warmed piazzas, soaring churches and a geography unlike anywhere else on the route.

The Danube then carries you to Vienna, Europe's imperial showpiece. Schönbrunn Palace, St. Stephen's Cathedral, legendary coffee houses and an unrivalled musical heritage make this one of the continent's truly unmissable cities. Across the border, Bratislava offers a compelling contrast — baroque streetscapes giving way to a confident, contemporary energy.
The journey reaches its magnificent conclusion in Budapest, where the grand sweep of Parliament, the elegant Chain Bridge and a spa culture rooted deep in history make for a finale that genuinely lives up to the build-up.

This is river cruising at its most ambitious — culture, history and natural beauty woven together across three countries and two thousand years of European civilisation.
excerpt: Experience an extraordinary river cruise along the three most important waterways in Europe - the Rhine, Main and the Danube. Your journey begins in picturesque Amsterdam, famous for its canals, art museums and lively atmosphere. From there, your route takes you through fascinating landscapes and along important cultural centers.

title: Europas River Passage
description:
Experience an unforgettable journey along the great rivers of Europe - the Rhine, Main and the Danube. Your journey begins in Budapest, where the Danube flows majestically through the Hungarian capital and paves the way to historic cities such as Bratislava and Vienna. These metropolises enchant with their rich culture, magnificent palaces, classical music tradition and impressive architecture.

Your journey then continues to Passau and Regensburg, where medieval old towns, Gothic cathedrals and winding alleyways offer a real journey through European history. Be impressed by the Marienberg Fortress in Würzburg and the imposing Imperial Castle in Nuremberg - two places where history comes alive.

Further downstream, you will experience a city full of Roman traces in Mainz and discover a city full of history in Strasbourg and discover the combination of German and French culture with highlights such as the Gothic cathedral and the picturesque La Petite France district.

The crowning glory is Basel. The modern architecture, the renowned art museum and the historic center make Basel a final highlight of this trip.

This cruise is more than just a journey - it is a homage to Europe's cultural heritage, a feast for the senses and a unique experience, that harmoniously combines nature, culture and history.

accommodations.name: VIVA ENJOY
accommodations.description: Düsseldorf-based river tour operator VIVA Cruises is continuing to grow: after the VIVA ONE (2022) and the VIVA TWO (2023), the third newbuild VIVA ENJOY will join the fleet next year. The ship was previously announced with the working title VIVA THREE, but in keeping with the company motto "Enjoy the Moment", the final name has now been decided. The maiden voyage of the VIVA ENJOY will start on September 22, 2024 from Frankfurt in the direction of Vienna. The tour operator is responding to the increasing demand for river cruises by expanding its fleet. "We have grown strongly over the last five years, as has our customer base and the demand from international guests, especially on the Danube. The third new building in combination with our remaining fleet gives us new scope again, not only with regard to our routings, but also with regard to our international partners and guests," explains Andrea Kruse, Managing Director of VIVA Cruises. The VIVA ENJOY will be the sister ship of the VIVA TWO and therefore identical in design. The ship has a total of 95 outside cabins with space for a maximum of 190 passengers. With a total of three restaurants, an open-plan lounge, a spacious sun deck and a fitness and wellness area, the ship is a floating premium hotel with a new, modern look and a pure feel-good ambience.

title: Rome to Sicily – A Mediterranean Journey
description:
Begin your Italian escape in Rome, a city where ancient history and vibrant modern life exist side by side. Spend two unforgettable nights exploring iconic landmarks such as the Colosseum, wandering through charming piazzas and tossing a coin into the Trevi Fountain to ensure your return.

Enjoy Big Bus Rome Hop-On Hop-Off Tour in Rome, Discover the secrets of Ancient Rome as you explore the Eternal City on a hop-on hop-off sightseeing tour that endeavours to show you the most famous landmarks in the city.

Discover the treasures of Vatican City, home to St Peter’s Basilica and the world-famous Vatican Museums. Evenings are best spent enjoying authentic Italian cuisine in a traditional trattoria, soaking up Rome’s romantic atmosphere.

Travel south in classic European style aboard an overnight train to Sicily. Relax in your comfortable sleeper compartment as you journey through the Italian countryside. It’s a unique and memorable way to travel, maximising your holiday time while adding a touch of adventure.

Wake up in beautiful Sicily, where Mediterranean sunshine, dramatic landscapes and rich history await. Over four nights, experience the island’s unique blend of Greek, Roman and Norman influences.

Marvel at the mighty Mount Etna, Europe’s highest active volcano, or relax along stunning coastal shores with crystal-clear waters. Explore the vibrant markets and historic architecture of Palermo, or visit elegant Taormina, famous for its ancient theatre and breathtaking sea views.
excerpt: This perfectly balanced 7-night Italian getaway combines the timeless grandeur of Rome with the laid-back charm of Sicily. Ideal for British travellers seeking culture, history, sunshine and superb food, this itinerary blends iconic sightseeing with authentic local experiences — all wrapped up with the comfort of seamless rail travel.

title: Sardinian Seaside Escape in San Teodoro
description:
Discover the natural beauty of north-east Sardinia with a relaxing stay at Li Suari Club Village, a charming seaside resort surrounded by Mediterranean greenery and located close to the crystal-clear waters of Cala d’Ambra Bay. Set within the picturesque Punta Isuledda area near the lively town of San Teodoro, this welcoming club village offers the perfect balance of relaxation, beach life and Sardinian culture.

The resort features independent villas nestled within landscaped gardens, creating a peaceful village-style atmosphere just a short stroll from the beach. Guests can unwind by the swimming pools, enjoy delicious Mediterranean cuisine in the restaurant, or explore the spectacular coastline famous for its white-sand beaches and turquoise waters.

With entertainment activities, sports facilities and easy access to the vibrant town centre of San Teodoro, this Sardinian escape is ideal for couples, families and travellers seeking a relaxing Mediterranean holiday.

accommodations.name: Li Suari Club Village
accommodations.description:
Li Suari Club Village is a welcoming resort located in the scenic Punta Isuledda area of Sardinia’s north-east coast, around 30 km from Olbia. The property is surrounded by lush Mediterranean vegetation and arranged like a traditional Sardinian village, with independent ground-floor villas connected by charming illuminated pathways.

Accommodation is set within spacious gardens, offering comfortable rooms equipped with air conditioning, private bathrooms, TV, safe, minibar and a patio or veranda with seating areas – ideal for enjoying warm Sardinian evenings.

Guests can relax by the resort’s two outdoor swimming pools or enjoy the nearby beach, accessible via a short pedestrian path. The hotel also offers an air-conditioned restaurant serving buffet meals, a pool bar with refreshments, and a variety of leisure facilities including sports courts, children’s play areas and evening entertainment.

Thanks to its tranquil setting close to the sea yet within easy reach of San Teodoro’s restaurants, markets and nightlife, Li Suari Club Village provides the perfect base for discovering the beauty and culture of Sardinia.

title: Wonders of South America Peru, Argentina & Brazil Explorer
description:
Experience the vibrant culture, ancient history, and breathtaking natural wonders of South America on this unforgettable 13-day journey through Peru, Argentina, and Brazil. Your adventure begins in the coastal capital of Lima, where colonial architecture, fascinating museums, and centuries of history introduce you to the cultural richness of Peru. From there, fly to Cusco, once the capital of the Inca Empire and a gateway to the legendary Andean landscapes.
While in Cusco, explore impressive archaeological sites and colonial landmarks before heading into the scenic Sacred Valley, a region known for its traditional villages, colorful markets, and ancient Inca ruins. The highlight of your journey awaits with a spectacular train ride through the Andes to the iconic Machu Picchu, the legendary “Lost City of the Incas” and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World. Here you will explore the magnificent citadel and learn about its fascinating history and mysterious past.
The journey continues in the elegant city of Buenos Aires, famous for its European-style architecture, lively culture, and world-renowned tango. Enjoy a spectacular evening at Madero Tango, where music, dance, and live orchestra bring Argentina’s most iconic cultural tradition to life.
Next, travel to the awe-inspiring Iguazu Falls, one of the largest and most powerful waterfall systems in the world. Explore the Argentine side of the falls through scenic trails and boardwalks that bring you close to the thundering cascades and the dramatic Devil’s Throat viewpoint.
Your adventure concludes in the vibrant city of Rio de Janeiro, known for its stunning beaches, lively culture, and spectacular landscapes. Discover iconic landmarks including Sugarloaf Mountain, the colorful Selarón Steps, and the world-famous Christ the Redeemer statue overlooking the city. This carefully designed itinerary blends ancient civilizations, vibrant cities, and natural wonders to create an extraordinary South American travel experience.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Lima – City Tour
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Lima International Airport, you will be welcomed by a representative and transferred to your hotel for check-in. Later in the afternoon, around 1:45 PM, depart for a guided exploration of Lima’s historic center, a UNESCO World Heritage Site filled with remarkable colonial architecture. The tour begins in the traditional Pueblo Libre district with a visit to the renowned Larco Museum, housed in a beautifully restored colonial mansion built on a pre-Columbian pyramid. The museum showcases an impressive collection of pre-Hispanic gold, silver, and fascinating artifacts. Continue to Casa Aliaga, a historic colonial mansion granted by conquistador Francisco Pizarro to Captain Jerónimo de Aliaga, which has remained in the same family for centuries. The tour then proceeds through Lima’s colonial downtown, including the Main Square and the magnificent Lima Cathedral built in the 16th century. After the 4-hour tour, return to your hotel around 6:30 PM.

itinerary.title: Lima – Cusco Flight – City Tour & Archaeological Sites
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Lima Airport for your flight to Cusco. Your arrival should be scheduled before 10:30 AM to allow time for the afternoon tour. Upon arrival in Cusco, you will be transferred to your hotel for check-in and acclimatization. At around 1:00 PM, begin a guided city tour of Cusco, the former capital of the Inca Empire. Visit the Santo Domingo Convent, built over the foundations of the ancient Coricancha Temple, once one of the most important temples dedicated to the Sun God. Continue to Cusco Cathedral in the Main Square, an impressive colonial landmark. The tour then takes you to the hills above the city to explore the archaeological remains of Sacsayhuamán, known for its massive stone walls and panoramic views of Cusco. Continue to the sacred sites of Qenqo, where the Incas performed agricultural rituals, and Puka Pukara, an ancient military complex with terraces, walls, and towers. Return to your hotel around 5:30 PM.

itinerary.title: Cusco – Sacred Valley – Chinchero & Ollantaytambo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart at around 8:00 AM for the Sacred Valley. Your first stop is Chinchero, a traditional Andean town offering breathtaking views of the valley. The local community proudly preserves ancient Inca traditions, visible in their vibrant textiles and cultural practices. Explore the archaeological remains and visit the beautiful 17th-century church built during the colonial period. Continue to the Living Museum of Yucay, where local artisans demonstrate traditional Andean crafts such as textile weaving, pottery, adobe construction, and silverwork. The museum is also home to llamas, alpacas, and sheep, offering a unique cultural experience. Arrive in Ollantaytambo around 1:00 PM and enjoy a delightful Andean lunch at a local restaurant. Later, visit the iconic Ollantaytambo Fortress, an impressive Inca archaeological site built into the mountainside. After the visit, return to your hotel in the Sacred Valley.

itinerary.title: Sacred Valley – Machu Picchu – Cusco
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to the train station to begin your journey to Machu Picchu. Enjoy a scenic train ride to Aguas Calientes, also known as Machu Picchu Pueblo, the gateway to the ancient citadel. Upon arrival, take a short bus ride up the mountain to the legendary Machu Picchu, the “Lost City of the Incas.” Built in the 15th century by Inca Emperor Pachacútec, this remarkable site remained hidden in the jungle until it was rediscovered in 1911. Enjoy a guided 2.5-hour tour of the archaeological complex, exploring its temples, terraces, and iconic viewpoints while learning about its fascinating history. After the tour, return to Aguas Calientes for lunch before taking the train back to Ollantaytambo and continuing by road to your hotel in Cusco.

itinerary.title: Cusco – Buenos Aires
itinerary.description: After breakfast at the hotel, transfer to Alejandro Velasco Astete Airport in Cusco to board your flight to Buenos Aires. Upon arrival in Argentina’s vibrant capital, you will be greeted and transferred to your hotel for check-in.

itinerary.title: Madero Tango Show
itinerary.description: In the evening, enjoy one of Buenos Aires’ most spectacular tango performances at Madero Tango. Located in the modern Puerto Madero district, the show combines the passion of traditional tango with modern production elements. Featuring over 20 talented performers and accompanied by a live six-piece orchestra led by maestro Humberto Ridolfi, the show takes you on an emotional journey through the history of tango. Your ticket includes the show along with beverages for a memorable cultural evening.

itinerary.title: Explore Buenos Aires - Full-Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy a full-day guided tour of Buenos Aires, exploring its most famous landmarks and vibrant neighborhoods. Visit iconic sites such as Floralis Genérica, the elegant Recoleta district, and the historic Plaza de Mayo with views of the Casa Rosada. Continue to the charming San Telmo for a brief wine tasting, then visit the colorful La Boca area including the famous Caminito and a photo stop at La Bombonera. The tour concludes in the modern waterfront district of Puerto Madero before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Buenos Aires – Iguazú
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Iguazú. Upon arrival, you will be transferred to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure preparing to explore the magnificent waterfalls the following day.

itinerary.title: Iguazú Falls – Argentine Side
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for a full-day guided tour of Iguazú National Park on the Argentine side. Accompanied by a bilingual specialist guide, explore the park’s three main circuits. The Lower Trail offers dramatic close-up views of several waterfalls, including the impressive Bossetti Falls, where you may feel the refreshing mist. The Upper Trail provides panoramic views from above the cascades along a flat elevated walkway. Finally, take the Ecological Jungle Train to Devil’s Throat Station and walk along the boardwalk through the rainforest to reach the spectacular Devil’s Throat viewpoint, where the immense power of the waterfalls can be truly appreciated.

itinerary.title: Iguazú – Rio de Janeiro
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Rio de Janeiro. Upon arrival in Brazil’s most iconic city, you will be transferred to your hotel for check-in and relaxation.

itinerary.title: Rio City Tour – Sugarloaf Mountain & Christ the Redeemer
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a comprehensive tour of Rio de Janeiro. Travel along the famous beaches of Leblon, Ipanema, and Copacabana while learning about the city’s history. Continue through the Botafogo district and downtown Rio, passing landmarks such as Guanabara Palace, the Sambodrome, and the Metropolitan Cathedral. Next, visit Sugarloaf Mountain and ascend by cable car, stopping first at Urca Hill before reaching the summit for breathtaking 360-degree views of Guanabara Bay and the city skyline. After lunch at a local restaurant, visit the colorful Selarón Steps in the artistic Santa Teresa neighborhood. The tour concludes with a visit to the iconic Christ the Redeemer statue in Tijuca National Park, one of the world’s most famous landmarks.

itinerary.title: Rio de Janeiro – Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Enjoy a full day at leisure to explore Rio at your own pace. Relax on the famous beaches, visit local attractions, shop for souvenirs, or simply soak in the vibrant Brazilian culture.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Rio de Janeiro International Airport for your departure flight home, carrying unforgettable memories of Peru, Argentina, and Brazil.

title: Discover Sri Lanka Culture, Wildlife & Beaches
description:
Discover the best of Sri Lanka on this 11-day journey combining culture, nature, wildlife, and relaxation. Begin in Sigiriya with a visit to the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress and experience authentic village life. Explore ancient heritage at Dambulla Cave Temple and Polonnaruwa Ancient City.
Continue to Kandy, home to the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic, before heading into the scenic hill country of Nuwara Eliya with its lush tea plantations and cool climate.
Enjoy an exciting wildlife safari at Yala National Park, known for leopards and elephants, and end your journey with a relaxing beach stay in Mirissa. A perfect blend of exploration and relaxation, this tour showcases the very best of Sri Lanka.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Sri Lanka | Transfer to Sigiriya
itinerary.description:
Upon arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by our representative and transferred to Sigiriya. Check in at your hotel and relax after your journey. Spend the rest of the day at leisure enjoying the peaceful surroundings.
Dinner & Overnight stay in Sigiriya

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Rock Fortress & Village Experience
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, visit the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site built by King Kashyapa. Climb the 200-meter-high rock and explore the ancient ruins, landscaped gardens, and famous frescoes of the “Heavenly Maidens.”
In the afternoon, enjoy a unique village experience including a tractor ride through rural landscapes, a canoe ride across a serene lake, and a traditional Sri Lankan cooking demonstration followed by a homemade meal.
Dinner & Overnight stay in Sigiriya

itinerary.title: Dambulla Cave Temple & Polonnaruwa Excursion
itinerary.description:
Post breakfast, visit the Dambulla Cave Temple, a spectacular complex of five caves filled with ancient Buddhist murals and over 150 Buddha statues.
Later, proceed to Polonnaruwa, the ancient capital of Sri Lanka. Explore the well-preserved ruins including the Royal Palace, Gal Vihara rock statues, Audience Hall, Lotus Bath, and Parakrama Samudraya.
Return to Sigiriya in the evening.
Dinner & Overnight stay in Sigiriya

itinerary.title: Sigiriya to Kandy via Matale
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, depart for Kandy. En route, visit a Spice Garden in Matale where you will learn about Sri Lanka’s famous spices and enjoy a cooking demonstration along with lunch.
Continue to Kandy and check in at your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure. Enjoy a complimentary glass of wine or beer with dinner.
Dinner & Overnight stay in Kandy

itinerary.title: Kandy Sightseeing & Cultural Show
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, explore Kandy, the last royal capital of Sri Lanka. Visit Kandy Lake, local markets, arts & crafts center, and a gem museum.
In the evening, visit the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic, one of the most important Buddhist sites. Later, enjoy a vibrant cultural dance performance showcasing traditional Sri Lankan music and dance.
Dinner & Overnight stay in Kandy (with complimentary drink)

itinerary.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, proceed to Nuwara Eliya, known as “Little England.” En route, visit a tea plantation and factory to learn about the tea-making process and enjoy a fresh cup of Ceylon tea.
On arrival, check in at your hotel and later explore the charming town with its colonial architecture and cool climate.
Dinner & Overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya to Yala (Wildlife Safari)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, travel to Tissamaharama near Yala National Park. Check in at your hotel.
In the afternoon, embark on an exciting jeep safari in Yala National Park, home to elephants, leopards, bears, crocodiles, and a wide variety of birdlife.
Return to the hotel after the safari.
Dinner & Overnight stay in Tissamaharama

itinerary.title: Yala to Mirissa (Beach Escape)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive to Mirissa, a beautiful coastal town known for its golden beaches and relaxed vibe. Check in at your beach resort and spend the rest of the day at leisure enjoying the ocean views.
Dinner & Overnight stay in Mirissa

itinerary.title: Mirissa Leisure Day
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, enjoy a full day at leisure. Relax on the beach, swim in the ocean, or opt for optional activities such as whale watching (seasonal) or water sports.
Dinner & Overnight stay in Mirissa

itinerary.title: Mirissa Leisure Day
itinerary.description:
Another day to unwind and soak in the tropical paradise. Enjoy the sun, sand, and sea or explore nearby coastal attractions at your own pace.
Dinner & Overnight stay in Mirissa

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to the airport for your onward journey with beautiful memories of Sri Lanka.

accommodations.name: Kassapa Lions Rock
accommodations.description: An ideally located hotel situated facing the magnificent Sigiriya rock in the midst of a small village named Digampathaha. It is located just 20 minutes from the beautiful and ever famous town of Dambulla. A short 15 kilometer drive towards Habarana and you will be in Digampathaha. A turn to your right and in 5 minutes you'll be in the most scenic location in the area. Kassapa Lions Rock is an ideal base from which you can explore all the historical sites such as Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, Sigiriya, and Dambulla . Only hotel in the area with two swimming pools. Wi -Fi Facility is available

accommodations.name: Hotel Topaz Kandy
accommodations.description: Hotel Topaz was built in 1976 and fashioned after a much loved gem stone found in Sri Lanka. Considering its situation in the hill capital of Kandy, the last royal stronghold in the country, Hotel Topaz is considered the jewel in the crown of Kandy.Nestled amidst lush tropical greenery, surrounded by the distinctive Knuckles Mountain range and Bible Rock, enveloped in the cool winds blowing through the mountains, Hotel Topaz offers something for everyone.The short distance away from the city centre itself, lends the hotel and its guests maximum accessibility no matter what the choice of activity is. However Hotel Topaz offers guests a tranquil setting and the option of exploring the city’s rich heritage in style and comfort.The warm and personal service serves to truly bring out the widely famed Sri Lankan hospitality. Guests at Hotel Topaz are made to feel at home, and explore the surrounding gardens or have a cocktail or high-tea on our famous rooftop terrace with its 360 degree view of the city and its hills.

accommodations.name: Araliya Red Hotel, Nuwara Eliya
accommodations.description: Feast your eyes upon magnificent vistas of misty mountains, cleanse your lungs with clean and refreshing air from salubrious regions and relish a relaxing stay here at the heart of the Sri Lankan Tea country. Settle in and unwind at Araliya Red – a premier amongst Nuwara Eliya hotels and craft lifetime memories at an enchanting destination that is embellished in colonial charms!

accommodations.name: Oak Ray Wild Yala, Tissamaharama
accommodations.description:
Oak Ray Wild Yala, Tissamaharama

 “Oak Ray Wild Yala” is situated at Tissamaharama in close proximity to the Yala wild life sanctuary. The hotel consists of 44 Superior Deluxe room with all modern amenities. The facilities include an elegant restaurant and Bar located near to the pool area with breath taking view of surrounding landscape garden. The Large pool located amongst the landscape garden is vantage point to have a spectacular view of the sunset.

accommodations.name: Mandara Resort Mirissa
accommodations.description: Mandara Resort at Mirissa Weligama, Overlooking famous Read Cliff Mountains and Mirissa Bay with a breathtaking view of the Indian Ocean, Mandara Resort lets you leave all worldly cares behind. The rooms are fully equipped with satellite TV, DVD player and home theater systems, safety lockers, AC, rooms with jacuzzi, rooms with private plunge pools. Swimming pool with fiber optic lighting, restaurant, bar and gymnasium with state of the art equipment to keep you fit, Wi-Fi facility. With its en-suite concept of accommodation, Mandara Resort offers you luxury of delectable food prepared by our chefs to suit your biological cycle with the choice of both international and local cuisine and wines to complement your palate. Our staff would serve your food in the place of your choice (garden, in room, under the shade of Panda muss).

Early Check in / Late Check out.

Get a closer insight into Sri Lanka with our below optional tours!

Discover the Jewels of Polonnaruwa

Roam the grand temples built by the kings of the 11th to 13th centuries. Savour the beauty of the Royal Palace and at Gal Vihare and the Temples of Shiva gaze at the exquisite paintings and superb statues.

Mountains & Lakes of Horton Plains

Lying in the lap of the central highlands, the beauty of the Horton Plains is unsurpassable – dotted with lakes of ice-cold waters, montane forests, rocky outcrops and tumbling waterfalls. The experience is enhanced with a visit to “World’s End” for mind-blowing views.

Cruise the Beautiful Madhu River

Immensely beautiful and deeply vital to those who call its banks home, the Madhu River is a must-see destination. Take this rare opportunity to sail pass dozens of islets and get a closer insight into local life.

title: Dalmatian Highlights Split and Dubrovnik Region Cruise
description:
Unique cruise among a thousand islands, with extremely indented coastline adorned with numerous magical islands, Croatia is a place made for cruise trips. Join us on an unforgettable island-hopping journey while we explore natural wonders scattered around the Adriatic Sea.

Trogir: Small-sized but famous for its rich history and unparalleled beauty, this Croatian treasure is waiting for you with standout landmarks such as palaces, churches, ancient walls, and a superb castle.

Split: Surrounded by imposing mountains and crystal-clear waters, the paradisiacal city of Split is famous for its picturesque views, as well as for hosting some of the best Roman ruins in the world.

Island Brac: Steep cliffs, pine forests and crystalline water gathered to create a dramatic landscape on one of the largest Croatian islands, Brač. This magnificent island is wildly famous for radiant white stone used to build some of the most famous historical monuments and Zlatni rat, golden pebble beach.

Island Korcula: Korčula offers up Croatia at its most authentic, with tiny communities and ancient fishing villages dotted amongst pine forests and vineyards.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL TROGIR PORT – SPLIT PORT
itinerary.description:
Our journey starts in Trogir for those who will board between 12:00 to 2pm (passengers that arrive later can embark on the boat in the port of Split). The captain and the crew will give you a warm welcome and during lunch snack we will take off to one of the bays on the island of Čiovo. After having enjoyed swimming and sunbathing, we will set sail for Split, our first port of call. Split is Croatia’s second largest city and the capital of Dalmatia. The 1700-year-old city was once the palace of the Roman Emperor Diocletian and is today a UNESCO-protected site. After a guided city tour, you will have the rest of the evening at your disposal to discover the old town on your own and to enjoy the bustling Mediterranean atmosphere on the famous promenade of Split.

*In exceptional circumstances, it may not be possible to call at Split due to reconstruction work in the port of Split, so that guided tour of Split will not be organized.

Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: SPLIT – ISLAND HVAR
itinerary.description:
Today we will leave Split, heading to the island of Hvar known for its mild climate and fragrant lavender fields. On our way to Hvar, we will stop in a secluded bay for a swim. After having reached Hvar, we will anchor in the port of Hvar, the homonymous capital of the island. The port lies at the foot of an impressive fortress, which offers spectacular views of the offshore islands “Pakleni otoci”. Provided that the number of boats anchoring in the small port of Hvar allows us to do so, we will stay here overnight. Otherwise, we will approach Hvar already in the afternoon and you will have enough time to explore the islan’s capital before we head for a nearby bay to spend the night there.

Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: ISLAND HVAR - ISLAND MLJET
itinerary.description:
Sailing along the south coast of the island of Korčula, we will stop at one of the numerous bays for a swim, before heading to our next port of call – Pomena or Polače, on the island of Mljet. Part of the island was declared a National Park – two saltwater lakes (in the larger of the two lakes you will find a small island with a former monastery) are connected to the sea by a narrow channel. Do not miss the opportunity to visit the National Park (entrance not included). We recommend a swim in the saltwater lakes, where the temperature is always 2°C above the temperature of the sea.

Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: ISLAND MLJET - DUBROVNIK
itinerary.description:
We leave the island of Mljet and continue our journey. After a swimming break at the Elafiti Islands, we will enter the port of Dubrovnik around 4:00 pm. Dubrovnik is also called the “Pearl of the Adriatic”, since in the Middle Ages the city counted among the most important economic and cultural centres of the Mediterranean area. Today, the Old City unfolds a unique open air museum with countless attractions. After arriving in Dubrovnik, we are invited to enjoy a guided tour through the historic town with its impressive walls. It takes only a few minutes by bus to get to the old town. The bus stop is located right next to the port, the bus leaves every 10 minutes (tickets are available from the kiosk or on the bus). After the guided city tour, you will have plenty of time to discover the gems of Dubrovnik on your own. Stroll through the famous “Stradun”, take a walk along the massive city walls and visit the numerous unique sights or take the cable car to the 415 m high mountain Srđ, from which you can enjoy a unique view of the old town and the sea.

Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: DUBROVNIK – ISLAND KORČULA
itinerary.description:
Continuing our cruise in a northwestward direction, we will first stop in a bay of the Elafiti Islands for swimming and sunbathing, before heading to the island of Korčula – our today’s port of call. Korčula boasts one of the most beautiful old towns in Dalmatia and because of its fortress-like appearance it is often called “Little Dubrovnik”. Overnight stay in the birthplace of the famous sailor and explorer Marco Polo.

Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: ISLAND KORČULA – ISLAND BRAČ
itinerary.description:
Passing the mountainous Pelješac Peninsula, we head towards the island of Brač. On our way to Brač, we will stop in one of the beautiful secluded bays of this area for swimming and sunbathing. The island of Brač is not only well-known for its white limestone. Even world-famous buildings like the White House in Washington and the Reichstag building in Berlin are built with stone, which still today is exported to countries all over the world. Brač is also known for being one of the largest islands in the entire Adriatic Sea. Overnight stay in one of the lovely places in the northern part of the island – the perfect setting for tonight’s Captain’s Dinner.

Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: ISLAND BRAČ - TROGIR
itinerary.description:
We leave the island of Brač and after a swimming break in a bay on the island of Čiovo, we will bid farewell to the Dalmatian islands and return to the starting point of our journey, Trogir, with its beautiful old town, protected by the UNESCO and also called “the Museum City”. Enjoy the experience of a guided walking tour through the winding streets and discover impressive walls, towers, churches, frescoes and vaults. Do not miss out on taking a look into the unique old yards. Enjoy the last evening of your cruise with a romantic dinner at one of Trogir’s numerous restaurants (own expense).

Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: DEPARTURE TROGIR
itinerary.description: After breakfast, disembarkation until 9:00 am. Have a pleasant journey!

accommodations.name: MY Vilma
accommodations.description:
MY Vilma is an elegant motor yacht designed for unforgettable cruising experiences, combining comfort, style, and smooth sailing performance. With its sleek exterior and spacious decks, the vessel offers the perfect setting for relaxing under the sun, enjoying panoramic sea views, and creating memorable moments on the water.

Onboard, guests can unwind in well-appointed cabins and comfortable lounge areas, thoughtfully designed to provide a cosy yet refined atmosphere. The open deck spaces allow for alfresco dining, sunset cocktails, and soaking in the refreshing sea breeze while cruising along stunning coastlines.

Whether for private charters, island hopping, or leisurely coastal exploration, MY Vilma delivers a seamless blend of luxury and adventure — making every journey as special as the destination itself.
